 # OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
 
-A Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic optimization and punishment management.
-
-## Description
-
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy implements a contextual multi-armed bandit algorithm for intelligent routing of Large Language Model (LLM) API requests. It dynamically selects the optimal provider and model based on performance feedback, cost considerations, and failure patterns.
+A Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for intelligent LLM traffic routing, load balancing, and model performance optimization.
 
 ## Features
+- **Intelligent Routing**: Uses a Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm to select the best-performing LLM models based on real-time feedback (TTFT, throughput).
+- **Error Handling**: Implements a 5-scope error classification system (ban, cooldown, flag, etc.) and aggressive 3-strike punishment system for critical failures.
+- **Real-time Monitoring**: Integrated WebSocket-based dashboard for tracking model performance, punishment events, and training status.
+- **Resilience**: Features automatic fallback routing and in-memory/SQLite-backed state management.
+- **PWA Ready**: Optimized for progressive web application usage.
 
-- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Uses Discounted Upper Confidence Bound (UCB1) algorithm with 0.99 discount factor for adaptive model selection
-- **Real-time Metrics**: WebSocket-based live updates for dashboard monitoring
-- **Punishment System**: Automatic handling of critical failures with 3-strike aggressive punishment
-- **Training Feedback**: Operational metrics tracking without UCB1 score pollution
-- **Provider Quotas**: Atomic minute and day window quota checking
-- **Emergency Relaxation**: Tiered fallback system for handling model unavailability
-

 ## Architecture
+OmniRoute uses an isolated training feedback loop (`models_train` table) and combines it with production metrics (`models`) for dynamic model selection, applying a `profileMultiplier` for soft biasing of model selection.
 
-### Core Components
-
-| Component | File | Description |
-|-----------|------|-------------|
-| Bandit Router | `src/bandit.mjs` | Main UCB1 bandit implementation |
-| Event System | `src/events.mjs` | WebSocket events and punishment logging |
-| Provider Quota | `src/provider-quota.mjs` | RPM/RPD quota management |
-| Request Tracker | `src/request-tracker.mjs` | Request lifecycle tracking |
-| Health Check | `src/health-check.mjs` | Provider health monitoring |
-
-### Database Schema
-
-The system uses SQLite with additive-only migrations (`ADD COLUMN`):
-
-| Table | Purpose |
-|-------|---------|
-| `models` | Model configurations and UCB1 scores |
-| `models_train` | Training feedback (isolated from production) |
-| `punishment_events` | Audit trail of all punishment events |
-| `provider_history` | Daily/hourly request counts and quota state |
-| `request_logs` | Historical request records |
-
-### Punishment System
-
-The 3-strike system tracks consecutive critical failures:
-
-| Failure Type | Classification | Action |
-|--------------|---------------|--------|
-| 403 Forbidden | `ban-model` | Permanent model ban after 3 strikes |
-| 429 Rate Limit | `flag-provider` | Triggers cooldown/punishment |
-| Timeout | `cooldown-provider` | Progressive backoff cooldowns |
-| safeWrite Errors | `ban-model` | Critical failure tracking |
-
-**Cooldown Progression**: 15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → Permanent
-
-**Reset Conditions**: Consecutive failures reset on success. Total failures tracked across all events.
-
-### Error Classification
-
-Error patterns are mapped in `config/bandit.json`:
-
-| Pattern | Resulting Classification |
-|---------|-------------------------|
-| `account disabled|banned|suspended` | `ban-provider` |
-| `429|rate limit` | `flag-provider` |
-| `timeout` | `cooldown-provider` |
-| `consecutive_5xx ≥ 3` | `degraded` mode |
-
-## API Endpoints
-
-### Production Read Query
-- Returns: models with 0.3*models_train blended scores (if N < 1)
-
-### Active Requests
-```
-GET /v1/active
-- Returns: current requests, recent punishments, active sessions
-- Protected: Requires authentication
-```
-
-### Configuration
-```
-GET /v1/config/status
-- Returns: current dashboard flags (excludePaid, onlyFree, etc.)
-
-POST /v1/config/toggle
-- Body: { flag: string, enabled: boolean }
-- Toggles runtime configuration flags
-```
-
-## Dashboard
-
-The web dashboard is available at the root path and provides:
-
-| Tab | Purpose |
-|-----|---------|
-| **Logs** | Request history with filtering |
-| **Models** | Model performance metrics |
-| **Train** | Training daemon status |
-| **Modes** | Current routing modes |
-| **Providers** | Quota usage and status |
-| **Scripts** | Training daemon management |
-| **Consideration** | Unified history of punishments |
-

+                // Sanitize model name by stripping provider prefix (same logic as in fmtRow)
+                function sanitizeModelName(model, provider) {
+                    if (!model || model === '—') return model;
+                    if (provider && provider !== '-' && model.includes(provider)) {
+                        return model.replace(new RegExp('^' + escapeRegex(provider) + '/'), '');
+                    }
+                    // Also handle cases where model contains provider as first part (e.g., "openrouter/anthropic/claude")
+                    if (model.includes('/')) {
+                        const parts = model.split('/');
+                        if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[0] === parts[1]) {
+                            // Handle format like "openrouter/openrouter/anthropic/claude"
+                            return parts.slice(2).join('/');
+                        } else if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] === parts[1]) {
+                            return parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        } else if (parts.length >= 2 && provider && parts[0] === provider) {
+                            return parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        }
+                    }
+                    return model;
+                }

+               ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET

+            ).run(sanitizedModelId, provider, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, newConsecutive, Date.now());

+            const sanitizedModelId = this._sanitizeModelId(model.id);

+            this.db.prepare(

+            ).run(sanitizedModelId, provider);

+            const currentFailRow = this.db.prepare("SELECT fails, total_failures FROM models WHERE id = ?").get(sanitizedModelId);

+            const newFailCount = currentFails + 1;
+            const cooldownMs = this._getModelCooldownMs(newFailCount);
+            if (cooldownMs === null || cooldownMs === 0) {
+              // Permanent ban case (5+ failures) - escalate to permanent ban
+              // Reset consecutive_critical_failures on successful ban escalation

+              logPunishment({ bandit: this, type: EVENT_TYPES.BAN_MODEL, provider: provider, modelId: sanitizedModelId, reason: rejectionReason, cooldownMs: 0, failures: newFailCount });

-## Overview
-
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy is a sophisticated reverse proxy that intelligently routes LLM API requests across multiple providers using a Discounted Upper Confidence Bound (UCB1) multi-armed bandit algorithm. It provides real-time monitoring, automated error handling with 3-strike punishment, and a web-based dashboard for comprehensive observability.
+A Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic optimization and punishment management.
+
+## Description
+
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy implements a contextual multi-armed bandit algorithm for intelligent routing of Large Language Model (LLM) API requests. It dynamically selects the optimal provider and model based on performance feedback, cost considerations, and failure patterns.
 
 ## Features
 
-- **Intelligent Model Selection**: UCB1 algorithm with discount factor (0.99/event) for dynamic model routing
-- **Real-time Dashboard**: Web-based PWA dashboard with live metrics, logs, and controls
-- **3-Strike Punishment System**: Aggressive punishment for critical failures (403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors)
-- **Exponential Backoff Cooldowns**: Progressive cooldown periods (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
-- **Provider Quota Management**: RPM/RPD tracking with atomic minute and day window checks
-- **Session Affinity**: Configurable session persistence with 30-minute TTL
-- **WebSocket Support**: Real-time script output streaming via WebSocket
-- **Training Daemon**: Automated model evaluation with live log streaming
-- **Error Classification**: 5-scope error handling (ban, cooldown, flag, degraded, provider)
-- **Degraded Mode**: Models with consecutive 5xx errors receive 0.3x score multiplier
+- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Uses Discounted Upper Confidence Bound (UCB1) algorithm with 0.99 discount factor for adaptive model selection
+- **Real-time Metrics**: WebSocket-based live updates for dashboard monitoring
+- **Punishment System**: Automatic handling of critical failures with 3-strike aggressive punishment
+- **Training Feedback**: Operational metrics tracking without UCB1 score pollution
+- **Provider Quotas**: Atomic minute and day window quota checking
+- **Emergency Relaxation**: Tiered fallback system for handling model unavailability

 ### Configuration
 
-The `.env` file supports the following variables:
-
-| Variable | Description | Default |
-|----------|-------------|---------|
-| `PORT` | Server port | 8080 |
-| `API_TOKEN` | API authentication token | - |
-| `SESSION_TTL_MS` | Session TTL in milliseconds | 1800000 (30m) |
-| `STREAM_IDLE_MS` | Stream idle timeout | 60000 (60s) |
-| `LOG_LEVEL` | Logging verbosity | info |
-
-Provider configuration is managed in `config/provider-limits.json`:
-
-```json

-  "provider": {
-    "rpm": 100,

-      "rpd": 100
-    }
-  }

-### Bandit Configuration
-

 ## Architecture
 
-```
-┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
-│                    OmniRoute Bandit Proxy                   │
-├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
-│  ┌────────────┐  ┌────────────┐  ┌────────────┐            │
-│  │   Client   │──│   Index    │──│   Bandit   │            │
-│  │   Request  │  │ Middleware │─▶│  Selector  │            │
-│  └────────────┘  └────────────┘  └────────────┘              │
-│                                                  │            │
-│  ┌────────────┐  ┌────────────┐  ┌────────────┐  ┌───────┐  │
-│  │ Dashboard  │  │  Notifier  │  │ Request    │  │ DB    │  │
-│  │    UI      │  │   Service  │  │  Tracker   │─▶│       │  │
-│  └────────────┘  └────────────┘  └────────────┘  └───────┘  │
-│                    │                                         │
-│                    ▼                                         │
-│            ┌──────────────┐                                  │
-│            │   Upstream   │──▶ Provider APIs (OpenAI,       │
-│            │   Proxy      │     Anthropic, Google, etc.)    │
-│            └──────────────┘                                  │
-└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
-```
-
 ### Core Components
 
-1. **DiscountedUCB1Bandit** (`src/bandit.mjs`): Multi-armed bandit algorithm for model selection
-2. **Express Server** (`src/index.mjs`): Main proxy server with middleware pipeline
-3. **Request Tracker**: Tracks request metrics, errors, and feedback
-4. **Punishment System**: Manages model/provider bans and cooldowns
-5. **Quota Manager**: Tracks provider-level RPM/RPD limits
-6. **Training Daemon** (`scripts/train-daemon.mjs`): Automated model evaluation
+| Component | File | Description |
+|-----------|------|-------------|
+| Bandit Router | `src/bandit.mjs` | Main UCB1 bandit implementation |
+| Event System | `src/events.mjs` | WebSocket events and punishment logging |
+| Provider Quota | `src/provider-quota.mjs` | RPM/RPD quota management |
+| Request Tracker | `src/request-tracker.mjs` | Request lifecycle tracking |
+| Health Check | `src/health-check.mjs` | Provider health monitoring |

-## Dashboard
-
-The web-based dashboard provides:
+| Failure Type | Classification | Action |
+|--------------|---------------|--------|
+| 403 Forbidden | `ban-model` | Permanent model ban after 3 strikes |
+| 429 Rate Limit | `flag-provider` | Triggers cooldown/punishment |
+| Timeout | `cooldown-provider` | Progressive backoff cooldowns |
+| safeWrite Errors | `ban-model` | Critical failure tracking |
 
-- **Top Panel**: Current model metrics, session info, and controls
-- **Models Tab**: Available models with UCB1 scores, observation counts, and latency metrics
-- **Providers Tab**: Provider status, quota usage, and cooldown information
-- **Training Tab**: Training daemon controls and live log streaming
-- **Logs Tab**: Real-time request logs with filtering by type
-- **Scripts Tab**: Execution controls for maintenance scripts
+**Cooldown Progression**: 15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → Permanent
 
-### Dashboard Metrics
-
-- **Reward**: Success rate per model
-- **Latency**: Average response time
-- **Score**: UCB1 selection score
-- **N**: Number of observations
-- **Degraded**: Models with 0.3x score penalty
-
-## Error Handling & Punishment System
+**Reset Conditions**: Consecutive failures reset on success. Total failures tracked across all events.
 
 ### Error Classification
 
-Errors are classified into 5 scopes:
-
-1. **ban**: Permanent model/provider ban
-2. **cooldown**: Temporary unavailability
-3. **flag**: Provider attention required
-4. **degraded**: Reduced performance mode
-5. **provider**: Provider-level issues
-
-### 3-Strike System
-
-Critical failures trigger permanent bans after 3 consecutive occurrences:
-- HTTP 403 (Forbidden)
-- HTTP 429 (Rate Limit)
-- Request timeout
-- safeWrite errors
-
-The `consecutive_critical_failures` counter tracks streaks and resets on successful requests.
-
-### Exponential Backoff
-
-Cooldown progression:
-1. 15 seconds
-2. 5 minutes
-3. 30 minutes
-4. 2 hours
-5. Permanent ban
-
-### Error Patterns
-
-Configured in `config/bandit.json`:
-```json
-{
-  "errorPatterns": {
-    "ban-model": [
-      "safeWrite",
-      "cannot access safeWrite",
-      "safeWrite before initialization",
-      "safeWrite is not initialized"
-    ]
-  }
-}
-```
-
-## Provider Quota Management
-
-The proxy enforces per-provider quotas:
+Error patterns are mapped in `config/bandit.json`:
 
-| Metric | Description | Window |
-|--------|-------------|--------|
-| RPM | Requests Per Minute | Rolling 60 seconds |
-| RPD | Requests Per Day | Rolling 24 hours |
+| Pattern | Resulting Classification |
+|---------|-------------------------|
+| `account disabled|banned|suspended` | `ban-provider` |
+| `429|rate limit` | `flag-provider` |
+| `timeout` | `cooldown-provider` |
+| `consecutive_5xx ≥ 3` | `degraded` mode |
 
-Quota checks are atomic and occur before model selection. Exceeded quotas result in provider cooldown.
+## API Endpoints
 
-## Training Daemon
+### Production Read Query
+- Returns: models with 0.3*models_train blended scores (if N < 1)

-GET  /training/status  # Check status
-
-# WebSocket log streaming
-wss://localhost:8080/ws/training-logs
+### Active Requests
 ```
-
-Key features:
-- Round-robin model evaluation
-- Automatic 404 detection with permanent flag
-- Live log streaming via WebSocket
-- Status heartbeat every 30 seconds

 # OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
 
-A multi-armed bandit reverse proxy system for intelligent LLM traffic routing and load balancing.
+[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
+[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.28.17-blue)](https://github.com/CherrugDeveloper/omniroute-bandit-proxy/releases)
+
+A Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic with intelligent routing, real-time monitoring, and automated error handling.

 ## Overview
 
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy implements a Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm for dynamic traffic routing across multiple LLM providers. The system continuously learns from traffic patterns and provider performance to optimize routing decisions, balancing cost, latency, and quality metrics.
-
-### Key Characteristics
-
-- **Adaptive Routing**: Uses DiscountedUCB1 bandit algorithm with 0.99 discount factor for temporal adaptation
-- **Provider Intelligence**: Tracks success/failure patterns with exponential backoff cooldowns (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
-- **Safety Mechanisms**: 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures (403, 429, timeouts, safeWrite errors)
-- **Rate Limiting**: Per-provider quota management with atomic minute/day window checks
-- **Session Persistence**: 30-minute session TTL with 60-second stream idle timeout
-- **Event System**: Real-time punishment event streaming via WebSocket at `/v1/events`
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy is a sophisticated reverse proxy that intelligently routes LLM API requests across multiple providers using a Discounted Upper Confidence Bound (UCB1) multi-armed bandit algorithm. It provides real-time monitoring, automated error handling with 3-strike punishment, and a web-based dashboard for comprehensive observability.
 
 ## Features
 
-### Traffic Management
-
-- Multi-provider load balancing with configurable weight profiles
-- Automatic failover and degraded mode on consecutive 5xx errors
-- Real-time provider health monitoring
-- Session affinity with graceful degradation
-
-### Bandit Algorithm
-
-- DiscountedUCB1 implementation with 0.99 event discount factor
-- 30-second cache TTL for ranking computations (`_rankCache`)
-- Profile multiplier stacking for soft bias optimization
-- Separate training data table (`models_train`) with production read merging (0.3 × training if N < 1)
-
-### Database Layer
-
-- SQLite via better-sqlite3 for embedded storage
-- Schema migrations restricted to ADD COLUMN operations only
-- Isolated `models_train` table for training data
-- Automatic model registration and cleanup
-
-### Error Handling
-
-- Five classification scopes: ban, cooldown, flag, degraded, retry
-- Error pattern mapping for immediate model banning (including `safeWrite` errors)
-- Consecutive failure tracking with automatic reset on success
-- `consecutive_5xx` triggers degraded mode
-
-### Monitoring & Dashboard
-
-- Web-based monitoring dashboard at `/dashboard.html`
-- Real-time statistics and provider status
-- Request history and session tracking
-- Unified Chronology panel with selection history
-- WebSocket-based log streaming
+- **Intelligent Model Selection**: UCB1 algorithm with discount factor (0.99/event) for dynamic model routing
+- **Real-time Dashboard**: Web-based PWA dashboard with live metrics, logs, and controls
+- **3-Strike Punishment System**: Aggressive punishment for critical failures (403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors)
+- **Exponential Backoff Cooldowns**: Progressive cooldown periods (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
+- **Provider Quota Management**: RPM/RPD tracking with atomic minute and day window checks
+- **Session Affinity**: Configurable session persistence with 30-minute TTL
+- **WebSocket Support**: Real-time script output streaming via WebSocket
+- **Training Daemon**: Automated model evaluation with live log streaming
+- **Error Classification**: 5-scope error handling (ban, cooldown, flag, degraded, provider)
+- **Degraded Mode**: Models with consecutive 5xx errors receive 0.3x score multiplier

-### Database Schema
+### Core Components
 
-The system uses two main tables:
+1. **DiscountedUCB1Bandit** (`src/bandit.mjs`): Multi-armed bandit algorithm for model selection
+2. **Express Server** (`src/index.mjs`): Main proxy server with middleware pipeline
+3. **Request Tracker**: Tracks request metrics, errors, and feedback
+4. **Punishment System**: Manages model/provider bans and cooldowns
+5. **Quota Manager**: Tracks provider-level RPM/RPD limits
+6. **Training Daemon** (`scripts/train-daemon.mjs`): Automated model evaluation
 
-1. **`models`** - Production model information (id, provider, N, sum_reward, fails, degraded, cooldown_until, permanent)
-2. **`models_train`** - Isolated training data (merged 0.3× if N < 1)

+### Health Check
 
-### Error Classification System
+```
+GET /health
+```
 
-The system classifies errors into five scopes:
+Returns server health status.
 
-1. **ban** - Immediate model blocking (403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors trigger 3-strike system → permanent ban)
-2. **cooldown** - Temporary suspension with exponential backoff
-3. **flag** - Non-blocking issue marking
-4. **degraded** - Reduced functionality mode (score × 0.3)
-5. **retry** - Automatic retry logic
+### Models Catalog
 
-### Cooldown Algorithm
+```
+GET /v1/models
+```
 
-Exponential backoff progression:
-- First failure: 15 seconds
-- Second consecutive: 5 minutes  
-- Third consecutive: 30 minutes
-- Fourth consecutive: 2 hours
-- Fifth+: Permanent ban (3-strike system for critical failures)
+Returns available models with metadata including:
+- `id`: Model identifier
+- `created`: Creation timestamp
+- `expires`: Expiration timestamp
+- `n`: Observation count
+- `avg`: Average response time
+- `rewards`: Success rate data
 
-### 3-Strike Punishment System
+Query parameters:
+- `source`: `all` | `catalog` | `train` (default: `all`)
 
-Aggressive punishment for critical failures (403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors):
-- Permanent ban after 3 consecutive critical failures
-- `consecutive_critical_failures` counter tracks the streak

+Errors are classified into 5 scopes:
 
-### Reset Endpoints
+1. **ban**: Permanent model/provider ban
+2. **cooldown**: Temporary unavailability
+3. **flag**: Provider attention required

-| `/v1/provider/retry/{p}` | POST | Retry provider |
-| `/v1/provider/ignore/{p}` | POST | Ignore provider |

-#### WebSocket Event Monitoring
+## Provider Quota Management
 
-The proxy provides real-time punishment event streaming via WebSocket. This is useful for monitoring when models or providers are banned due to critical failures (403, 429, timeouts, safeWrite errors) or consecutive 5xx errors.
+The proxy enforces per-provider quotas:
 
-**Endpoint:** `ws://localhost:20128/v1/events/punishment`
+| Metric | Description | Window |
+|--------|-------------|--------|
+| RPM | Requests Per Minute | Rolling 60 seconds |
+| RPD | Requests Per Day | Rolling 24 hours |
 
-**Event Types:**
-- `ban-model` - Model permanently banned (3 consecutive critical failures)
-- `ban-provider` - Provider permanently banned
-- `cooldown` - Model/provider on exponential backoff (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
+Quota checks are atomic and occur before model selection. Exceeded quotas result in provider cooldown.
 
-See `examples/monitor.mjs` for a complete implementation with error handling.
+## Training Daemon
 
-#### Running Example Scripts
-
-Example scripts demonstrating API usage are available in the `examples/` directory:
+The training daemon automatically evaluates models:
 
 ```bash
-# Monitor real-time punishment events (shows all ban/cooldown events)
-node examples/monitor.mjs
+# Manual control
+POST /training/start   # Start daemon
+POST /training/stop    # Stop daemon
+GET  /training/status  # Check status
 
-# Fetch and display current dashboard statistics
-node examples/stats.mjs
+# WebSocket log streaming
+wss://localhost:8080/ws/training-logs
 ```
 
-**Output Example for `monitor.mjs`:**
+Key features:
+- Round-robin model evaluation
+- Automatic 404 detection with permanent flag
+- Live log streaming via WebSocket
+- Status heartbeat every 30 seconds

+                function fmtPunishmentRow(event) {
+                    const dObj = new Date(event.timestamp || Date.now());
+                    const timeStr = dObj.toLocaleTimeString();
+                    
+                    const provider = event.provider || '-';
+                    const model = event.modelId || '-';
+                    
+                    // Determine punishment type and status
+                    const punishmentType = event.subtype || event.type;
+                    const isBan = punishmentType.includes('ban');
+                    const isCritical = event.reason === 'critical_failure';
+                    
+                    let statusLabel = '';
+                    let statusColor = '#c9d1d9';
+                    
+                    if (isBan) {
+                        statusLabel = punishmentType.replace('-', ' ').toUpperCase();
+                        statusColor = '#f85149';
+                    } else if (punishmentType.includes('cooldown')) {
+                        statusLabel = punishmentType.replace('-', ' ').toUpperCase();
+                        statusColor = '#f1c40f';
+                    } else if (punishmentType.includes('flag')) {
+                        statusLabel = punishmentType.replace('-', ' ').toUpperCase();
+                        statusColor = '#e6ac00';
+                    } else if (punishmentType.includes('degraded')) {
+                        statusLabel = 'DEGRADED';
+                        statusColor = '#d29922';
+                    } else if (isCritical) {
+                        statusLabel = 'CRITICAL';
+                        statusColor = '#ff5858';
+                    } else {
+                        statusLabel = punishmentType.replace('-', ' ');
+                        statusColor = '#58a6ff';
+                    }
+                    
+                    // Calculate consequences
+                    const consequences = [];
+                    if (event.subtype === 'permanent') consequences.push('Permanent ban');
+                    if (event.consecutive >= 3) consequences.push('3-strike rule');
+                    if (consequences.length === 0 && punishmentType.includes('ban')) consequences.push('Banned');
+                    
+                    // Format reason for display
+                    let reasonDisplay = event.reason || '-';
+                    if (reasonDisplay === 'critical_failure') reasonDisplay = 'Critical failure';
+                    else if (reasonDisplay === 'rate_limit') reasonDisplay = 'Rate limit';
+                    else if (reasonDisplay === 'context_exhausted') reasonDisplay = 'Context exhausted';
+                    else if (reasonDisplay === 'insufficient_quota') reasonDisplay = 'Insufficient quota';
+                    else reasonDisplay = reasonDisplay.replace(/_/g, ' ');
+                    
+                    const punishmentId = 'pun-' + (event.timestamp || Date.now());
+                    
+                    return `<tr data-row-key="${punishmentId}" style="border-bottom: 1px solid #21262d; background: rgba(248, 81, 73, 0.05);">
+                        <td style="padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap;"><span style="background: #f85149; color: #fff; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold;">PUN</span></td>
+                        <td style="padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap; color: #8b949e; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px;">${timeStr}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap; color: #8b949e; font-size: 10px;">[${escapeHtml(provider)}]</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 2px 6px; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; color: #58a6ff; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer;" title="Clicca per visualizzare nel tab Modelli" onclick="navigateToModel('${escapeHtml(provider)}', '${escapeHtml(model)}')">${escapeHtml(model)}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 2px 6px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap;"><span style="color: ${statusColor}; font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px;">${escapeHtml(statusLabel)}</span></td>

+  recordPunishmentEvent(eventType, provider, modelId, reason, cooldownMs, failures, consecutive) {
+    try {
+      const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
+        INSERT INTO punishment_events (event_type, provider, model_id, reason, cooldown_ms, failures, consecutive, created_at)
+        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+      `);
+      stmt.run(eventType, provider, modelId || null, reason || null, cooldownMs || 0, failures || 0, consecutive || 0, Date.now());
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error("[BANDIT] Errore registrazione evento punizione:", err.message);
+    }
+  }
+
+  getRecentPunishmentEvents(limit = 20) {
+    try {
+      const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
+        SELECT event_type as type, provider, model_id as modelId, reason, cooldown_ms as cooldownMs,
+               failures, consecutive, created_at as timestamp
+        FROM punishment_events
+        ORDER BY created_at DESC
+        LIMIT ?
+      `);
+      return stmt.all(limit);
+    } catch (err) {
+      console.error("[BANDIT] Errore recupero eventi punizione:", err.message);
+      return [];
+    }
+  }

+### Using the API
+
+#### REST API Examples
+
+The proxy server runs on port **20128** by default.
+
+```bash
+# Fetch dashboard statistics
+curl http://localhost:20128/v1/dashboard/stats
+
+# Get available models from production catalog
+curl http://localhost:20128/v1/models?source=prod
+
+# Get provider quota information
+curl http://localhost:20128/v1/quota
+```
+
+#### WebSocket Event Monitoring
+
+The proxy provides real-time punishment event streaming via WebSocket. This is useful for monitoring when models or providers are banned due to critical failures (403, 429, timeouts, safeWrite errors) or consecutive 5xx errors.
+
+**Endpoint:** `ws://localhost:20128/v1/events/punishment`
+
+**Event Types:**
+- `ban-model` - Model permanently banned (3 consecutive critical failures)
+- `ban-provider` - Provider permanently banned
+- `cooldown` - Model/provider on exponential backoff (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
+
+See `examples/monitor.mjs` for a complete implementation with error handling.
+
+#### Running Example Scripts
+
+Example scripts demonstrating API usage are available in the `examples/` directory:
+
+```bash
+# Monitor real-time punishment events (shows all ban/cooldown events)
+node examples/monitor.mjs
+
+# Fetch and display current dashboard statistics
+node examples/stats.mjs
+```
+
+**Output Example for `monitor.mjs`:**
+```
+Connecting to ws://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/events/punishment...
+Connected to punishment stream.
+Received punishment event: {
+  "type": "cooldown",
+  "provider": "openai",

+});
+

 ## Overview
 
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy acts as an intelligent HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer optimized for LLM inference providers. It utilizes a Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm to dynamically route requests across available models and providers, maximizing success rates, minimizing latency, and respecting quota limits while ensuring robust failure isolation and automatic circuit breaking.
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy implements a Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm for dynamic traffic routing across multiple LLM providers. The system continuously learns from traffic patterns and provider performance to optimize routing decisions, balancing cost, latency, and quality metrics.
 
----
+### Key Characteristics
 
-## Key Features
+- **Adaptive Routing**: Uses DiscountedUCB1 bandit algorithm with 0.99 discount factor for temporal adaptation
+- **Provider Intelligence**: Tracks success/failure patterns with exponential backoff cooldowns (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent)
+- **Safety Mechanisms**: 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures (403, 429, timeouts, safeWrite errors)
+- **Rate Limiting**: Per-provider quota management with atomic minute/day window checks
+- **Session Persistence**: 30-minute session TTL with 60-second stream idle timeout
 
-- **Discounted UCB1 Bandit Routing**: Intelligent multi-armed bandit selection with a 0.99 discount factor per event and 30-second rank caching.
-- **Robust Error Classification & Punishment**: 5 classification scopes (ban, cooldown, flag, provider, model) with exponential backoff cooling (15s to permanent) and a 3-strike aggressive punishment system for critical failures.
-- **Provider-Level Quota Tracking**: Atomic minute and day window checks preventing rate-limit overflows across shared provider infrastructure.
-- **Session & Stream Management**: 30-minute session TTL (`SESSION_TTL_MS`) and 60-second idle stream timeouts (`STREAM_IDLE_MS`) resetting on any chunk or heartbeat.
-- **Interactive Real-Time Dashboard**: Comprehensive web UI (`public/dashboard.html`) featuring metrics, model status, training controls, and live request tracing.
-- **Zero-Dependency SQLite Storage**: Built on [`better-sqlite3`](package.json:14) with additive-only schema migrations.
+## Features
 
----
+### Traffic Management
+- Multi-provider load balancing with configurable weight profiles
+- Automatic failover and degraded mode on consecutive 5xx errors
+- Real-time provider health monitoring
+
+### Bandit Algorithm
+- DiscountedUCB1 implementation with 0.99 event discount factor
+- 30-second cache TTL for ranking computations
+- Profile multiplier stacking for soft bias optimization
+
+### Database Layer
+- SQLite via better-sqlite3 for embedded storage
+- Schema migrations restricted to ADD COLUMN operations only
+- Separate training data table with production read merging (0.3 * training if N < 1)
+
+### Error Handling
+- Five classification scopes: ban, cooldown, flag, degraded, retry
+- Error pattern mapping for immediate model banning
+- Consecutive failure tracking with automatic reset on success
+
+### Monitoring & Dashboard
+- Web-based monitoring dashboard at `/dashboard.html`
+- Real-time statistics and provider status
+- Request history and session tracking
+

+## Architecture
+
+### System Components
+
+```
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│                    Client Request                            │
+└───────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
+                        │
+                        ▼
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│              Session Manager (30m TTL)                      │
+└───────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
+                        │
+                        ▼
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│               Bandit Router (DiscountedUCB1)                │
+│              - 0.99 discount factor                         │
+│              - 30s _rankCache TTL                           │
+└───────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
+                        │
+                        ▼
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│              Provider Quota Manager                         │
+│              - Atomic minute/day window checks              │
+│              - Exponential backoff cooldowns                │
+└───────────────────────┬─────────────────────────────────────┘
+                        │
+                        ▼
+┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
+│              Provider Selection & Proxy                     │
+│              - Fallback chains                              │
+│              - Error handling                               │
+│              - STREAM_IDLE_MS = 60s                         │
+└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
+```
+
+### Database Schema
+
+The system uses two main tables:
+
+1. **`models`** - Production model information
+2. **`models_train`** - Isolated training data (merged 0.3x if N < 1)
+
+Schema migrations are restricted to `ADD COLUMN` operations only.
+
+### Error Classification System
+
+The system classifies errors into five scopes:
 
-## Running Tests
+1. **ban** - Immediate model blocking
+2. **cooldown** - Temporary suspension with exponential backoff
+3. **flag** - Non-blocking issue marking
+4. **degraded** - Reduced functionality mode
+5. **retry** - Automatic retry logic
+
+### Cooldown Algorithm
+
+Exponential backoff progression:
+- First failure: 15 seconds
+- Second consecutive: 5 minutes
+- Third consecutive: 30 minutes
+- Fourth consecutive: 2 hours
+- Fifth+: Permanent ban
+

+  });
+
+  after(() => {
+    if (bandit && typeof bandit.close === "function") {
+      bandit.close();
+    }
+  });
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    bandit.db.prepare(`UPDATE models SET N = 5, sum_reward = 4.5, fails = 2, consecutive_critical_failures = 0, cooldown_until = 0 WHERE id = 'test-provider/model-a'`).run();
+    bandit.db.prepare(`UPDATE provider_history SET fails = 1, consecutive_failures = 1 WHERE provider = 'test-provider'`).run();
+  });
+
+  it('should update operational metrics and provider health on training success without polluting UCB1 scores', () => {
+    const modelBefore = bandit.db.prepare('SELECT N, sum_reward, fails FROM models WHERE id = ?').get('test-provider/model-a');
+    assert.strictEqual(modelBefore.N, 5);
+    assert.strictEqual(modelBefore.sum_reward, 4.5);
+    assert.strictEqual(modelBefore.fails, 2);
+
+    // Record training success
+    bandit.recordFeedback('test-provider/model-a', true, 1.0, null, { source: 'training' });
+
+    const modelAfter = bandit.db.prepare('SELECT N, sum_reward, fails FROM models WHERE id = ?').get('test-provider/model-a');
+    // UCB1 N and sum_reward must remain unchanged (no pollution)
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.N, 5, 'UCB1 N should not increase during training');
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.sum_reward, 4.5, 'UCB1 sum_reward should not increase during training');
+    // Operational fails should be reset to 0
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.fails, 0, 'Operational fails should be reset on training success');
+
+    const providerAfter = bandit.db.prepare('SELECT consecutive_failures FROM provider_history WHERE provider = ?').get('test-provider');
+    assert.strictEqual(providerAfter.consecutive_failures, 0, 'Provider consecutive failures should be reset on training success');
+  });
+
+  it('should trigger model and provider punishment on training failure', () => {
+    // Record training failure with critical error (e.g. 403 Account disabled)
+    bandit.recordFeedback('test-provider/model-a', false, 0, { status: 403, message: 'Account disabled' }, { source: 'training' });
+
+    const modelAfter = bandit.db.prepare('SELECT fails, total_failures, consecutive_critical_failures FROM models WHERE id = ?').get('test-provider/model-a');
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.fails, 3, 'Fails should increment');
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.total_failures, 1, 'Total failures should increment');
+    assert.strictEqual(modelAfter.consecutive_critical_failures, 1, 'Consecutive critical failures should track critical error');
+  });
+});

+# Punishment System & Dashboard Optimization Plan
+
+## Synthesis
+The punishment mechanism is technically sound, utilizing exponential backoff and a 3-strike critical failure system, with permanent bans triggered at 10 failures. The dashboard latency observed is caused by the overhead of parsing/buffering up to 5000 log entries on the API path.
+
+## Proposed Plan
+1. **Log Aggregation:** Move away from scanning the full 5000-entry log buffer on the dashboard API path. Implement an asynchronous log aggregator that pre-calculates summary metrics and stores them in a memory-efficient structure.
+2. **Dashboard API Optimization:** Refactor `/v1/dashboard/stats` to query the new aggregated summary store instead of parsing logs.
+3. **Punishment Visibility:** Enrich the dashboard data by directly querying the `provider_history` table for the most recent `punishment_log` entries to explain the *reason* for bans more clearly.
+
+## Architecture
+```mermaid
+graph LR
+    A[Log Emitter] --> B[Aggregator]
+    B --> C[Summary Store]
+    C --> D[Dashboard API]
+```

+# Test Suite Database Issue Fix Plan
+
+## Problem Analysis
+
+The `npm run test` command hangs with the error:
+```
+[PROVIDER_QUOTA] Background roll error: The database connection is not open
+```
+
+### Root Cause
+
+1. **Background Timer Race Condition**: In `src/provider-quota.mjs`, the `_startBackgroundRoller()` method creates an `setInterval` that executes every 60 seconds and accesses `this.db`.
+
+2. **Test Teardown Issue**: In `__tests__/itpm-quota.test.js`, the `afterEach` hook calls `bandit.close()` which:
+   - Calls `stopBackgroundRoller()` to clear the interval
+   - Then closes the database
+
+3. **Timing Gap**: The background timer callback might be executing when:
+   - The interval is cleared but the executing callback continues
+   - The database is being closed while the callback tries to access it
+
+4. **SQLite Behavior**: When the database is closed while a query is in progress, `better-sqlite3` throws "The database connection is not open"
+
+## Solution
+
+The `close()` method in `src/bandit.mjs` needs to ensure the background timer is completely stopped before closing the database. The current implementation clears the interval immediately, but there's no guarantee the currently executing callback has finished.
+
+### Fix Options
+
+1. **Add a "closing" flag** to prevent database access during shutdown
+2. **Use setImmediate/setTimeout(0)** to allow pending callbacks to complete before closing
+3. **Add proper synchronization** in ProviderQuota to prevent queries during close
+
+## Recommended Fix
+
+Modify the `close()` method in `src/bandit.mjs` to:
+1. Set a `closing` flag
+2. Stop the background roller
+3. Wait for any in-progress operations
+4. Then close the database
+
+Also modify `src/provider-quota.mjs` to check the flag before querying the database.
+
+## Files to Modify
+
+- `src/bandit.mjs` - Add closing flag and wait logic
+- `src/provider-quota.mjs` - Add flag check before database operations
\ No newline at end of file

+# Plan: Training Feedback Metrics & Punishment Refinement
+
+## Overview
+Refine how training feedback (`x-source: training`) is processed in `src/bandit.mjs`. 
+- **Training Success**: Update `models_train` and provider health (`last_success_time`, resetting provider failure counters) without polluting or falsifying production UCB1 scoring (`sum_reward` and `N` in the main `models` table) since training calls are trivial.
+- **Training Failure**: Fully apply all failure metrics, escalation, 3-strike rule, critical failure tracking, model cooldowns, permanent bans, and provider failure tracking so that problematic models encountered during training are rigorously punished.
+
+## Proposed Architecture / Workflow
+
+```mermaid
+graph TD
+    A[API Request Response] --> B{Feedback Source}
+    B -->|Training| C{Success or Failure?}
+    B -->|Production| D[Full UCB1 & Error Handling]
+    C -->|Success| E[Update models_train N and sum_reward]
+    C -->|Success| F[Update provider health last_success_time]
+    C -->|Success| G[Skip main models UCB1 sum_reward and N increment]
+    C -->|Failure| H[Increment model fails and total_failures]
+    C -->|Failure| I[Evaluate 3-strike rule and critical failures]
+    C -->|Failure| J[Apply model cooldowns or permanent ban]
+    C -->|Failure| K[Update provider failure history]
+```
+
+## Actionable Steps
+
+- [ ] Modify `src/bandit.mjs` feedback handling for `source === 'training'` on success:
+  - Keep `_recordTrainingFeedback` updating `models_train`.
+  - Update provider health (`last_success_time`, clear consecutive provider failures).
+  - Bypass updating production UCB1 `sum_reward` and `N` in the main `models` table for training successes.
+- [ ] Ensure training failures (`source === 'training'` and `success === false`) execute full error classification, model failure increments, 3-strike rule punishment, cooldowns, bans, and provider error tracking.
+- [ ] Add unit tests in `__tests__/` (or update existing bandit tests) to verify that training successes do not corrupt production UCB1 scores while training failures correctly punish problematic models and update provider health metrics.
+- [ ] Run test suite (`npm test`) and check (`npm run check`) to validate functionality.

+/**
+ * High-priority event system for critical punishment events.
+ * Bypasses log buffer polling to deliver immediate visibility
+ * for ban/cooldown events to the dashboard.
+ * 
+ * Based on AGENTS.md rules:
+ * - 3-strike system: Aggressive punishment for critical failures (403, 429, timeout, safeWrite errors)
+ * - Permanent ban after 3 consecutive critical failures (paid models punished as group)
+ * - Exponential backoff cooldowns (15s→5m→30m→2h→permanent)
+ */
+
+import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
+
+/**
+ * Event types for punishment/consequence notifications
+ */
+export const EVENT_TYPES = {
+  BAN_PROVIDER: 'ban-provider',
+  BAN_MODEL: 'ban-model',
+  BAN_PAID_GROUP: 'ban-paid-group',
+  COOLDOWN_PROVIDER: 'cooldown-provider',
+  COOLDOWN_MODEL: 'cooldown-model',
+  FLAG_PROVIDER: 'flag-provider',
+  DEGRADED_MODEL: 'degraded',
+  CRITICAL_FAILURE: 'critical-failure'
+};
+
+/**
+ * Creates a singleton event emitter for punishment events
+ * @returns {EventEmitter}
+ */
+export function createPunishmentEvents() {
+  if (!globalThis.__punishmentEvents__) {
+    globalThis.__punishmentEvents__ = new EventEmitter();
+  }
+  return globalThis.__punishmentEvents__;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Emits a high-priority ban event for immediate dashboard visibility
+ * @param {Object} event - Event data
+ * @param {string} event.type - Event type from EVENT_TYPES
+ * @param {string} event.provider - Provider name
+ * @param {string} [event.modelId] - Model ID (if applicable)
+ * @param {string} event.reason - Reason for the ban/cooldown
+ * @param {number} event.cooldownMs - Cooldown duration in milliseconds
+ * @param {number} event.failures - Total failure count
+ * @param {number} [event.consecutive] - Consecutive critical failures
+ * @param {object} [event.context] - Additional context
+ */
+export function emitPunishmentEvent(event) {
+  const events = createPunishmentEvents();
+  events.emit('punishment', event);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Creates a WebSocket-compatible event payload for dashboard clients
+ * @param {Object} event - Raw event data
+ * @returns {Object} Formatted event for WS transmission
+ */
+export function formatEventPayload(event) {
+  return {
+    type: 'punishment',
+    subtype: event.type,
+    timestamp: Date.now(),
+    provider: event.provider,
+    modelId: event.modelId || null,
+    reason: event.reason,
+    cooldownMs: event.cooldownMs || 0,
+    failures: event.failures,
+    consecutive: event.consecutive || 0,
+    context: event.context || {}
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Classifies an error as critical for the 3-strike system
+ * Based on AGENTS.md: 403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors
+ * @param {number} statusCode 
+ * @param {string} message 
+ * @param {object} errorDetails 
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isCriticalFailure(statusCode, message = '', errorDetails = {}) {
+  const msg = message || errorDetails.message || '';
+  
+  // 403 Forbidden - account disabled, banned, key limit exceeded
+  if (statusCode === 403) {
+    return /account disabled|banned|suspended|key limit exceeded|does not reset|never resets/i.test(msg);
+  }
+  
+  // 429 Rate Limit - model_cooldown code or cooling down
+  if (statusCode === 429) {
+    return /model_cooldown|cooling down/i.test(msg);
+  }
+  
+  // Timeout errors
+  if (/fetch timeout|timeout/i.test(msg)) {
+    return true;
+  }
+  
+  // safeWrite errors (OpenCode-specific)
+  if (/safeWrite|cannot access safeWrite|safeWrite before initialization|safeWrite is not initialized/i.test(msg)) {
+    return true;
+  }
+  
+  return false;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Logs a punishment event to the console for immediate visibility
+ * Also broadcasts to connected dashboard clients via WebSocket
+ * @param {Object} params
+ */
+export function logPunishment({ type, provider, modelId, reason, cooldownMs, failures, consecutive }) {
+  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
+  let logLine;
+  
+  if (type === EVENT_TYPES.BAN_PROVIDER) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT-3STRIKE] BAN-PROVIDER | provider=${provider} | ${reason} | failures=${failures}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.BAN_MODEL) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT-EMERGENCY] BAN-MODEL | model=${modelId} | ${reason} | failures=${failures}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.BAN_PAID_GROUP) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT-3STRIKE] PAID-GROUP-BAN | provider=${provider} | 3 consecutive critical failures | model=${modelId}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.COOLDOWN_PROVIDER) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT] cooldown-provider | provider=${provider} | ${reason} | ${Math.round(cooldownMs/1000)}s | failures=${failures}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.COOLDOWN_MODEL) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT] cooldown-model | model=${modelId} | ${reason} | ${Math.round(cooldownMs/1000)}s | failures=${failures}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.FLAG_PROVIDER) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT] flag-provider | provider=${provider} | ${reason}`;
+  } else if (type === EVENT_TYPES.CRITICAL_FAILURE) {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT-3STRIKE] CRITICAL | model=${modelId} | status=X | reason=${reason} | consecutive=${consecutive}/3`;
+  } else {
+    logLine = `[BANDIT] ${type} | provider=${provider} | model=${modelId} | ${reason}`;
+  }
+  
+  console.log(logLine);
+  
+  // Emit for WebSocket subscribers
+  const events = createPunishmentEvents();
+  events.emit('event', formatEventPayload({ type, provider, modelId, reason, cooldownMs, failures, consecutive }));
+}

 ## Overview
 
-Omniroute Bandit Proxy sits between client applications and large language model (LLM) providers. It dynamically selects the optimal model/provider combination using Discounted UCB1 multi-armed bandit algorithms, tracks request performance and latency, applies soft bias multipliers (`profileMultiplier`), enforces provider-level rate limits (RPM/RPD), and executes aggressive 3-strike multi-tier failure recovery.
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy acts as an intelligent HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer optimized for LLM inference providers. It utilizes a Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithm to dynamically route requests across available models and providers, maximizing success rates, minimizing latency, and respecting quota limits while ensuring robust failure isolation and automatic circuit breaking.
 
 ---
 
 ## Key Features
 
-- **Discounted UCB1 Bandit**: Optimizes routing decisions with a 0.99 discount factor per event and a 30s rank caching TTL.
-- **Isolated Training & Production**: Maintains isolated `models_train` and production tables with seamless blended scoring.
-- **Multi-Tier Error Classification & Punishment**: 5 classification scopes (ban, cooldown, flag, etc.) featuring exponential backoff cooldowns and an aggressive 3-strike system for critical failures.
-- **Provider-Level Quota Management**: Atomic minute and day window checks across provider requests.
-- **Advanced Management Dashboard**: Real-time web console [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html) featuring responsive table layouts, sanitized model names, request logs, and system controls.
+- **Discounted UCB1 Bandit Routing**: Intelligent multi-armed bandit selection with a 0.99 discount factor per event and 30-second rank caching.
+- **Robust Error Classification & Punishment**: 5 classification scopes (ban, cooldown, flag, provider, model) with exponential backoff cooling (15s to permanent) and a 3-strike aggressive punishment system for critical failures.
+- **Provider-Level Quota Tracking**: Atomic minute and day window checks preventing rate-limit overflows across shared provider infrastructure.
+- **Session & Stream Management**: 30-minute session TTL (`SESSION_TTL_MS`) and 60-second idle stream timeouts (`STREAM_IDLE_MS`) resetting on any chunk or heartbeat.
+- **Interactive Real-Time Dashboard**: Comprehensive web UI (`public/dashboard.html`) featuring metrics, model status, training controls, and live request tracing.
+- **Zero-Dependency SQLite Storage**: Built on [`better-sqlite3`](package.json:14) with additive-only schema migrations.

-## Architecture & Design Patterns
+## Architecture & Design
 
-- **ES Modules**: Built on modern JavaScript (ESM) running on Node.js.
-- **Database**: Uses `better-sqlite3` with additive-only schema migrations (`ADD COLUMN` in `_migrateDB`).
-- **Proxy/Sessions**: 30-minute session TTL (`SESSION_TTL_MS`) and 60-second stream idle timeout (`STREAM_IDLE_MS`) refreshed on any chunk or heartbeat.
+```
+[ Client Request ] ---> [ OmniRoute Bandit Proxy ] ---> [ UCB1 Bandit Selector ]
+                                  |                             |
+                                  v                             v
+                        [ Request Tracker & DB ]       [ Provider Inference API ]
+                                  |
+                                  v
+                        [ Operational Dashboard ]
+```
+
+The system separates production routing from background training (`models_train` table) and utilizes robust circuit breakers to degrade or ban unhealthy endpoints automatically.

-## Health Checks & Rehabilitation
+## Dashboard & Management UI
+

+- **Modelli & Train Tabs**: Optimized 11-column tables with sanitized model names (removing explicit provider prefixes) and responsive column layouts.

+---
+
+## Error Handling & Punishment System
 
-The background health checker probes unhealthy models periodically (`[HealthChecker](src/health-check.mjs:44)`), automatically clearing attention flags and resetting cooldowns upon successful responses.
+- **5 Scopes**: Ban, cooldown, flag provider/model.
+- **Consecutive 5xx Tracking**: `consecutive_5xx ≥ 3` transitions models into degraded mode.
+- **3-Strike System**: Permanent ban after 3 consecutive critical failures (403 forbidden, 429 rate limit, timeout, safeWrite errors), tracked via `consecutive_critical_failures`.

+# Plan: Optimize Models and Train Dashboard Layout & Model Name Sanitization
+
+This plan addresses layout, sizing, responsiveness, and model name sanitization in the 'Modelli e Train' tabs (`#tab-models` and `#tab-train`) within [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html).
+
+## Objectives
+
+1. **Layout & Resizing Optimization (`#tab-models` & `#tab-train`)**:
+   - Ensure all 11 columns (Rank, Model Name, N, Avg, Fails, Score/Badge, Free, Paid, Tools, Vision, Actions) are properly proportioned, never clipped, and remain fully visible and readable across different window sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
+   - Fix issues where cells like rank, free, paid, tools, and vision appear empty or cut off due to overly aggressive column width constraints or hiding (`display: none`) in media queries.
+   - Improve CSS table layout (`table-layout: fixed`), padding, font sizing, and flex/overflow properties so each row fits entirely within the window/wrapper.
+
+2. **Model Name Sanitization**:
+   - Strip explicit provider prefixes from model IDs when rendering model rows (`renderModelRow` in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html)), since models are already grouped under provider headers (e.g. displaying `gpt-4o` instead of `openai/gpt-4o`).
+   - Implement a robust sanitization helper `sanitizeModelName(modelId, provider)` that checks if `modelId` starts with `provider + '/'` or `provider + ':'` or contains duplicated provider prefixes and cleans it accordingly.
+
+---
+
+## Proposed Changes in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html)
+
+### 1. Model Name Sanitization Function
+Add or update a client-side sanitization helper:
+```javascript
+function sanitizeModelName(modelId, provider) {
+    if (!modelId) return '';
+    if (provider) {
+        const prefix1 = provider.toLowerCase() + '/';
+        const prefix2 = provider.toLowerCase() + ':';
+        const idLower = modelId.toLowerCase();
+        if (idLower.startsWith(prefix1)) {
+            return modelId.substring(prefix1.length);
+        }
+        if (idLower.startsWith(prefix2)) {
+            return modelId.substring(prefix2.length);
+        }
+    }
+    return modelId;
+}
+```
+Update `renderModelRow(m, isCollapsed)` to use `sanitizeModelName(m.id, m.provider)` for the displayed model name while keeping the full ID in `data-model` attributes.
+
+### 2. Table Column Widths & CSS Responsiveness (`#tab-models` & `#tab-train`)
+- Review `#tab-models` and `#tab-train` table selectors in the `<style>` block.
+- Adjust `nth-child` column widths so badges (`Free`, `Paid`, `✓`, `—`) and ranks have guaranteed minimum widths and do not overflow or collapse into invisibility.
+- Ensure smaller viewports (`@media (max-width: 900px)` and `@media (max-width: 600px)`) keep columns visible with balanced widths (`table-layout: fixed` with appropriate horizontal scrolling or compact badge rendering) rather than `display: none`.
+
+---
+
+## Verification Steps
+1. Open [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html) or run `npm start` to test the proxy and view the dashboard in browser / via Playwright or manual inspection.
+2. Verify that Rank, Free, Paid, Tools, and Vision cells render correctly across `#tab-models` and `#tab-train`.
+3. Verify that model names under each provider group are cleanly sanitized (no redundant provider prefix).

+Omniroute Bandit Proxy intercepts LLM API requests and dynamically selects the optimal model using Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithms, taking into account provider limits, historical reliability, soft biases, and real-time failure tracking. +import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert';
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from '../src/bandit.mjs';

+import path from 'path';

+/**
+ * @fileoverview Unit tests for proxy improvements and error classification of browser/runtime dependencies
+ * [`__tests__/proxy-improvements.test.js`](__tests__/proxy-improvements.test.js:1).
+ */
+test('Proxy Improvements & Error Classification', async (t) => {
+  const bandit = new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+  const configRaw = fs.readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), 'config/bandit.json'), 'utf8');
+  const config = JSON.parse(configRaw);
+
+  await t.test('should classify Playwright / Cloudflare Playground runtime errors correctly', () => {
+    const errorMsg = 'Cloudflare Playground needs Playwright and its Chromium browser';
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError({ status: 502, message: errorMsg }, 'cfp');
+    assert.strictEqual(classification.action, 'cooldown-provider');
+    assert.strictEqual(classification.reason, 'provider-misconfigured');
+  });
+
+  await t.test('should classify missing binary / ENOENT errors correctly', () => {
+    const errorMsg = 'spawn chromium ENOENT';
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError({ status: 500, message: errorMsg }, 'zc');
+    assert.strictEqual(classification.action, 'cooldown-provider');
+  });
+
+  await t.test('fallback models configuration is accessible and non-empty', () => {
+    assert.ok(Array.isArray(config.fallbackModels));
+    assert.ok(config.fallbackModels.length > 0);
+  });
+
+  bandit.close();
+});

 # OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
 
-Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic with dynamic provider routing, fallback chains, quotas, exponential backoff punishments, and real-time dashboard analytics.
-
-## Overview
-
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy acts as an intelligent proxy layer for Large Language Model (LLM) APIs across multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.). It optimizes routing using Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithms, monitors provider error patterns, enforces quotas and rate limits, and provides a real-time web dashboard for telemetry, debugging, and training management.
+Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic with intelligent provider routing, dynamic reinforcement learning (Discounted UCB1), granular error handling, quota management, and automated training daemon.
 
 ## Features
 
-- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Uses `DiscountedUCB1Bandit` (0.99 discount factor) with profile multipliers and real-time scoring.
-- **Robust Error Classification & Punishment**: 5-tier classification scope with exponential backoff cooldowns (15s up to permanent ban) and 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures.
-- **Provider Quota Management**: Atomic minute and day window checks at the provider level.
-- **Comprehensive Real-Time Dashboard**: Tabbed interface (`public/dashboard.html`) for monitoring models, providers, training status, consideration logs, and system stats.
-- **SQLite Persistence**: Powered by `better-sqlite3` with additive-only schema migrations.
-
-## System Requirements
-
-- Node.js (v18+ recommended)
-- npm
+- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Discounted UCB1 bandit algorithm (discount factor 0.99) with 30s rank caching and profile multipliers.
+- **Robust Error Classification & Punishment**: 5 classification scopes (ban, cooldown, flag, etc.), exponential backoff cooldowns (15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent), and 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures.
+- **Training Daemon**: Automated background training cycles (`scripts/train-daemon.mjs`) with automatic 404 error auto-flagging (`permanent = 1`) to prevent dead model retry loops.
+- **Atomic Quota Management**: Provider-level rate limit (RPM/RPD) and token (ITPM) atomic minute/day window checks.
+- **Session Tracking**: Persistent request tracking with SQLite (`better-sqlite3`), 30-minute session TTL, and 60-second stream idle timeout.
+- **Interactive Dashboard**: Real-time web UI (`public/dashboard.html`) for monitoring models, providers, logs, and training status.

+        function navigateToModel(provider, modelName) {
+            switchTab('models', true);
+            setTimeout(() => {
+                const tbody = document.getElementById('models-tbody');
+                if (!tbody) return;
+                const rows = tbody.querySelectorAll('tr.model-row');
+                let targetRow = null;
+                const cleanProvider = (provider || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+                const cleanModel = (modelName || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+
+                for (const row of rows) {
+                    const rowProvider = (row.getAttribute('data-provider') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+                    const rowModel = (row.getAttribute('data-model') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+                    const text = row.textContent.toLowerCase();
+
+                    if (rowProvider === cleanProvider && (rowModel === cleanModel || rowModel.includes(cleanModel) || cleanModel.includes(rowModel))) {
+                        targetRow = row;
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    if (text.includes(cleanProvider) && text.includes(cleanModel)) {
+                        targetRow = row;
+                        break;
+                    }
+                }
+                if (!targetRow) {
+                    for (const row of rows) {
+                        const rowModel = (row.getAttribute('data-model') || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+                        if (rowModel === cleanModel || row.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(cleanModel)) {
+                            targetRow = row;
+                            break;
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+
+                if (targetRow) {
+                    targetRow.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
+                    const origBg = targetRow.style.background;
+                    targetRow.style.transition = 'background 0.5s ease';
+                    targetRow.style.background = 'rgba(88, 166, 255, 0.35)';
+                    setTimeout(() => {
+                        targetRow.style.background = origBg;
+                    }, 3000);
+                }
+            }, 200);
+        }

 # OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
 
-**Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic** — intelligently routes requests across multiple LLM providers and models using a Discounted UCB1 bandit algorithm with real-time learning and adaptive exploration.
+Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic with dynamic provider routing, fallback chains, quotas, exponential backoff punishments, and real-time dashboard analytics.
 
----
+## Description
 
-## Features
-
-- **Bandit-based Model Selection**: Discounted UCB1 algorithm (discount factor 0.99 per event) with 30s rank cache TTL
-- **Multi-Provider Support**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
-- **Provider Quota Management**: Atomic RPM/RPD limit enforcement with minute/day rolling windows
-- **Training Daemon**: Background process that continuously evaluates models and updates bandit scores
-- **Error Classification**: 5-scope error handling (ban/cooldown/flag provider/model) with exponential backoff
-- **Session Management**: 30m TTL sessions with streaming support (60s idle timeout, heartbeat reset)
-- **Soft Bias System**: Profile multipliers that stack on UCB1 scores for preference steering
-- **Real-time Dashboard**: Web UI with Models, Train, Scripts, Providers, Modes, and Consideration tabs
-- **Live Log Streaming**: Real-time training log tail via `/v1/training/log-stream` endpoint
-
----
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy acts as an intelligent proxy layer for Large Language Model (LLM) APIs across multiple providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.). It optimizes routing using Discounted UCB1 Multi-Armed Bandit algorithms, monitors provider error patterns, enforces quotas and rate limits, and provides a real-time web dashboard for telemetry, debugging, and training management.
 
-## Quick Start
+## Features
 
-### Prerequisites
-- Node.js 18+
-- API keys for desired providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter, etc.)
+- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Uses `DiscountedUCB1Bandit` (0.99 discount factor) with profile multipliers and real-time scoring.
+- **Robust Error Classification & Punishment**: 5-tier classification scope with exponential backoff cooldowns (15s up to permanent ban) and 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures.
+- **Provider Quota Management**: Atomic minute and day window checks at the provider level.
+- **Comprehensive Real-Time Dashboard**: Tabbed interface (`public/dashboard.html`) for monitoring models, providers, training status, consideration logs, and system stats.
+- **SQLite Persistence**: Powered by `better-sqlite3` with additive-only schema migrations.

-Key tables:

-- `models_train` — Training evaluations (includes control record `id='train-daemon'`)
-- `provider_history` — Quota tracking, circuit breakers, punishment logs
-- `sessions` — Streaming session state
-- `request_tracker` — In-flight request correlation

-
-## Error Handling & Punishment
-
-### Classification Scopes
-| Scope | Action | Use Case |
-|-------|--------|----------|
-| `ban-model` | Permanent model ban | Critical: 403, 429, timeout, safeWrite errors |
-| `cooldown-model` | Temporary model cooldown | Transient: 413, TPM exceeded |
-| `ban-provider` | Permanent provider ban | Auth failures, quota exhaustion |
-| `cooldown-provider` | Temporary provider cooldown | Rate limits, connection errors |
-| `flag-provider` | Soft flag | Warnings, degraded performance |
-
-### 3-Strike System
-Critical failures (403, 429, timeout, safeWrite) → permanent ban after 3 consecutive occurrences.
-Counter resets on success.
-
-### Exponential Backoff
-Cooldowns: 15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent.
-
-### Emergency Relaxation
-When all models filtered, falls back to all catalog/db models **respecting active cooldowns**.
-

 # OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
 
-OmniRoute Bandit Proxy is a high-performance, intelligent reverse proxy for Large Language Model (LLM) traffic, powered by a Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) routing algorithm (`DiscountedUCB1Bandit`). It optimizes routing across multiple upstream providers and models based on success rates, latency, reward history, and provider quotas.
+**Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy for LLM traffic** — intelligently routes requests across multiple LLM providers and models using a Discounted UCB1 bandit algorithm with real-time learning and adaptive exploration.
+
+---
 
 ## Features
 
-- **Multi-Armed Bandit Routing**: Uses Discounted UCB1 (0.99 discount factor) with 30s rank caching to dynamically select the best performing model/provider.
-- **Provider Quota Management**: Atomic minute and day window checks for rate limits (RPM/RPD) at the provider level.
-- **Robust Error Classification & Handling**: 5 classification scopes (ban, cooldown, flag, degradation) with exponential backoff cooldowns (15s up to permanent ban) and 3-strike aggressive punishment for critical failures.
-- **Persistent State & Training**: Powered by `better-sqlite3` with additive-only migrations and isolated `models_train` table for background training daemon integration.
-- **Real-Time Dashboard**: Responsive web dashboard (`public/dashboard.html`) providing live telemetry, model/provider management, metrics, and script output streaming via WebSockets.
-- **Session Tracking**: Session TTL management (30m) and stream idle timeouts (60s).
+- **Bandit-based Model Selection**: Discounted UCB1 algorithm (discount factor 0.99 per event) with 30s rank cache TTL
+- **Multi-Provider Support**: OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, OpenRouter, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints
+- **Provider Quota Management**: Atomic RPM/RPD limit enforcement with minute/day rolling windows
+- **Training Daemon**: Background process that continuously evaluates models and updates bandit scores
+- **Error Classification**: 5-scope error handling (ban/cooldown/flag provider/model) with exponential backoff
+- **Session Management**: 30m TTL sessions with streaming support (60s idle timeout, heartbeat reset)
+- **Soft Bias System**: Profile multipliers that stack on UCB1 scores for preference steering
+- **Real-time Dashboard**: Web UI with Models, Train, Scripts, Providers, Modes, and Consideration tabs
+- **Live Log Streaming**: Real-time training log tail via `/v1/training/log-stream` endpoint

+## Training Daemon
+
+The training daemon runs in the background, continuously:
+1. Selecting models via bandit (exploration/exploitation)
+2. Sending test requests
+3. Recording latency, success/failure, token usage
+4. Updating UCB1 scores in `models_train` table
+
+### Control Script
+```bash
+./scripts/train-ctl.sh start    # Start daemon
+./scripts/train-ctl.sh stop     # Stop daemon
+./scripts/train-ctl.sh restart  # Restart daemon
+./scripts/train-ctl.sh status   # Show status
+./scripts/train-ctl.sh logs     # Tail training.log
+```
+
+### Dashboard Integration
+- **Training Status** card shows: active/inactive, cycle count, cumulative OK/fail, success rate
+- **Scripts Tab** → "Log Training" quick action streams `training.log` live
+- **Train Tab** shows model rankings from `models_train` (excludes control record)
+
+---
+
+## Database Schema
+
+SQLite with additive-only migrations (`better-sqlite3`).
+
+Key tables:
+- `models` — Production model registry
+- `models_train` — Training evaluations (includes control record `id='train-daemon'`)
+- `provider_history` — Quota tracking, circuit breakers, punishment logs
+- `sessions` — Streaming session state
+- `request_tracker` — In-flight request correlation
+
+---
+
+## Error Handling & Punishment
+
+### Classification Scopes
+| Scope | Action | Use Case |
+|-------|--------|----------|
+| `ban-model` | Permanent model ban | Critical: 403, 429, timeout, safeWrite errors |
+| `cooldown-model` | Temporary model cooldown | Transient: 413, TPM exceeded |
+| `ban-provider` | Permanent provider ban | Auth failures, quota exhaustion |
+| `cooldown-provider` | Temporary provider cooldown | Rate limits, connection errors |
+| `flag-provider` | Soft flag | Warnings, degraded performance |
+
+### 3-Strike System
+Critical failures (403, 429, timeout, safeWrite) → permanent ban after 3 consecutive occurrences.
+Counter resets on success.
+
+### Exponential Backoff
+Cooldowns: 15s → 5m → 30m → 2h → permanent.
+
+### Emergency Relaxation
+When all models filtered, falls back to all catalog/db models **respecting active cooldowns**.
+
+---
+
+## Dashboard Tabs
+
+| Tab | Purpose |
+|-----|---------|
+| **Models** | Production model registry, quota, status, per-model reset |
+| **Train** | Training model rankings, filters, cumulative metrics |
+| **Scripts** | Script manager with running badges, live log streaming |
+| **Providers** | Provider quota, RPM/RPD, reset controls |
+| **Modes** | Signature & multiplier tables for soft bias |
+| **Consideration** | Bandit decision log with filtering |
+| **Logs** | System log viewer with source filters |

+## Architecture
+
+```
+src/
+├── index.mjs              # Express server, API routes, middleware
+├── bandit.mjs             # DiscountedUCB1Bandit, model selection, training status
+├── provider-quota.mjs     # RPM/RPD atomic quota enforcement
+├── request-tracker.mjs    # In-flight request correlation
+├── health-check.mjs       # Provider health monitoring
+├── log-throttle.mjs       # Structured logging with suppression
+├── modes-registry.mjs     # Profile multipliers, signatures
+└── notifier.mjs           # Webhook/email notifications
+
+scripts/
+├── train-daemon.mjs       # Background training process
+├── train-ctl.sh           # Daemon control (systemd-compatible)

+└── check-*.mjs            # Diagnostic utilities
+

+```

+## Deployment
+
+### Systemd Service
+```ini
+# /etc/systemd/system/omniroute-bandit-proxy.service
+[Unit]
+Description=OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
+After=network.target
+
+[Service]
+Type=simple
+User=omniroute
+WorkingDirectory=/opt/omniroute-bandit-proxy
+ExecStart=/usr/bin/node src/index.mjs
+Restart=on-failure
+RestartSec=5
+EnvironmentFile=/opt/omniroute-bandit-proxy/.env
+
+[Install]
+WantedBy=multi-user.target
+```
+
+```bash
+sudo systemctl daemon-reload
+sudo systemctl enable --now omniroute-bandit-proxy
+```
+
+### Docker
+```dockerfile
+FROM node:20-alpine
+WORKDIR /app
+COPY package*.json ./
+RUN npm ci --production
+COPY . .
+EXPOSE 8080
+CMD ["node", "src/index.mjs"]
+```

+            output.textContent = 'Connessione al log stream in corso...\n';
+

+                const res = await fetch('/v1/training/log-stream', {
+                    headers: authHeaders(),
+                    signal: trainingLogAbortController.signal
+                });
+                if (!res.ok) {
+                    throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${res.status}`);
+                }
+                
+                const reader = res.body.getReader();
+                const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+                output.textContent = ''; // Clear connection message
+
+                while (true) {
+                    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
+                    if (done) break;
+                    const chunk = decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+                    output.textContent += chunk;
+                    output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
+                }
+            } catch (e) {
+                if (e.name !== 'AbortError') {
+                    if (status) status.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f85149;">Errore log stream: ${escapeHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
+                }
+            }
+        }

+
+// Check if training daemon process is running (based on PID file)
+app.get('/v1/training/daemon-status', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const pidFile = path.join(__dirname, "../.train-daemon.pid");
+    let isRunning = false;
+    let pid = null;
+    
+    if (fs.existsSync(pidFile)) {
+      const pidContent = fs.readFileSync(pidFile, 'utf8').trim();
+      pid = parseInt(pidContent, 10);
+      if (!isNaN(pid)) {
+        try {
+          process.kill(pid, 0);
+          isRunning = true;
+        } catch (e) {
+          isRunning = false;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    
+    res.json({ 
+      isRunning, 
+      pid: isRunning ? pid : null,
+      pidFileExists: fs.existsSync(pidFile)
+    });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error("[API] Errore /v1/training/daemon-status:", e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
+  }
+});
+
+// Stream training.log live (like tail -f)
+app.get('/v1/training/log-stream', requireAuth, (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const logFile = path.join(__dirname, "../training.log");
+    
+    // Set headers for streaming
+    res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/plain; charset=utf-8');
+    res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache');
+    res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive');
+    
+    if (!fs.existsSync(logFile)) {
+      res.write('Log file not found yet. Waiting for training daemon to start...\n');
+    }
+    
+    // Get initial file size to start from end
+    let lastSize = 0;
+    try {
+      const stats = fs.statSync(logFile);
+      lastSize = Math.max(0, stats.size - 10000); // Start from last 10KB
+    } catch (e) {
+      lastSize = 0;
+    }
+    
+    let fd = null;
+    let isClosed = false;
+    
+    const readAndSend = () => {
+      if (isClosed) return;
+      
+      try {
+        if (!fs.existsSync(logFile)) {
+          return;
+        }
+        
+        const stats = fs.statSync(logFile);
+        if (stats.size > lastSize) {
+          if (fd === null) {
+            fd = fs.openSync(logFile, 'r');
+          }
+          
+          const buffer = Buffer.alloc(stats.size - lastSize);
+          const bytesRead = fs.readSync(fd, buffer, 0, buffer.length, lastSize);
+          if (bytesRead > 0) {
+            const chunk = buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead).toString('utf8');
+            res.write(chunk);
+          }
+          lastSize = stats.size;
+        }
+      } catch (e) {
+        // Ignore errors, will retry
+      }
+    };
+    
+    // Send initial chunk
+    readAndSend();
+    
+    // Poll for new content every 500ms
+    const interval = setInterval(readAndSend, 500);
+    
+    // Clean up on client disconnect
+    req.on('close', () => {
+      isClosed = true;
+      clearInterval(interval);
+      if (fd !== null) {
+        try { fs.closeSync(fd); } catch (e) {}
+      }
+    });
+    
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error("[API] Errore /v1/training/log-stream:", e.message);
+    if (!res.headersSent) {
+      res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
+    }
+  }
+});
