-## v1.4.2 — 2026-10-22
-
-- **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
-
-  - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
-
-  - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
-
-  - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
-
-  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
-
-  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
-
-  - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+

+
+  - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
+
+  - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
+
+  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+
+  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.

+## v1.10.3 — 2026-10-29
+
+- **Fix**: Repeated Provider Errors in Bandit Model Selection.
+
+  - Fixed `isModelAvailable()` to actively check `needs_attention` flag with auto-reset on cooldown expiry (was commented-out).
+
+  - Added `cooledDownThisRequest` filtering in `selectModel()` `filterModels()` to skip providers cooled down during current request, preventing cascade failures.
+
+  - Fixed `cooledDownThisRequest` default from `true` (boolean) to `new Set()` to resolve `TypeError: .has is not a function`.
+
+  - Removed `!ignoreDynamicMaxTokens` condition so runtime-discovered TPM limits (from 413 errors) are always enforced during relaxation tiers.
+
+  - Added `dynamic_max_tokens` check to absolute last resort fallback that previously bypassed all token filtering.
+
+  - All 5 tests in `__tests__/itpm-quota.test.js` now pass.
+
+- **Fix**: Connection Errors in Chrome Dashboard Client.
+
+  - Added top-level try/catch wrapper to `/v1/chat/completions` route handler to prevent uncaught exceptions from crashing the server process.
+
+  - Previously, exceptions in `compressBody()`, `estimateTokens()`, or model selection logic would trigger the uncaughtException handler, which immediately calls `process.exit(1)`.
+
+  - Now, unhandled exceptions are caught, logged, and a proper 500 JSON response is returned to the client instead of crashing the server.
+

+## v1.4.2 — 2026-10-22
+
+- **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
+
+  - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
+
+  - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
+
+  - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
+
+  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+
+  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
+
+  - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+# Piano di Risoluzione: Formattazione di `CHANGELOG.md` e Robustezza Dashboard
+
+## Contesto e Causa Radice
+Nel file [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:2109), la funzione [`renderChangelog()`](public/dashboard.html:2091) elabora le righe del changelog cercando l'intestazione di versione con la seguente espressione regolare:
+```javascript
+const h2 = line.match(/^##\s+(v[\d.]+|Unreleased)\s*(.*)$/);
+```
+Tuttavia, in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md:1), le intestazioni sono attualmente scritte con parentesi quadre e trattino singolo:
+```markdown
+## [v1.13.6] - 2026-11-01
+```
+Poiché il pattern regex richiede `## v...` o `## Unreleased` senza parentesi quadre:
+1. `releases.length` rimane a `0`.
+2. Il parser entra nel ramo di fallback alla riga [`public/dashboard.html:2123`](public/dashboard.html:2123):
+   ```javascript
+   if (releases.length === 0) {
+       return '<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:13px; color:#c9d1d9;">' + escapeHtml(md) + '</pre>';
+   }
+   ```
+3. Il modal mostra quindi il markdown grezzo non formattato in un blocco `<pre>`, come mostrato nello screenshot dell'utente.
+
+Inoltre, lo standard del repository (definito in [`.roo/tools/update_changelog.ts`](.roo/tools/update_changelog.ts:62)) prevede il formato con em dash (`—`):
+```markdown
+## v1.13.6 — 2026-11-01
+```
+
+---
+
+## Piano di Azione
+
+### 1. Correzione di [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md:1)
+Sostituire tutte le intestazioni delle 39 versioni convertendole da:
+`## [vX.Y.Z] - YYYY-MM-DD`  
+a:  
+`## vX.Y.Z — YYYY-MM-DD`
+
+Eliminare le parentesi quadre attorno ai tag di versione e standardizzare il separatore con l'em dash `—` (o trattino con spazi) in conformità con [`.roo/tools/update_changelog.ts`](.roo/tools/update_changelog.ts:72).
+
+### 2. Aggiornamento difensivo del parser in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:2109)
+Rendere il parser resistente sia a formati con parentesi quadre sia senza, modificando la regex in [`renderChangelog()`](public/dashboard.html:2109):
+```javascript
+// Prima:
+const h2 = line.match(/^##\s+(v[\d.]+|Unreleased)\s*(.*)$/);
+
+// Dopo:
+const h2 = line.match(/^##\s+\[?(v[\d.]+|Unreleased)\]?\s*(.*)$/);
+```
+Questo garantisce che, anche qualora un commit futuro introduca intestazioni con o senza quadre, il dashboard esegua sempre correttamente il rendering HTML.
+
+---
+
+## Verifiche Post-Implementazione
+1. Verificare che la regex in [`renderChangelog()`](public/dashboard.html:2109) faccia match sia con `## v1.13.6 — 2026-11-01` sia con `## [v1.13.6] - 2026-11-01`.
+2. Verificare che [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md:1) non contenga più `## [` e che tutte le date e release siano coerenti.
+3. Testare la visualizzazione nel browser / dashboard.

-## [v1.4.2] - 2026-10-22
-
-- **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
-
-  - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
-
-  - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
-
-  - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
-
-  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
-
-  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.

-  - Previously, exceptions in `compressBody()`, `estimateTokens()`, or model selection logic would trigger the uncaughtException handler, which immediately calls `process.exit(1)`

-  - This resolves `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` and `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` errors in the Chrome dashboard client after successful API calls

+
+- **Fix**: Cooldown Reset on Successful Requests.
+
+  - Fixed `recordFeedback()` in [src/bandit.mjs](src/bandit.mjs:1) to clear `cooldown_until` on successful requests.
+
+  - Models/providers were stuck in cooldown because successful requests didn't reset `cooldown_until`, causing continuous `provider_cooldown` rejections.
+
+  - Added `cooldown_until = 0` reset in the success path of `recordFeedback()` for both model and provider records.
+
+  - Provider cooldown is now properly cleared via `UPDATE provider_history SET cooldown_until = 0` on success.

+## [v1.11.2] - 2026-10-30
+
+- **Fix**: Service Startup Crash (Duplicate Variable Declaration).
+
+  - Removed duplicate `const isHardError` declaration at `src/index.mjs:1732` inside `noteProviderFail()`.
+
+  - The duplicate caused `SyntaxError: Identifier 'isHardError' has already been declared` at module load, preventing the server from binding port 8080.
+
+  - This was the root cause of `restart-safe.sh` failing with "Porta 127.0.0.1:8080 non si è bindata dopo 60s" — systemd's `Restart=on-failure` kept restarting the crashed process in a loop.
+
+  - Also ran `npm install` to restore missing `node_modules` (express and other dependencies were absent).
+
+- **Fix**: Cronologia Unificata Timestamp Overlap.
+
+  - Removed orange "try N" text from active model timestamp cell in `fmtRow()` (was causing visual overflow into Provider column).
+
+  - Active thinking models now show only timestamp + elapsed seconds, e.g. `19:57:05 (20.6s)`.
+
+  - Non-active rows show clean timestamp only, e.g. `19:55:24`.
+
+  - This eliminates the column overlap in the unified history table.

+## [v1.4.2] - 2026-10-22
+
+- **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
+
   - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
+
   - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
+
   - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
+
   - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+
   - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
+
   - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+
+const providersToReset = ['openrouter', 'xao', 'xai-oauth'];
+
+console.log("Resetting provider attention flags...");
+
+const stmt = db.prepare(`
+  UPDATE provider_history 
+  SET needs_attention = 0, 
+      attention_reason = '',
+      attention_message = '',
+      quota_resets_at = 0,
+      quota_reason = ''
+  WHERE provider = ?
+`);
+
+for (const provider of providersToReset) {
+  const info = stmt.run(provider);
+  console.log(`Provider ${provider}: ${info.changes} rows updated`);
+}
+
+console.log("\nVerification:");
+const checkStmt = db.prepare("SELECT provider, needs_attention, attention_reason, quota_resets_at FROM provider_history WHERE provider IN (?, ?, ?)");
+const results = checkStmt.all(...providersToReset);
+
+results.forEach(r => {
+  console.log(`${r.provider}: needs_attention=${r.needs_attention}, attention_reason='${r.attention_reason}', quota_resets_at=${r.quota_resets_at}`);
+});
+
+console.log("\nDone!");

   - Added top-level try/catch wrapper to `/v1/chat/completions` route handler to prevent uncaught exceptions from crashing the server process.
+
   - Previously, exceptions in `compressBody()`, `estimateTokens()`, or model selection logic would trigger the uncaughtException handler, which immediately calls `process.exit(1)`.
+
   - Now, unhandled exceptions are caught, logged, and a proper 500 JSON response is returned to the client instead of crashing the server.
+
   - This resolves `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` and `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` errors in the Chrome dashboard client after successful API calls.

+## [v1.4.2] - 2026-10-22
+
 - **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
+
   - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
+
   - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
+
   - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
+
   - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+
   - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
+
   - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+  - Models/providers were stuck in cooldown because successful requests didn't reset `cooldown_until`, causing continuous `provider_cooldown` rejections.
+  - Added `cooldown_until = 0` reset in the success path of `recordFeedback()` for both model and provider records.
+  - Provider cooldown is now properly cleared via `UPDATE provider_history SET cooldown_until = 0` on success.

+  - The duplicate caused `SyntaxError: Identifier 'isHardError' has already been declared` at module load, preventing the server from binding port 8080.
+  - This was the root cause of `restart-safe.sh` failing with "Porta 127.0.0.1:8080 non si è bindata dopo 60s" — systemd's `Restart=on-failure` kept restarting the crashed process in a loop.

+## [v1.1.70] - 2026-10-22
+- **Enhancement**: Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy.
   - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
   - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
   - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
   - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
   - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
   - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+  pruneModels() {
+    try {
+      const thirtyDaysAgo = Date.now() / 1000 - 30 * 24 * 60 * 60;
+      // Get models not in catalog and used > 30 days ago
+      const stmt = this.db.prepare(`
+        DELETE FROM models
+        WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM catalog)
+        AND id IN (
+          SELECT model FROM request_logs
+          GROUP BY model
+          HAVING MAX(started_at) < ?
+        )
+      `);
+      const result = stmt.run(thirtyDaysAgo);

+## v1.1.93 — 2026-10-30
+- **Fix Model ID Sanitization Validation**:
+  - `_sanitizeModelId()` now validates sanitized model IDs against the catalog, preventing invalid model selection
+  - Resolves the `groq/groq/compound` 404 issue caused by malformed model IDs passing through without catalog validation
+- **Fix Provider Cooldown Duration for Transient 429 Errors**:
+  - `_classifyError()` reduced provider cooldown from 24h to 5min for transient 429 rate-limit errors
+  - Respects `retry-after` header when present; falls back to 5-minute default for transient rate limits
+- **Increase Provider Fail Threshold to Reduce False Cooldowns**:
+  - `PROVIDER_FAIL_THRESHOLD` increased from 3 to 10 to reduce false provider cooldown triggers
+  - Prevents premature provider bans from transient error spikes
+- **Fix Default Error Classification Reason**:
+  - Default error classification now uses `"classification-fallback"` reason for proper metric tracking
+  - Ensures unclassified errors are consistently tagged for dashboard and learning analysis
+
+## v1.1.92 — 2026-10-30
+- **Fix Cooldown Reset on Successful Requests**:
+  - Fixed `recordFeedback()` in `src/bandit.mjs` to clear `cooldown_until` on successful requests
+  - Models/providers were stuck in cooldown because successful requests didn't reset `cooldown_until`, causing continuous `provider_cooldown` rejections
+  - Added `cooldown_until = 0` reset in the success path of `recordFeedback()` for both model and provider records
+  - Provider cooldown is now properly cleared via `UPDATE provider_history SET cooldown_until = 0` on success
+
+## v1.1.91 — 2026-10-30
+- **Fix Service Startup Crash (Duplicate Variable Declaration)**:
+  - Removed duplicate `const isHardError` declaration at `src/index.mjs:1732` inside `noteProviderFail()`
+  - The duplicate caused `SyntaxError: Identifier 'isHardError' has already been declared` at module load, preventing the server from binding port 8080
+  - This was the root cause of `restart-safe.sh` failing with "Porta 127.0.0.1:8080 non si è bindata dopo 60s" — systemd's `Restart=on-failure` kept restarting the crashed process in a loop
+  - Also ran `npm install` to restore missing `node_modules` (express and other dependencies were absent)
+- **Fix Cronologia Unificata Timestamp Overlap**:
+  - Removed orange "try N" text from active model timestamp cell in `fmtRow()` (was causing visual overflow into Provider column)
+  - Active thinking models now show only timestamp + elapsed seconds, e.g. `19:57:05 (20.6s)`
+  - Non-active rows show clean timestamp only, e.g. `19:55:24`
+  - This eliminates the column overlap in the unified history table
+
+## v1.1.90 — 2026-10-30
+- **Auto-Git Command Enhancement**:
+  - Added `# Skill: auto-git` directive to `.roo/commands/auto-git.md` to make the command executable via the skill system
+- **Dashboard Log Filter Enhancement**:
+  - Added `log-show-proxy` checkbox to dashboard log filter in `public/dashboard.html` for filtering proxy-related log entries
+- **Health Check Improvements**:
+  - Modified health check logic in `src/health-check.mjs` for improved reliability and error handling
+- **Proxy Error Handling Improvements**:
+  - Enhanced proxy error handling in `src/index.mjs` with better error classification and recovery mechanisms
+
+## v1.1.89 — 2026-10-29
+- **Fix Cronologia Unificata Timestamp Overlap**:
+  - Removed orange "try N" text from active model timestamp cell in `fmtRow()` (was causing visual overflow into Provider column)
+  - Active thinking models now show only timestamp + elapsed seconds, e.g. `19:57:05 (20.6s)`
+  - Non-active rows show clean timestamp only, e.g. `19:55:24`
+  - This eliminates the column overlap in the unified history table
+
+## v1.1.88 — 2026-10-29
+- **Fix Repeated Provider Errors in Bandit Model Selection**:
+  - Fixed `isModelAvailable()` to actively check `needs_attention` flag with auto-reset on cooldown expiry (was commented-out)
+  - Added `cooledDownThisRequest` filtering in `selectModel()` `filterModels()` to skip providers cooled down during current request, preventing cascade failures
+  - Fixed `cooledDownThisRequest` default from `true` (boolean) to `new Set()` to resolve `TypeError: .has is not a function`
+  - Removed `!ignoreDynamicMaxTokens` condition so runtime-discovered TPM limits (from 413 errors) are always enforced during relaxation tiers
+  - Added `dynamic_max_tokens` check to absolute last resort fallback that previously bypassed all token filtering
+  - All 5 tests in `__tests__/itpm-quota.test.js` now pass
+
+- **Fix Connection Errors in Chrome Dashboard Client**:
+  - Added top-level try/catch wrapper to `/v1/chat/completions` route handler to prevent uncaught exceptions from crashing the server process
+  - Previously, exceptions in `compressBody()`, `estimateTokens()`, or model selection logic would trigger the uncaughtException handler, which immediately calls `process.exit(1)`
+  - Now, unhandled exceptions are caught, logged, and a proper 500 JSON response is returned to the client instead of crashing the server
+  - This resolves `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED` and `ERR_CONNECTION_RESET` errors in the Chrome dashboard client after successful API calls

+  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.

+---
+description: Automate git commit-and-push workflow with repository cleanup, workspace problem resolution, documentation updates, and history optimization.
+---
+
+# Auto-Git Workflow
+
+Execute the complete git workflow following these steps:
+
+1. **Repository Analysis & Cleanup**:
+   - Check for useless files and temporary artifacts (`*.bak`, `*.old`, `*.log`, `tmp*`, `temp*`, `.script-output-*.json`) and untracked scripts (`*.sh`, `*.py`, `*.bat`, `*.mjs`) and remove them.
+
+2. **Resolve Workspace Problems**:
+   - If `package.json` has a `check` script, run it and ensure syntax checks and validations pass before proceeding.
+
+3. **Documentation Updates**:
+   - Read the current version from `package.json`.
+   - Automatically update `CHANGELOG.md` adding a new version entry and commit description.
+   - Update version strings in `README.md` if present.
+
+4. **Staging & Commit Message**:
+   - Stage all changes using `git add .`.
+   - Analyze staged changes to determine the type (`feat`, `docs`, `chore`), affected scopes (`src`, `tests`, `docs`, `scripts`, `config`), and generate a conventional commit message.
+   - Scan staged changes for potential secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords). If any are detected, abort immediately.
+   - Commit changes with the generated message.
+
+5. **History Optimization**:
+   - Unless skipped, check for consecutive generic/automated commits in recent history and squash them if appropriate.
+
+6. **Sync & Push**:
+   - Pull latest changes with rebase and autostash (`git pull --rebase --autostash origin main`).
+   - Push to remote (`git push origin main`) with retry attempts if necessary.

-
-This document describes the modifications made to the auto-git slash command script to improve commit message quality and add git history audit capabilities.
-
-## Overview of Changes
-
-The auto-git script has been enhanced with two major improvements:
-
-1. **Intelligent Commit Message Generation**: Commit messages are now generated based on actual file changes through diff analysis and pattern matching, replacing generic "automated commit" messages
-2. **Git History Audit System**: Automatic detection and rewriting of generic/automated commit messages with safety checks and backup mechanisms
-
-## New Features Added
-
-### 1. Intelligent Commit Message Generation
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:317)
-
-The `generate_commit_message()` function has been completely redesigned to analyze staged files and generate meaningful conventional commit messages.
-
-#### Key Improvements:
-
-- **Diff-based analysis**: Examines actual code changes using `git diff --cached` instead of just file names
-- **Pattern matching**: Detects specific changes in code (bandit algorithms, quota tracking, error classification, session management, streaming, context compression, mode detection, health checking, notifiers, request tracking, log throttling)
-- **Context-aware descriptions**: Extracts meaningful descriptions from changed functions/classes
-- **Multi-file consolidation**: Combines changes from multiple files into coherent descriptions
-- **Type determination**: Automatically determines commit type (feat, docs, chore, refactor) based on file changes
-
-### 2. Git History Audit and Rewrite
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:117)
-
-The `audit_and_fix_history()` function audits recent git history for generic messages and offers rewriting options.
-
-#### Key Features:
-
-- **Generic message detection**: Identifies commits with messages like "automated commit", "feat(...): automated commit", "chore: automated commit", or containing "automated commit"
-- **Consecutive commit grouping**: Detects groups of consecutive generic commits by same author within 1 hour
-- **Safety checks**: Verifies if commits are pushed to remote before suggesting rewrites
-- **Backup branch creation**: Automatically creates backup branches before any history modifications
-- **Dry-run analysis**: Analyzes proposed squashes without executing destructive operations
-- **Environment-based configuration**: Can be skipped or auto-executed via environment variables
-
-## Commit Message Generation
-
-### How It Works Now
-
-The commit message generation process follows these steps:
-
-1. **Staged File Collection**: Gather all staged files using `git diff --cached --name-only`
-2. **File Type Classification**: Categorize files into types (src, tests, docs, scripts, config, readme, changelog)
-3. **Commit Type Determination**: Set type based on file types:
-   - `feat` for source or test files
-   - `docs` for documentation only
-   - `chore` for config changes or changelog updates
-4. **Scope Building**: Create scope from file categories (e.g., `(src,tests,docs)`)
-5. **Diff Analysis**: For each staged file:
-   - Extract diff content using `git diff --cached`
-   - Apply pattern matching for specific technologies/features
-   - Extract changed function/class names when possible
-6. **Description Construction**: Build concise description with fallback logic
-7. **Message Assembly**: Combine type, scope, and description into conventional format
-
-### Pattern Matching Details
-
-The script recognizes specific change patterns:
-
-| Pattern | Detected In | Example Message |
-|---------|-------------|-----------------|
-| `bandit\|Bandit\|discountFactor\|ucb\|UCB` | src files | "update bandit algorithm" |
-| `quota\|Quota\|provider.*limit\|rpm\|rpd` | src files | "update provider quota tracking" |
-| `error\|Error\|classify\|Classify\|ban\|cooldown` | src files | "fix error classification" |
-| `session\|Session\|SESSION_TTL\|affinity` | src files | "update session management" |
-| `stream\|Stream\|STREAM_IDLE\|STREAM_MAX` | src files | "fix streaming timeouts" |
-| `context\|Context\|compress\|truncate` | src files | "update context compression" |
-| `mode\|Mode\|detectProfile\|profileMultiplier` | src files | "update mode detection" |
-| `health\|Health\|health-check\|HealthChecker` | src files | "update health checking" |
-| `notifier\|Notifier\|notify` | src files | "update notifier" |
-| `request.*tracker\|RequestTracker` | src files | "update request tracking" |
-| `log.*throttle\|LogThrottle` | src files | "update log throttling" |
-
-### File Type Handling
-
-| File Pattern | Handling |
-|--------------|----------|
-| `src/*.mjs\|src/*.js\|src/*.ts` | Deep diff analysis with pattern matching |
-| `config/*.json` | Specific config names (bandit.json, provider-limits.json, modes.json) |
-| `tests/*\|__tests__/*` | Marked as tests |
-| `docs/*\|*.md` | Documentation updates, CHANGELOG/README special handling |
-| `scripts/*` | Script updates |
-| `*.json\|*.config.*\|*.rc` | Configuration updates |
-
-## History Audit Functionality
-
-### Detection of Generic Messages
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:28)
-
-The `is_generic_commit_message()` function detects generic messages using:
-- Exact pattern matches: `^automated commit$`, `^feat\(.*\): automated commit$`, `^chore: automated commit$`
-- Contains check: any message containing "automated commit" (case-insensitive)
-
-### Safety Checks
-
-Before offering history rewrites, the script performs:
-
-1. **Push Status Check**: Verifies if generic commits are pushed to remote
-   - If unpushed: Safe to rewrite (local only)
-   - If pushed: Requires force push warning
-
-2. **Backup Branch Creation**: Creates timestamped backup branch
-   - Format: `backup/pre-audit-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS`
-   - Ensures recovery option if rewrite goes wrong
-
-3. **Consecutive Commit Analysis**: Groups commits by:
-   - Same author
-   - Within 1 hour time window
-   - Consecutive in history
-
-### Squash Logic
-
-The `auto_squash_generic_commits()` function:
-
-1. Identifies groups of consecutive generic commits (2+ commits)
-2. Analyzes combined file changes across all commits
-3. Proposes new consolidated commit message using `analyze_commit_for_message()`
-4. Currently operates in **dry-run mode** for safety
-5. Logs proposed changes without executing destructive rewrites
-
-## Configuration Options
-
-### Environment Variables
-
-#### `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT`
-
-**Default**: `false`
-**Type**: boolean string
-
-Skips the history audit phase entirely.
-
-```bash
-SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true ./auto-git.sh
-```
-
-**Use cases**:
-- Non-interactive CI/CD pipelines
-- When history is already clean
-- Faster execution without audit overhead
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:119)
-
-#### `AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC`
-
-**Default**: `false`
-**Type**: boolean string
-
-Automatically proceeds with auto-squash of consecutive generic commits without interactive prompt.
-
-```bash
-AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC=true ./auto-git.sh
-```
-
-**Behavior**:
-- Skips interactive menu
-- Runs squash analysis automatically
-- Currently in dry-run mode (safe)
-- Still requires manual review for actual rewrite
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:247)
-
-### Interactive Options
-
-When history audit detects generic commits, users can choose:
-
-1. **Review and rewrite messages individually** (not implemented in current version)
-2. **Auto-squash consecutive generic commits** (dry-run analysis only)
-3. **Skip history fix this time** (default)
-
-## Examples
-
-### Before and After Commit Messages
-
-#### Example 1: Bandit Algorithm Changes
-
-**Before** (generic):
-```
-chore: automated commit
-```
-
-**After** (specific):
-```
-feat(src): update bandit algorithm
-```
-
-**Analysis**: Detected changes in `src/bandit.mjs` with patterns matching "bandit", "discountFactor", "ucb"
-
-#### Example 2: Provider Quota Updates
-
-**Before** (generic):
-```
-automated commit
-```
-
-**After** (specific):
-```
-chore(config): update provider limits
-```
-
-**Analysis**: Changes in `config/provider-limits.json` detected
-
-#### Example 3: Multiple File Types
-
-**Before** (generic):
-```
-feat(src): automated commit
-```
-
-**After** (specific):
-```
-feat(src,tests,docs): update session management, update tests
-```
-
-**Analysis**: 
-- Source files changed with session-related patterns
-- Test files updated
-- Documentation updated
-
-#### Example 4: Documentation Only
-
-**Before** (generic):
-```
-chore: automated commit
-```
-
-**After** (specific):
-```
-docs(docs): update readme
-```
-
-**Analysis**: Only README.md changed, no source files
-
-### History Audit Example
-
-**Detected generic commits**:
-```
-Found 3 generic commit(s) in last 20 commits:
-  1. abc1234 (by marco on 2024-01-15 10:30:00)
-     Message: chore: automated commit
-     Files: src/index.mjs public/dashboard.html
-  2. def5678 (by marco on 2024-01-15 10:32:15)
-     Message: automated commit
-     Files: src/bandit.mjs config/bandit.json
-  3. ghi9012 (by marco on 2024-01-15 10:45:00)
-     Message: feat(src): automated commit
-     Files: src/notifier.mjs
-
-Safety check:
-  WARNING: 2 generic commit(s) are NOT pushed to remote.
-  Rewriting will be safe (local only).
-
-Found 1 group(s) of consecutive generic commits that can be squashed.
-  Group 1: abc1234,def5678
-```
-
-**Proposed squash**:
-```
-Proposed squash message: feat(src,config): update bandit algorithm
-[DRY RUN] Would squash 2 commits into: feat(src,config): update bandit algorithm
-Commit hashes: abc1234 def5678
-```

-## Usage Instructions
-
-### Basic Usage
-
-Run the auto-git script as normal:
-
-```bash
-/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
-```
-
-The script will:
-1. Stage all changes
-2. Scan for secrets
-3. Generate intelligent commit message
-4. Audit recent history for generic messages
-5. Commit and push changes
-
-### Skipping History Audit
-
-For faster execution or when you know history is clean:
-
-```bash
-SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true /home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
-```
-
-### Auto-Squash Mode
-
-For non-interactive operation with automatic squash analysis:
-
-```bash
-AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC=true /home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
-```
-
-### Manual History Audit
-
-To manually trigger audit without committing:
-
-The audit runs automatically after `git pull --rebase` and before commit. To skip commit:
-
-1. Run script with no changes
-2. Or modify script to exit after audit phase
-
-### Best Practices
-
-1. **Review proposed messages**: Always verify the generated commit message looks appropriate
-2. **Backup before rewrite**: Script automatically creates backup branches
-3. **Check remote status**: Be aware that pushed commits require force push to rewrite
-4. **Use environment variables**: Set `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true` in CI/CD environments
-5. **Dry-run first**: Squash operations are in dry-run mode - review proposals carefully
-
-## Technical Details
-
-### Commit Message Analysis Function
-
-**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:42)
-
-The `analyze_commit_for_message()` function analyzes historical commits:
-
-- Examines commit diff using `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r`
-- Detects file types and builds scope
-- Analyzes diff content for patterns
-- Proposes consistent message for historical commits
-
-### Lock Mechanism
-
-The script uses file locking to prevent concurrent runs:
-
-```bash
-LOCKFILE="/tmp/auto-git.lock"
-exec 200>"$LOCKFILE"
-flock -n 200
-```
-
-### Safety Features
-
-1. **File lock**: Prevents concurrent executions
-2. **Secret scanning**: Checks staged files for API keys, tokens, secrets
-3. **Rebase handling**: Uses `--autostash` for conflict avoidance
-4. **Push verification**: Confirms remote push succeeded
-5. **Backup branches**: Creates restore points before history modifications
-6. **Dry-run mode**: Squash operations don't execute destructively
-
-## Migration Notes
-
-### From Old Behavior
-
-**Previous behavior**:
-- All commits used generic "automated commit" message
-- No history analysis
-- Manual commit message creation required for meaningful messages
-
-**New behavior**:
-- Messages automatically generated from code analysis
-- History audit identifies and can fix past generic commits
-- Conventional commit format enforced
-
-### Breaking Changes
-
-None. All changes are backward compatible and additive.
-
-## Troubleshooting
-
-### Issue: Commit message still generic
-
-**Solution**: Ensure changes are staged and contain analyzable content. Empty commits fall back to generic message.
-
-### Issue: History audit skipped unexpectedly
-
-**Solution**: Check if `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true` is set in environment.
-
-### Issue: Backup branch creation fails
-
-**Solution**: Script will warn but continue. Ensure you have branch creation permissions.
-
-### Issue: Pattern matching not working
-
-**Solution**: Verify file extensions are recognized. Add custom patterns to the case statements in `generate_commit_message()`.
-
-## Future Enhancements
-
-Potential improvements for the auto-git script:
-
-1. Interactive message editing before commit
-2. Custom pattern configuration files
-3. Machine learning-based message generation
-4. Integration with commit message linters
-5. Full interactive rebase for actual history rewriting
-6. Commit message templates per file type
-7. Integration with AI for more sophisticated analysis
-

+# Auto-Git Script Modifications Documentation
+
+**File**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:1)
+
+This document describes the modifications made to the auto-git slash command script to improve commit message quality and add git history audit capabilities.
+
+## Overview of Changes
+
+The auto-git script has been enhanced with two major improvements:
+
+1. **Intelligent Commit Message Generation**: Commit messages are now generated based on actual file changes through diff analysis and pattern matching, replacing generic "automated commit" messages
+2. **Git History Audit System**: Automatic detection and rewriting of generic/automated commit messages with safety checks and backup mechanisms
+
+## New Features Added
+
+### 1. Intelligent Commit Message Generation
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:317)
+
+The `generate_commit_message()` function has been completely redesigned to analyze staged files and generate meaningful conventional commit messages.
+
+#### Key Improvements:
+
+- **Diff-based analysis**: Examines actual code changes using `git diff --cached` instead of just file names
+- **Pattern matching**: Detects specific changes in code (bandit algorithms, quota tracking, error classification, session management, streaming, context compression, mode detection, health checking, notifiers, request tracking, log throttling)
+- **Context-aware descriptions**: Extracts meaningful descriptions from changed functions/classes
+- **Multi-file consolidation**: Combines changes from multiple files into coherent descriptions
+- **Type determination**: Automatically determines commit type (feat, docs, chore, refactor) based on file changes
+
+### 2. Git History Audit and Rewrite
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:117)
+
+The `audit_and_fix_history()` function audits recent git history for generic messages and offers rewriting options.
+
+#### Key Features:
+
+- **Generic message detection**: Identifies commits with messages like "automated commit", "feat(...): automated commit", "chore: automated commit", or containing "automated commit"
+- **Consecutive commit grouping**: Detects groups of consecutive generic commits by same author within 1 hour
+- **Safety checks**: Verifies if commits are pushed to remote before suggesting rewrites
+- **Backup branch creation**: Automatically creates backup branches before any history modifications
+- **Dry-run analysis**: Analyzes proposed squashes without executing destructive operations
+- **Environment-based configuration**: Can be skipped or auto-executed via environment variables
+
+## Commit Message Generation
+
+### How It Works Now
+
+The commit message generation process follows these steps:
+
+1. **Staged File Collection**: Gather all staged files using `git diff --cached --name-only`
+2. **File Type Classification**: Categorize files into types (src, tests, docs, scripts, config, readme, changelog)
+3. **Commit Type Determination**: Set type based on file types:
+   - `feat` for source or test files
+   - `docs` for documentation only
+   - `chore` for config changes or changelog updates
+4. **Scope Building**: Create scope from file categories (e.g., `(src,tests,docs)`)
+5. **Diff Analysis**: For each staged file:
+   - Extract diff content using `git diff --cached`
+   - Apply pattern matching for specific technologies/features
+   - Extract changed function/class names when possible
+6. **Description Construction**: Build concise description with fallback logic
+7. **Message Assembly**: Combine type, scope, and description into conventional format
+
+### Pattern Matching Details
+
+The script recognizes specific change patterns:
+
+| Pattern | Detected In | Example Message |
+|---------|-------------|-----------------|
+| `bandit\|Bandit\|discountFactor\|ucb\|UCB` | src files | "update bandit algorithm" |
+| `quota\|Quota\|provider.*limit\|rpm\|rpd` | src files | "update provider quota tracking" |
+| `error\|Error\|classify\|Classify\|ban\|cooldown` | src files | "fix error classification" |
+| `session\|Session\|SESSION_TTL\|affinity` | src files | "update session management" |
+| `stream\|Stream\|STREAM_IDLE\|STREAM_MAX` | src files | "fix streaming timeouts" |
+| `context\|Context\|compress\|truncate` | src files | "update context compression" |
+| `mode\|Mode\|detectProfile\|profileMultiplier` | src files | "update mode detection" |
+| `health\|Health\|health-check\|HealthChecker` | src files | "update health checking" |
+| `notifier\|Notifier\|notify` | src files | "update notifier" |
+| `request.*tracker\|RequestTracker` | src files | "update request tracking" |
+| `log.*throttle\|LogThrottle` | src files | "update log throttling" |
+
+### File Type Handling
+
+| File Pattern | Handling |
+|--------------|----------|
+| `src/*.mjs\|src/*.js\|src/*.ts` | Deep diff analysis with pattern matching |
+| `config/*.json` | Specific config names (bandit.json, provider-limits.json, modes.json) |
+| `tests/*\|__tests__/*` | Marked as tests |
+| `docs/*\|*.md` | Documentation updates, CHANGELOG/README special handling |
+| `scripts/*` | Script updates |
+| `*.json\|*.config.*\|*.rc` | Configuration updates |
+
+## History Audit Functionality
+
+### Detection of Generic Messages
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:28)
+
+The `is_generic_commit_message()` function detects generic messages using:
+- Exact pattern matches: `^automated commit$`, `^feat\(.*\): automated commit$`, `^chore: automated commit$`
+- Contains check: any message containing "automated commit" (case-insensitive)
+
+### Safety Checks
+
+Before offering history rewrites, the script performs:
+
+1. **Push Status Check**: Verifies if generic commits are pushed to remote
+   - If unpushed: Safe to rewrite (local only)
+   - If pushed: Requires force push warning
+
+2. **Backup Branch Creation**: Creates timestamped backup branch
+   - Format: `backup/pre-audit-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS`
+   - Ensures recovery option if rewrite goes wrong
+
+3. **Consecutive Commit Analysis**: Groups commits by:
+   - Same author
+   - Within 1 hour time window
+   - Consecutive in history
+
+### Squash Logic
+
+The `auto_squash_generic_commits()` function:
+
+1. Identifies groups of consecutive generic commits (2+ commits)
+2. Analyzes combined file changes across all commits
+3. Proposes new consolidated commit message using `analyze_commit_for_message()`
+4. Currently operates in **dry-run mode** for safety
+5. Logs proposed changes without executing destructive rewrites
+
+## Configuration Options
+
+### Environment Variables
+
+#### `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT`
+
+**Default**: `false`
+**Type**: boolean string
+
+Skips the history audit phase entirely.
+
+```bash
+SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true ./auto-git.sh
+```
+
+**Use cases**:
+- Non-interactive CI/CD pipelines
+- When history is already clean
+- Faster execution without audit overhead
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:119)
+
+#### `AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC`
+
+**Default**: `false`
+**Type**: boolean string
+
+Automatically proceeds with auto-squash of consecutive generic commits without interactive prompt.
+
+```bash
+AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC=true ./auto-git.sh
+```
+
+**Behavior**:
+- Skips interactive menu
+- Runs squash analysis automatically
+- Currently in dry-run mode (safe)
+- Still requires manual review for actual rewrite
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:247)
+
+### Interactive Options
+
+When history audit detects generic commits, users can choose:
+
+1. **Review and rewrite messages individually** (not implemented in current version)
+2. **Auto-squash consecutive generic commits** (dry-run analysis only)
+3. **Skip history fix this time** (default)
+

+## Usage Instructions
+
+### Basic Usage
+
+Run the auto-git script as normal:
+
+```bash
+/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
+```
+
+The script will:
+1. Stage all changes
+2. Scan for secrets
+3. Generate intelligent commit message
+4. Audit recent history for generic messages
+5. Commit and push changes
+
+### Skipping History Audit
+
+For faster execution or when you know history is clean:
+
+```bash
+SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true /home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
+```
+
+### Auto-Squash Mode
+
+For non-interactive operation with automatic squash analysis:
+
+```bash
+AUTO_SQUASH_GENERIC=true /home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh
+```
+
+### Manual History Audit
+
+To manually trigger audit without committing:
+
+The audit runs automatically after `git pull --rebase` and before commit. To skip commit:
+
+1. Run script with no changes
+2. Or modify script to exit after audit phase
+
+### Best Practices
+
+1. **Review proposed messages**: Always verify the generated commit message looks appropriate
+2. **Backup before rewrite**: Script automatically creates backup branches
+3. **Check remote status**: Be aware that pushed commits require force push to rewrite
+4. **Use environment variables**: Set `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true` in CI/CD environments
+5. **Dry-run first**: Squash operations are in dry-run mode - review proposals carefully
+
+## Technical Details
+
+### Commit Message Analysis Function
+
+**Location**: [`/home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh`](file:///home/marco/.roo/commands/auto-git.sh:42)
+
+The `analyze_commit_for_message()` function analyzes historical commits:
+
+- Examines commit diff using `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r`
+- Detects file types and builds scope
+- Analyzes diff content for patterns
+- Proposes consistent message for historical commits
+
+### Lock Mechanism
+
+The script uses file locking to prevent concurrent runs:
+
+```bash
+LOCKFILE="/tmp/auto-git.lock"
+exec 200>"$LOCKFILE"
+flock -n 200
+```
+
+### Safety Features
+
+1. **File lock**: Prevents concurrent executions
+2. **Secret scanning**: Checks staged files for API keys, tokens, secrets
+3. **Rebase handling**: Uses `--autostash` for conflict avoidance
+4. **Push verification**: Confirms remote push succeeded
+5. **Backup branches**: Creates restore points before history modifications
+6. **Dry-run mode**: Squash operations don't execute destructively
+
+## Migration Notes
+
+### From Old Behavior
+
+**Previous behavior**:
+- All commits used generic "automated commit" message
+- No history analysis
+- Manual commit message creation required for meaningful messages
+
+**New behavior**:
+- Messages automatically generated from code analysis
+- History audit identifies and can fix past generic commits
+- Conventional commit format enforced
+
+### Breaking Changes
+
+None. All changes are backward compatible and additive.
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+### Issue: Commit message still generic
+
+**Solution**: Ensure changes are staged and contain analyzable content. Empty commits fall back to generic message.
+
+### Issue: History audit skipped unexpectedly
+
+**Solution**: Check if `SKIP_HISTORY_AUDIT=true` is set in environment.
+
+### Issue: Backup branch creation fails
+
+**Solution**: Script will warn but continue. Ensure you have branch creation permissions.
+
+### Issue: Pattern matching not working
+
+**Solution**: Verify file extensions are recognized. Add custom patterns to the case statements in `generate_commit_message()`.
+
+## Future Enhancements
+
+Potential improvements for the auto-git script:
+
+1. Interactive message editing before commit
+2. Custom pattern configuration files
+3. Machine learning-based message generation
+4. Integration with commit message linters
+5. Full interactive rebase for actual history rewriting
+6. Commit message templates per file type
+7. Integration with AI for more sophisticated analysis
+

   while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do

+    local detection_method=""
     
+    # Fallback 1: nc check (connection test)

+        detection_method="nc"
+      fi
+    fi

+        detection_method="ss"

+        bound=true
+        detection_method="ss (socket only)"
+      fi

+    
+    # Fallback 3: lsof check (process listening)

+        bound=true
+        detection_method="lsof (node)"
+      elif lsof -i :${port} 2>/dev/null | grep -q "LISTEN"; then
+        bound=true
+        detection_method="lsof"

-      echo "✓ Porta ${host}:${port} in ascolto"
+      echo "✓ Porta ${host}:${port} in ascolto (rilevato via $detection_method)"

+      if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        local node_pid=$(ss -tulnpe "sport = :${port}" 2>/dev/null | grep node | grep -oP 'pid=\K[0-9]+' | head -1)
+        if [ -n "$node_pid" ]; then
+          echo "  PID processo node: $node_pid"
+        fi
+      fi
       return 0
     fi
     
+    # Log diagnostico ogni 10 secondi
+    if [ $((elapsed % 10)) -eq 0 ] && [ $elapsed -gt 0 ]; then
+      echo "  ... $elapsed/${timeout}s trascorsi, porta non ancora bindata"
+    fi
+    
     sleep 1
     elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
   done
   
   echo "✗ ERRORE: Porta ${host}:${port} non si è bindata dopo ${timeout}s"

-   - Finalize with verification and completion.
-

-description: Automate comprehensive git commit-and-push workflow including project cleanup, changelog updates, and verification
----
-
-# Auto-Git
-
-## When to use
-Use this skill when you need to automate a full git maintenance and commit workflow for the project: cleanup, documentation updates, and safe commit/push with problem resolution.
-
-## When NOT to use
-Do not use for manual git operations that require human review of individual changes, or for branches where a specific custom commit message is mandated.
-
-## Inputs required
-No explicit inputs required; operates on the current workspace root.
-
-## Workflow
-1. **Resolve workspace problems**
-   - Ensure all syntax errors, lint errors, and test failures are fixed.
-   - Resolve all `@problems` before proceeding.
-
-2. **Cleanup and Maintenance**
-   - Remove superfluous files: `plans/` directory, `tests/*.bak` files, and temporary build artifacts (`dist/`, `build/`).
-   - Clean unuseful scripts (`sh`, `py`, `bat`, `mjs`) **EXCLUDING production scripts in `scripts/` and `src/` directories**.
-   - Clean unused test scripts, unused `.md` plans files, unused `.png`/`.jpg` images.
-   - Perform artifact cleanup and validate `.gitignore` staging.
-
-3. **Documentation**
-   - Update `CHANGELOG.md` (integrated directly):
-     1) Get recent git commits: `git log -n <limit> --pretty=format:%s (%h) %ad --date=short`
-     2) Read existing `CHANGELOG.md`
-     3) Append new entries under today’s date
-     4) Write back `CHANGELOG.md`
-   - Update `README.md` to ensure it is current.
-
-4. **Git workflow**
-   - Run `git status --porcelain`.
-   - **CRITICAL:** Before committing, perform `git status` to detect existing staged files. If changes are staged, `git reset` the staging area, then `git add -A` to stage ALL changes (modifications, deletions, untracked files).
-   - **CRITICAL:** Never skip production files during cleanup – always stage files from `src/`, `scripts/`, `config/`, and service configuration files before committing.
-   - Secret scanning on staged diff (`git diff --cached`).
-   - Generate conventional commit message based on staged files.
-   - Inspect old commits and clean/merge as needed to maintain clear history.
-   - Commit for every modified file, including hidden folders.
-   - Perform compliance, commit count, duplicate analysis, and squash resolution as needed.
-   - Push to remote with conflict handling (`git pull --rebase`).
-   - Verify git push succeeded and resolve any fatal errors.
-   - Finalize with verification and completion.
-
-## Examples
-- Running the skill automatically triggers the cleanup → changelog → git workflow sequence.
-- After execution, the repository should be clean, documented, and pushed.
-
-## Troubleshooting
-- If git push fails due to conflicts, perform `git pull --rebase`, resolve conflicts, and retry.
-- If staging area contains unexpected files, `git reset` and re-run `git add -A` before committing.
-- Ensure production directories are never removed during cleanup.

+    _startBackgroundRoller() {
+        // Periodically roll quota windows even without incoming requests,
+        // so providers recover from rate-limit exhaustion without needing a request.
+        this._bgTimer = setInterval(() => {
+            try {
+                const now = Date.now();

+                ).all();
+                for (const row of providers) {
+                    this._rollWindows(row.provider, false);
+                    this._rollWindows(row.provider, true);
+                }
+            } catch (err) {
+                console.error("[PROVIDER_QUOTA] Background roll error:", err.message);
+            }
+        }, 60000); // every 60s
+    }

+## v1.1.91 — 2026-10-30
+- **Fix Service Startup Crash (Duplicate Variable Declaration)**:
+  - Removed duplicate `const isHardError` declaration at `src/index.mjs:1732` inside `noteProviderFail()`
+  - The duplicate caused `SyntaxError: Identifier 'isHardError' has already been declared` at module load, preventing the server from binding port 8080
+  - This was the root cause of `restart-safe.sh` failing with "Porta 127.0.0.1:8080 non si è bindata dopo 60s" — systemd's `Restart=on-failure` kept restarting the crashed process in a loop
+  - Also ran `npm install` to restore missing `node_modules` (express and other dependencies were absent)
+- **Fix Cronologia Unificata Timestamp Overlap**:
+  - Removed orange "try N" text from active model timestamp cell in `fmtRow()` (was causing visual overflow into Provider column)
+  - Active thinking models now show only timestamp + elapsed seconds, e.g. `19:57:05 (20.6s)`
+  - Non-active rows show clean timestamp only, e.g. `19:55:24`

@@ -1,111 +0,0 @@
-# OmniRoute Bandit Proxy - AGENTS.md
-
-## Overview
-Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy router for dynamic LLM traffic distribution. Routes requests to different LLM providers based on performance metrics and feedback using Discounted UCB1.
-
-## Build/Lint/Test Commands
-
-### Build
-- `npm start` - Start the proxy server on 127.0.0.1:8080
-- `npm run dev` - Start with file watching (`--watch`)
-- `npm run check` - Validate TypeScript and JavaScript syntax (`node --check`)
-
-### Testing
-- `npm test` - Run all tests via `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`
-- `node --test tests/bandit.test.mjs` - Run single test file
-
-## Critical Non-Obvious Patterns
-
-### Bandit Algorithm (`src/bandit.mjs`)
-- **Discounted UCB1**: Uses `discountFactor=0.99` applied per feedback event, not per timestep. The `_rankCache` (30s TTL) stores precomputed rankings to avoid recalculation on every request.
-- **Catalog vs Database merge**: `selectModel()` prefers database models over catalog when conflicts exist (same provider+id). Database models carry learned `N`, `sum_reward`, `fails`, `cooldown_until`, `permanent`, `degraded`, `consecutive_5xx`.
-- **Soft bias via modes**: `profileMultiplier(profile, modelName)` from `modes-registry.mjs` applies runtime multipliers based on regex detection: `isCode`, `isThinking`, `isFast`, `isBig`, `isSmall`, `isFIM`, `isLowTPM`. These multiply the UCB1 score, not the reward.
-- **Training isolation**: Separate `models_train` table. Daemon writes there. `selectModel()` uses `models_train` × 0.3 as prior when production `N < 1`. See `train-daemon.mjs`.
-- **Fallback chain**: 6-model chain in `config/bandit.json` used when no models available after filtering. Returns first that passes token limit check.
-
-### Error Classification (`_classifyError` in `src/bandit.mjs:100-300`)
-Five actions with scope (provider/model) and reason:
-| Action | Typical Triggers |
-|--------|------------------|
-| `ban-provider` | 401/403 auth, 404 deleted, 418 teapot, 429 org-quota, 5xx repeated |
-| `ban-model` | 400 context-length, 404 model-not-found, 410 gone |
-| `cooldown-provider` | 429 rate-limit (respects `retry-after`), 5xx transient |
-| `cooldown-model` | 429 model-specific, 503 overloaded |
-| `flag-provider` | 400 validation (non-context), 408 timeout, 422 unprocessable, 502/504 gateway |
-
-Key: parses `retry-after` header (seconds or HTTP-date). `quota_exhausted` reason triggers permanent ban. `consecutive_5xx` counter on models table triggers degraded mode after 3.
-
-### Provider Quota Tracking (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
-Rolling minute/day windows per provider. Limits in `config/provider-limits.json` (RPM/RPD). `canCall(provider)` checks both windows. Quota exhaustion recorded via `recordQuotaExhausted()` → triggers provider ban with reason `quota_exhausted`.
-
-### Session Affinity (`src/index.mjs`)
-Key = MD5(systemPrompt + firstUserMessage). Stored in `sessionModelMap` with 30-min TTL (not 24h - that's for cleanup). Invalidated on model failure (non-2xx or validation fail). Max 10k entries with LRU eviction.
-
-### Three-Level Streaming Timeouts
-1. `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20s): Connection + first byte
-2. `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60s): Content-based idle timeout (resets on each chunk)
-3. `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180s): Hard cap per request (60s for summarizer profile)
-
-### Retry Loop (`src/index.mjs:800-1100`)
-`maxAttempts = Math.min(providerCount * 4 + 100, 500)`. Per-request `excludedModels` Set tracks failed (model, provider) pairs. Falls through to `fallbackModels` chain after exhaustion. Skips models exceeding `max_input_tokens` (estimated via `estimateTokens()`).
-
-### Context Compression (`compressBody`, `truncateBiggestMessage`)
-Auto-triggers when estimated tokens > 80% of model's `max_input_tokens`. Strategies: sliding window (keep system + last N), message truncation (largest first), drop tools. Preserves system prompt and last user message.
-
-### Health Checker (`src/health-check.mjs`)
-Runs every 5 min (configurable). Candidates: `permanent=1` OR `cooldown_until > 1 hour` OR `degraded=1`. Batch size 20, 15s timeout per probe. Probe request: `"ok"` with `max_tokens: 1`. Revives via `bandit.reviveModel()`.
-
-### Mode Detection (`src/modes-registry.mjs`)
-3-tier: 1) MD5 signature cache (`modes.signatures.json`) → 2) Regex patterns from `config/modes.json` (14 Zoo Code modes) → 3) Unknown → auto-discovered, persisted to `modes.discovered.json`. `detectProfile()` returns one of: `summarizer`, `code`, `reasoning`, `general`.
-
-### Notifier (`src/notifier.mjs`)
-Webhooks: Slack, Discord, Telegram, generic. Throttling: same `event+subject` max 1 per 5 min (configurable). Emoji mapping per event type.
-
-### Database Schema (6 tables, auto-migrated in `_migrateDB`)
-| Table | Key Columns |
-|-------|-------------|
-| `models` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, fails, cooldown_until, permanent, last_used_index, consecutive_5xx, degraded, degraded_since, is_paid |
-| `models_train` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, last_used_index |
-| `provider_history` | provider, fails, cooldown_until, pointer, permanent, needs_attention, attention_reason, attention_message |
-| `catalog` | id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools |
-| `meta` | key, value (counters: total_requests, total_errors, etc.) |
-| `request_logs` | timestamp, model, provider, status, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, error_type |
-
-### Environment Variables (see `.env.example`)
-Critical: `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, `OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL`, `DASHBOARD_TOKEN` (for `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/scripts/*`), `EXCLUDE_PAID`, `ONLY_FREE`, `EXCLUDE_THINKING`, `EXPLOIT_ONLY`, `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `SESSION_TTL_MS` (default 1800000 = 30min), `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20000), `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60000), `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180000).
-
-### API Endpoints
-- `POST /v1/chat/completions` - Main proxy
-- `GET /v1/metrics` - Auth required (x-api-token header or ?token=)
-- `POST /v1/reset/provider/:provider` - Clear provider bans/cooldowns
-- `POST /v1/provider/retry/:provider` - Clear `needs_attention` flag
-- `GET /v1/models` - All models with status
-- `GET /v1/providers` - Provider status
-- `GET /v1/sessions` - Active sessions
-- `GET /v1/health-check/status` - Health checker status
-- `GET /v1/logs` - Ring buffer (200 entries)
-- `GET /v1/inflight` - In-flight requests
-- `GET /v1/active` - Active request count
-- `GET /v1/scripts/*` - Script manager (list/run/status/kill/logs)
-- `GET /v1/quota` - Provider quota snapshot
-
-### Monitoring
-- Dashboard: `http://127.0.0.1:8080` (single-file `public/dashboard.html` with 6 tabs)
-- Health checks every 5 min, metrics via `/v1/metrics`
-- Logs: console (structured), `training.log` (daemon), SQLite `request_logs`
-- Ring buffer: 200 log entries with deduplication
-
-### Systemd Service
-Production deployment via `omniroute-bandit-proxy.service` (reads `.env`). See `scripts/switch-mode.sh` for mode transitions (prod/train-gentle/train/stop).
-
-### Common Pitfalls (Non-Obvious)
-1. **Provider attention flags persist**: Must call `POST /v1/provider/retry/:p` or `clearProviderAttention()` to clear `needs_attention` - health checks don't auto-clear.
-2. **Migrations are additive only**: `_migrateDB()` only ADD COLUMN, never DROP/ALTER TYPE. New columns added per release.
-3. **Session TTL is 30 min, not 24h**: `SESSION_TTL_MS` default 1800000. The 24h in old docs is stale.
-4. **Token estimation is approximate**: `estimateTokens()` uses 4 chars/token heuristic. For precise limits, rely on upstream 413 errors.
-5. **Fallback models bypass bandit**: When all ranked models fail, fallback chain from config is used without UCB1 scoring.
-6. **Training mode isolates writes**: Daemon writes to `models_train`. Production reads from `models` + blends `models_train × 0.3` as prior only when `N < 1`.
-7. **Quota limits are per-provider, not per-model**: `config/provider-limits.json` defines RPM/RPD at provider level.
-8. **Soft bias multipliers stack**: A model matching multiple patterns (e.g., `isCode` + `isFast`) gets product of multipliers.
-9. **Stream idle timeout resets on ANY chunk**: Not just content chunks - SSE comments/heartbeats also reset the 60s timer.
-10. **Ring buffer deduplication**: Consecutive identical log lines are collapsed with count suffix.
\ No newline at end of file

+function createLogEntry(message) {
+  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
+
+  // Determine source and type from message content
+  let source = 'system';
+  let type = null;
+  let provider = null;
+  let status = null;
+  let is_paid = false;
+
+  if (/\[BAN\]|\[BANNED\]|ban-provider|ban_model/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'ban';
+    type = 'ban';
+  } else if (/\[COOLDOWN\]|cooldown-provider|cooldown_model/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'cooldown';
+    type = 'cooldown';
+  } else if (/\[FLAG\]|flag-provider/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'flag';
+    type = 'flag';
+  } else if (/\[DEGRADED\]/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'degraded';
+    type = 'degraded';
+  } else if (/\[TRAIN\]|\[TRAINING\]|training daemon|train-daemon/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'training';
+  } else if (/\[DEBUG\]|debug verbose/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'debug';
+  } else if (/\[ZOO\]/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'zoo';
+  } else if (/\[SUCCESS\]/i.test(message)) {
+    source = 'zoo';
+  }
+
+  // Try to extract provider from patterns like "[provider/model]"
+  const providerMatch = message.match(/\[([a-z0-9_-]+)\/[a-z0-9_-]+\/?/i);
+  if (providerMatch) provider = providerMatch[1];
+
+  // Try to extract HTTP status codes
+  const statusMatch = message.match(/\b([45]\d{2})\b/);
+  if (statusMatch) status = statusMatch[1];
+
+  // Check for paid-only indicators
+  if (/paid-only|is_paid.*1|PAID-ONLY/i.test(message)) is_paid = true;
+
+  return { timestamp, source, type, provider, status, message, is_paid };
+}

+# auto-git
+
+Automate comprehensive git commit-and-push workflow including project cleanup, changelog updates, and verification.
+
+## Usage
+
+Type `/auto-git` in the chat to execute this command.
+
+## Workflow
+
+This command invokes the `auto-git` skill, which performs the following steps:
+
+1. **Resolve workspace problems**
+   - Ensure all syntax errors, lint errors, and test failures are fixed.
+   - Resolve all `@problems` before proceeding.
+
+2. **Cleanup and Maintenance**
+   - Remove superfluous files: `plans/` directory, `tests/*.bak` files, and temporary build artifacts (`dist/`, `build/`).
+   - Clean unuseful scripts (`sh`, `py`, `bat`, `mjs`) **EXCLUDING production scripts in `scripts/` and `src/` directories**.
+   - Clean unused test scripts, unused `.md` plans files, unused `.png`/`.jpg` images.
+   - Perform artifact cleanup and validate `.gitignore` staging.
+
+3. **Documentation**
+   - Update `CHANGELOG.md` (integrated directly):
+     1) Get recent git commits: `git log -n <limit> --pretty=format:%s (%h) %ad --date=short`
+     2) Read existing `CHANGELOG.md`
+     3) Append new entries under today's date
+     4) Write back `CHANGELOG.md`
+   - Update `README.md` to ensure it is current.
+
+4. **Git workflow**
+   - Run `git status --porcelain`.
+   - **CRITICAL:** Before committing, perform `git status` to detect existing staged files. If changes are staged, `git reset` the staging area, then `git add -A` to stage ALL changes (modifications, deletions, untracked files).
+   - **CRITICAL:** Never skip production files during cleanup – always stage files from `src/`, `scripts/`, `config/`, and service configuration files before committing.
+   - Secret scanning on staged diff (`git diff --cached`).
+   - Generate conventional commit message based on staged files.
+   - Inspect old commits and clean/merge as needed to maintain clear history.
+   - Commit for every modified file, including hidden folders.
+   - Perform compliance, commit count, duplicate analysis, and squash resolution as needed.
+   - Push to remote with conflict handling (`git pull --rebase`).
+   - Verify git push succeeded and resolve any fatal errors.
+   - Finalize with verification and completion.
+
+## When NOT to use
+Do not use for manual git operations that require human review of individual changes, or for branches where a specific custom commit message is mandated.
