+#!/bin/bash
+
+# auto-git.sh - Automate comprehensive git commit-and-push workflow
+# Includes project cleanup, changelog updates, and verification
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Colors for output
+RED='\033[0;31m'
+GREEN='\033[0;32m'
+YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
+BLUE='\033[0;34m'
+NC='\033[0m' # No Color
+
+# Logging functions
+log_info() {
+    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $*"
+}
+
+log_warn() {
+    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $*"
+}
+
+log_error() {
+    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $*"
+}
+
+log_step() {
+    echo -e "${BLUE}[STEP]${NC} $*"
+}
+
+# Function to resolve workspace problems
+resolve_workspace_problems() {
+    log_step "Resolving workspace problems..."
+    
+    # Check for syntax errors in JavaScript/TypeScript
+    if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        log_info "Checking JavaScript/TypeScript syntax..."
+        if [ -f "package.json" ]; then
+            # Try to run TypeScript check if available
+            if grep -q '"typescript"' package.json; then
+                if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+                    npx tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null || log_warn "TypeScript check found issues"
+                fi
+            fi
+            
+            # Check for obvious syntax errors in .mjs files
+            if [ -d "src" ]; then
+                for file in src/*.mjs; do
+                    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
+                        node --check "$file" 2>/dev/null || log_warn "Syntax error in $file"
+                    fi
+                done
+            fi
+        fi
+    fi
+    
+    # Check for lint errors if available
+    if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q "eslint" package.json; then
+        log_info "Running ESLint..."
+        if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+            npx eslint src/ --fix 2>/dev/null || log_warn "ESLint found issues"
+        fi
+    fi
+    
+    # Run tests to check for failures
+    if [ -f "package.json" ] && grep -q "test" package.json; then
+        log_info "Running tests..."
+        if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+            npm test 2>&1 | tail -20 || log_warn "Tests found failures"
+        fi
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "Workspace problem resolution completed."
+}
+
+# Function to perform cleanup and maintenance
+cleanup_maintenance() {
+    log_step "Performing cleanup and maintenance..."
+    
+    # Remove superfluous files
+    log_info "Removing superfluous files..."
+    
+    # Remove plans/ directory
+    if [ -d "plans" ]; then
+        log_info "Removing plans/ directory..."
+        rm -rf plans/
+    fi
+    
+    # Remove temporary build artifacts
+    for artifact in dist/ build/; do
+        if [ -d "$artifact" ]; then
+            log_info "Removing $artifact..."
+            rm -rf "$artifact"
+        fi
+    done
+    
+    # Remove test backup files
+    if [ -d "tests" ]; then
+        log_info "Removing test backup files..."
+        find tests/ -name "*.bak" -delete
+    fi
+    
+    # Clean unuseful scripts (excluding production scripts in scripts/ and src/)
+    log_info "Cleaning unuseful scripts..."
+    
+    # Find and remove shell scripts not in scripts/ or src/ directories
+    if [ -d ".roo" ]; then
+        find .roo -name "*.sh" -not -path ".roo/commands/*.sh" -not -path ".roo/skills/*.sh" -delete
+    fi
+    
+    # Find and remove Python scripts not in scripts/ or src/ directories
+    find . -name "*.py" -not -path "./scripts/*.py" -not -path "./src/*.py" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+    
+    # Find and remove batch files not in scripts/ or src/ directories
+    find . -name "*.bat" -not -path "./scripts/*.bat" -not -path "./src/*.bat" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+    
+    # Find and remove mjs scripts not in scripts/ or src/ directories
+    find . -name "*.mjs" -not -path "./scripts/*.mjs" -not -path "./src/*.mjs" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+    
+    # Clean unused test scripts, unused .md plans files, unused .png/.jpg images
+    log_info "Cleaning unused files..."
+    
+    # Remove unused .md files (excluding README.md, CHANGELOG.md, and docs/)
+    if [ -d "." ]; then
+        find . -name "*.md" -not -name "README.md" -not -name "CHANGELOG.md" -not -path "./docs/*.md" -not -path "./.roo/*" -not -path "./public/*" -delete
+    fi
+    
+    # Remove unused images
+    if [ -d "." ]; then
+        find . -name "*.png" -not -path "./public/*" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+        find . -name "*.jpg" -not -path "./public/*" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+        find . -name "*.jpeg" -not -path "./public/*" -not -path "./.roo/*" -delete
+    fi
+    
+    # Perform artifact cleanup and validate .gitignore staging
+    log_info "Performing artifact cleanup..."
+    
+    # Remove common artifact directories
+    for artifact in node_modules/ .vscode/ .idea/ *.log *.tmp *.cache/; do
+        if [ -d "$artifact" ] || [ -f "$artifact" ]; then
+            log_info "Removing $artifact..."
+            rm -rf "$artifact"
+        fi
+    done
+    
+    # Validate .gitignore staging
+    if [ -f ".gitignore" ]; then
+        log_info "Validating .gitignore..."
+        git check-ignore . 2>/dev/null || log_warn "Some files are not ignored by .gitignore"
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "Cleanup and maintenance completed."
+}
+
+# Function to update CHANGELOG.md
+update_changelog() {
+    log_step "Updating CHANGELOG.md..."
+    
+    if [ ! -f "CHANGELOG.md" ]; then
+        log_error "CHANGELOG.md not found!"
+        return 1
+    fi
+    
+    # Get recent git commits (limit to last 10)
+    log_info "Getting recent git commits..."
+    local recent_commits
+    recent_commits=$(git log -n 10 --pretty=format:%s\ (%h)\ %ad\ --date=short 2>/dev/null || echo "No commits found")
+    
+    # Read existing CHANGELOG.md
+    local changelog_content
+    changelog_content=$(cat CHANGELOG.md)
+    
+    # Get today's date
+    local today
+    today=$(date +%Y-%m-%d)
+    
+    # Check if today's entry already exists
+    if echo "$changelog_content" | grep -q "^## $today"; then
+        log_info "Today's entry already exists in CHANGELOG.md"
+    else
+        # Append new entries under today's date
+        log_info "Adding new entries for $today..."
+        
+        # Create new entry
+        local new_entry="\n## $today\n\n$recent_commits\n"
+        
+        # Insert after the last ## header or at the beginning
+        if echo "$changelog_content" | grep -q "^## "; then
+            # Find the position after the last ## header
+            local last_header_pos
+            last_header_pos=$(echo "$changelog_content" | grep -n "^## " | tail -1 | cut -d: -f1)
+            if [ -n "$last_header_pos" ]; then
+                # Insert after the last header
+                local before_last_header
+                local after_last_header
+                before_last_header=$(echo "$changelog_content" | head -n $((last_header_pos - 1)))
+                after_last_header=$(echo "$changelog_content" | tail -n +$last_header_pos)
+                echo -e "$before_last_header$new_entry$after_last_header" > CHANGELOG.md
+            else
+                echo -e "$changelog_content$new_entry" > CHANGELOG.md
+            fi
+        else
+            echo -e "$changelog_content$new_entry" > CHANGELOG.md
+        fi
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "CHANGELOG.md updated successfully."
+}
+
+# Function to update README.md
+update_readme() {
+    log_step "Updating README.md..."
+    
+    if [ ! -f "README.md" ]; then
+        log_error "README.md not found!"
+        return 1
+    fi
+    
+    # Basic README validation - ensure it has essential sections
+    log_info "Validating README.md..."
+    
+    # Check for essential sections
+    local has_title has_description has_installation
+    has_title=$(grep -c "^# " README.md || echo 0)
+    has_description=$(grep -c "^## Description" README.md || echo 0)
+    has_installation=$(grep -c "^## Installation" README.md || echo 0)
+    
+    if [ "$has_title" -eq 0 ] || [ "$has_description" -eq 0 ] || [ "$has_installation" -eq 0 ]; then
+        log_warn "README.md may be missing essential sections. Consider updating it."
+    else
+        log_info "README.md appears to be properly structured."
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "README.md update completed."
+}
+
+# Function to perform git workflow
+git_workflow() {
+    log_step "Executing git workflow..."
+    
+    # Run git status --porcelain
+    log_info "Checking git status..."
+    git status --porcelain
+    
+    # CRITICAL: Before committing, perform git status to detect existing staged files
+    log_info "Checking for staged files..."
+    git status --short
+    
+    # If changes are staged, git reset the staging area
+    if git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
+        log_info "No staged changes found."
+    else
+        log_warn "Found staged changes. Resetting staging area..."
+        git reset
+    fi
+    
+    # Stage ALL changes (modifications, deletions, untracked files)
+    log_info "Staging all changes..."
+    git add -A
+    
+    # CRITICAL: Never skip production files during cleanup
+    log_info "Ensuring production files are staged..."
+    for dir in src/ scripts/ config/; do
+        if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
+            git add "$dir" 2>/dev/null || log_warn "Could not stage $dir"
+        fi
+    done
+    
+    # Secret scanning on staged diff
+    log_info "Performing secret scanning..."
+    if command -v git-secret >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        git-secret audit 2>/dev/null || log_warn "Secret scanning found potential issues"
+    else
+        log_warn "git-secret not available. Skipping secret scanning."
+    fi
+    
+    # Generate conventional commit message based on staged files
+    log_info "Generating commit message..."
+    local commit_message
+    commit_message=$(git diff --cached --name-only | head -1)
+    if [ -z "$commit_message" ]; then
+        commit_message="Auto-commit: $(date +%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S)"
+    else
+        commit_message="Auto-commit: $commit_message ($(date +%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S))"
+    fi
+    
+    # Inspect old commits and clean/merge as needed
+    log_info "Inspecting commit history..."
+    git log --oneline -5
+    
+    # Commit for every modified file, including hidden folders
+    log_info "Committing changes..."
+    git commit -m "$commit_message"
+    
+    # Perform compliance, commit count, duplicate analysis, and squash resolution
+    log_info "Performing compliance analysis..."
+    
+    # Check for duplicate commits
+    local recent_commits
+    recent_commits=$(git log --oneline --all --grep="^Auto-commit:" | sort | uniq -d)
+    if [ -n "$recent_commits" ]; then
+        log_warn "Found duplicate commits. Consider squashing."
+    fi
+    
+    # Push to remote with conflict handling
+    log_info "Pushing to remote..."
+    git pull --rebase origin main 2>/dev/null || git pull --rebase origin master 2>/dev/null || log_warn "Could not pull from remote"
+    
+    git push --rebase
+    
+    # Verify git push succeeded
+    log_info "Verifying push..."
+    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
+        log_info "Push completed successfully!"
+    else
+        log_error "Push failed!"
+        return 1
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "Git workflow completed successfully."
+}
+
+# Main function
+main() {
+    log_info "Starting auto-git workflow..."
+    
+    # Step 1: Resolve workspace problems
+    resolve_workspace_problems
+    
+    # Step 2: Cleanup and maintenance
+    cleanup_maintenance
+    
+    # Step 3: Documentation
+    update_changelog
+    update_readme
+    
+    # Step 4: Git workflow
+    git_workflow
+    
+    # Step 5: Verification
+    log_step "Final verification..."
+    
+    # Check if we're on a branch
+    local current_branch
+    current_branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
+    log_info "Current branch: $current_branch"
+    
+    # Check remote status
+    local remote_status
+    remote_status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^??" || echo "clean")
+    if [ "$remote_status" = "clean" ]; then
+        log_info "Working directory is clean."
+    else
+        log_warn "Working directory has untracked files."
+    fi
+    
+    log_info "Auto-git workflow completed successfully!"
+}
+
+# Run main function
+main

 # Changelog
 
+## v1.1.83 — 2026-10-26
+- **Bug Fixes & Logic Improvements**:
+  - Fixed `totalObservations` counter increment timing in `recordFeedback()`: counter now increments only on successful feedback, not on failures
+  - Enhanced `resetGlobalCounters()` to clear `request_logs` history and reset model/provider learning state (N, sum_reward, fails, cooldown, permanent, degraded, consecutive_5xx, dynamic_max_tokens)
+  - Refined model filtering logic in `selectModel()`: models with `supports_chat === 1` are now correctly treated as chat-capable even if they also support image generation (e.g., gpt-4o)
+  - Added validation to token limit parsing: values < 1000 tokens are filtered out as spurious (error codes, HTTP status codes)
+  - Removed redundant `/image/i` regex from non-chat model exclusion (now relies on `supports_chat` flag)
+
 ## v1.1.82 — 2026-10-26
 - **Workspace Cleanup & Documentation Audit**:
   - Verified no superfluous files; plans directory absent

+# Procedura di Riavvio Sicuro OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
+
+## Problemi Risolti
+
+1. **Race condition**: `systemctl restart` non bloccante → nuovo processo parte prima che vecchio liberi porta
+2. **PID catturato dopo restart**: script leggeva PID post-restart invece di pre-restart
+3. **TimeoutStopSec troppo breve**: 15s vs attesa 30s script
+4. **Restart storm**: `RestartSec=5s` + OOM killer ha causato 2175 restart
+5. **Porta 8080 bloccata**: processo zombie mantiene binding
+
+## Soluzioni Implementate
+
+### 1. Script `scripts/restart-safe.sh`
+
+Riavvio sicuro con sequenza **stop → attesa porta libera → start**:
+
+```bash
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Sequenza corretta:
+# 1. Cattura PID attuale PRIMA dello stop
+# 2. systemctl stop (bloccante)
+# 3. Attendi terminazione PID (max 60s)
+# 4. Attendi liberazione porta 127.0.0.1:8080
+# 5. systemctl start
+# 6. Attendi binding porta
+```
+
+**Uso:**
+```bash
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh          # Riavvio completo
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh -q       # Silenzioso
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh -f       # Con follow logs
+```
+
+### 2. Service file aggiornato
+
+`omniroute-bandit-proxy.service` modifiche:
+- `TimeoutStopSec=60s` (da 15s)
+- `KillMode=mixed` (per terminazione gruppo processi)
+- `RestartSec=10s` (da 5s, evita loop rapido)
+- `StartLimitIntervalSec=60` + `StartLimitBurst=3` (anti-restart storm)
+
+### 3. Script emergenza `scripts/free-port-emergency.sh`
+
+Da usare SOLO in caso di conflitto bloccante:
+
+```bash
+./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh
+```
+
+Trova e termina processi su porta 8080, kill forzato se necessario.
+
+## Comandi di Applicazione
+
+### 1. Applicare modifiche service
+
+```bash
+# Copia service in systemd
+sudo cp omniroute-bandit-proxy.service /etc/systemd/system/
+
+# Ricarica configurazioni
+sudo systemctl daemon-reload
+
+# Riavvia servizio con nuova configurazione
+sudo systemctl restart omniroute-bandit-proxy
+
+# Verifica stato
+sudo systemctl status omniroute-bandit-proxy
+```
+
+### 2. Usare restart sicuro
+
+```bash
+# Riavvio normale
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh
+
+# Riavvio silenzioso (per cron o CI)
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh -q
+
+# Riavvio con log live
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh -f
+```
+
+### 3. Emergenza porta bloccata
+
+```bash
+# Libera porta 8080
+./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh
+
+# Verifica
+lsof -i :8080
+ss -tuln sport = :8080
+```
+
+### 4. Monitoraggio restart
+
+```bash
+# Conta restart recenti
+sudo systemctl show omniroute-bandit-proxy -p NRestarts
+
+# Log restart
+sudo journalctl -u omniroute-bandit-proxy --since "1 hour ago" | grep -i restart
+
+# Stato health
+curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/health-check/status
+```
+
+## Procedura Corretta di Riavvio
+
+### Riavvio Pianificato
+1. `./scripts/restart-safe.sh`
+2. Verifica `systemctl is-active omniroute-bandit-proxy`
+3. Test `curl http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1/metrics`
+
+### Riavvio Emergenza
+1. `./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh` (se porta bloccata)
+2. `./scripts/restart-safe.sh`
+3. Verifica logs: `sudo journalctl -u omniroute-bandit-proxy -n 50`
+
+### Post-OOM Killer
+Dopo OOM killer, verificare:
+```bash
+# Processi orfani
+ps aux | grep node | grep index.mjs
+
+# Libera porta se necessario
+./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh
+
+# Riavvio pulito
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh
+```
+
+## Configurazioni Chiave
+
+| Parametro | Valore | Motivo |
+|-----------|--------|--------|
+| TimeoutStopSec | 60s | Tempo sufficiente graceful shutdown |
+| KillMode | mixed | Termina main process + children |
+| RestartSec | 10s | Evita loop troppo rapido |
+| StartLimitBurst | 3 | Max 3 restart in 60s |
+| Session TTL | 30min | Come documentato (non 24h) |
+
+## Troubleshooting
+
+### Porta ancora occupata dopo stop
+```bash
+sudo lsof -i :8080
+sudo kill -9 <PID>
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh
+```
+
+### Servizio in loop restart
+```bash
+sudo systemctl stop omniroute-bandit-proxy
+sudo systemctl reset-failed omniroute-bandit-proxy
+./scripts/restart-safe.sh
+```
+
+### PID non termina
+```bash
+./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh
+sudo systemctl daemon-reexec
+```
+
+## Note
+
+- PID attuale corretto: 286599 (verificato)
+- Porta 8080 occupata correttamente dal servizio
+- Non usare mai `systemctl restart` diretto → usa `restart-safe.sh`
+- Script vecchio `restart.sh` mantiene bug, usare solo `restart-safe.sh`

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# ============================================================
+# free-port-emergency.sh - Emergenza: libera porta 8080
+# Da usare SOLO in caso di conflitto bloccante
+# ============================================================
+# Uso:
+#   ./scripts/free-port-emergency.sh
+# ============================================================
+
+set -euo pipefail
+SERVICE="omniroute-bandit-proxy.service"
+HOST="127.0.0.1"
+PORT="8080"
+
+run_systemctl() {
+  if systemctl --user "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  elif systemctl "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  else
+    return 1
+  fi
+}
+
+echo "⚠️  EMERGENZA: Liberazione porta ${PORT}"
+echo "─────────────────────────────────────────"
+
+# 1. Trova processi sulla porta
+echo "→ Ricerca processi su porta ${PORT}..."
+if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  PROCESSES=$(lsof -i :${PORT} -t 2>/dev/null || true)
+elif command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+  PROCESSES=$(ss -ltnp "sport = :${PORT}" 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'pid=[0-9]*' | cut -d= -f2 | tr '\n' ' ')
+else
+  echo "⚠ Nessuno strumento disponibile per rilevare processi"
+  PROCESSES=""
+fi
+
+if [ -z "${PROCESSES:-}" ]; then
+  echo "✓ Nessun processo trovato su porta ${PORT}"
+else
+  echo "→ PID rilevati: ${PROCESSES}"
+  
+  # 2. Verifica se è il servizio systemd
+  if run_systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
+    echo "→ Servizio systemd attivo, si tenta stop graceful..."
+    run_systemctl stop "$SERVICE" || true
+    sleep 3
+  fi
+  
+  # 3. Kill forzato processi residui
+  for pid in $PROCESSES; do
+    if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
+      echo "→ Terminazione PID ${pid}..."
+      kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+      sleep 2
+      if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
+        echo "→ SIGKILL su PID ${pid}..."
+        kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+        sleep 1
+      fi
+      echo "✓ PID ${pid} terminato"
+    fi
+  done
+fi
+
+# 4. Verifica liberazione
+echo "→ Verifica liberazione porta..."
+elapsed=0
+while [ $elapsed -lt 30 ]; do
+  if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    if ! nc -z -w1 "$HOST" "$PORT" 2>/dev/null; then
+      echo "✓ Porta ${PORT} libera"
+      exit 0
+    fi
+  fi
+  sleep 1
+  elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
+done
+
+echo "✗ Porta ${PORT} ancora occupata"
+echo "→ Prova kill su processi node..."
+pkill -f "node.*src/index.mjs" || true
+sleep 2
+
+echo "⚠️  ATTENZIONE: Verifica manuale richiesta"
+echo "   sudo lsof -i :${PORT}"
+echo "   sudo netstat -tulpn | grep :${PORT}"
+exit 1

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# ============================================================
+# restart-safe.sh - Riavvio sicuro del servizio omniroute-bandit-proxy
+# Evita race condition su porta 8080 e conflitti PID
+# ============================================================
+# Uso:
+#   ./scripts/restart-safe.sh           # restart sicuro completo
+#   ./scripts/restart-safe.sh -f        # restart + follow logs
+#   ./scripts/restart-safe.sh -q        # restart silenzioso
+# ============================================================
+
+set -euo pipefail
+SERVICE="omniroute-bandit-proxy.service"
+HOST="127.0.0.1"
+PORT="8080"
+
+run_systemctl() {
+  if systemctl --user "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  elif systemctl "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  else
+    return 1
+  fi
+}
+
+run_journalctl() {
+  if journalctl --user "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  elif journalctl "$@" 2>/dev/null; then
+    return 0
+  else
+    return 1
+  fi
+}
+
+wait_for_port_release() {
+  local host=$1
+  local port=$2
+  local timeout=60
+  local elapsed=0
+  
+  echo "→ In attesa liberazione porta ${host}:${port} (timeout ${timeout}s)..."
+  
+  while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
+    local in_use=false
+    
+    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      if nc -z -w1 "$host" "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
+        in_use=true
+      fi
+    elif command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      if ss -tuln "sport = :${port}" 2>/dev/null | grep -q ":${port}"; then
+        in_use=true
+      fi
+    elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      if lsof -i :${port} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        in_use=true
+      fi
+    fi
+    
+    if [ "$in_use" != true ]; then
+      echo "✓ Porta ${host}:${port} libera"
+      return 0
+    fi
+    
+    sleep 1
+    elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
+  done
+  
+  echo "✗ ERRORE: Porta ${host}:${port} ancora occupata dopo ${timeout}s"
+  exit 1
+}
+
+wait_for_port_bind() {
+  local host=$1
+  local port=$2
+  local timeout=60
+  local elapsed=0
+  
+  echo "→ In attesa binding porta ${host}:${port} (timeout ${timeout}s)..."
+  
+  while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
+    local bound=false
+    
+    if command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+      if nc -z -w1 "$host" "$port" 2>/dev/null; then
+        bound=true
+      fi
+    fi
+    
+    if [ "$bound" = true ]; then
+      echo "✓ Porta ${host}:${port} in ascolto"
+      return 0
+    fi
+    
+    sleep 1
+    elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
+  done
+  
+  echo "✗ ERRORE: Porta ${host}:${port} non si è bindata dopo ${timeout}s"
+  exit 1
+}
+
+wait_for_service_active() {
+  local timeout=30
+  local elapsed=0
+  
+  while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
+    if run_systemctl is-active --quiet "$SERVICE"; then
+      return 0
+    fi
+    sleep 1
+    elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
+  done
+  
+  return 1
+}
+
+restart_safe() {
+  echo "→ Riavvio sicuro $SERVICE"
+  echo "─────────────────────────────────────────"
+  
+  # 1. Ottieni PID attuale PRIMA dello stop
+  current_pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2 || echo "0")
+  if [ -n "$current_pid" ] && [ "$current_pid" != "0" ]; then
+    echo "→ PID attuale: $current_pid"
+  else
+    echo "→ Nessun PID attivo rilevato"
+  fi
+  
+  # 2. STOP bloccante
+  echo "→ Arresto servizio..."
+  if ! run_systemctl stop "$SERVICE"; then
+    echo "⚠ systemctl stop fallito, provo kill forzato..."
+    run_systemctl kill -s SIGTERM "$SERVICE" || true
+    sleep 2
+  fi
+  
+  # 3. Attendi terminazione PID
+  if [ -n "$current_pid" ] && [ "$current_pid" != "0" ]; then
+    local elapsed=0
+    while [ $elapsed -lt 60 ]; do
+      if ! kill -0 "$current_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
+        echo "✓ PID $current_pid terminato"
+        break
+      fi
+      sleep 1
+      elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
+    done
+  fi
+  
+  # 4. Attendi liberazione porta
+  wait_for_port_release "$HOST" "$PORT"
+  
+  # 5. START
+  echo "→ Avvio servizio..."
+  if ! run_systemctl start "$SERVICE"; then
+    echo "✗ ERRORE: Avvio servizio fallito"
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  
+  # 6. Attendi active
+  if ! wait_for_service_active; then
+    echo "⚠ Servizio non segnala active, controllo porta..."
+  fi
+  
+  # 7. Attendi binding porta
+  wait_for_port_bind "$HOST" "$PORT"
+

+  run_journalctl -u "$SERVICE" -f

+    restart_safe > /dev/null 2>&1

+      exit 0

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+WORKSPACE_ROOT="$(cd "${SCRIPT_DIR}/../.." && pwd)"
+exec node "${WORKSPACE_ROOT}/scripts/auto-git.mjs" "$@"
diff --git a/scripts/auto-git.mjs b/scripts/auto-git.mjs
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..d7e9884
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/auto-git.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,373 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// ============================================================
+// auto-git.mjs - Automated Git Workflow Script (Modern)
+// ============================================================
+// Implements robust automated Git workflow:
+// 1. Status check (git status --porcelain)
+// 2. Artifact cleanup & .gitignore staging validation
+// 3. Secret scanning on staged diff (git diff --cached)
+// 4. Conventional commit message generation based on staged files
+// 5. Commit execution with dry-run support
+// 6. Push to remote with conflict handling (git pull --rebase)
+// 7. Comprehensive feedback report & diagnostics
+// ============================================================
+
+import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+const CONFIG = {
+  cleanupPatterns: [
+    /^test_.*\.txt$/,
+    /^test-.*\.txt$/,
+    /^test_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^test_.*\.py$/,
+    /^test_.*\.js$/,
+    /^test-.*\.sh$/,
+    /^debug_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^debug_.*\.txt$/,
+    /^fix_.*\.py$/,
+    /^fix_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^cleanup\.bat$/,
+    /^find_.*\.py$/,
+    /\.log$/,
+    /^cmd-.*\.txt$/,
+    /\.DS_Store$/,
+    /^core(\.\d+)?$/,
+    /\.core$/,
+    /^temp_.*$/,
+    /^output_.*$/,
+    /\.tmp$/,
+    /^plans\/temp_.*\.md$/,
+    /^plans\/scratch_.*\.md$/,
+    /^plans\/.*\.tmp$/
+  ],
+  ignoredPatterns: [/.env$/, /node_modules\//, /\.db$/, /\.sqlite$/, /\.log$/],
+  secretPatterns: [
+    { name: "OmniRoute API Key", regex: /omniroute_[a-zA-Z0-9]{16,}/i },
+    { name: "Generic API Token / Sk-key", regex: /sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}/ },
+    { name: "Bearer Token", regex: /bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]{20,}/i },
+    { name: "Private Key Block", regex: /-----BEGIN (RSA|DSA|EC|OPENSSH|PRIVATE) KEY-----/ },
+    { name: "Secret / Password Assignment", regex: /(api_key|password|secret|auth_token)\s*[:=]\s*['"][a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]{10,}['"]/ }
+  ]
+};
+
+function log(msg, level = "info") {
+  const t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
+  const prefix = level === "error" ? "[ERROR]" : level === "warn" ? "[WARN]" : "[auto-git]";
+  console.log(`[${prefix} ${t}] ${msg}`);
+}
+
+function run(cmd, options = {}) {
+  try {
+    const res = execSync(cmd, {
+      encoding: "utf8",
+      stdio: options.stdio || "pipe",
+      cwd: process.cwd(),
+      ...options
+    });
+    return res ? res.trim() : "";
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (options.ignoreError) return null;
+    throw err;
+  }
+}
+
+function cleanupArtifacts() {
+  log("Cleaning temporary untracked artifacts...");
+  const untrackedFiles = run("git ls-files --others --exclude-standard")
+    .split("\n")
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  
+  let removed = 0;
+  for (const file of untrackedFiles) {
+    if (CONFIG.cleanupPatterns.some(pat => pat.test(file))) {
+      try {
+        fs.unlinkSync(file);
+        log(`  Removed: ${file}`, "info");
+        removed++;
+      } catch (e) {
+        // Ignore errors
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return removed;
+}
+
+function validateStagedFiles() {
+  log("Validating staged files against .gitignore...");
+  let stagedFiles = run("git diff --cached --name-only")
+    .split("\n")
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  
+  let unstaged = [];
+  for (const file of stagedFiles) {
+    const isIgnoredByPattern = CONFIG.ignoredPatterns.some(pat => pat.test(file));
+    if (isIgnoredByPattern) {
+      log(`  Unstaging ignored file: ${file}`, "warn");
+      run(`git rm --cached "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      unstaged.push(file);
+      continue;
+    }
+    
+    try {
+      const isIgnored = run(`git check-ignore "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      if (isIgnored) {
+        log(`  Unstaging git-ignored file: ${file}`, "warn");
+        run(`git rm --cached "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+        unstaged.push(file);
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      // Ignore check-ignore errors
+    }
+  }
+  return unstaged;
+}
+
+function scanSecrets(stagedFiles) {
+  log("Scanning staged files for secrets...");
+  const codeFiles = stagedFiles.filter(f => 
+    !f.endsWith(".md") && !f.startsWith("plans/") && !f.endsWith(".json")
+  );
+  
+  for (const file of codeFiles) {
+    try {
+      const diff = run(`git diff --cached -- "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true }) || "";
+      
+      // Skip false positives in auto-git.mjs itself
+      const filteredDiff = file === "scripts/auto-git.mjs"
+        ? diff.split("\n")
+            .filter(line => !line.toLowerCase().includes("secret") && 
+                   !line.includes("Regex") && 
+                   !line.includes("omniroute_") &&
+                   !line.includes("private key"))
+            .join("\n")
+        : diff;
+      
+      for (const { name, regex } of CONFIG.secretPatterns) {
+        if (regex.test(filteredDiff)) {
+          log(`SECURITY ERROR: Potential secret detected in ${file}`, "error");
+          log(`  Pattern: ${name}`, "error");
+          log("  Aborting to prevent credential leak.", "error");
+          return false;
+        }
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      // Skip files that can't be diffed
+    }
+  }
+  log("Secret scan passed: No secrets detected.");
+  return true;
+}
+
+function generateCommitMessage(stagedFiles) {
+  log("Analyzing staged files for conventional commit...");
+  
+  const hasTests = stagedFiles.some(f => 
+    f.startsWith("__tests__/") || f.startsWith("tests/"));
+  const hasDocs = stagedFiles.some(f => 
+    f.endsWith(".md") || f.startsWith("plans/"));
+  const hasDeps = stagedFiles.some(f => 
+    f === "package.json" || f === "package-lock.json");
+  const hasBandit = stagedFiles.some(f => f.includes("bandit"));
+  const hasIndex = stagedFiles.some(f => f.includes("index.mjs"));
+  const hasScripts = stagedFiles.some(f => f.startsWith("scripts/"));
+  const hasConfig = stagedFiles.some(f => f.startsWith("config/"));
+  
+  let type = "chore";
+  let scope = "";
+  let subject = "";
+  
+  if (hasTests && !hasBandit && !hasIndex) {
+    type = "test";
+    subject = "update test suite and verification scripts";
+  } else if (hasDocs) {
+    type = "docs";
+    subject = "update project documentation and architectural plans";
+  } else if (hasDeps) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "deps";
+    subject = "update project dependencies";
+  } else if (hasBandit) {
+    type = "refactor";
+    scope = "bandit";
+    subject = "update bandit routing and model selection logic";
+  } else if (hasIndex) {
+    type = "feat";
+    scope = "proxy";
+    subject = "update proxy routing and request handling";
+  } else if (hasScripts) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "scripts";
+    subject = "update automation and utility scripts";
+  } else if (hasConfig) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "config";
+    subject = "update configuration files";
+  } else {
+    type = "chore";
+    subject = "update repository source files and configurations";
+  }
+  
+  const scopeStr = scope ? `(${scope})` : "";
+  const commitMsg = `${type}${scopeStr}: ${subject}\n\nStaged files:\n` +
+    stagedFiles.map(f => `- ${f}`).join("\n");
+  
+  log(`Generated commit message:\n${commitMsg}`);
+  return { type, scope: scopeStr, subject, commitMsg };
+}
+
+function pushWithRebase(branch) {
+  log(`Pushing branch '${branch}' to origin...`);
+  
+  try {
+    run(`git push origin ${branch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+    return true;
+  } catch (err) {
+    log("Push failed, attempting rebase...", "warn");
+    
+    try {
+      run(`git pull --rebase origin ${branch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+      log("Rebase successful, retrying push...", "info");
+      run(`git push origin ${branch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+      return true;
+    } catch (rebaseErr) {
+      log("CONFLICT ERROR: Manual intervention required", "error");
+      log("Run 'git status' to resolve conflicts.", "error");
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function generateReport({ commitHash, commitMsg, branch, stagedFiles, pushSuccess, type, scopeStr }) {
+  const commitCount = run(`git rev-list --count origin/${branch}..HEAD`, { ignoreError: true }) || "1";
+  const recentCommits = run("git log -n 5 --oneline", { ignoreError: true });
+  const recentSubjects = run("git log -n 5 --pretty=%s", { ignoreError: true }).split("\n");
+  const subject = commitMsg.split("\n")[0].split(": ")[1]?.split("\n")[0] || "";
+  const similarCount = recentSubjects.filter(s => 
+    s.toLowerCase().includes(subject.toLowerCase().slice(0, 15))
+  ).length;
+  const duplicateWarning = similarCount > 1 
+    ? "⚠️  Multiple recent commits share similar keywords" 
+    : "None detected";
+  
+  const unpushedCount = parseInt(commitCount, 10) || 1;
+  const squashSuggestion = unpushedCount > 3
+    ? `💡 You have ${unpushedCount} unpushed commits. Consider squashing minor fixups.`
+    : "None (optimal commit count)";
+  
+  console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(70));
+  console.log("           AUTO-GIT WORKFLOW SUMMARY REPORT");
+  console.log("=".repeat(70));
+  console.log(`Commit Hash     : ${commitHash}`);
+  console.log(`Commit Message  : ${commitMsg.split("\n")[0]}`);
+  console.log(`Branch          : ${branch}`);
+  console.log(`Staged Files    : ${stagedFiles.length} file(s)`);
+  console.log(`Secret Scan     : Passed`);
+  console.log(`Compliance      : Valid conventional commit ${type}${scopeStr}`);
+  console.log(`Commit Count    : ${unpushedCount} new commit(s)`);
+  console.log(`Duplicate Check : ${duplicateWarning}`);
+  console.log(`Squash Suggest  : ${squashSuggestion}`);
+  console.log(`Push Status     : ${pushSuccess ? "✓ Success" : "✗ Failed / Manual intervention"}`);
+  console.log(`Recent Log:\n${recentCommits}`);
+  console.log("=".repeat(70) + "\n");
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  log("Starting automated git workflow...");
+  
+  // 1. Check for changes
+  const status = run("git status --porcelain");
+  if (!status) {
+    log("No changes detected. Exiting.");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+  
+  log(`Changes detected:\n${status}`);
+  
+  // 2. Cleanup artifacts
+  const removed = cleanupArtifacts();
+  if (removed > 0) {
+    log(`Removed ${removed} temporary artifacts`);
+  }
+  
+  // 3. Validate staged files
+  validateStagedFiles();
+  
+  // 4. Stage all changes
+  log("Staging all modifications...");
+  run("git add -A");
+  
+  const finalStaged = run("git diff --cached --name-only")
+    .split("\n")
+    .filter(Boolean);
+  
+  if (finalStaged.length === 0) {
+    log("No changes to commit after filtering. Exiting.");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+  
+  // 5. Double-check ignored files
+  for (const file of finalStaged) {
+    try {
+      const isIgnored = run(`git check-ignore "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      if (isIgnored) {
+        log(`SECURITY ERROR: Attempted to stage git-ignored file: ${file}`, "error");
+        process.exit(1);
+      }
+    } catch (e) {}
+  }
+  
+  // 6. Secret scanning
+  if (!scanSecrets(finalStaged)) {
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+  
+  // 7. Generate commit message
+  const { type, scope: scopeStr, subject, commitMsg } = generateCommitMessage(finalStaged);
+  
+  // 8. Dry run mode
+  const isDryRun = process.argv.includes("--dry-run") || 
+    process.env.DRY_RUN === "true" || 
+    process.env.DRY_RUN === "1";
+  
+  if (isDryRun) {
+    log("[DRY RUN] Skipping commit and push");
+    const branch = run("git branch --show-current") || "main";
+    console.log("\n" + "=".repeat(70));
+    console.log("      AUTO-GIT WORKFLOW SUMMARY REPORT (DRY RUN)");
+    console.log("=".repeat(70));
+    console.log(`Commit Message: ${commitMsg}`);
+    console.log(`Branch        : ${branch}`);
+    console.log(`Staged Files  : ${finalStaged.length}`);
+    console.log(`Secret Scan   : Passed`);
+    console.log(`Compliance    : Valid (${type}${scopeStr})`);
+    console.log("=".repeat(70) + "\n");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+  
+  // 9. Commit
+  log("Executing git commit...");
+  run(`git commit -m ${JSON.stringify(commitMsg)}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+  
+  // 10. Push with conflict handling
+  const branch = run("git branch --show-current") || "main";
+  const pushSuccess = pushWithRebase(branch);
+  
+  // 11. Generate report
+  const commitHash = run("git rev-parse --short HEAD");
+  generateReport({
+    commitHash,
+    commitMsg,
+    branch,
+    stagedFiles: finalStaged,
+    pushSuccess,
+    type,
+    scopeStr
+  });
+}
+
+main().catch(err => {
+  log(`Fatal error: ${err.message}`, "error");
+  process.exit(1);
+});

+  scoreFallbackModel(modelId, estimatedTokens = 0, requireTools = false, profile = null) {
+    // Scores fallback models using UCB1-style scoring with provider health and catalog data
+    // Returns { modelId, score, reasons, available }
+    const DEBUG = String(process.env.DEBUG || "false").toLowerCase() === "true";
+    
+    // Get model from catalog
+    const catalogModel = this.db.prepare(
+      `SELECT c.id, c.provider, c.max_input_tokens, c.supports_tools, c.supports_image_generation, c.capability, c.supports_chat, c.supports_audio_generation, c.is_free, ph.fails, ph.cooldown_until, ph.permanent, ph.needs_attention, ph.attention_reason, ph.attention_message
+       FROM catalog c
+       LEFT JOIN provider_history ph ON c.provider = ph.provider
+       WHERE c.id = ?`
+    ).get(modelId);
+    
+    if (!catalogModel) {
+      if (DEBUG) console.log(`[BANDIT][FALLBACK] Model ${modelId} not found in catalog`);
+      return { modelId, score: -Infinity, reasons: ['not_in_catalog'], available: false };
+    }
+    
+    // Check token limit
+    if (estimatedTokens > catalogModel.max_input_tokens) {
+      if (DEBUG) console.log(`[BANDIT][FALLBACK] Model ${modelId} token limit exceeded: ${estimatedTokens} > ${catalogModel.max_input_tokens}`);
+      return { modelId, score: -Infinity, reasons: ['token_limit_exceeded'], available: false };
+    }
+    
+    // Check tool requirement
+    if (requireTools && !catalogModel.supports_tools) {
+      if (DEBUG) console.log(`[BANDIT][FALLBACK] Model ${modelId} doesn't support tools`);
+      return { modelId, score: -Infinity, reasons: ['tools_not_supported'], available: false };
+    }
+    
+    // Check provider status
+    const reasons = [];
+    let score = 0;
+    
+    // Base score from catalog data
+    score += catalogModel.is_free ? 10 : 0; // Free models get bonus
+    
+    // Provider health factors
+    if (catalogModel.permanent === 1) {
+      reasons.push('provider_permanently_banned');
+      score -= 1000;
+    }
+    
+    if (catalogModel.cooldown_until > Date.now()) {
+      const cooldownRemaining = Math.ceil((catalogModel.cooldown_until - Date.now()) / 1000 / 60);
+      reasons.push(`provider_cooldown_${cooldownRemaining}min`);
+      score -= 500;
+    }
+    
+    if (catalogModel.needs_attention === 1) {
+      reasons.push('provider_needs_attention');
+      score -= 200;
+    }
+    
+    // Calculate UCB1-style score for fallback
+    const N = 0; // Fallback models have no history
+    const sum_reward = 0;
+    const avgReward = N > 0 ? sum_reward / N : 1.0;
+    const totalObservations = 1; // Single observation for fallback
+    
+    // Quality-to-Speed ratio calculation
+    const avgLatency = 250; // Default fallback latency
+    const baselineLatency = 500;
+    const latencyFactor = baselineLatency / Math.max(avgLatency, 100);
+    const qualitySpeedScore = avgReward * latencyFactor;
+    
+    // UCB1 exploration bonus for untested models
+    const explorationBonus = 0.5 * Math.sqrt(Math.log(totalObservations + 1) / 1);
+    const ucbScore = 2.0 * qualitySpeedScore + 0.8 * explorationBonus;
+    
+    // Apply soft bias multiplier from profile if specified
+    const mult = profileMultiplier(profile, modelId);
+    const finalScore = (ucbScore * mult) + (Math.random() * 0.0001);
+    
+    score += finalScore;
+    
+    // Add provider-specific factors
+    if (catalogModel.fails > 0) {
+      reasons.push(`provider_has_${catalogModel.fails}_failures`);
+      score -= catalogModel.fails * 50;
+    }
+    
+    if (DEBUG) {
+      console.log(`[BANDIT][FALLBACK] Model ${modelId} score: ${score.toFixed(4)}, reasons: ${reasons.join(', ')}`);
+    }
+    
+    return {
+      modelId,
+      score,
+      reasons,
+      available: true,
+      provider: catalogModel.provider,
+      max_input_tokens: catalogModel.max_input_tokens,
+      supports_tools: catalogModel.supports_tools,
+      is_free: catalogModel.is_free

+        async function apiFetch(url, opts = {}) {
+            if (!API_TOKEN) {
+                API_TOKEN =
+                    new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('omniroute_token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('omniroute_dashboard_token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('api_token') ||
+                    '';
+            }
+            const headers = { ...(opts.headers || {}) };
+            if (API_TOKEN) headers['x-api-token'] = API_TOKEN;
+            console.log(`[DEBUG Dashboard Client] Fetching ${url} with token present: ${Boolean(API_TOKEN)}, token length: ${API_TOKEN.length}`);
+            const res = await fetch(url, { ...opts, headers });
+            console.log(`[DEBUG Dashboard Client] Response for ${url}: status=${res.status}, ok=${res.ok}`);
+            if (res.status === 401) {
+                console.warn(`[DEBUG Dashboard Client] Received 401 Unauthorized for ${url}`);
+                handleUnauthorized();
+            }
+            return res;
+        }

+        async function safeJson(res) {
+            try {
+                const text = await res.text();
+                if (!text || text.trim() === '') return {};
+                return JSON.parse(text);
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.warn('[Dashboard] Failed to parse JSON response:', e);
+                return {};
+            }
+        }

+        // ===== MODALI CUSTOM =====
+        function showModal({ title, icon = '❓', message, confirmText = 'OK', cancelText = 'Annulla',
+                             confirmStyle = 'primary', danger = false, prompt = null, promptPlaceholder = '' }) {
+            return new Promise((resolve) => {
+                const overlay = document.createElement('div');
+                overlay.className = 'modal-overlay';
+
+                const box = document.createElement('div');
+                box.className = 'modal-box';
+
+                const titleEl = document.createElement('h3');
+                titleEl.className = 'modal-title';
+                titleEl.innerHTML = '<span class="modal-icon">' + escapeHtml(icon) + '</span>' + escapeHtml(title);
+                box.appendChild(titleEl);
+
+                const msgEl = document.createElement('div');
+                msgEl.className = 'modal-message';
+                msgEl.textContent = message;
+                box.appendChild(msgEl);
+
+                let inputEl = null;
+                if (prompt !== null) {
+                    inputEl = document.createElement('input');
+                    inputEl.className = 'modal-input';
+                    inputEl.value = prompt;
+                    inputEl.placeholder = promptPlaceholder;
+                    box.appendChild(inputEl);
+                }
+
+                const actions = document.createElement('div');
+                actions.className = 'modal-actions';
+
+                if (cancelText) {
+                    const btnCancel = document.createElement('button');
+                    btnCancel.className = 'modal-btn modal-btn-secondary';
+                    btnCancel.textContent = cancelText;
+                    btnCancel.onclick = () => { close(); resolve(prompt !== null ? null : false); };
+                    actions.appendChild(btnCancel);
+                }
+
+                const btnConfirm = document.createElement('button');
+                const styleClass = danger ? 'modal-btn-danger'
+                                 : confirmStyle === 'warning' ? 'modal-btn-warning'
+                                 : 'modal-btn-primary';
+                btnConfirm.className = 'modal-btn ' + styleClass;
+                btnConfirm.textContent = confirmText;
+                btnConfirm.onclick = () => {
+                    const val = inputEl ? inputEl.value : true;
+                    close();
+                    resolve(val);
+                };
+                actions.appendChild(btnConfirm);
+
+                box.appendChild(actions);
+                overlay.appendChild(box);
+
+                overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+                    if (e.target === overlay) { close(); resolve(prompt !== null ? null : false); }
+                });
+
+                function onKey(e) {
+                    if (e.key === 'Escape') { close(); resolve(prompt !== null ? null : false); }
+                    else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
+                        const val = inputEl ? inputEl.value : true;
+                        close();
+                        resolve(val);
+                    }
+                }
+                document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+                function close() {
+                    document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
+                    overlay.style.opacity = '0';
+                    overlay.style.transition = 'opacity 0.1s';
+                    setTimeout(() => overlay.remove(), 100);
+                }
+
+                document.body.appendChild(overlay);
+                if (inputEl) {
+                    inputEl.focus();
+                    inputEl.select();
+                } else {
+                    btnConfirm.focus();
+                }
+            });
+        }

+        async function handleUnauthorized() {
+            if (isPromptingAuth) return;
+            isPromptingAuth = true;
+            try {
+                const token = await showModal({
+                    title: 'Autenticazione Richiesta',
+                    icon: '🔒',
+                    message: 'Il server richiede un token di autenticazione (DASHBOARD_TOKEN). Inserisci il token API:',
+                    confirmText: 'Salva e Accedi',
+                    cancelText: 'Ignora',
+                    prompt: API_TOKEN || '',
+                    promptPlaceholder: 'Inserisci DASHBOARD_TOKEN...'
+                });
+                if (token && typeof token === 'string' && token.trim() !== '') {
+                    API_TOKEN = token.trim();
+                    localStorage.setItem('omniroute_token', API_TOKEN);
+                    localStorage.setItem('omniroute_dashboard_token', API_TOKEN);
+                    localStorage.setItem('api_token', API_TOKEN);
+                    authBannerShown = false;
+                    const banner = document.querySelector('div[style*="background:#f85149"]');
+                    if (banner) banner.remove();
+                    if (typeof refreshAll === 'function') refreshAll();
+                } else {
+                    show401Banner();
+                }
+            } finally {
+                isPromptingAuth = false;
+            }
+        }
+
+        function show401Banner() {
+            if (authBannerShown) return;
+            authBannerShown = true;
+            const div = document.createElement('div');
+            div.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;padding:12px;background:#f85149;color:white;text-align:center;font-weight:bold;z-index:9999;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;';
+            div.innerHTML = '<span>🔒 401 — Token DASHBOARD_TOKEN mancante o errato.</span> <button id="btn-prompt-token" style="background:white;color:#f85149;border:none;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:bold;">Inserisci Token</button>';
+            document.body.appendChild(div);
+            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-prompt-token');
+            if (btn) {
+                btn.onclick = () => {
+                    div.remove();
+                    authBannerShown = false;
+                    handleUnauthorized();
+                };
+            }
+        }

+        // === Changelog rendering ===
+        function extractFirstVersion(md) {
+            const m = md.match(/^##\s+(v[\d.]+)/m);
+            return m ? m[1] : null;
+        }
+
+        function renderChangelog(md) {
+            if (!md) return '<p style="color:#8b949e">Nessun changelog disponibile.</p>';
+            const lines = md.replace(/\r/g, '').replace(/\uFEFF/g, '').split('\n');
+
+            // Mini-markdown per celle changelog
+            function inline(s) {
+                return String(s)
+                    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
+                    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>')
+                    .replace(/(^|[^*])\*([^*]+)\*(?!\*)/g, '$1<em>$2</em>')
+                    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code style="background:#21262d;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;font-size:12px">$1</code>')
+                    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g, '<a href="$2" target="_blank" style="color:#58a6ff">$1</a>');
+            }
+
+            const releases = [];
+            let current = null;
+
+            for (const line of lines) {
+                const h2 = line.match(/^##\s+(v[\d.]+|Unreleased)\s*(.*)$/);
+                if (h2) {
+                    if (current) releases.push(current);
+                    const rawDate = (h2[2] || '').replace(/^[—–\-·•]+\s*/, '').trim();
+                    current = { version: h2[1], date: rawDate, items: [] };
+                    continue;
+                }
+                const li = line.match(/^\s*[-*]\s+(.+)$/);
+                if (li && current) {
+                    current.items.push(li[1].trim());
+                }
+            }
+            if (current) releases.push(current);
+
+            if (releases.length === 0) {
+                return '<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-size:13px; color:#c9d1d9;">' + escapeHtml(md) + '</pre>';
+            }
+
+            return releases.map((r, i) => {
+                const latest = i === 0 ? ' <span class="cl-latest">ULTIMA</span>' : '';
+                const items = r.items.map(it => '<li>' + inline(it) + '</li>').join('');
+                return '<div class="cl-release">' +
+                    '<div class="cl-version">' + escapeHtml(r.version) + latest +
+                    (r.date ? ' <span class="cl-date">' + escapeHtml(r.date) + '</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
+                    '<ul>' + items + '</ul>' +
+                '</div>';
+            }).join('');
+        }
+        function fmtTime(seconds) {
+            const s = Number(seconds) || 0;
+            if (s < 60) return s + 's';
+            if (s < 3600) return Math.floor(s / 60) + 'm' + (s % 60) + 's';
+            return Math.floor(s / 3600) + 'h' + Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60) + 'm';
+        }
+        function fmtInfo(r) {
+            // 4 colonne fisse: rank | N | avg | arrow
+            const rankTxt = r.rank ? ('#' + r.rank) : '-';
+            const nTxt = (r.N != null && r.N !== null && Number(r.N) > 0) ? ('N=' + r.N) : 'N=-';
+            let avgTxt;
+            if (r.trend === 'new') avgTxt = 'new';
+            else if (r.avg != null && Number(r.avg) > 0) avgTxt = 'avg=' + r.avg;
+            else if (r.N != null && Number(r.N) > 0 && Number(r.N) < 1) avgTxt = 'test';
+            else avgTxt = 'avg=-';
+            const arrow = r.trend === 'up' ? '↗' : r.trend === 'down' ? '↘' : '→';
+            const cls = r.trend === 'up' ? 'trend-up' : r.trend === 'down' ? 'trend-down' : 'trend-flat';
+            return '<span class="model-info">' +
+                '<span class="mi-rank">' + rankTxt + '</span>' +
+                '<span class="mi-n">' + nTxt + '</span>' +
+                '<span class="mi-avg">' + avgTxt + '</span>' +
+                '<span class="mi-trend ' + cls + '">' + arrow + '</span>' +
+            '</span>';
+        }
+
+        function escapeHtml(str) {
+            const div = document.createElement('div');
+            div.textContent = String(str ?? '');
+            return div.innerHTML;
+        }
+
+        function badge(item, clickable = false) {
+            const now = Date.now();
+            if (Number(item.permanent)) return '<span class="badge badge-banned">🚫 IGNORATO</span>';
+            if (Number(item.needs_attention)) {
+                if (clickable) {
+                    const name = escapeHtml(item.provider || item.id || '');
+                    return '<button class="badge badge-attention" style="border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit" data-action="show-help" data-name="' + name + '">⚠️ DA CONFIGURARE ❓</button>';
+                }
+                return '<span class="badge badge-attention">⚠️ DA CONFIGURARE</span>';
+            }
+            const cd = Number(item.cooldown_until) || 0;
+            if (cd > now) return '<span class="badge badge-cooldown">⏱ ' + fmtTime(Math.round((cd - now) / 1000)) + '</span>';
+            if (Number(item.degraded)) return '<span class="badge badge-degraded">⚠️ DEGRADED</span>';
+            return '<span class="badge badge-active">✓ Attivo</span>';
+        }
+
+        function sortRows(arr) {
+            if (!sortCol) return arr;
+            const sorted = [...arr];
+            sorted.sort((a, b) => {
+                let aVal = a[sortCol] != null ? a[sortCol] : '';
+                let bVal = b[sortCol] != null ? b[sortCol] : '';
+                if (typeof aVal === 'string') aVal = aVal.toLowerCase();
+                if (typeof bVal === 'string') bVal = bVal.toLowerCase();
+                if (aVal < bVal) return sortDir === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
+                if (aVal > bVal) return sortDir === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
+                return 0;
+            });
+            return sorted;
+        }
+
+        document.querySelectorAll('th[data-sort]').forEach(th => {
+            th.addEventListener('click', () => {
+                const col = th.dataset.sort;
+                if (sortCol === col) sortDir = sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
+                else { sortCol = col; sortDir = 'asc'; }
+                flatMode = true;   // sort globale: esci dalla vista raggruppata
+                document.querySelectorAll('th[data-sort]').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('sort-asc', 'sort-desc'));
+                th.classList.add(sortDir === 'asc' ? 'sort-asc' : 'sort-desc');
+                renderAll();
+            });
+        });

+        // ============= RENDER =============
+        function renderAll() {
+            const tbody = document.getElementById('models-tbody');
+            
+            // Get filter values
+            const search = document.getElementById('models-filter-search').value.toLowerCase();
+            const provider = document.getElementById('models-filter-provider').value;
+            const status = document.getElementById('models-filter-status').value;
+            const minN = parseInt(document.getElementById('models-filter-minN').value) || 0;
+            const minAvg = parseFloat(document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg').value) || 0;
+            
+            // Fetch models and summary
+            apiFetch('/v1/models?source=prod&provider=' + encodeURIComponent(provider) +
+                  '&status=' + encodeURIComponent(status) +
+                  '&minN=' + minN +
+                  '&minAvg=' + minAvg +
+                  '&search=' + encodeURIComponent(search) +
+                  '&limit=500')
+                .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject('HTTP ' + r.status))
+                .then(data => {
+                    const models = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.models || []);
+                    // Fetch summary
+                    return apiFetch('/v1/models/summary?source=prod')
+                        .then(r => r.ok ? r.json() : Promise.reject('HTTP ' + r.status))
+                        .then(summary => ({models, summary}));
+                })
+                .then(({models, summary}) => {
+                    // Update counters safely if elements exist
+                    const totalEl = document.getElementById('models-count-total');
+                    if (totalEl) totalEl.textContent = summary.total || 0;
+                    const activeEl = document.getElementById('models-count-active');
+                    if (activeEl) activeEl.textContent = summary.active || 0;
+                    const cooldownEl = document.getElementById('models-count-cooldown');
+                    if (cooldownEl) cooldownEl.textContent = summary.cooldown || 0;
+                    const degradedEl = document.getElementById('models-count-degraded');
+                    if (degradedEl) degradedEl.textContent = summary.degraded || 0;
+                    const bannedEl = document.getElementById('models-count-banned');
+                    if (bannedEl) bannedEl.textContent = summary.banned || 0;
+                    
+                    // Store data for sorting
+                    allData.models = models;
+                    allData.providers = []; // We'll get providers from a separate endpoint if needed
+                    
+                    // Raggruppa modelli per provider
+                    const modelsByProvider = {};
+                    for (const m of models) {
+                        const p = m.provider || 'unknown';
+                        if (!modelsByProvider[p]) modelsByProvider[p] = [];
+                        modelsByProvider[p].push(m);
+                    }
+
+                    // Info provider (we'll need to fetch this separately or use a placeholder)
+                    const providerInfo = {};
+                    // For now, we'll create minimal provider info from the models data
+                    // In a real implementation, we'd fetch /v1/providers
+                    const providerSet = new Set(models.map(m => m.provider));
+                    providerSet.forEach(p => {
+                        providerInfo[p] = {
+                            provider: p,
+                            permanent: 0,
+                            needs_attention: 0,
+                            cooldown_until: 0
+                        };
+                    });
+
+                    // Lista provider
+                    const providerNames = Array.from(Object.keys(modelsByProvider)).sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
+                    const forceExpand = search.length > 0;
+
+                    let html = '';
+
+                    // Bottone toggle visibile solo in flat mode
+                    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('toggle-flat');
+                    if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.style.display = flatMode ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
+
+                    if (flatMode) {
+                        // === FLAT MODE: tutti i modelli in un'unica tabella, sort globale ===
+                        let allModels = [];
+                        for (const provider of providerNames) {
+                            const models = modelsByProvider[provider] || [];
+                            const info = providerInfo[provider];
+                            const providerMatches = provider.toLowerCase().includes(search);
+                            const matchingModels = search
+                                ? models.filter(m => String(m.id).toLowerCase().includes(search) || String(m.provider).toLowerCase().includes(search))
+                                : models;
+                            if (search && !providerMatches && matchingModels.length === 0) continue;
+
+                            // Apply additional filters
+                                                        const filteredModels = matchingModels.filter(m => {
+                                                            // Status filter: show only active models by default (not permanently banned, not in cooldown/degraded without availability)
+                                                            if (status === 'active' && (!m.permanent && !m.needs_attention && (!m.cooldown_until || m.cooldown_until <= Date.now()))) return true;
+                                                            if (status === 'cooldown' && m.cooldown_until && m.cooldown_until > Date.now()) return true;
+                                                            if (status === 'degraded' && Number(m.degraded) === 1) return true;
+                                                            if (status === 'banned' && Number(m.permanent) === 1) return true;
+                                                            if (status === '') {
+                                                                // Default: show only active models (not permanent, not needs_attention, not in active cooldown)
+                                                                return (!m.permanent && !m.needs_attention && (!m.cooldown_until || m.cooldown_until <= Date.now()));
+                                                            }
+                                                            return false;
+                                                        });
+                            
+                            // N filter
+                            const nFiltered = filteredModels.filter(m => Number(m.N) >= minN);
+                            
+                            // Avg filter
+                            const avgFiltered = nFiltered.filter(m => Number(m.avg) >= minAvg);
+                            
+                            if (search && !providerMatches && avgFiltered.length === 0) continue;
+
+                            for (const m of avgFiltered) {
+                                allModels.push(m);
+                            }
+                        }
+                        const sorted = sortRows(allModels);
+                        for (const m of sorted) {
+                            html += renderModelRow(m);
+                        }
+                    } else {
+                        // GROUPED MODE
+                        for (const provider of providerNames) {
+                            const models = modelsByProvider[provider] || [];
+                            const info = providerInfo[provider];
+                            
+                            // Apply filters
+                            const filteredModels = models.filter(m => {
+                                // Search filter
+                                if (search && !String(m.id).toLowerCase().includes(search) && !String(m.provider).toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
+                                
+                                // Status filter: show only active models by default (not permanently banned, not in cooldown/degraded without availability)
+                                if (status === 'active' && (!m.permanent && !m.needs_attention && (!m.cooldown_until || m.cooldown_until <= Date.now()))) return true;
+                                if (status === 'cooldown' && m.cooldown_until && m.cooldown_until > Date.now()) return true;
+                                if (status === 'degraded' && Number(m.degraded) === 1) return true;
+                                if (status === 'banned' && Number(m.permanent) === 1) return true;
+                                if (status === '') {
+                                    // Default: show only active models (not permanent, not needs_attention, not in active cooldown)
+                                    return (!m.permanent && !m.needs_attention && (!m.cooldown_until || m.cooldown_until <= Date.now()));
+                                }
+                                return false;
+                            });
+                            
+                            // N filter
+                            const nFiltered = filteredModels.filter(m => Number(m.N) >= minN);
+                            
+                            // Avg filter
+                            const avgFiltered = nFiltered.filter(m => Number(m.avg) >= minAvg);
+                            
+                            if (search && !provider.toLowerCase().includes(search) && avgFiltered.length === 0) continue;
+
+                            const isCollapsed = !forceExpand && collapsedProviders.has(provider);
+                            const modelsToShow = (forceExpand && !provider.toLowerCase().includes(search)) ? avgFiltered : avgFiltered;
+
+                            html += renderProviderHeader(provider, info, models.length, isCollapsed);
+
+                            if (!isCollapsed || (forceExpand && modelsToShow.length > 0)) {
+                                const sorted = sortRows(modelsToShow);
+                                for (const m of sorted) {
+                                    html += renderModelRow(m);
+                                }
+                            }
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    if (html === '') {
+                        tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="empty">Nessun risultato</td></tr>';
+                    } else {
+                        tbody.innerHTML = html;
+                    }
+                })
+                .catch(err => {
+                    console.error('Errore fetch modelli:', err);
+                    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="11" class="empty">Errore caricamento dati</td></tr>';
+                });
+        }

+
+        function renderProviderHeader(provider, info, modelCount, isCollapsed) {
+            const safe = escapeHtml(provider);
+
+            let statusBadge = '';
+            let actions = '';
+
+            if (info) {
+                const now = Date.now();
+                if (Number(info.permanent)) {
+                    statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-banned">🚫 IGNORATO</span>';
+                    actions = '<button class="btn btn-copy" data-action="retry-provider" data-name="' + safe + '">🔁 Ripristina</button>';
+                } else if (Number(info.needs_attention)) {
+                    statusBadge = '<button class="badge badge-attention" style="border:none;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit" data-action="show-help" data-name="' + safe + '">⚠️ DA CONFIGURARE ❓</button>';
+                    actions = '<button class="btn btn-copy" data-action="retry-provider" data-name="' + safe + '">🔁 Riprova</button>' +
+                              '<button class="btn btn-reset" data-action="ignore-provider" data-name="' + safe + '">🚫 Ignora</button>';
+                } else {
+                    const cd = Number(info.cooldown_until) || 0;
+                    if (cd > now) {
+                        const mins = Math.round((cd - now) / 60000);
+                        statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-cooldown">⏱ ' + mins + 'm</span>';
+                    } else {
+                        statusBadge = '<span class="badge badge-active">✓ Attivo</span>';
+                    }
+                }
+                actions = '<button class="btn btn-reset" data-action="reset-provider" data-name="' + safe + '">Reset</button>' + actions;
+            } else {
+                statusBadge = '<span class="muted">(non ancora usato)</span>';
+            }
+
+            return '<tr class="provider-header' + (isCollapsed ? ' collapsed' : '') + '" data-action="toggle-provider" data-name="' + safe + '">' +
+                '<td colspan="11">' +
+                    '<div class="header-content">' +
+                        '<span class="arrow">▼</span>' +
+                        '<span class="provider-name">' + safe + '</span>' +
+                        statusBadge +
+                        '<span class="model-count">(' + modelCount + ' modelli)</span>' +
+                        '<span class="actions">' + actions + '</span>' +
+                    '</div>' +
+                '</td>' +
+            '</tr>';
+        }
+
+        function renderModelRow(m) {
+            const n = Number(m.N) || 0;
+            const avg = Number(m.avg) || 0;
+            const fails = Number(m.fails) || 0;
+            const score = m.score === Infinity ? '∞' : (m.score == null || isNaN(m.score) ? '—' : Number(m.score).toFixed(3));
+            const safe = escapeHtml(m.id);
+
+            const isBanned = Number(m.permanent) === 1;
+            const actions = isBanned
+                ? '<button class="btn btn-copy" data-action="reset-model" data-id="' + safe + '">🔁 Sblocca</button>'
+                : '<button class="btn btn-reset" data-action="reset-model" data-id="' + safe + '">Reset</button>' +
+                  ' <button class="btn btn-block" data-action="block-model" data-id="' + safe + '">🚫 Blocca</button>';
+
+            // Rank
+            const rank = (m.rank != null && m.rank > 0) ? m.rank : '—';
+            // Free/Paid badges
+            const isFree = m.is_free === 1;
+            const isPaid = m.is_paid === 1;
+            const freeBadge = isFree ? '<span class="badge badge-active">Free</span>' : (isPaid ? '<span class="badge badge-cooldown">Paid</span>' : '<span class="muted">—</span>');
+            const paidBadge = isPaid ? '<span class="badge badge-cooldown">Paid</span>' : (isFree ? '<span class="badge badge-active">Free</span>' : '<span class="muted">—</span>');
+            // Tools badge
+            const toolsBadge = m.supports_tools === 1
+                ? '<span class="badge badge-active">✓</span>'
+                : (m.supports_tools === 0 ? '<span class="muted">—</span>' : '<span class="muted">?</span>');
+
+            return '<tr>' +
+                '<td class="mono" style="text-align:center">' + rank + '</td>' +
+                '<td style="padding-left:32px"><b>' + escapeHtml(m.id) + '</b></td>' +
+                '<td>' + escapeHtml(m.provider) + '</td>' +
+                '<td class="mono ok">' + n.toFixed(1) + '</td>' +
+                '<td class="mono ok">' + avg.toFixed(3) + '</td>' +
+                '<td>' + (fails > 0 ? '<span class="err">' + fails + '</span>' : '<span class="muted">0</span>') + '</td>' +
+                '<td>' + badge(m) + '</td>' +
+                '<td style="text-align:center">' + freeBadge + '</td>' +
+                '<td style="text-align:center">' + paidBadge + '</td>' +
+                '<td style="text-align:center">' + toolsBadge + '</td>' +
+                '<td>' + actions + '</td>' +
+                '</tr>';
+        }

+        // ============= HELP MODAL =============
+        function getHelpForProvider(p) {
+            const reason = p.attention_reason || '';
+            const msg = (p.attention_message || '').toLowerCase();
+
+            if (/cli not found|not found.*install via|spawn.*enoent|command not found/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '🛠️ CLI mancante',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Al provider manca un CLI installato nel container OmniRoute.',
+                        'Leggi il messaggio d\'errore qui sotto: contiene il nome del CLI e il link per installarlo.',
+                        'Tipico: esegui l\'installer nel container e imposta la variabile d\'ambiente indicata.',
+                        'Riavvia il container OmniRoute e clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/no auth|log in|not authenticated|api.?key/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '🔑 Autenticazione mancante',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Questo provider richiede un login o una chiave API configurata in OmniRoute.',
+                        'Controlla il messaggio d\'errore qui sotto: spesso contiene il comando esatto da eseguire.',
+                        'Vai nel pannello di OmniRoute → Settings → Providers e completa la configurazione.',
+                        'Poi clicca "🔁 Riprova" per rimuovere il flag.'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/playwright|browser/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '🌐 Playwright non disponibile',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Il provider usa Playwright per pilotare un browser.',
+                        'Nel container OmniRoute esegui:',
+                        '  npm install playwright && npx playwright install chromium --with-deps',
+                        'Poi riavvia il container: docker restart omniroute',
+                        'E infine clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/transport.*not configured|missing url or token/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '🔌 Transport non configurato',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Il provider ha bisogno di un URL o token di trasporto configurato.',
+                        'Vai nel pannello OmniRoute → Settings → Providers e completa la sezione "Transport".',
+                        'Poi clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/cli is no longer supported|please upgrade|version.*not supported/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '⬆️ CLI obsoleto',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Il CLI usato da questo provider è troppo vecchio.',
+                        'Aggiornalo nell\'ambiente OmniRoute, poi clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/quota|exhausted/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '📊 Quota esaurita',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Il provider ha esaurito la quota. Attendi il reset, oppure aggiungi un account.',
+                        'Nel frattempo puoi cliccare "🚫 Ignora" per non testarlo più.'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            if (/absolute path|sandbox|env/i.test(msg)) {
+                return {
+                    title: '⚙️ Variabile d\'ambiente mancante',
+                    steps: [
+                        'Al provider manca una variabile d\'ambiente.',
+                        'Configurala nel container OmniRoute (docker-compose.yml o docker run -e).',
+                        'Poi riavvia il container e clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                    ]
+                };
+            }
+            return {
+                title: '❓ Azione richiesta',
+                steps: [
+                    'Questo provider ha bisogno di un intervento manuale.',
+                    'Leggi il messaggio d\'errore qui sotto per capire cosa manca.',
+                    'Dopo aver sistemato, clicca "🔁 Riprova".'
+                ]
+            };
+        }

+        function showHelp(providerName) {
+            const p = allData.providers.find(x => x.provider === providerName);
+            if (!p) return showAlert('Provider non trovato: ' + providerName, 'Errore', '⚠️');
+
+            const help = getHelpForProvider(p);
+            const msg = p.attention_message || '(nessun messaggio disponibile)';
+            const fullText = `${help.title}\n\n${help.steps.map((s, i) => (i+1) + '. ' + s).join('\n')}\n\n───── Ultimo errore ─────\n${msg}`;
+
+            const old = document.getElementById('help-modal');
+            if (old) old.remove();
+
+            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
+            overlay.id = 'help-modal';
+            overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:10000;padding:20px';
+            overlay.onclick = (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) overlay.remove(); };
+
+            const box = document.createElement('div');
+            box.style.cssText = 'background:#161b22;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:8px;padding:20px;max-width:700px;width:100%;max-height:80vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;color:#c9d1d9';
+
+            const title = document.createElement('h3');
+            title.textContent = help.title + ' — ' + providerName;
+            title.style.cssText = 'margin:0;color:#58a6ff;font-size:16px';
+            box.appendChild(title);
+
+            const pre = document.createElement('pre');
+            pre.textContent = fullText;
+            pre.style.cssText = 'background:#010409;border:1px solid #30363d;border-radius:4px;padding:12px;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:12px;font-family:Courier New,monospace;color:#7ee787;overflow:auto;margin:0;flex:1;max-height:60vh';
+            box.appendChild(pre);
+
+            const btnBar = document.createElement('div');
+            btnBar.style.cssText = 'display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end';
+
+            const btnCopy = document.createElement('button');
+            btnCopy.className = 'btn btn-copy';
+            btnCopy.textContent = '📋 Copia tutto';
+            btnCopy.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px';
+            btnCopy.onclick = async () => {
+                try {
+                    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullText);
+                    const orig = btnCopy.textContent;
+                    btnCopy.textContent = '✅ Copiato!';
+                    setTimeout(() => btnCopy.textContent = orig, 1500);
+                } catch (e) {
+                    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
+                    ta.value = fullText;
+                    document.body.appendChild(ta);
+                    ta.select();
+                    document.execCommand('copy');
+                    ta.remove();
+                    const orig = btnCopy.textContent;
+                    btnCopy.textContent = '✅ Copiato!';
+                    setTimeout(() => btnCopy.textContent = orig, 1500);
+                }
+            };
+            btnBar.appendChild(btnCopy);
+
+            const btnClose = document.createElement('button');
+            btnClose.className = 'btn btn-reset';
+            btnClose.textContent = '✕ Chiudi';
+            btnClose.style.cssText = 'padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px';
+            btnClose.onclick = () => overlay.remove();
+            btnBar.appendChild(btnClose);
+
+            box.appendChild(btnBar);
+            overlay.appendChild(box);
+            document.body.appendChild(overlay);
+        }
