+        // ============= CLICK DELEGATION =============
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const btn = e.target.closest('[data-action]');
+            if (!btn) return;
+            const a = btn.dataset.action;
+            if (a === 'reset-model') resetModel(btn.dataset.id);
+            else if (a === 'block-model') blockModel(btn.dataset.id);
+            else if (a === 'reset-provider') resetProvider(btn.dataset.name);
+            else if (a === 'retry-provider') retryProvider(btn.dataset.name);
+            else if (a === 'ignore-provider') ignoreProvider(btn.dataset.name);
+            else if (a === 'show-help') showHelp(btn.dataset.name);
+            else if (a === 'refresh-all') refreshAll();
+            else if (a === 'copy-logs') copyLogs();
+            else if (a === 'reset-counters') {
+                apiFetch('/v1/reset/counters', { method: 'POST' }).then(() => refreshAll());
+            }
+            else if (a === 'toggle-provider') {
+                const name = btn.dataset.name;
+                if (collapsedProviders.has(name)) collapsedProviders.delete(name);
+                else collapsedProviders.add(name);
+                renderAll();
+            }
+        });

+        async function refreshAll() {
+            if (refreshing) return;
+            refreshing = true;
+            try {
+                console.log('[DEBUG dashboard] Fetching /v1/dashboard/stats with token:', API_TOKEN ? 'present' : 'missing');
+                const r = await apiFetch('/v1/dashboard/stats');
+                console.log('[DEBUG dashboard] /v1/dashboard/stats response status:', r.status, 'ok:', r.ok);
+                if (r.status === 401) {
+                    show401Banner();
+                    handleUnauthorized();
+                    return;
+                }
+                if (!r.ok) {
+                    console.warn('[DEBUG dashboard] /v1/dashboard/stats non-OK status:', r.status);
+                    return;
+                }
+                const existingBanner = document.querySelector('div[style*="background:#f85149"]');
+                if (existingBanner) existingBanner.remove();
+                authBannerShown = false;
+                const d = await safeJson(r);
+                console.log('[DEBUG dashboard] /v1/dashboard/stats data:', d);
+                allData = d;
+
+                const reqs = Number(d.totalRequests) || 0;
+                // Observations can never exceed requests; cap to avoid display inconsistencies
+                const rawObs = Number(d.totalObservations) || 0;
+                const obs = Math.max(0, Math.min(rawObs, reqs));
+                document.getElementById('total-req').textContent = reqs;
+                document.getElementById('total-obs').textContent = obs;
+
+                const rateEl = document.getElementById('success-rate');
+                if (reqs === 0) {
+                    rateEl.textContent = '(successo: —)';
+                    rateEl.className = 'muted';
+                } else {
+                    const pct = reqs > 0 ? Math.round((obs / reqs) * 100) : 0;
+                    rateEl.textContent = '(' + pct + '% successo)';
+                    rateEl.className = pct >= 80 ? 'ok' : pct >= 50 ? 'warn' : 'err';
+                }
+
+                document.getElementById('avg-reward').textContent = (d.avgReward || 0).toFixed(3);
+                document.getElementById('avg-latency').textContent = (d.avgLatencySec || 0).toFixed(1) + 's';
+                document.getElementById('free-active').textContent = d.freeActive ?? 0;
+                
+                if (d.topModel) {
+                    const topModelEl = document.getElementById('top-model');
+                    topModelEl.textContent = d.topModel.name || d.topModel;
+                    // Add subtitle with score and provider if available
+                    if (d.topModel.score !== undefined || d.topModel.provider) {
+                        const subtitle = [];
+                        if (d.topModel.score !== undefined) {
+                            subtitle.push('score: ' + d.topModel.score.toFixed(3));
+                        }
+                        if (d.topModel.provider) {
+                            subtitle.push('provider: ' + d.topModel.provider);
+                        }
+                        if (subtitle.length > 0) {
+                            topModelEl.title = subtitle.join(', ');
+                        }
+                    }
+                } else {
+                    document.getElementById('top-model').textContent = '—';
+                }
+
+                document.getElementById('catalog-models').textContent = d.catalogTotal ?? '?';
+                document.getElementById('catalog-free').textContent = d.catalogFree ?? '?';
+                document.getElementById('catalog-models-raw').textContent = d.catalogRawCount ?? '?';
+
+                document.getElementById('active-models').textContent = d.modelsActive ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('cooldown-models').textContent = d.modelsCooldown ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('banned-models').textContent = d.modelsBanned ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('degraded-models').textContent = d.modelsDegraded ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('attention-models').textContent = d.modelsAttention ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('total-models').textContent = d.totalModels ?? 0;
+
+                document.getElementById('active-providers').textContent = d.providersActive ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('cooldown-providers').textContent = d.providersCooldown ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('banned-providers').textContent = d.providersBanned ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('attention-providers').textContent = d.providersAttention ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('total-providers').textContent = d.totalProviders ?? 0;
+                document.getElementById('catalog-providers').textContent = d.catalogProviders ?? 0;
+
+                renderAll();
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error('Errore fetch dashboard stats:', e);
+                const topModelEl = document.getElementById('top-model');
+                if (topModelEl && topModelEl.textContent === '—') {
+                    topModelEl.textContent = 'Errore connessione';
+                }
+            }
+            finally { refreshing = false; }
+        }

+        async function fetchQuota() {
+            try {
+                const r = await apiFetch('/v1/quota');
+                if (r.status === 401) { handleUnauthorized(); return; }
+                if (!r.ok) return;
+                const d = await safeJson(r);
+                renderProviderQuota(d);
+            } catch (e) { console.error('Errore fetch quota:', e); }
+        }
+
+        function renderProviderQuota(input) {
+            const tbody = document.getElementById('providers-tbody');
+            if (!tbody) return;
+            const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
+
+            const providers = Array.isArray(input) ? input : (input?.quota || input?.providers || []);
+
+            if (!providers || !Array.isArray(providers) || providers.length === 0) {
+                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+                const td = document.createElement('td');
+                td.colSpan = 5;
+                td.className = 'empty';
+                td.textContent = 'Nessun dato quota disponibile';
+                tr.appendChild(td);
+                fragment.appendChild(tr);
+                tbody.replaceChildren(fragment);
+                return;
+            }
+
+            const fmtMs = (ms) => {
+                if (ms <= 0) return '—';
+                const days = Math.floor(ms / 86400000);
+                const hours = Math.floor((ms % 86400000) / 3600000);
+                const mins = Math.floor(((ms % 3600000) / 60000));
+                if (days > 0) return days + 'd ' + hours + 'h';
+                if (hours > 0) return hours + 'h ' + mins + 'm';
+                return mins + 'm';
+            };
+
+            const rpmColor = (used, limit) => {
+                if (limit === 0) return 'muted';
+                const pct = (used / limit) * 100;
+                if (pct >= 80) return 'err';
+                if (pct >= 50) return 'warn';
+                return 'ok';
+            };
+
+            for (const p of providers) {
+                const rpmUsed = p.rpm_used !== undefined ? p.rpm_used : (p.callsLastMinute || p.calls_last_minute || 0);
+                const rpmLimit = p.rpm_limit !== undefined ? p.rpm_limit : (p.rpmLimit || 0);
+                const rpdUsed = p.rpd_used !== undefined ? p.rpd_used : (p.callsToday || p.calls_today || 0);
+                const rpdLimit = p.rpd_limit !== undefined ? p.rpd_limit : (p.rpdLimit || 0);
+                const quotaReset = p.quota_resets_at ? fmtMs(p.quota_resets_at - Date.now()) : '—';
+                let state = 'attivo';
+                if (p.quota_resets_at && p.quota_resets_at > Date.now()) {
+                    state = 'quota-exhausted';
+                } else if (rpmUsed >= rpmLimit * 0.8 && rpmLimit > 0) {
+                    state = 'cooldown';
+                }
+
+                const rpmClass = rpmColor(rpmUsed, rpmLimit);
+                const rpdClass = rpmColor(rpdUsed, rpdLimit);
+
+                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
+                const td1 = document.createElement('td');
+                td1.textContent = p.provider;
+                tr.appendChild(td1);
+
+                const td2 = document.createElement('td');
+                const spanRpm = document.createElement('span');
+                spanRpm.className = rpmClass;
+                spanRpm.textContent = `${rpmUsed} / ${rpmLimit}`;
+                td2.appendChild(spanRpm);
+                tr.appendChild(td2);
+
+                const td3 = document.createElement('td');
+                const spanRpd = document.createElement('span');
+                spanRpd.className = rpdClass;
+                spanRpd.textContent = `${rpdUsed} / ${rpdLimit}`;
+                td3.appendChild(spanRpd);
+                tr.appendChild(td3);
+
+                const td4 = document.createElement('td');
+                const spanReset = document.createElement('span');
+                spanReset.className = 'muted';
+                spanReset.textContent = quotaReset;
+                td4.appendChild(spanReset);
+                tr.appendChild(td4);
+
+                const td5 = document.createElement('td');
+                const spanState = document.createElement('span');
+                spanState.className = state === 'quota-exhausted' ? 'badge badge-bannati' :
+                                      state === 'cooldown' ? 'badge badge-cooldown' :
+                                      'badge badge-active';
+                spanState.textContent = state;
+                td5.appendChild(spanState);
+                tr.appendChild(td5);
+
+                fragment.appendChild(tr);
+            }
+
+            tbody.replaceChildren(fragment);
+        }
+
+        async function fetchLogs() {
+            try {
+                const r = await apiFetch('/v1/logs');
+                if (r.status === 401) { handleUnauthorized(); return; }
+                if (!r.ok) return;
+                const d = await r.json();
+                if (!Array.isArray(d)) return;
+                // Cap logs to prevent unbounded memory growth
+                window.__rawLogs = d.slice(-500);
+                renderFilteredLogs();
+            } catch (e) {}
+        }
+        function renderFilteredLogs() {
+            const el = document.getElementById('logs');
+            if (!el) return;
+            const raw = window.__rawLogs || [];
+            const filter = (document.getElementById('log-filter')?.value || '').toLowerCase();
+            const showZoo = document.getElementById('log-show-zoo')?.checked ?? true;
+            const showTrain = document.getElementById('log-show-train')?.checked ?? true;
+            const showDebug = document.getElementById('log-show-debug')?.checked ?? true;
+            
+            // Tagga ogni riga. Priorità:
+            // 1. Marker espliciti nella riga ([TRAIN], [ZOO], [BANDIT-TRAIN])
+            // 2. Marker [PROXY] POST aggiorna lo "stato corrente"
+            // 3. Nessun marker → eredita dall'ultimo POST
+            const tagged = [];
+            let currentSource = null;
+            // Prefissi di sistema: non appartengono a ZOO né a TRAIN.
+            // Non devono mai ereditare currentSource, altrimenti spariscono
+            // quando filtri per zoo o train.
+            const SYSTEM_LINE_RE = /\[(?:HEALTH|CONFIG|INIT|MODES|DASHBOARD|NOTIFIER|SECURITY|FATAL|MIGRAZIONE)\]/;
+            for (const line of raw) {
+                const s = String(line);
+                let src = currentSource;
+
+                if (/\[PROXY\] POST \/v1\/chat\/completions \[TRAIN\]/.test(s)) {
+                    currentSource = 'train'; src = 'train';
+                } else if (/\[PROXY\] POST \/v1\/chat\/completions \[ZOO\]/.test(s)) {
+                    currentSource = 'zoo'; src = 'zoo';
+                } else if (/\[BANDIT-TRAIN\]/.test(s)) {
+                    src = 'train';   // marker esplicito, indipendentemente dal contesto
+                } else if (/\[TRAIN\]/.test(s)) {
+                    src = 'train';
+                } else if (/\[ZOO\]/.test(s)) {
+                    src = 'zoo';
+                } else if (/\[DEBUG\]/.test(s) || /\/debug\/\w+/.test(s) || /debug\s*:/.test(s)) {
+                    src = 'debug';
+                } else if (SYSTEM_LINE_RE.test(s)) {
+                    // Riga di sistema: la taggo esplicitamente 'system'
+                    // così non eredita da ZOO/TRAIN e non sparisce mai.
+                    src = 'system';
+                }
+                tagged.push({ line: s, source: src });
+            }
+
+            let filtered = tagged;
+            if (!showZoo) filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.source !== 'zoo');
+            if (!showTrain) filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.source !== 'train');
+            if (!showDebug) filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.source !== 'debug');
+            if (filter) filtered = filtered.filter(t => t.line.toLowerCase().includes(filter));
+
+            // Color and format the logs
+            const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
+            if (filtered.length === 0) {
+                const span = document.createElement('span');
+                span.textContent = 'Nessun log corrispondente.';
+                fragment.appendChild(span);
+            } else {
+                for (const t of filtered) {
+                    const span = document.createElement('span');
+                    span.className = t.source ? `log-line ${t.source}` : 'log-line system';
+                    span.textContent = t.line;
+                    fragment.appendChild(span);
+                }
+            }
+            
+            const wasAtBottom = el.scrollTop + el.clientHeight >= el.scrollHeight - 20;
+            el.replaceChildren(fragment);
+            if (wasAtBottom) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
+        }
+        // Aggiorna log quando cambiano i filtri
+        ['log-filter', 'log-show-train', 'log-show-zoo', 'log-show-debug'].forEach(id => {
+            document.getElementById(id)?.addEventListener('input', () => {
+                renderFilteredLogs();
+                fetchActive();   // <-- aggiorna anche "In corso"
+            });
+            document.getElementById(id)?.addEventListener('change', () => {
+                renderFilteredLogs();
+                fetchActive();
+            });
+        });
+        async function fetchActive() {
+            try {
+                console.debug('[DEBUG Dashboard] fetchActive polling triggered at', Date.now());
+                const r = await apiFetch('/v1/active');
+                if (!r.ok) return;
+                const d = await r.json();
+                const tbody = document.getElementById('unified-cronologia-tbody');
+                if (!tbody) return;
+
+                function fmtRow(r, kind) {
+                    const ts = r.timestamp || r.endedAt || Date.now();
+                    const dObj = new Date(ts);
+                    const timeStr = dObj.toLocaleTimeString();
+                    // Timestamp on the left; elapsed seconds ONLY for active thinking model
+                    const timeVal = (kind === 'active')
+                        ? (timeStr + ' <span style="color:#d29922; font-weight:bold;">(' + Number(r.elapsedSec || 0).toFixed(1) + 's try ' + (r.attempt || 1) + ')</span>')
+                        : timeStr;
+
+                    let model = r.model || r.selectedModel || r.requestedModel || '(selezione...)';
+                    let provider = r.provider || r.selectedProvider || '-';
+
+                    // Parse double provider prefixes like nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-...
+                    if (model.includes('/')) {
+                        const parts = model.split('/');
+                        if (parts.length >= 3 && parts[0] === parts[1]) {
+                            provider = parts[0];
+                            model = parts.slice(2).join('/');
+                        } else if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] === parts[1]) {
+                            provider = parts[0];
+                            model = parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        } else if (parts.length >= 2 && (provider === '-' || provider === parts[0])) {
+                            provider = parts[0];
+                            model = parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        }
+                    }
+                    if (provider === '-' && model.includes('/')) {
+                        const parts = model.split('/');
+                        if (parts.length >= 2 && parts[0] === parts[1]) {
+                            provider = parts[0];
+                            model = parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        } else if (parts.length >= 2) {
+                            provider = parts[0];
+                            model = parts.slice(1).join('/');
+                        }
+                    }
+
+                    let statusLabel = '';
+                    let statusColor = '#c9d1d9';
+                    if (kind === 'active') {
+                        statusLabel = 'Active ⏳';
+                        statusColor = '#d29922';
+                    } else if (r.status === 'success') {
+                        statusLabel = 'Success ✅';
+                        statusColor = '#3fb950';
+                    } else if (r.status && (r.status.startsWith('error') || r.status.startsWith('err') || r.status.includes('fail'))) {
+                        statusLabel = 'Rejected ❌';
+                        statusColor = '#f85149';
+                    } else {
+                        statusLabel = 'Success ✅';
+                        statusColor = '#3fb950';
+                    }
+
+                    let statsParts = [];
+                    if (r.trend) {
+                        const trendMap = { up: '↗', down: '↘', flat: '→', new: 'NEW' };
+                        const arrow = trendMap[r.trend] || r.trend;
+                        statsParts.push(arrow);
+                    }
+                    if (r.rank) statsParts.push(`rank #${r.rank}`);
+                    if (r.N != null) statsParts.push(`N=${r.N}`);
+                    if (r.avg != null) statsParts.push(`avg=${r.avg}`);
+                    if (r.latency_ms) statsParts.push(`${r.latency_ms}ms`);
+                    if (r.tokens_in || r.tokens_out) statsParts.push(`tok:${r.tokens_in || 0}in/${r.tokens_out || 0}out`);
+                    // Combine reason and error to avoid redundancy - prefer reason, fallback to lastError
+                    const reasonOrError = r.reason || r.lastError;
+                    if (reasonOrError) {
+                        // Escape HTML to prevent XSS and improve readability
+                        const cleanReason = reasonOrError
+                            .replace(/</g, '<')
+                            .replace(/>/g, '>')
+                            .replace(/"/g, '"');
+                        statsParts.push(`reason: ${cleanReason}`);
+                    }
+                    if (r.selectionHistory && r.selectionHistory.length > 0) {
+                        const rejected = r.selectionHistory.filter(sh => sh.status === 'rejected');
+                        if (rejected.length > 0) {
+                            statsParts.push(`<span title="Modelli scartati per questa richiesta">scarti: ${rejected.length}</span>`);
+                        }
+                    }
+                    const statsStr = statsParts.join(' | ') || '-';
+
+                    return `<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #21262d;">
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; white-space: nowrap; color: #8b949e; font-family: monospace;">${timeVal}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; white-space: nowrap; color: #8b949e; font-size: 11px;">[${escapeHtml(provider)}]</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; color: #58a6ff;">${escapeHtml(model)}</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap;"><span style="color: ${statusColor}; font-weight: 600;">${escapeHtml(statusLabel)}</span></td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; font-family: monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #c9d1d9;">${escapeHtml(statsStr)}</td>
+                    </tr>`;
+                }
+
+                const showZoo = document.getElementById('log-show-zoo')?.checked ?? true;
+                const showTrain = document.getElementById('log-show-train')?.checked ?? true;
+                const filterSrc = (arr) => (arr || []).filter(item => {
+                    if (!showZoo && item.source === 'zoo') return false;
+                    if (!showTrain && item.source === 'training') return false;
+                    return true;
+                });
+
+                const activeHtml = filterSrc(d.requests).map(r => fmtRow(r, 'active')).join('');
+                const recentHtml = filterSrc(d.recent).slice(-10).reverse().map(r => fmtRow(r, 'recent')).join('');
+                
+                const totalRows = (d.requests || []).length + Math.min((d.recent || []).length, 10);
+                const placeholders = Math.max(0, 4 - totalRows);
+                let placeholderHtml = '';
+                for (let i = 0; i < placeholders; i++) {
+                    placeholderHtml += `<tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #21262d; opacity: 0.2;">
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px;">-</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px;">-</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px;">-</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px; text-align: center;">-</td>
+                        <td style="padding: 3px 6px;">-</td>
+                    </tr>`;
+                }
+
+                tbody.innerHTML = activeHtml + recentHtml + placeholderHtml;
+                console.debug('[DEBUG Dashboard] fetchActive table updated, active:', (d.requests || []).length, 'recent:', (d.recent || []).length);
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error('[DEBUG Dashboard] fetchActive error:', e);
+            }
+        }
+        // ============= INIT =============
+        // Attach filter event listeners to existing filter elements
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-search')?.addEventListener('input', renderAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-provider')?.addEventListener('change', renderAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-status')?.addEventListener('change', renderAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-minN')?.addEventListener('input', renderAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg')?.addEventListener('input', renderAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-search-train')?.addEventListener('input', renderTrainAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-provider-train')?.addEventListener('change', renderTrainAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-status-train')?.addEventListener('change', renderTrainAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-minN-train')?.addEventListener('input', renderTrainAll);
+        document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg-train')?.addEventListener('input', renderTrainAll);
+
+        // Reset filtri al load (no persistenza browser)
+        const logFilterEl = document.getElementById('log-filter');
+        if (logFilterEl) logFilterEl.value = '';
+        ['log-show-zoo', 'log-show-train', 'log-show-debug'].forEach(id => {
+            const el = document.getElementById(id);
+            if (el) el.checked = true;
+        });
+
+        // refreshAll(); // Moved to DOMContentLoaded
+        fetchLogs();
+        fetchActive();
+        fetchQuota();
+        fetchConsideration();
+        const polls = [
+            { fn: refreshAll, interval: 10000, lastRun: 0 },
+            { fn: fetchLogs, interval: 5000, lastRun: 0 },
+            { fn: fetchActive, interval: 5000, lastRun: 0 },
+            { fn: fetchQuota, interval: 30000, lastRun: 0 },
+            { fn: fetchConsideration, interval: 10000, lastRun: 0 }
+        ];
+
+        setInterval(() => {
+            if (document.hidden) return;
+            // Only poll if dashboard tab is visible (not just browser tab)
+            const activeTab = document.querySelector('.tab-content.active');
+            if (!activeTab) return;
+            const now = Date.now();
+            for (const poll of polls) {
+                if (now - poll.lastRun >= poll.interval) {
+                    poll.fn();
+                    poll.lastRun = now;
+                }
+            }
+        }, 1000);
+
+        let lastConsiderationData = [];
+
+        async function fetchConsideration() {
+            try {
+                const res = await apiFetch('/v1/consideration');
+                if (!res.ok) {
+                    if (res.status === 401) { handleUnauthorized(); return; }
+                    return;
+                }
+                const data = await res.json();
+                lastConsiderationData = data.consideration || [];
+                renderTopSpecSheet(lastConsiderationData);
+                renderConsiderationTab();
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error("[Dashboard] Error fetching consideration:", e);
+            }
+        }
+
+        function renderTopSpecSheet(list) {
+            const specSheet = document.getElementById('chronological-spec-sheet');
+            if (!specSheet) return;
+            if (!list || list.length === 0) {
+                specSheet.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#8b949e;">Nessuna valutazione UCB1 recente registrata.</span>';
+                return;
+            }
+            specSheet.innerHTML = list.map((item, idx) => {
+                const num = idx + 1;
+                const isSelected = item.status === 'selected' || item.selected;
+                const badgeColor = isSelected ? '#3fb950' : '#f85149';
+                const statusText = isSelected ? 'SELEZIONATO ✅ (In Uso)' : `scartato: ${item.reason || item.filterReason || 'unknown'}`;
+                const rewardTxt = item.reward !== undefined ? ` | Reward: ${Number(item.reward).toFixed(3)}` : '';
+                const nTxt = item.N !== undefined ? ` | N: ${item.N}` : '';
+                const latTxt = item.latency_ms !== undefined ? ` | ${item.latency_ms}ms` : '';
+                return `<div style="margin-bottom:4px; padding:4px 6px; border-radius:3px; background:${isSelected ? '#1f382b' : '#311b1b'}; border-left:3px solid ${badgeColor}; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
+                    <div><strong>#${num}</strong> <code>${escapeHtml(item.id || item.model || 'model')}</code> <span style="color:#8b949e; font-size:11px;">[${escapeHtml(item.provider || 'provider')}]</span></div>
+                    <div style="text-align:right;"><span style="color:${badgeColor}; font-weight:600;">${escapeHtml(statusText)}</span><span style="color:#8b949e; font-size:10px;">${nTxt}${rewardTxt}${latTxt}</span></div>
+                </div>`;
+            }).join('');
+        }
+
+        function switchUnifiedSubTab(tab) {
+            const activeContent = document.getElementById('unified-subtab-active');
+            const specContent = document.getElementById('unified-subtab-spec');
+            const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.unified-tab-btn');
+            if (!activeContent || !specContent) return;
+
+            buttons.forEach(btn => {
+                btn.style.background = 'transparent';
+                btn.style.color = '#8b949e';
+                btn.classList.remove('active');
+            });
+
+            if (tab === 'active') {
+                activeContent.style.display = 'block';
+                specContent.style.display = 'none';
+                const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick*="switchUnifiedSubTab(\'active\')"]');
+                if (btn) {
+                    btn.style.background = '#161b22';
+                    btn.style.color = '#58a6ff';
+                    btn.classList.add('active');
+                }
+            } else {
+                activeContent.style.display = 'none';
+                specContent.style.display = 'block';
+                const btn = document.querySelector('button[onclick*="switchUnifiedSubTab(\'spec\')"]');
+                if (btn) {
+                    btn.style.background = '#161b22';
+                    btn.style.color = '#58a6ff';
+                    btn.classList.add('active');
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        let unifiedPanelCollapsed = false;
+        function toggleUnifiedPanel() {
+            const content = document.getElementById('unified-panel-content');
+            const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('unified-panel-toggle');
+            if (!content || !toggleBtn) return;
+            unifiedPanelCollapsed = !unifiedPanelCollapsed;
+            content.style.display = unifiedPanelCollapsed ? 'none' : 'block';
+            toggleBtn.textContent = unifiedPanelCollapsed ? '▲' : '▼';
+        }
+
+        function renderConsiderationTab() {
+            const tbody = document.getElementById('consideration-table-body');
+            const filterInput = document.getElementById('consideration-filter');
+            const filterVal = filterInput ? filterInput.value.toLowerCase() : '';
+            if (!tbody) return;
+
+            const list = lastConsiderationData;
+            let total = list.length;
+            let selectedCount = 0;
+            let rejectedCount = 0;
+            const reasonCounts = {};
+
+            const filtered = list.filter(item => {
+                const isSelected = item.status === 'selected' || item.selected;
+                if (isSelected) selectedCount++; else rejectedCount++;
+                const reason = item.reason || item.filterReason || 'none';
+                reasonCounts[reason] = (reasonCounts[reason] || 0) + 1;
+
+                if (!filterVal) return true;
+                const txt = `${item.id || item.model || ''} ${item.provider || ''} ${reason} ${item.status || ''}`.toLowerCase();
+                return txt.includes(filterVal);
+            });
+
+            document.getElementById('cons-stat-total').textContent = total;
+            document.getElementById('cons-stat-selected').textContent = selectedCount;
+            document.getElementById('cons-stat-rejected').textContent = rejectedCount;
+
+            let topReason = '-';
+            let maxReasonCount = 0;
+            for (const [r, c] of Object.entries(reasonCounts)) {
+                if (c > maxReasonCount) {
+                    maxReasonCount = c;
+                    topReason = `${r} (${c})`;
+                }
+            }
+            document.getElementById('cons-stat-top-reason').textContent = topReason;
+
+            if (filtered.length === 0) {
+                tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6" style="text-align:center; color:#8b949e; padding:20px;">Nessun record di considerazione corrispondente al filtro.</td></tr>';
+                return;
+            }
+
+            tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map((item, idx) => {
+                const isSelected = item.status === 'selected' || item.selected;
+                const badgeColor = isSelected ? '#3fb950' : '#f85149';
+                const statusText = isSelected ? 'SELEZIONATO ✅' : 'SCARTATO ❌';
+                const reason = item.reason || item.filterReason || 'unknown';
+                const bg = isSelected ? '#162b20' : '#2b1616';
+                const nVal = item.N !== undefined ? item.N : '-';
+                const rewardVal = item.reward !== undefined ? Number(item.reward).toFixed(3) : '-';
+                const latVal = item.latency_ms !== undefined ? `${item.latency_ms}ms` : '-';
+                const timeStr = item.timestamp ? new Date(item.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString() : `#${idx+1}`;
+
+                return `<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #30363d; background:${bg};">
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px; color:#8b949e;">${timeStr}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px;"><code>${escapeHtml(item.id || item.model || '-')}</code></td>
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px; color:#58a6ff;">${escapeHtml(item.provider || '-')}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px;"><span style="color:${badgeColor}; font-weight:600;">${statusText}</span></td>
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px; color:#c9d1d9;">${escapeHtml(reason)}</td>
+                    <td style="padding:8px; font-size:12px; color:#8b949e;">N: ${nVal} | Reward: ${rewardVal} | Lat: ${latVal}</td>
+                </tr>`;
+            }).join('');
+        }
+        function initFab() {
+            const fab = document.getElementById('dev-fab');
+            const menu = document.getElementById('dev-menu');
+
+            // Toggle menu
+            fab?.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+                e.stopPropagation();

+                menu?.classList.toggle('open');
+            });

+        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
+            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initFab);
+        } else {
+            initFab();
+        }

+        // Chiudi menu cliccando fuori
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const fab = document.getElementById('dev-fab');
+            const menu = document.getElementById('dev-menu');
+            if (!menu?.contains(e.target) && e.target !== fab) {
+                fab?.classList.remove('open');
+                menu?.classList.remove('open');
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Apri modal (event delegation)
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const item = e.target.closest('.dev-menu-item');
+            if (item) {
+                const fab = document.getElementById('dev-fab');
+                const menu = document.getElementById('dev-menu');
+                fab?.classList.remove('open');
+                menu?.classList.remove('open');
+                const which = item.dataset.open; // 'developer' | 'changelog'
+                const modal = document.getElementById('modal-' + which);
+                if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
+                if (which === 'changelog') {
+                    const cl = document.getElementById('changelog-content');
+                    if (cl && !cl.dataset.loaded) {
+                        fetch('/v1/changelog').then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
+                            cl.innerHTML = renderChangelog(d.changelog || '');
+                            cl.dataset.loaded = '1';
+                            // Marca come letto
+                            const v = extractFirstVersion(d.changelog || '');
+                            if (v) {
+                                localStorage.setItem('changelogLastRead', v);
+                                document.getElementById('dev-fab')?.classList.remove('has-update');
+                            }
+                        }).catch(() => { cl.textContent = 'Errore caricamento changelog.'; });
+                    } else {
+                        // Già caricato: comunque marca come letto
+                        const v = cl?.dataset.latestVersion;
+                        if (v) {
+                            localStorage.setItem('changelogLastRead', v);
+                            document.getElementById('dev-fab')?.classList.remove('has-update');
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Chiudi modal (click su overlay o X) (event delegation)
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const overlay = e.target.closest('.dev-modal-overlay');
+            if (overlay && e.target === overlay) {
+                overlay.style.display = 'none';
+            }
+        });
+        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
+            const btn = e.target.closest('.dev-modal-close');
+            if (btn) {
+                const id = btn.dataset.close;
+                const modal = document.getElementById(id);
+                if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
+            }
+        });
+
+        // Share (event delegation)
+        document.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
+            const shareBtn = e.target.closest('#dev-share-btn');
+            if (shareBtn) {
+                if (navigator.share) {
+                    try { await navigator.share({ title: 'OmniRoute Bandit Proxy', url: location.href }); } catch {}
+                } else {
+                    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href);
+                    alert('URL copiato negli appunti!');
+                }
+            }
+        });
+        // Badge changelog: check nuovo changelog
+        fetch('/v1/changelog').then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
+            const latest = extractFirstVersion(d.changelog || '');
+            if (!latest) return;
+            const lastRead = localStorage.getItem('changelogLastRead');

+        // Inizializza filtri con localStorage
+        function initFilters() {
+                // Models filters
+                const savedModelsFilters = localStorage.getItem('models.filters');
+                if (savedModelsFilters) {
+                    const filters = JSON.parse(savedModelsFilters);
+                    if (filters.search) document.getElementById('models-filter-search').value = filters.search;
+                    if (filters.provider) document.getElementById('models-filter-provider').value = filters.provider;
+                    if (filters.status) document.getElementById('models-filter-status').value = filters.status;
+                    if (filters.minN !== undefined) document.getElementById('models-filter-minN').value = filters.minN;
+                    if (filters.minAvg !== undefined) document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg').value = filters.minAvg;
+                }
+
+                // Train filters
+                const savedTrainFilters = localStorage.getItem('train.filters');
+                if (savedTrainFilters) {
+                    const filters = JSON.parse(savedTrainFilters);
+                    if (filters.search) document.getElementById('models-filter-search-train').value = filters.search;
+                    if (filters.provider) document.getElementById('models-filter-provider-train').value = filters.provider;
+                    if (filters.status) document.getElementById('models-filter-status-train').value = filters.status;
+                    if (filters.minN !== undefined) document.getElementById('models-filter-minN-train').value = filters.minN;
+                    if (filters.minAvg !== undefined) document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg-train').value = filters.minAvg;
+                }
+
+                // Add event listeners to save filters
+                const filterInputs = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-input');
+                filterInputs.forEach(input => {
+                    input.addEventListener('change', () => {
+                        const form = input.closest('.filter-bar');
+                        if (form.id === 'models-filter-form') {
+                            const filters = {
+                                search: document.getElementById('models-filter-search').value,
+                                provider: document.getElementById('models-filter-provider').value,
+                                status: document.getElementById('models-filter-status').value,
+                                minN: parseInt(document.getElementById('models-filter-minN').value) || 0,
+                                minAvg: parseFloat(document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg').value) || 0
+                            };
+                            localStorage.setItem('models.filters', JSON.stringify(filters));
+                            renderAll();
+                        } else if (form.id === 'train-filter-form') {
+                            const filters = {
+                                search: document.getElementById('models-filter-search-train').value,
+                                provider: document.getElementById('models-filter-provider-train').value,
+                                status: document.getElementById('models-filter-status-train').value,
+                                minN: parseInt(document.getElementById('models-filter-minN-train').value) || 0,
+                                minAvg: parseFloat(document.getElementById('models-filter-minAvg-train').value) || 0
+                            };
+                            localStorage.setItem('train.filters', JSON.stringify(filters));
+                            renderTrainAll();
+                        }
+                    });
+                });

+        // ========================================
+        // SCRIPT MANAGER FUNCTIONALITY
+        // ========================================
+        
+        let scriptsData = [];
+        
+        // Helper function to get auth headers
+        function authHeaders() {
+            if (!API_TOKEN) {
+                API_TOKEN =
+                    new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('omniroute_token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('omniroute_dashboard_token') ||
+                    localStorage.getItem('api_token') ||
+                    '';
+            }
+            const headers = {};
+            if (API_TOKEN) headers['x-api-token'] = API_TOKEN;
+            return headers;
+        }
+        
+        // Helper function to format bytes
+        function formatBytes(bytes, decimals = 2) {
+            if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';
+            const k = 1024;
+            const dm = decimals < 0 ? 0 : decimals;
+            const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB', 'PB', 'EB', 'ZB', 'YB'];
+            const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));
+            return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(dm)) + ' ' + sizes[i];
+        }
+        
+        async function loadScripts() {
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/v1/scripts', { headers: authHeaders() });
+                const text = await res.text();
+                let data;
+                try {
+                    data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
+                } catch (jsonErr) {
+                    throw new Error(`Risposta non valida dal server (${res.status}): ${text.substring(0, 100)}`);
+                }
+
+                if (res.status === 401) {
+                    handleUnauthorized();
+                    return;
+                }
+
+                if (!res.ok) {
+                    throw new Error(data.error || `Errore HTTP ${res.status}`);
+                }
+
+                scriptsData = data.scripts || [];
+                renderScripts();
+            } catch (e) {
+                console.error('Error loading scripts:', e);
+                document.getElementById('scripts-tbody').innerHTML =
+                    `<tr><td colspan="5" style="text-align:center; color:#f85149;">Errore caricamento script: ${escapeHtml(e.message)}</td></tr>`;
+            }
+        }
+        
+        const scriptDescriptions = {
+            'check-db.mjs': 'Verifica l’integrità del database SQLite, conteggi tabelle e stato generale.',
+            'clean-cjs-tests.mjs': 'Pulisce file di test CommonJS obsoleti o residui dalla directory.',
+            'inspect-db.mjs': 'Ispeziona lo schema e i dati contenuti nelle tabelle del database principale.',
+            'restart.sh': 'Riavvia il servizio del proxy in modo pulito preservando le sessioni attive.',
+            'switch-mode.sh': 'Gestisce i passaggi tra modalità (prod, train-gentle, train, stop).',
+            'test-final.mjs': 'Esegue i test finali di verifica del sistema e della suite di proxy.',
+            'test-target.sh': 'Esegue test mirati su componenti specifici o moduli isolati.',
+            'train-ctl.sh': 'Controlla il daemon di training e lo stato dell’apprendimento UCB1.',
+            'train-daemon.mjs': 'Daemon in background per l’addestramento asincrono e isolato dei modelli.',
+            'verify-dashboard-stats.mjs': 'Verifica la correttezza e la sincronizzazione delle metriche della dashboard.',
+            'verify-server.mjs': 'Esegue un health check approfondito sull’endpoint e sullo stato di avvio.',
+            'wrapper-test.sh': 'Script wrapper per l’esecuzione dei test in ambiente controllato.'
+        };
+
+        function renderScripts() {
+            const tbody = document.getElementById('scripts-tbody');
+            const filter = document.getElementById('script-filter')?.value.toLowerCase() || '';
+            
+            const filtered = scriptsData.filter(s =>
+                s.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter) ||
+                s.type.toLowerCase().includes(filter) ||
+                (scriptDescriptions[s.name] && scriptDescriptions[s.name].toLowerCase().includes(filter))
+            );
+            
+            document.getElementById('scripts-count').textContent =
+                `${filtered.length} script${filtered.length !== 1 ? 'i' : ''}`;
+            
+            tbody.innerHTML = filtered.map(s => {
+                const desc = scriptDescriptions[s.name] || 'Script di utilità e gestione di sistema.';
+                return `
+                    <tr>
+                        <td>
+                            <div style="font-weight:600; color:#58a6ff; margin-bottom:4px; font-family:monospace; font-size:13px;">${escapeHtml(s.name)}</div>
+                            <div style="font-size:12px; color:#c9d1d9; line-height:1.4; white-space:normal; word-break:break-word;">${escapeHtml(desc)}</div>
+                        </td>
+                        <td><span class="badge badge-${s.type === 'shell' ? 'warning' : 'info'}">${s.type}</span></td>
+                        <td>${formatBytes(s.size)}</td>
+                        <td>${new Date(s.modified).toLocaleString()}</td>
+                        <td>
+                            <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center;">
+                                <input type="text" id="script-args-${escapeHtml(s.name)}" placeholder="args (es. status)" title="Argomenti riga di comando opzionali" style="width:110px; padding:4px 6px; font-size:11px; background:#0d1117; color:#c9d1d9; border:1px solid #30363d; border-radius:4px;">
+                                <button class="btn btn-sm" onclick="executeScript('${escapeHtml(s.name)}')" title="Esegui script">
+                                    ▶ Esegui
+                                </button>
+                            </div>
+                        </td>
+                    </tr>
+                `;
+            }).join('');
+        }
+        
+        async function executeScript(scriptName) {
+            const script = scriptsData.find(s => s.name === scriptName);
+            if (!script) return;
+            
+            const argsInput = document.getElementById(`script-args-${scriptName}`);
+            let args = [];
+            if (argsInput && argsInput.value.trim()) {
+                args = argsInput.value.trim().split(/\s+/);
+            }
+            
+            // Mostra il container di output
+            const container = document.getElementById('script-output-container');
+            const title = document.getElementById('script-output-title');
+            const status = document.getElementById('script-output-status');
+            const output = document.getElementById('script-output');
+            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('script-progress-container');
+            const progressBar = document.getElementById('script-progress-bar');
+            const progressPct = document.getElementById('script-progress-pct');
+            
+            container.style.display = 'block';
+            title.textContent = `Output: ${scriptName}${args.length ? ' ' + args.join(' ') : ''}`;
+            status.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#58a6ff;">⏳ Esecuzione in corso...</span>';
+            output.textContent = '';
+            
+            if (progressContainer) progressContainer.style.display = 'block';
+            if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '10%';
+            if (progressPct) progressPct.textContent = '10%';
+            
+            // Scroll to output
+            container.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+            
+            try {
+                const res = await fetch('/v1/scripts/execute', {
+                    method: 'POST',
+                    headers: { ...authHeaders(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+                    body: JSON.stringify({ scriptPath: script.name, args })
+                });
+                
+                const text = await res.text();
+                let result;
+                try {
+                    result = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
+                } catch (jsonErr) {
+                    throw new Error(`Risposta non valida dal server (${res.status}): ${text.substring(0, 100)}`);
+                }
+
+                if (!res.ok) {
+                    throw new Error(result.error || `Errore HTTP ${res.status}`);
+                }
+                
+                // Poll for completion
+                await pollScriptOutput(result.pid);
+                
+            } catch (e) {
+                status.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#f85149;">✗ Errore: ${escapeHtml(e.message)}</span>`;
+                output.textContent = e.message;
+            }
+        }
+        
+        async function pollScriptOutput(pid) {
+            const status = document.getElementById('script-output-status');
+            const output = document.getElementById('script-output');
+            const progressContainer = document.getElementById('script-progress-container');
+            const progressBar = document.getElementById('script-progress-bar');
+            const progressPct = document.getElementById('script-progress-pct');
+            
+            let isStopped = false;
+            let idleCount = 0;
+            
+            while (!isStopped) {
+                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));
+                
+                try {
+                    const res = await fetch(`/v1/scripts/output/${pid}`, { headers: authHeaders() });
+                    if (res.status === 401) {
+                        handleUnauthorized();
+                        isStopped = true;
+                        break;
+                    }
+                    if (!res.ok) {
+                        idleCount++;
+                        if (idleCount > 15) {
+                            status.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#f85149;">⚠ Script terminato (errore polling)</span>';
+                            isStopped = true;
+                            break;
+                        }
+                        continue;
+                    }
+                    
+                    const text = await res.text();
+                    let data;
+                    try {
+                        data = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
+                    } catch (err) {
+                        idleCount++;
+                        continue;
+                    }
+                    
+                    idleCount = 0;
+                    
+                    let liveText = '';
+                    if (data.stdout) liveText += `=== STDOUT ===\n${data.stdout}\n`;
+                    if (data.stderr) liveText += `=== STDERR ===\n${data.stderr}\n`;
+                    if (liveText) {
+                        output.textContent = liveText;
+                        output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
+                    }
+                    
+                    if (data.status === 'completed') {
+                        if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '100%';
+                        if (progressPct) progressPct.textContent = '100%';
+                        
+                        const exitCode = data.exitCode;
+                        const color = exitCode === 0 ? '#3fb950' : '#f85149';
+                        const icon = exitCode === 0 ? '✓' : '✗';
+                        
+                        status.innerHTML = `<span style="color:${color};">${icon} Completato (exit code: ${exitCode}, ${data.duration}ms)</span>`;
+                        
+                        let outText = '';
+                        if (data.stdout) outText += `=== STDOUT ===\n${data.stdout}\n`;
+                        if (data.stderr) outText += `=== STDERR ===\n${data.stderr}\n`;
+                        if (!outText) outText = '(nessun output)';
+                        
+                        output.textContent = outText;
+                        output.scrollTop = output.scrollHeight;
+                        return;
+                    } else if (data.status === 'running') {
+                        const elapsed = data.startTime ? Math.floor((Date.now() - data.startTime) / 1000) : 0;
+                        status.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#58a6ff;">⏳ In esecuzione continua... (${elapsed}s)</span>`;
+                        if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '100%';
+                        if (progressPct) progressPct.textContent = `${elapsed}s`;
+                    } else if (data.status === 'stopped') {
+                        status.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#f89d0a;">⏹ Script interrotto dall\'utente</span>';
+                        isStopped = true;
+                        return;
+                    }
+                } catch (e) {
+                    // Ignore polling errors
+                }
+            }
+            
+            if (progressBar) progressBar.style.width = '100%';
+            if (progressBar) progressBar.style.background = '#f85149';
+            if (progressPct) progressPct.textContent = 'Interrotto';
+            status.innerHTML = '<span style="color:#f85149;">⏹ Polling interrotto</span>';
+        }
+        
+        // Event listeners per Script Manager
+        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
+            // Refresh button
+            document.getElementById('scripts-refresh')?.addEventListener('click', loadScripts);
+            
+            // Filter
+            document.getElementById('script-filter')?.addEventListener('input', renderScripts);
+            
+            // Close output
+            document.getElementById('script-output-close')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+                document.getElementById('script-output-container').style.display = 'none';
+            });
+
+            // Copy script output log
+            document.getElementById('script-output-copy')?.addEventListener('click', copyScriptOutput);
+            
+            // Load scripts when tab is activated
+            const scriptsTab = document.querySelector('[data-tab="scripts"]');
+            if (scriptsTab) {
+                scriptsTab.addEventListener('click', () => {
+                    if (scriptsData.length === 0) {
+                        loadScripts();
+                    }
+                });
+            }
+        });
+    </script>
+</body>
 </html>

-# POST /v1/images/generations Endpoint Design
-
-## Overview
-Create a new endpoint for image generation requests that follows the same pattern as the chat/completions endpoint but routes to image generation models only.
-
-## Request Format (OpenAI-compatible)
-```json
-{
-  "prompt": "A beautiful sunset over the ocean",
-  "model": "dall-e-3", // optional, if not provided will use bandit selection
-  "n": 1, // number of images to generate (default: 1)
-  "size": "1024x1024", // image size (default: 1024x1024)
-  "quality": "standard", // or "hd" for dall-e-3
-  "style": "vivid", // or "natural" for dall-e-3
-  "response_format": "url", // or "b64_json"
-  "user": "optional-user-id"
-}
-```
-
-## Implementation Details
-
-### 1. Route Registration
-Add to src/index.mjs after the chat/completions endpoint:
-```javascript
-app.post("/v1/images/generations", async (req, res) => {
-  // Image generation endpoint implementation
-});
-```
-
-### 2. Request Processing Steps
-Similar to chat/completions but adapted for image generation:
-
-#### A. Setup and Tracking
-- Generate request ID
-- Start request tracking
-- Set up cleanup handlers for disconnect/finish
-
-#### B. Parameter Extraction and Validation
-- Extract `prompt` (required)

-## 1. Executive Summary

-# Performance Analysis & Optimization Report: OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
-
-This report presents a thorough static code analysis of the `omniroute-bandit-proxy` codebase, identifying performance bottlenecks, architectural risks, and actionable recommendations.
-
-## 1. Critical Performance Bottlenecks
-
-### A. Schema Introspection on Every Quota Check (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
-- **Location**: [`src/provider-quota.mjs:40`](src/provider-quota.mjs:40) and [`src/provider-quota.mjs:93`](src/provider-quota.mjs:93)
-- **Issue**: `this.db.pragma("table_info(provider_history)")` is invoked inside `_rollWindows()` and `canCall()` on **every single API request and quota evaluation**. Table schema introspection queries SQLite internal metadata tables (`sqlite_master`) every time, causing severe database contention, CPU overhead, and blocking latency under high concurrency.
-- **Recommendation**: Cache the table column existence check once in the `ProviderQuota` constructor (or lazily initialize a boolean flag `this._hasGroupCols`) rather than querying `pragma` per request.
-
-### B. SQLite Statement Compilation & Execution Contention
-- **Location**: Across [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) and [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs)
-- **Issue**: Many methods call `this.db.prepare(...)` inline on every execution. While `better-sqlite3` caches prepared statements internally by SQL string hash, caching statement objects in class fields or initialization reduces JS-to-C++ binding overhead and query parsing overhead.
-- **Recommendation**: Pre-compile all frequently used SQLite statements in constructors and store them as class properties (e.g., `this.stmtUpdateQuota = this.db.prepare(...)`).
-
-### C. JavaScript-Side Model Filtering & Sorting
-- **Location**: [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) (`selectModel()`)
-- **Issue**: Filtering through the entire model catalog, merging database models with catalog models, applying soft bias multipliers, and sorting by UCB1 scores happens frequently. Although buffered by the 30-second `_rankCache`, cache misses during heavy traffic spikes can saturate the event loop with sorting and filtering operations across hundreds of models.
-- **Recommendation**: Ensure `_rankCache` keys include all relevant profile and filtering flags, and consider indexing model metadata in memory if model counts scale beyond 1,000.
-
----
-
-## 2. Memory Sizing, Caching, and TTL Management
-
-### A. Session Map LRU Eviction & Cleanup (`src/index.mjs`)
-- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) (`sessionModelMap`)
-- **Issue**: `sessionModelMap` maintains session affinity with a max capacity of 10,000 entries and a 30-minute TTL. While LRU eviction prevents unbounded memory growth, stale sessions that are never accessed again remain in memory until capacity is reached or periodic timer sweeps execute.
-- **Recommendation**: Ensure periodic cleanup intervals (e.g., every 5 minutes) actively purge expired entries rather than relying solely on lazy eviction during insertion.
-
-### B. Rank Cache Invalidation Granularity (`src/bandit.mjs`)
-- **Location**: [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) (`_rankCache`)
-- **Issue**: The 30-second rank cache speeds up routing significantly. However, feedback events (success/failure recording) should immediately invalidate or update the rank cache for the affected model/profile rather than waiting up to 30 seconds for stale UCB1 rankings to expire.
-- **Recommendation**: Invalidate or update `_rankCache` entries instantly upon `recordFeedback()` or provider status changes.
-
----
-
-## 3. Concurrency, Async/Await, and Resource Cleanup
-
-### A. Synchronous SQLite Operations in Async Handlers
-- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) and [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs)
-- **Issue**: `better-sqlite3` is synchronous. While this eliminates async mutex locking overhead in single-process Node.js, heavy SQLite queries or transactions will block the event loop if executed during high-throughput proxy streaming.
-- **Recommendation**: Keep transactions short, use SQLite WAL mode (`PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;`), and set an appropriate busy timeout (`PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;`).
-
-### B. Stream Timeout and Resource Cleanup (`src/index.mjs`)
-- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) (Upstream fetch and SSE streaming handlers)
-- **Issue**: Three-level timeouts (`UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS`, `STREAM_IDLE_MS`, `STREAM_MAX_MS`) are well implemented with AbortControllers. However, ensure that active response streams and upstream connections are explicitly aborted and destroyed in `finally` blocks upon client disconnect or error to prevent socket leaks.
-- **Recommendation**: Verify `req.on('close', ...)` handlers clean up all active upstream fetch `AbortController` instances.
-
----
-
-## Summary of Actionable Next Steps
-1. Remove `pragma("table_info(...)")` calls from [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs) request path.
-2. Pre-compile SQLite prepared statements in constructors.
-3. Optimize rank cache invalidation on feedback recording.
-4. Ensure robust abort controller cleanup on client disconnects in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs).

+// Temporary diagnostic: replicate bandit._parseTokenLimit() against real error messages
+import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
+
+const db = new Database('bandit.db', { readonly: true });
+
+function parseTokenLimit(message) {
+  if (!message || typeof message !== 'string') return null;
+  const limitPatterns = [
+    /(?:limit|maximum|max|capacity|tpm|token\s+limit|rate\s+limit)[^\d]*(\d+)/i,
+    /(\d+)\s*(?:tokens\s+per\s+minute|tpm)/i
+  ];
+  for (const pat of limitPatterns) {
+    const m = message.match(pat);
+    if (m && m[1]) {
+      const val = parseInt(m[1], 10);
+      if (val > 0) return val;
+    }
+  }
+  return null;
+}
+
+const rows = db.prepare(`
+  SELECT r.model, r.status_code, r.error_message, m.dynamic_max_tokens, m.N, m.fails
+  FROM request_logs r
+  JOIN models m ON m.id = r.model
+  WHERE r.error_message IS NOT NULL
+  ORDER BY r.id DESC
+  LIMIT 400
+`).all();
+
+const seen = new Map();
+for (const r of rows) {
+  const parsed = parseTokenLimit(r.error_message);
+  const key = `${r.status_code}|${parsed}|${r.dynamic_max_tokens}`;
+  if (!seen.has(key)) {
+    seen.set(key, { ...r, parsed, sample: r.error_message.slice(0, 160) });
+  }
+}
+
+console.log('=== status | parsedLimit | dynamic_max_tokens | count ===');
+const agg = new Map();
+for (const r of rows) {
+  const parsed = parseTokenLimit(r.error_message);
+  const k = `${r.status_code} | parsed=${parsed} | dyn=${r.dynamic_max_tokens}`;
+  agg.set(k, (agg.get(k) || 0) + 1);
+}
+for (const [k, v] of [...agg.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])) {
+  console.log(`${String(v).padStart(4)}x  ${k}`);
+}
+
+console.log('\n=== sample messages whose parsed limit is small (<100) ===');
+for (const r of seen.values()) {
+  if (r.parsed !== null && r.parsed < 100) {
+    console.log(`model=${r.model}\n  status=${r.status_code} parsed=${r.parsed} dyn=${r.dynamic_max_tokens} N=${r.N}\n  msg=${r.sample}\n`);
+  }
+}
+
+console.log('\n=== models with dynamic_max_tokens < 100 (count + N distribution) ===');
+const small = db.prepare(
+  `SELECT dynamic_max_tokens, COUNT(*) c, SUM(CASE WHEN N>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) with_traffic, MAX(N) maxN
+  FROM models WHERE dynamic_max_tokens > 0 AND dynamic_max_tokens < 100

+console.table(small);

+### 12. Controllo del rumore di log e polling efficiente
+
+Il proxy include [`src/log-throttle.mjs`](src/log-throttle.mjs:1) per ridurre il rumore di console e migliorare l'efficienza del polling:
+
+- **Throttling per endpoint**: `DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS` (default 60s) e `MODELS_LOG_THROTTLE_MS` (default 60s) limitano la frequenza dei log di `/v1/dashboard/stats` e `GET /v1/models`.
+- **CORS/debug silenzioso**: `CORS_DEBUG=false` disabilita il log della riga CORS/debug per ogni richiesta in ingresso.
+- **Verbose debug con TTL**: `DEBUG_VERBOSE=false` e `DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS=900000` (15 min) attivano log dettagliati che scadono automaticamente.
+- **Ring buffer denylist**: `LOG_BUFFER_DENYLIST` (pipe-separated tag names) esclude tag come `CORS/DEBUG|DEBUG AUTH|DEBUG server|PROXY` dal ring buffer `/v1/logs`, mantenendoli solo sul terminale.
+
+Configura queste variabili in `.env` (vedi `.env.example` per i valori di default).

+/**
+ * Shared throttling + log-filtering helpers for the OmniRoute Bandit Proxy.
+ *
+ * These small, side-effect-free utilities are extracted from src/index.mjs so
+ * that the polling-noise behaviour can be unit-tested without booting the
+ * whole Express server (which would otherwise open the SQLite database and
+ * register hundreds of routes).
+ *
+ * Four concerns live here:
+ *   1. createThrottledLogger() — the `{ lastLogAt, suppressed }` pattern that
+ *      previously existed twice (dashboard-stats and /v1/models) with two
+ *      different windows and inconsistent defaults.  Now there is ONE factory
+ *      and both call sites use it.
+ *   2. isLowValueNoise() — the ring-buffer denylist predicate that decides
+ *      whether a console line is cheap enough to skip from the in-memory
+ *      `logBuffer` (which backs the dashboard Logs tab at /v1/logs).
+ *   3. createTtlFlag() — the TTL-bounded `debugVerbose` flag (R2).  A flag that
+ *      is switched on automatically expires so that a forgotten `/v1/debug/
+ *      toggle` cannot keep the server in verbose mode forever.
+ *   4. isPollingPath() — the list of dashboard-polled API routes whose access
+ *      log lines are low-value noise (R5).
+ */
+
+/**
+ * Default TTL applied to the verbose debug flag: 15 minutes.
+ * @type {number}
+ */
+export const DEFAULT_DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS = 900000;
+
+/**
+ * Build a throttled-logger state machine.
+ *
+ * The returned `decide(message, now = Date.now())` returns an object describing
+ * what to do:
+ *   - { log: true,  message, suppressed } → emit this line now
+ *   - { log: false, suppressed: N }      → suppress; N is the running count of
+ *                                         suppressed calls since the last emit
+ *
+ * When the throttle window elapses, the caller is responsible for emitting a
+ * single summary line that includes the suppressed count.  The convention
+ * used throughout this codebase is the suffix:
+ *
+ *     ` (soppresse ${N} richieste precedenti)`
+ *
+ * which is exactly what the original two call sites appended.
+ *
+ * @param {string} _key        Unused but kept for API symmetry / future stats.
+ * @param {number} windowMs    Milliseconds between allowed log emissions.
+ * @returns {{ decide: Function, getState: Function }}
+ */
+export function createThrottledLogger(_key, windowMs) {
+  const state = { lastLogAt: 0, suppressed: 0 };
+
+  /**
+   * @param {string} message
+   * @param {number} [now=Date.now()]
+   * @returns {{ log: boolean, message?: string, suppressed: number }}
+   */
+  const decide = (message, now = Date.now()) => {
+    if (now - state.lastLogAt >= windowMs) {
+      const suppressed = state.suppressed;
+      state.lastLogAt = now;
+      state.suppressed = 0;
+      return { log: true, message, suppressed };
+    }
+    state.suppressed++;
+    return { log: false, suppressed: state.suppressed };
+  };
+
+  return { decide, getState: () => ({ ...state }) };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Regex that matches the low-value polling-noise lines we want to keep OUT of
+ * the in-memory ring buffer while STILL writing them to the terminal/stdout.
+ *
+ * Groups (case-sensitive, matching the exact prefixes used in src/index.mjs):
+ *   - [CORS/DEBUG]        — the per-request CORS middleware line (R1)
+ *   - [DEBUG AUTH]        — the per-request requireAuth line (R2)
+ *   - [DEBUG server]      — the per-poll /v1/dashboard/stats line (R3)
+ *   - [PROXY]             — the per-request access log line
+ *
+ * The denylist is intentionally narrow: real production events ([ERROR],
+ * [WARN], [UPSTREAM], [BANDIT], [FALLBACK], [AFFINITY], [SUCCESS], …) must
+ * still land in the ring buffer so they are visible in the dashboard Logs
+ * tab.
+ *
+ * @param {string} message
+ * @param {RegExp} [denylistRegex]
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isLowValueNoise(message, denylistRegex) {
+  if (typeof message !== 'string') return false;
+  const pattern = denylistRegex || DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX;
+  return pattern.test(message);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Default denylist.  Overridable at runtime via the LOG_BUFFER_DENYLIST env
+ * var (a list of `|`-separated literal prefixes, e.g.
+ * `CORS/DEBUG|DEBUG AUTH|DEBUG server|PROXY`).
+ * @type {RegExp}
+ */
+export const DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX = /^\[(CORS\/DEBUG|DEBUG AUTH|DEBUG server|PROXY)\]/;
+
+/**
+ * Build a denylist RegExp from a user-supplied string.
+ *
+ * The string is a list of `|`-separated literal prefixes (NOT a full regex —
+ * we anchor each one with `^\[` automatically to avoid accidental partial
+ * matches).  Empty/falsy input falls back to the default.
+ *
+ * @param {string} [raw]
+ * @returns {RegExp}
+ */
+export function buildDenylistRegex(raw) {
+  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') {
+    return DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX;
+  }
+  const parts = raw.split('|').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean).map(escapeRegExp);
+  if (parts.length === 0) return DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX;
+  return new RegExp('^\\[(' + parts.join('|') + ')\\]');
+}
+
+/**
+ * Escape a string so it can be safely embedded inside a RegExp literal.
+ * @param {string} s
+ * @returns {string}
+ */
+function escapeRegExp(s) {
+  return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
+}
+
+/**
+ * True when an environment flag is explicitly enabled.
+ *
+ * Only the exact string "true" enables a flag — everything else (including
+ * "1", "yes", "TRUE" with different case) stays off, so a typo can never
+ * silently turn on verbose logging.
+ *
+ * @param {string|undefined} raw
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isEnvFlagEnabled(raw) {
+  return raw === 'true';
+}
+
+/**
+ * R1 — is the per-request CORS/DEBUG log line enabled?
+ * Opt-in via CORS_DEBUG=true; silent by default.
+ *
+ * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env]
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isCorsDebugEnabled(env = process.env) {
+  return isEnvFlagEnabled(env.CORS_DEBUG);
+}
+
+/**
+ * R2 — is the verbose debug mode seeded on at boot?
+ * Opt-in via DEBUG_VERBOSE=true; off by default.
+ *
+ * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env]
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isDebugVerboseEnabled(env = process.env) {
+  return isEnvFlagEnabled(env.DEBUG_VERBOSE);
+}
+
+/**
+ * R2 — read the TTL (ms) after which the verbose debug flag auto-expires.
+ * Falls back to DEFAULT_DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS (15 min) for missing/invalid
+ * values.
+ *
+ * @param {NodeJS.ProcessEnv} [env]
+ * @returns {number}
+ */
+export function readDebugVerboseTtlMs(env = process.env) {
+  const parsed = parseInt(env.DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS || "", 10);
+  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) return DEFAULT_DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS;
+  return parsed;
+}
+
+/**
+ * R2 — a boolean flag that expires automatically.
+ *
+ * The flag starts in the requested state and is switched on/off explicitly via
+ * set().  Once enabled it stays active for at most `ttlMs` milliseconds; after
+ * that isActive() returns false (and latches the flag off) until set() is
+ * called again.
+ *
+ * @param {boolean} initialEnabled
+ * @param {number} ttlMs
+ * @param {() => number} [nowFn=Date.now]
+ * @returns {{ isActive: Function, set: Function, isEnabled: Function }}
+ */
+export function createTtlFlag(initialEnabled, ttlMs, nowFn = Date.now) {
+  let enabled = !!initialEnabled;
+  let setAt = enabled ? nowFn() : 0;
+
+  const isActive = () => {
+    if (!enabled) return false;
+    if (nowFn() - setAt >= ttlMs) {
+      enabled = false;
+      setAt = 0;
+      return false;
+    }
+    return true;
+  };
+
+  const set = (value) => {
+    enabled = !!value;
+    setAt = enabled ? nowFn() : 0;
+    return enabled;
+  };
+
+  return { isActive, set, isEnabled: () => enabled };
+}
+
+/**
+ * R5 — API routes polled by the dashboard.  Access-log lines for these routes
+ * are pure noise (the dashboard polls them once per second), so they are not
+ * emitted as `[PROXY] ...` lines.
+ *
+ * NOTE: real proxy traffic (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/images/generations) is
+ * deliberately NOT in this list — it must always be logged.
+ *
+ * @type {string[]}
+ */
+export const POLLING_PATH_PREFIXES = [
+  "/v1/metrics",
+  "/v1/logs",
+  "/v1/active",
+  "/v1/modes",
+  "/v1/models",
+  "/v1/models/summary",
+  "/v1/debug/status",
+  "/v1/inflight",
+  "/v1/dashboard/stats",
+  "/v1/consideration",
+  "/v1/quota",
+  "/v1/providers",
+  "/v1/sessions",
+  "/v1/health-check/status",
+];
+
+/**
+ * R5 — is this request path a dashboard polling route?
+ * @param {string} path
+ * @returns {boolean}
+ */
+export function isPollingPath(path) {
+  if (typeof path !== 'string' || path === '') return false;
+  return POLLING_PATH_PREFIXES.some(prefix => path.startsWith(prefix));
+}

+import { test, describe, before, after } from "node:test";

+// ============================================================
+// createThrottledLogger
+// ============================================================
+describe("createThrottledLogger", () => {
+  test("first call within window is suppressed (lastLogAt starts at 0)", () => {
+    const logger = createThrottledLogger("test", 1000);
+    const result = logger.decide("hello", 0);
+    assert.equal(result.log, false);
+    assert.equal(result.suppressed, 1);
+  });
+
+  test("first call after window logs again", () => {
+    const logger = createThrottledLogger("test", 1000);
+    // First call at t=0 is suppressed (0-0=0 < 1000)
+    logger.decide("hello", 0);
+    // Calls within window are suppressed
+    logger.decide("hello", 500);
+    logger.decide("hello", 800);
+    // After window elapses, logs again
+    const r = logger.decide("hello", 1500);
+    assert.equal(r.log, true);
+    assert.equal(r.suppressed, 3); // reports how many were suppressed since last log
+  });
+
+  test("calls within window are suppressed", () => {
+    const logger = createThrottledLogger("test", 1000);
+    logger.decide("hello", 0); // first call suppressed
+    const r2 = logger.decide("hello", 500);
+    assert.equal(r2.log, false);
+    assert.equal(r2.suppressed, 2);
+    const r3 = logger.decide("hello", 800);
+    assert.equal(r3.log, false);
+    assert.equal(r3.suppressed, 3);
+  });
+
+  test("different keys have independent state", () => {
+    const a = createThrottledLogger("a", 1000);
+    const b = createThrottledLogger("b", 1000);
+    a.decide("x", 0);
+    a.decide("x", 100);
+    const r = b.decide("y", 100);
+    assert.equal(r.log, false);
+    assert.equal(r.suppressed, 1); // b has its own counter
+    assert.equal(a.getState().suppressed, 2); // a's counter is untouched by b
+  });
+
+  test("getState returns copy of internal state", () => {
+    const logger = createThrottledLogger("test", 1000);
+    logger.decide("x", 0);
+    const s = logger.getState();
+    assert.equal(s.lastLogAt, 0);
+    assert.equal(s.suppressed, 1);
+    // mutation of returned object does not affect internal state
+    s.lastLogAt = 9999;
+    const s2 = logger.getState();
+    assert.equal(s2.lastLogAt, 0);
+  });
+});
+

+// isLowValueNoise / buildDenylistRegex

+describe("isLowValueNoise / buildDenylistRegex", () => {

+
+  test("DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX matches DEBUG AUTH", () => {

+  test("DEFAULT_DENYLIST_REGEX does NOT match SUCCESS", () => {

+
+  test("isLowValueNoise returns true for denylisted tags", () => {

+  test("isLowValueNoise returns false for non-denylisted tags", () => {

+    assert.ok(!r.test("[CORS/DEBUG] something")); // default no longer applies

+    assert.equal(readDebugVerboseTtlMs({ DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS: "0" }), 900000);
+    assert.equal(readDebugVerboseTtlMs({ DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS: "-1" }), 900000);

+    assert.equal(readDebugVerboseTtlMs({ DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS: "60000" }), 60000);
+    assert.equal(readDebugVerboseTtlMs({ DEBUG_VERBOSE_TTL_MS: "123456" }), 123456);
