+// ============================================================
+// createTtlFlag
+// ============================================================
+describe("createTtlFlag", () => {
+  test("starts disabled when initialEnabled=false", () => {
+    const flag = createTtlFlag(false, 1000, () => 1000);
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), false);
+    assert.equal(flag.isEnabled(), false);
+  });
+
+  test("starts enabled when initialEnabled=true", () => {
+    const flag = createTtlFlag(true, 1000, () => 1000);
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), true);
+    assert.equal(flag.isEnabled(), true);
+  });
+
+  test("expires after TTL", () => {
+    let now = 1000;
+    const flag = createTtlFlag(true, 1000, () => now);
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), true);
+    now = 2001; // past TTL
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), false);
+    assert.equal(flag.isEnabled(), false);
+  });
+
+  test("set(true) re-enables and resets timer", () => {
+    let now = 1000;
+    const flag = createTtlFlag(false, 1000, () => now);
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), false);
+    flag.set(true);
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), true);
+    now = 1500;
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), true);
+    now = 2001;
+    assert.equal(flag.isActive(), false);
+  });
+
+  test("set(false) disables immediately", () => {
+    let now = 1000;

+## v1.1.70 — 2026-10-22
+- **Rewrite Image Generation Detection with Strict Three-Rule Strategy**:
+  - Rewrote `isImageGenerationRequest()` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:50) around three explicit rules (R1/R2/R3) to eliminate the recurring `400 Image generation requests are not supported` errors returned to Zoo Code on every request.
+  - **R1 — image model id**: extracted `IMAGE_MODEL_PATTERNS` in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:34); a model id matching `dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `midjourney`, `flux`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `sd-xl`, `playground`, `aihorde` (or the `aihorde/` prefix) is always an image request.
+  - **R2 — payload shape**: a `prompt` without `messages` is only an image request when image-specific params (`n`, `size`, `response_format`) are present or no `model` was supplied. A chat model such as `gpt-4o` carrying a `prompt` field is now correctly treated as a regular chat completion.
+  - **R3 — explicit intent**: kept the explicit phrase list and replaced the old "any ambiguous verb + any image noun anywhere" heuristic with the `STRICT_IMAGE_INTENT_RE` adjacency regex in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:47), requiring the image noun to directly follow the verb (optional article + up to 2 adjectives).
+  - Added diagnostic logging of the offending payload shape in the `POST /v1/chat/completions` handler in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1336) to pinpoint future false positives.
+  - Full test suite green: 140/140 tests passing (`node --test tests/*.test.mjs __tests__/*.test.mjs`).

+        function renderConsiderationTab() {
+            const tbody = document.getElementById('consideration-table-body');
+            const filterInput = document.getElementById('consideration-filter');
+            const filterVal = filterInput ? filterInput.value.toLowerCase() : '';

+            let total = list.length;

+                const reason = item.reason || item.filterReason || 'none';
+                reasonCounts[reason] = (reasonCounts[reason] || 0) + 1;
+

+# Performance Analysis & Optimization Report: OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
+
+This report presents a thorough static code analysis of the `omniroute-bandit-proxy` codebase, identifying performance bottlenecks, architectural risks, and actionable recommendations.
+
+## 1. Critical Performance Bottlenecks
+
+### A. Schema Introspection on Every Quota Check (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
+- **Location**: [`src/provider-quota.mjs:40`](src/provider-quota.mjs:40) and [`src/provider-quota.mjs:93`](src/provider-quota.mjs:93)
+- **Issue**: `this.db.pragma("table_info(provider_history)")` is invoked inside `_rollWindows()` and `canCall()` on **every single API request and quota evaluation**. Table schema introspection queries SQLite internal metadata tables (`sqlite_master`) every time, causing severe database contention, CPU overhead, and blocking latency under high concurrency.
+- **Recommendation**: Cache the table column existence check once in the `ProviderQuota` constructor (or lazily initialize a boolean flag `this._hasGroupCols`) rather than querying `pragma` per request.
+
+### B. SQLite Statement Compilation & Execution Contention
+- **Location**: Across [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) and [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs)
+- **Issue**: Many methods call `this.db.prepare(...)` inline on every execution. While `better-sqlite3` caches prepared statements internally by SQL string hash, caching statement objects in class fields or initialization reduces JS-to-C++ binding overhead and query parsing overhead.
+- **Recommendation**: Pre-compile all frequently used SQLite statements in constructors and store them as class properties (e.g., `this.stmtUpdateQuota = this.db.prepare(...)`).
+
+### C. JavaScript-Side Model Filtering & Sorting
+- **Location**: [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) (`selectModel()`)
+- **Issue**: Filtering through the entire model catalog, merging database models with catalog models, applying soft bias multipliers, and sorting by UCB1 scores happens frequently. Although buffered by the 30-second `_rankCache`, cache misses during heavy traffic spikes can saturate the event loop with sorting and filtering operations across hundreds of models.
+- **Recommendation**: Ensure `_rankCache` keys include all relevant profile and filtering flags, and consider indexing model metadata in memory if model counts scale beyond 1,000.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Memory Sizing, Caching, and TTL Management
+
+### A. Session Map LRU Eviction & Cleanup (`src/index.mjs`)
+- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) (`sessionModelMap`)
+- **Issue**: `sessionModelMap` maintains session affinity with a max capacity of 10,000 entries and a 30-minute TTL. While LRU eviction prevents unbounded memory growth, stale sessions that are never accessed again remain in memory until capacity is reached or periodic timer sweeps execute.
+- **Recommendation**: Ensure periodic cleanup intervals (e.g., every 5 minutes) actively purge expired entries rather than relying solely on lazy eviction during insertion.
+
+### B. Rank Cache Invalidation Granularity (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **Location**: [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs) (`_rankCache`)
+- **Issue**: The 30-second rank cache speeds up routing significantly. However, feedback events (success/failure recording) should immediately invalidate or update the rank cache for the affected model/profile rather than waiting up to 30 seconds for stale UCB1 rankings to expire.
+- **Recommendation**: Invalidate or update `_rankCache` entries instantly upon `recordFeedback()` or provider status changes.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Concurrency, Async/Await, and Resource Cleanup
+
+### A. Synchronous SQLite Operations in Async Handlers
+- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) and [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs)
+- **Issue**: `better-sqlite3` is synchronous. While this eliminates async mutex locking overhead in single-process Node.js, heavy SQLite queries or transactions will block the event loop if executed during high-throughput proxy streaming.
+- **Recommendation**: Keep transactions short, use SQLite WAL mode (`PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;`), and set an appropriate busy timeout (`PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000;`).
+
+### B. Stream Timeout and Resource Cleanup (`src/index.mjs`)
+- **Location**: [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs) (Upstream fetch and SSE streaming handlers)
+- **Issue**: Three-level timeouts (`UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS`, `STREAM_IDLE_MS`, `STREAM_MAX_MS`) are well implemented with AbortControllers. However, ensure that active response streams and upstream connections are explicitly aborted and destroyed in `finally` blocks upon client disconnect or error to prevent socket leaks.
+- **Recommendation**: Verify `req.on('close', ...)` handlers clean up all active upstream fetch `AbortController` instances.
+
+---
+
+## Summary of Actionable Next Steps
+1. Remove `pragma("table_info(...)")` calls from [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs) request path.
+2. Pre-compile SQLite prepared statements in constructors.
+3. Optimize rank cache invalidation on feedback recording.
+4. Ensure robust abort controller cleanup on client disconnects in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs).

-## 2. Detection Criteria
-
-A chat/completions request should be treated as an image generation request when:
-
-### A. Explicit Image Generation Parameters Present
-- `prompt` field is present (string or array) AND `messages` field is absent or empty
-- `model` field specified and matches known image generation model patterns
-- `n` (number of images) parameter present
-- `size` parameter present with format like "256x256", "512x512", "1024x1024", etc.
-- `response_format` parameter present with value "b64_json" or "url"
-
-### B. Context Clues in Messages
-- Last user message contains image generation keywords: "generate image", "create image", "draw", "paint", "make a picture of", etc.
-- System prompt or user message contains explicit image generation instructions
-- Messages contain only image-related content with no conversational context

-# Architectural & Technical Specification: Model Selection Refinement, Untested Model Prioritization, Quality-to-Speed Metrics, and High-Frequency Dashboard UI
-
-## Overview
-This document provides the technical specification and architectural blueprint for improving model selection, eliminating unnecessary last-resort fallbacks, prioritizing untested models ($N = 0$), incorporating a precise quality-to-speed ratio into [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394), rendering a vertical consideration list with discard reasons in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1), and accelerating dashboard polling frequency to 0.1s.
-
----
-
-## 1. Investigation of Last-Resort Triggers (`src/bandit.mjs`)
-### Root Causes
-- **Strict Constraint Enforcement**: [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394) applies strict filters across multiple dimensions:
-  1. [`resolvedExcluded`](src/bandit.mjs:1401) (already tried models in current request attempt loop).
-  2. [`model.permanent === 1`](src/bandit.mjs:1450) or [`model.degraded === 1`](src/bandit.mjs:1452).
-  3. [`provider_history`](src/bandit.mjs:1456) bans, cooldowns, or [`needs_attention`](src/bandit.mjs:1474) flags.
-  4. [`ProviderQuota`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1) rolling minute/day limit exhaustion (`canCall()`).
-  5. Policy filters: [`excludeThinking`](src/bandit.mjs:30), [`excludePaid`](src/bandit.mjs:28), [`onlyFree`](src/bandit.mjs:31).
-  6. Token limits: [`estimatedTokens > max_input_tokens`](src/bandit.mjs:1507) or [`dynamic_max_tokens`](src/bandit.mjs:1504) (413/TPM memory).
-  7. Capability requirements: [`requireTools`](src/bandit.mjs:1513), [`requireImageGeneration`](src/bandit.mjs:1517).
-- **Ranking Restriction**: [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:645) queries `WHERE permanent = 0 AND degraded = 0 AND N >= 3 AND N > 0`, which completely discards any model with $N < 3$ (including untested models with $N = 0$).
-
----
-
-## 2. Strategy for Prioritizing Untested Models ($N = 0$) and Removing $N$-Threshold Blocks
-### Implementation Steps
-1. **Remove $N \ge 3$ Restriction in [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:645)**:
-   - Update SQL query in [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:648) to include all available models (`N >= 0`), sorting unobserved models ($N = 0$) with an optimistic bonus.
-2. **UCB1 Optimistic Exploration Bonus**:
-   - In [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1615), ensure models with $N = 0$ receive an optimistic score boost:
-     $$\text{ucbScore} = \text{optimisticPrior} + c \sqrt{\frac{\ln(N_{\text{total}} + 1)}{\max(N, 1)}}$$
-     where $\text{optimisticPrior} = 1.0$ (or higher for new catalog models).
-
----
-
-## 3. Quality-to-Speed Ratio Metrics in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394)
-### Metric Formula
-Compute a composite performance metric combining success reward, latency efficiency, and throughput:
-$$\text{QualitySpeedScore} = \left(\frac{\sum \text{reward}}{N}\right) \times \left(\frac{\text{BaselineLatency}}{\max(\text{Latency}_{\text{avg}}, 100\text{ms})}\right) \times \left(1 + \min\left(\frac{\text{TokensPerSec}}{\text{MaxTokensPerSec}}, 1\right)\right)$$
-- Incorporate this ratio into the reward updating logic in [`recordFeedback()`](src/bandit.mjs:671) or directly weight the UCB1 average reward in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1624).
-
----
-
-## 4. Vertical Consideration List in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1)
-### UI Specifications
-- **Data Source**: Expose [`getLastSelectionHistory()`](src/bandit.mjs:1650) via an API endpoint (e.g., `GET /v1/consideration`).
-- **Layout**: Add a dedicated vertical panel / collapsible accordion in [`public/dashboard.html`](src/bandit.mjs:1) under the active request or model tab displaying:
-  - Model ID & Provider
-  - Status Badge (`selected` vs `rejected`)

-

+# Plan: Integration of Specchietto Cronologico into Dashboard Top Panel
+
+## Objective
+Integrate the chronological spec sheet ("specchietto") of latest model evaluations and considerations (`#chronological-spec-sheet`), currently located under the "🔍 Considerazioni" tab, directly into the top panel / header area of `public/dashboard.html` as a collapsible or persistent top widget. This allows users to view recent model evaluations, selections, and rejection reasons at a glance from any active tab.
+
+---
+
+## Proposed Layout & UI Design
+
+1. **Placement in Top Header Area (`public/dashboard.html`)**:
+   - Place right below the `<div class="stats-container">` inside the main header card (or as a dedicated collapsible card immediately following the stats container).
+   - Add a header bar for the widget:
+     - Title: `📋 Ultime Valutazioni & Considerazioni` with a toggle collapse/expand button (`▼` / `▲`) and a badge showing the last updated model/timestamp.
+   - Content Area:
+     - The `#chronological-spec-sheet` element (monospace, dark themed `#0d1117`, scrollable, max-height ~150px-180px).
+     - A quick link/button `"🔍 Vedi Tabella Completa"` that switches active tab to `consideration`.
+
+2. **CSS Styling**:
+   - Seamlessly blend with GitHub dark theme (`#161b22`, border `#30363d`, font-family monospace for log/spec output).
+   - Collapsible state managed via localStorage (`dashboard.specchietto.collapsed`) or simple interactive toggle.
+
+3. **JavaScript Integration**:
+   - Ensure `updateConsiderations(data)` (or equivalent function updating `#chronological-spec-sheet` and `#consideration-table-body`) correctly updates both the top panel spec sheet and the consideration tab table simultaneously.
+   - Preserve real-time updates via SSE / periodic metrics poll.
+
+---
+
+## Actionable Steps for Implementation (Code Mode)
+
+1. **Modify `public/dashboard.html` HTML Structure**:
+   - Extract / duplicate / move the `#chronological-spec-sheet` card container from `#tab-consideration` into the top header container (below `.stats-container`, inside the main top card).
+   - Give it a collapsible toggle (`<details>` or custom JS toggle) and a button to jump to the consideration tab.
+
+2. **Update CSS in `public/dashboard.html` `<style>`**:
+   - Add styling for `.top-spec-widget`, toggle buttons, and responsive height.
+
+3. **Refine JS Event Handlers**:
+   - Ensure the data update function updates `#chronological-spec-sheet` wherever it is rendered.

+import { test, describe, beforeEach, afterEach } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from "../src/bandit.mjs";
+
+/**
+ * @fileoverview Comprehensive unit and integration test suite for model capability
+ * categorization and strict filtering during chat completions in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1).
+ */
+describe("Model Capability Categorization and Strict Filtering Test Suite", () => {
+  let bandit;
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    bandit = new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+  });
+
+  afterEach(() => {
+    if (bandit && typeof bandit.close === "function") {
+      bandit.close();
+    }
+  });
+
+  test("Catalog sync correctly tags models (chat_completion, image, audio, embedding)", async () => {
+    const originalFetch = global.fetch;
+    const mockModels = [
+      { id: "openai/gpt-4o", max_input_tokens: 128000, capabilities: { tool_calling: true } },
+      { id: "openai/dall-e-3", max_input_tokens: 4000, type: "image" },
+      { id: "openai/tts-1", max_input_tokens: 2000 },
+      { id: "openai/text-embedding-3-small", max_input_tokens: 8192 },
+      { id: "aihorde/flux", max_input_tokens: 4000 }
+    ];
+
+    global.fetch = async () => ({
+      ok: true,
+      json: async () => ({ data: mockModels })
+    });
+
+    try {
+      await bandit.fetchAndSyncModels();
+
+      const gpt4 = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE id = ?").get("openai/gpt-4o");
+      assert.equal(gpt4.capability, "chat_completion");
+      assert.equal(gpt4.supports_chat, 1);
+      assert.equal(gpt4.supports_image_generation, 0);
+      assert.equal(gpt4.supports_audio_generation, 0);
+
+      const dalle = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE id = ?").get("openai/dall-e-3");
+      assert.equal(dalle.capability, "image");
+      assert.equal(dalle.supports_chat, 0);
+      assert.equal(dalle.supports_image_generation, 1);
+
+      const tts = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE id = ?").get("openai/tts-1");
+      assert.equal(tts.capability, "audio");
+      assert.equal(tts.supports_chat, 0);
+      assert.equal(tts.supports_audio_generation, 1);
+
+      const embed = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM catalog WHERE id = ?").get("openai/text-embedding-3-small");
+      assert.equal(embed.capability, "embedding");

+# Technical Specification: Model Categorization and Strict Filtering for Chat Completions
+
+## 1. Executive Summary
+This document outlines the architectural design and technical specification for robust model categorization (`chat_completion`, `image`, `audio`, `embedding`, etc.) during catalog synchronization and strict capability-based filtering during model selection in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) and [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1). It ensures that standard chat completion requests (including Zoo Code requests) exclusively route to models categorized as `chat_completion` and are strictly barred from selecting or falling back to image or audio generation models.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Review of Catalog Sync and Database Schema
+
+### 2.1 Database Schema (`catalog` and `models` tables)
+In [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:54), the SQLite schema includes:
+- [`catalog`](src/bandit.mjs:94): Stores model metadata fetched from upstream (`id`, `provider`, `max_input_tokens`, `is_free`, `supports_tools`, `supports_image_generation`).
+- [`models`](src/bandit.mjs:57): Stores bandit learning metrics (`N`, `sum_reward`, `fails`, `cooldown_until`, `permanent`, `degraded`, etc.) and joins with [`catalog`](src/bandit.mjs:94) during selection.
+
+### 2.2 Current Catalog Sync (`fetchAndSyncModels`)
+In [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:364), `fetchAndSyncModels()` fetches models from `/models`, filters out non-chat models (batch, embedding, rerank, moderation, STT/TTS without chat/omni keywords), and inserts them into [`catalog`](src/bandit.mjs:94).
+
+---
+
+## 3. Capability and Category Tagging Mechanism
+
+### 3.1 Schema Enhancements
+We introduce a unified capability tagging column or explicit capability flags in the [`catalog`](src/bandit.mjs:94) table:
+- `capability` TEXT DEFAULT 'chat_completion' (Values: `chat_completion`, `image`, `audio`, `embedding`, `rerank`, `moderation`).
+- `supports_chat` INTEGER DEFAULT 1
+- `supports_image_generation` INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+- `supports_audio_generation` INTEGER DEFAULT 0
+
+Migration in [`src/_migrateDB()`](src/bandit.mjs:122) will add `capability` and `supports_audio_generation` columns additively.
+
+### 3.2 Enhanced Classification in [`fetchAndSyncModels()`](src/bandit.mjs:364)
+During catalog sync:
+1. **Embedding / Rerank / Moderation**: Detected via regex (`embed`, `embedding`, `rerank`, `moderation`, `batch`) -> skipped or tagged accordingly.
+2. **Audio / Speech (TTS / STT)**: Detected via regex (`tts`, `speech`, `stt`, `whisper`, `voice`, `audio`) -> tagged as `audio` unless `omni`/`chat`/`multimodal` is present.
+3. **Image Generation**: Detected via regex (`dall-e`, `stable-diffusion`, `imagen`, `sdxl`, `flux`, `midjourney`, `image-generation`, `aihorde`, `playground`, `image`) or model `type === 'image'` -> tagged as `image`, `supports_image_generation = 1`, `supports_chat = 0`.
+4. **Chat Completion**: Default category (`chat_completion`), `supports_chat = 1`, `supports_image_generation = 0`, `supports_audio_generation = 0`.
+
+---
+
+## 4. Strict Filtering Logic for Chat Completions
+
+### 4.1 Model Selection in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1398)
+When processing `POST /v1/chat/completions`, `selectModel()` must enforce:
+- `requireImageGeneration = false` (default for chat).
+- Explicit exclusion check: Any model where `capability != 'chat_completion'` or `supports_image_generation == 1` or `supports_audio_generation == 1` or matching image/audio/embedding regex patterns is unconditionally rejected with rejection reason `'image_model_excluded_from_chat'` or `'non_chat_model_excluded'`.
+- Fallback rejection: In [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1580), fallback models from [`config/bandit.json`](config/bandit.json:1) must also be verified against [`catalog`](src/bandit.mjs:94) to ensure they have `supports_image_generation != 1` and `supports_audio_generation != 1` before being used in chat completion fallback chains.
+
+---
+
+## 5. Architecture Workflow (Mermaid)
+
+```mermaid
+graph TD
+    A[POST /v1/chat/completions] --> B[Select Model with UCB1]
+    B --> C{Model Capability Check}
+    C -->|Is Image/Audio/Embedding| D[Reject: Non-Chat Capability]
+    C -->|Is Chat Completion| E[Execute Upstream Request]
+    E -->|Success| F[Record Feedback (Reward 1)]
+    E -->|Failure / Error| G[Classify Error & Cooldown/Ban]
+    G --> H{Exhausted All Chat Models?}
+    H -->|Yes| I[Check Fallback Chain]
+    I --> J{Fallback Model Supports Chat?}
+    J -->|No| K[Skip Fallback Model]
+    J -->|Yes| L[Route to Fallback Chat Model]
+```
+
+---
+
+## 6. Summary of Implementation Steps
+1. Update [`_initDB()`](src/bandit.mjs:54) and [`_migrateDB()`](src/bandit.mjs:122) to include `capability` and capability flags.
+2. Refine [`fetchAndSyncModels()`](src/bandit.mjs:364) classification logic to tag `chat_completion`, `image`, `audio`, etc.
+3. Enforce strict capability filtering in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1398) and fallback processing in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1).
+4. Add comprehensive unit & integration tests in [`tests/`](tests/) validating that image and audio models never receive chat traffic.

+# Architectural & Technical Specification: Model Selection Refinement, Untested Model Prioritization, Quality-to-Speed Metrics, and High-Frequency Dashboard UI
+
+## Overview
+This document provides the technical specification and architectural blueprint for improving model selection, eliminating unnecessary last-resort fallbacks, prioritizing untested models ($N = 0$), incorporating a precise quality-to-speed ratio into [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394), rendering a vertical consideration list with discard reasons in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1), and accelerating dashboard polling frequency to 0.1s.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Investigation of Last-Resort Triggers (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+### Root Causes
+- **Strict Constraint Enforcement**: [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394) applies strict filters across multiple dimensions:
+  1. [`resolvedExcluded`](src/bandit.mjs:1401) (already tried models in current request attempt loop).
+  2. [`model.permanent === 1`](src/bandit.mjs:1450) or [`model.degraded === 1`](src/bandit.mjs:1452).
+  3. [`provider_history`](src/bandit.mjs:1456) bans, cooldowns, or [`needs_attention`](src/bandit.mjs:1474) flags.
+  4. [`ProviderQuota`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1) rolling minute/day limit exhaustion (`canCall()`).
+  5. Policy filters: [`excludeThinking`](src/bandit.mjs:30), [`excludePaid`](src/bandit.mjs:28), [`onlyFree`](src/bandit.mjs:31).
+  6. Token limits: [`estimatedTokens > max_input_tokens`](src/bandit.mjs:1507) or [`dynamic_max_tokens`](src/bandit.mjs:1504) (413/TPM memory).
+  7. Capability requirements: [`requireTools`](src/bandit.mjs:1513), [`requireImageGeneration`](src/bandit.mjs:1517).
+- **Ranking Restriction**: [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:645) queries `WHERE permanent = 0 AND degraded = 0 AND N >= 3 AND N > 0`, which completely discards any model with $N < 3$ (including untested models with $N = 0$).
+
+---
+
+## 2. Strategy for Prioritizing Untested Models ($N = 0$) and Removing $N$-Threshold Blocks
+### Implementation Steps
+1. **Remove $N \ge 3$ Restriction in [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:645)**:
+   - Update SQL query in [`getModelRank()`](src/bandit.mjs:648) to include all available models (`N >= 0`), sorting unobserved models ($N = 0$) with an optimistic bonus.
+2. **UCB1 Optimistic Exploration Bonus**:
+   - In [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1615), ensure models with $N = 0$ receive an optimistic score boost:
+     $$\text{ucbScore} = \text{optimisticPrior} + c \sqrt{\frac{\ln(N_{\text{total}} + 1)}{\max(N, 1)}}$$
+     where $\text{optimisticPrior} = 1.0$ (or higher for new catalog models).
+
+---
+
+## 3. Quality-to-Speed Ratio Metrics in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1394)
+### Metric Formula
+Compute a composite performance metric combining success reward, latency efficiency, and throughput:
+$$\text{QualitySpeedScore} = \left(\frac{\sum \text{reward}}{N}\right) \times \left(\frac{\text{BaselineLatency}}{\max(\text{Latency}_{\text{avg}}, 100\text{ms})}\right) \times \left(1 + \min\left(\frac{\text{TokensPerSec}}{\text{MaxTokensPerSec}}, 1\right)\right)$$
+- Incorporate this ratio into the reward updating logic in [`recordFeedback()`](src/bandit.mjs:671) or directly weight the UCB1 average reward in [`selectModel()`](src/bandit.mjs:1624).
+
+---
+
+## 4. Vertical Consideration List in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1)
+### UI Specifications
+- **Data Source**: Expose [`getLastSelectionHistory()`](src/bandit.mjs:1650) via an API endpoint (e.g., `GET /v1/consideration`).
+- **Layout**: Add a dedicated vertical panel / collapsible accordion in [`public/dashboard.html`](src/bandit.mjs:1) under the active request or model tab displaying:
+  - Model ID & Provider
+  - Status Badge (`selected` vs `rejected`)
+  - Discard Reason (`already_tried`, `model_cooldown`, `max_input_tokens_exceeded`, `no_tools_support`, etc.)
+  - Tier of filtering where rejection occurred (`strict`, `tier1`, `tier2`, `tier3`, `emergency`).
+
+---
+
+## 5. Dashboard Polling Frequency Update (0.1s)
+### Implementation Steps
+- Locate polling intervals in [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:2709+) (e.g., `setInterval(refreshDashboard, 500)`).
+- Change interval from `500` ms to `100` ms (0.1s) to ensure ultra-responsive real-time updates.

+            /(^|[-_/])(dall-e|stable-diffusion|imagen|sdxl|flux|midjourney|image-generation|playground)([-_/]|$)/i.test(fallbackModel) ||

+            continue;
+          }
+
           // Model passes all checks
           selectedFallbackModel = fallbackModel;
           break;

+function validateStreamAccumulated(raw, opts = {}) {
+  const requireTools = opts.requireTools === true;
+            // DEBUG risposta stream
+            if (requireTools) {
+              const toolCallMatches = raw.match(/"tool_calls"/g);
+              const toolNames = [...raw.matchAll(/"name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]).slice(0, 5);
+              console.log(`[RESPONSE-STREAM] tool_calls found: ${toolCallMatches?.length || 0} | names: ${toolNames.join(", ")}`);
+            }
+  if (!raw || raw.length === 0) return "empty stream";
+    if (/^\s*data:\s*\{\s*"error"/m.test(raw)) {
+      // Estrai la riga data: che contiene "error" — NON la prima riga data: {...}
+      // (il primo data: può essere un keepalive con delta vuoto)
+      let payload = "";
+      for (const line of raw.split("\n")) {
+        const t = line.trim();
+        if (t.startsWith("data:") && t.includes('"error"')) {
+          payload = t.slice(5).trim();
+          break;
+        }
+      }
+      if (!payload) payload = raw.slice(0, 2000);

+      let innerMessage = "";
+      let status = 0;
+      let code = "";

+        innerMessage = errObj.message || "";
+        code = errObj.code || "";

+        else if (code === "model_not_found") status = 400;
+        else if (/unknown provider for model|not supported|model_not_found/i.test(innerMessage)) status = 400;
+        else if (/does not exist|not found|no longer available/i.test(innerMessage)) status = 404;
+        else if (/quota|rate limit/i.test(innerMessage)) status = 429;
+      } catch (_) {}
+      console.error(`[SSE ERROR RAW] ${payload.slice(0, 600)}`);
+      return { reason: "SSE contains error", status, message: innerMessage || payload.slice(0, 500) };
+    }
+  // Estrai l'ultimo data: {...} utile e verifica se ha contenuto
+  const lines = raw.split("\n").filter(l => l.startsWith("data: "));
+  if (lines.length === 0) return "no SSE data lines";
+
+  let hasContent = false;
+  let hasTools = false;
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    const json = line.slice(6).trim();
+    if (json === "[DONE]") continue;
+    try {
+      const obj = JSON.parse(json);
+      if (obj.error) return "SSE chunk error: " + (obj.error.message || "").slice(0, 100);
+      const delta = obj.choices?.[0]?.delta;
+      if (!delta) continue;
+      if (typeof delta.content === "string" && delta.content.length > 0) hasContent = true;
+      if (Array.isArray(delta.tool_calls) && delta.tool_calls.length > 0) hasTools = true;
+    } catch {}
+  }
+  if (requireTools && !hasTools) {

+    const legitRefusal = /(non posso|cannot|can't|not able|refuse)/i.test(raw);
+    if (!legitRefusal) {
+      return "no-tool-call-but-required (model ignored tools)";
+    }
+  }

+  if (!hasContent && !hasTools) return "stream has no content nor tool_calls";
+  return null;  // valida

+// Compressione d'emergenza: pochi messaggi ma uno è enorme (system/env_details).
+// Tronca il messaggio più grande finché il totale scende sotto targetTokens.
+function truncateBiggestMessage(body, targetTokens) {
+  if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return null;
+  const messages = body.messages;
+  if (!Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) return null;
+
+  const msgText = (m) => {
+    if (typeof m.content === "string") return m.content;
+    if (Array.isArray(m.content)) return m.content.map(p => p?.text || "").join("\n");
+    return JSON.stringify(m.content || "");
+  };
+  const msgTokens = (m) => Math.ceil(msgText(m).length / 3);
+
+  // Trova il messaggio più grande
+  let idx = 0;
+  for (let k = 1; k < messages.length; k++) {
+    if (msgTokens(messages[k]) > msgTokens(messages[idx])) idx = k;
+  }
+  const big = messages[idx];
+  const bigText = msgText(big);
+  const bigTokens = msgTokens(big);
+
+  // Se è già piccolo, non c'è nulla da tagliare
+  if (bigTokens < 2000) return null;
+
+  // Calcola quanti char tenere: proporzione rispetto al target
+  const totalTokens = messages.reduce((s, m) => s + msgTokens(m), 0);
+  const keepRatio = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(0.9, targetTokens / Math.max(1, totalTokens)));
+  const keepChars = Math.max(2000, Math.ceil(bigText.length * keepRatio));
+  const removedChars = bigText.length - keepChars;
+  const removedTokens = Math.ceil(removedChars / 3);
+
+  const truncated = bigText.slice(0, keepChars)
+    + `\n\n[... troncato: ${removedTokens} token rimossi per limite contesto ...]`;
+
+  const newMsg = Array.isArray(big.content)
+    ? { ...big, content: [{ type: "text", text: truncated }] }
+    : { ...big, content: truncated };
+
+  const newMessages = messages.slice();
+  newMessages[idx] = newMsg;
+  const newBody = { ...body, messages: newMessages };
+  return { body: newBody, omitted: 0, truncatedBig: true, removedTokens };
+}
+// ========================================
+// CONTEXT COMPRESSION (sliding window per agent di coding)
+// ========================================
+// Mantiene: system + primo user + ultimi N messaggi.
+// Rispetta i confini dei blocchi tool_call/tool result (non li spezza mai).
+function compressBody(body, targetTokens) {
+  if (!body || typeof body !== "object") return null;
+  const messages = body.messages;
+  if (!Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) return null;
+  // Con pochi messaggi (2-5), la compressione strutturale non ha nulla da rimuovere.
+  // Tronca direttamente il messaggio più grande.
+  if (messages.length < 6) {
+    return truncateBiggestMessage(body, targetTokens);
+  }
+  // 1. Prendi system + primo user (parte "fissa")
+  const head = [];
+  let i = 0;
+  while (i < messages.length && messages[i].role === "system") {
+    head.push(messages[i]);
+    i++;
+  }
+  if (i < messages.length && messages[i].role === "user") {
+    head.push(messages[i]);
+    i++;
+  }
+
+  // 2. Trova un boundary sicuro per la coda:
+  //    non deve iniziare con un "tool" orfano (deve essere user o assistant senza tool_calls pendenti).
+  const TAIL_TARGET = 8;
+  let tailStart = Math.max(i, messages.length - TAIL_TARGET);
+  while (tailStart > i && tailStart < messages.length) {
+    const m = messages[tailStart];
+    if (m.role === "user" || (m.role === "assistant" && !m.tool_calls)) break;
+    tailStart++;
+  }
+  // Se ci siamo spostati troppo avanti, non è comprimibile in modo sicuro
+  if (tailStart >= messages.length - 1) return null;
+  if (tailStart <= i) return null;
+
+  // 3. Verifica che head non finisca con un assistant con tool_calls (orfano)
+  //    Se sì, rimuovi l'ultimo elemento di head.
+  while (head.length > 0 && head[head.length - 1].role === "assistant" && head[head.length - 1].tool_calls) {
+    head.pop();
+  }
+
+  const tail = messages.slice(tailStart);
+  const omitted = tailStart - i;
+
+  const compressed = [
+    ...head,
+    {
+      role: "user",
+      content: `[Sistema: ${omitted} messaggi intermedi omessi per ridurre il contesto. Se hai bisogno di dettagli su passaggi precedenti, chiedili esplicitamente.]`
+    },
+    ...tail
+  ];
+
+  const newBody = { ...body, messages: compressed };
+  // Verifica dimensione risultante
+  // Iterative reduction instead of recursive calls to prevent Maximum call stack size exceeded
+  let currentBody = newBody;
+  let totalOmitted = omitted;
+  let iterations = 0;
+  
+  while (iterations < 10) {
+    const s = JSON.stringify(currentBody);
+    const newTokens = Math.ceil(s.length / 3);
+    if (newTokens <= targetTokens) break;
+
+    const nextRes = truncateBiggestMessage(currentBody, targetTokens);
+    if (!nextRes || !nextRes.body) break;
+    currentBody = nextRes.body;
+    totalOmitted += (nextRes.omitted || 0);
+    iterations++;
+  }
+
+  return { body: currentBody, omitted: totalOmitted };
+}

+// ========================================
+// RING BUFFER PER LOG CIRCOLARI
+// ========================================
+
+class RingBuffer {
+  constructor(maxSize) {
+    this.maxSize = maxSize;
+    this.buffer = [];
+    this.index = 0;
+  }
+
+  push(item) {
+    if (this.buffer.length < this.maxSize) {
+      this.buffer.push(item);
+    } else {
+      this.buffer[this.index] = item;
+      this.index = (this.index + 1) % this.maxSize;
+    }
+  }
+
+  getAll() {
+    if (this.buffer.length < this.maxSize) {
+      return [...this.buffer];
+    }
+    return [...this.buffer.slice(this.index), ...this.buffer.slice(0, this.index)];
+  }
+
+  clear() {
+    this.buffer = [];
+    this.index = 0;
+  }
+}

+// Mappa sessionKey → { model, ts }

+function computeSessionKey(messages) {
+  if (!Array.isArray(messages) || messages.length === 0) return null;
+
+  // Prendi il system prompt (o, se manca, il primo user message)
+  const sys = messages.find(m => m.role === "system");
+  const firstUser = messages.find(m => m.role === "user");
+
+  const sysStr = sys
+    ? (typeof sys.content === "string" ? sys.content : JSON.stringify(sys.content))
+    : "";
+  const userStr = firstUser
+    ? (typeof firstUser.content === "string" ? firstUser.content : JSON.stringify(firstUser.content))
+    : "";
+
+  // 🎯 Usa SOLO il prefisso stabile:
+  // - system: primi 800 char (l'header "You are Zoo..." è lì)
+  // - user:   primi 300 char (la richiesta originale dell'utente è lì)
+  // Tutto ciò che viene dopo è contesto dinamico che cambia ad ogni turno.
+  const stableSys  = sysStr.slice(0, 800);
+  const stableUser = userStr.slice(0, 300);
+
+  if (!stableSys && !stableUser) return null;
+
+  return createHash("md5")
+    .update(stableSys + "|" + stableUser)
+    .digest("hex")
+    .slice(0, 16);

+let requestCounter = 0;
+function newRequestId() {

+// Moltiplicatore reward basato sul tipo di tool chiamato.
+// I modelli che rispondono con "ask_followup_question" invece di agire
+// prendono reward bassi → UCB1 li declassa.
+function computeToolRewardMultiplier(toolNames, hasWrittenInSession) {
+  if (!toolNames || toolNames.length === 0) return 0.6;
+  const first = String(toolNames[0] || '').toLowerCase();
+
+  if (first === 'ask_followup_question') return 0.5;
+  if (first === 'update_todo_list') return 0.8;
+
+  // attempt_completion senza mai aver scritto → conclusione prematura
+  if (first === 'attempt_completion') {
+    return hasWrittenInSession ? 1.0 : 0.3;
+  }
+
+  // Delegare ad un'altra mode è sempre un'azione valida
+  if (first === 'new_task') return 1.0;
+
+  // Tool di scrittura/modifica: reward pieno
+  const writeTools = ['apply_diff','write_to_file','replace_in_file',
+                      'execute_command','insert_content'];
+  if (writeTools.includes(first)) return 1.0;
+
+  // Tool di lettura/ricerca: neutro
+  const readTools = ['read_file','list_files','search_files','codebase_search'];
+  if (readTools.includes(first)) return 1.0;
+
+  return 0.9;
+}

+// Ritorna true se almeno un assistant message nella history ha chiamato
+// un tool di scrittura. Serve per capire se attempt_completion è prematuro.
+function sessionHasWritten(messages) {
+  const writeTools = new Set(['apply_diff','write_to_file','replace_in_file',
+                              'execute_command','insert_content']);
+  const msgs = messages || [];
+
+  // Pass 1: raccogli gli id dei tool_call di scrittura
+  const writeCallIds = new Set();
+  for (const m of msgs) {
+    if (m.role !== 'assistant' || !Array.isArray(m.tool_calls)) continue;
+    for (const tc of m.tool_calls) {
+      const name = (tc.function?.name || tc.name || '').toLowerCase();
+      if (writeTools.has(name) && tc.id) writeCallIds.add(tc.id);
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Fallback legacy: nessun id → comportamento originale (qualsiasi write call → true)
+  if (writeCallIds.size === 0) {
+    for (const m of msgs) {
+      if (m.role !== 'assistant' || !Array.isArray(m.tool_calls)) continue;
+      for (const tc of m.tool_calls) {
+        const name = (tc.function?.name || tc.name || '').toLowerCase();
+        if (writeTools.has(name)) return true;
+      }
+    }
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  // Pass 2: cerca i tool_result associati e marca quelli falliti
+  const FAIL_RE = /unable to apply all diff|unable to apply any part|no sufficiently similar|edit unsuccessful/i;
+  const failedIds = new Set();
+  for (const m of msgs) {
+    if (m.role !== 'tool') continue;
+    const id = m.tool_call_id || m.toolCallId;
+    if (!id || !writeCallIds.has(id)) continue;
+    const c = typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : JSON.stringify(m.content || '');
+    if (FAIL_RE.test(c)) failedIds.add(id);
+  }
+
+  // True se almeno un write call NON è fallito
+  for (const id of writeCallIds) {
+    if (!failedIds.has(id)) return true;
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+function trackRequestStart(id, meta) {
+  tracker.trackRequestStart(id, meta);
+}
+
+function trackRequestUpdate(id, patch) {
+  tracker.trackRequestUpdate(id, patch);
+}
+
+function trackRequestEnd(id) {
+  tracker.trackRequestEnd(id);
+}
+
+function getActiveRequestsSnapshot() {
+  const now = Date.now();
+  return tracker.getActiveRequestsValues().map(r => {
+    const info = r.model ? bandit.getModelInfo(r.model) : null;
+    const rank = r.model ? bandit.getModelRank(r.model) : null;
+    return {
+      ...r,
+      elapsedMs: now - r.startTime,
+      elapsedSec: Math.round((now - r.startTime) / 100) / 10,
+      N: info?.N ?? null,
+      avg: info?.avg ?? null,
+      trend: info?.trend ?? 'flat',
+      rank,
+    };
+  }).sort((a, b) => b.startTime - a.startTime);
+}
+
+// Ultime richieste completate (per mostrare activity quando idle)
+const recentRequests = new RingBuffer(5);
+
+function trackRequestComplete(id, meta) {
+  const r = tracker.getRequest(id);
+  if (r) {
+    const info = r.model ? bandit.getModelInfo(r.model) : null;
+    const rank = r.model ? bandit.getModelRank(r.model) : null;
+    recentRequests.push({
+      ...r,
+      ...meta,
+      endedAt: Date.now(),
+      durationSec: Math.round((Date.now() - r.startTime) / 100) / 10,
+      N: info?.N ?? null,
+      avg: info?.avg ?? null,
+      trend: info?.trend ?? 'flat',
+      rank,
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+function pushLog(message) {
+   // Event grouping: if the same message repeats within 5 seconds, increment counter instead of new log entry
+   const now = Date.now();
+   if (global.lastLogMessage === message && global.lastLogTime && (now - global.lastLogTime) < 5000) {
+     // Same message within 5 seconds, increment counter
+     global.logMessageCount++;
+     // Update the last entry in logBuffer to show the count
+     const lastEntry = logBuffer.getAll().pop();
+     if (lastEntry && lastEntry.includes(message)) {
+       // Replace the last entry with grouped version
+       logBuffer.push(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${message} (x${global.logMessageCount + 1})`);
+       // Remove the previous entry since we're replacing it
+       if (logBuffer.buffer.length > 0) {
+         logBuffer.buffer.pop();
+         if (logBuffer.index > 0) logBuffer.index--;
+       }
+     }
+   } else {
+     // New message or timeout exceeded, reset counter and log normally
+     if (global.logMessageCount > 0) {
+       // If we had a grouped message, add it with its final count
+       const groupedMessage = `${global.lastLogMessage} (x${global.logMessageCount + 1})`;
+       logBuffer.push(`[${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}] ${groupedMessage}`);
+     }
+     global.lastLogMessage = message;
+     global.logMessageCount = 0;
+     global.lastLogTime = now;
+     const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
+     logBuffer.push(`[${timestamp}] ${message}`);
+   }
+ }
+
+// Consolidated request outcome log
+function logSuccess(model, dur, opts = {}) {
+  const { stream, toolNames, hasWritten, rewardScore, baseReward } = opts;
+  const tag = stream ? "[SUCCESS-STREAM]" : "[SUCCESS]";
+  console.log(`${tag} ${model} in ${dur.toFixed(2)}s ` +
+              `(reward: ${(rewardScore || 0).toFixed(3)} = base ${(baseReward || 0).toFixed(3)} ` +
+              `x ${(toolNames ? 0.6 : 1).toFixed(1)} tool=${toolNames?.[0] || 'none'} hasWritten=${hasWritten ?? '?'})`);
+}
+
+// ========================================
+// CONSOLE OVERRIDE CON TRUNCATURA
+// ========================================
+
+const originalLog = console.log;
+const originalError = console.error;
+const originalWarn = console.warn;
+
+function serializeArgs(args) {
+  return args.map(arg => {
+    if (typeof arg === "string") return arg;
+    if (arg instanceof Error) return arg.stack || arg.message;
+    try {
+      const str = JSON.stringify(arg);
+      return str && str.length > 1000 ? str.substring(0, 1000) + "... (truncated)" : str;
+    } catch {
+      return String(arg);
+    }
+  }).join(" ");
+}
+
+console.log = (...args) => { originalLog(...args); pushLog(serializeArgs(args)); };
+console.error = (...args) => { originalError(...args); pushLog("ERROR: " + serializeArgs(args)); };
+console.warn = (...args) => { originalWarn(...args); pushLog("WARN: " + serializeArgs(args)); };

+});

+app.get("/v1/scripts", requireAuth, (req, res) => {

+      .filter(f => f.endsWith('.mjs') || f.endsWith('.sh'))
+      .map(f => {
+        const fullPath = path.join(scriptsDir, f);
+        const stats = fs.statSync(fullPath);
+        return {
+          name: f,
+          path: fullPath,
+          size: stats.size,
+          modified: stats.mtime.toISOString(),
+          isExecutable: (stats.mode & 0o111) !== 0,
+          type: f.endsWith('.mjs') ? 'javascript' : 'shell'
+        };
+      });
+    res.json({ scripts });
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error("[API] Errore lettura script:", e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
+  }
+});

+app.post("/v1/scripts/execute", requireAuth, express.json(), (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { scriptPath, args = [] } = req.body || {};
+    if (!scriptPath) {
+      return res.status(400).json({ error: "scriptPath richiesto" });
+    }
+
+    // Validazione del percorso per prevenire path traversal
+    const scriptsDir = path.join(__dirname, "../scripts");
+    const normalizedPath = path.normalize(scriptPath);
+    const absolutePath = path.join(scriptsDir, normalizedPath);
+
+    if (!absolutePath.startsWith(scriptsDir)) {
+      return res.status(403).json({ error: "Percorso non autorizzato" });
+    }
+
+    if (!fs.existsSync(absolutePath)) {
+      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Script non trovato" });
+    }
+
+    // Esecuzione dello script
+    const isShell = absolutePath.endsWith('.sh');
+
+    let command, options;
+    if (isShell) {
+      command = "bash";
+      options = { shell: true };
+    } else {
+      command = "node";
+      options = {};
+    }
+
+    const child = spawn(command, [absolutePath, ...args], {
+      cwd: scriptsDir,
+      stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
+      ...options
+    });
+
+    const output = {
+      pid: child.pid,
+      command: `${command} ${absolutePath} ${args.join(' ')}`,
+      startTime: Date.now(),
+      status: "running"
+    };
+
+    let stdoutData = "";
+    let stderrData = "";
+
+    const writeOutputFile = () => {
+      const outputFile = path.join(scriptsDir, `.script-output-${child.pid}.json`);
+      const currentOutput = {
+        ...output,
+        stdout: stdoutData,
+        stderr: stderrData,
+        endTime: output.endTime || Date.now(),
+        duration: (output.endTime || Date.now()) - output.startTime
+      };
+      try {
+        fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, JSON.stringify(currentOutput, null, 2));
+      } catch (err) {
+        console.error("[API] Errore scrittura output script in tempo reale:", err.message);
+      }
+    };
+
+    child.stdout?.on("data", (data) => {
+      stdoutData += data.toString();
+      writeOutputFile();
+    });
+
+    child.stderr?.on("data", (data) => {
+      stderrData += data.toString();
+      writeOutputFile();
+    });
+
+    child.on("close", (code) => {
+      output.status = "completed";
+      output.exitCode = code;
+      output.stdout = stdoutData;
+      output.stderr = stderrData;
+      output.endTime = Date.now();
+      output.duration = output.endTime - output.startTime;
+
+      // Salva l'output in un file per riferimento
+      const outputFile = path.join(scriptsDir, `.script-output-${child.pid}.json`);
+      fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, JSON.stringify(output, null, 2));
+    });
+
+    res.json(output);
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error("[API] Errore esecuzione script:", e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
+  }
+});
+
+app.get("/v1/scripts/output/:pid", requireAuth, (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { pid } = req.params;
+    const scriptsDir = path.join(__dirname, "../scripts");
+    const outputFile = path.join(scriptsDir, `.script-output-${pid}.json`);
+
+    if (!fs.existsSync(outputFile)) {
+      return res.status(404).json({ error: "Output script non trovato" });
+    }
+
+    const output = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(outputFile, "utf8"));
+    res.json(output);
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.error("[API] Errore lettura output script:", e.message);
+    res.status(500).json({ error: e.message });
+  }
+});
