+// ========================================
+// PROXY ENDPOINT
+// ========================================
+
+app.post(["/v1/chat/completions", "/chat/completions"], async (req, res) => {
+  const { stream } = req.body || {};
+  const requestId = newRequestId();
+
+  trackRequestStart(requestId, {
+    source: (req.get("x-source") === "training") ? "training" :
+            (req.get("x-source") === "changelog") ? "changelog" : "zoo",
+    model: null,
+    attempt: 0,
+    stream: !!stream,
+    status: "starting",
+    clientIp: req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress || "?"
+  });
+
+  // Cleanup a fine richiesta (success, error, disconnect)
+  res.once("finish", () => { trackRequestComplete(requestId); trackRequestEnd(requestId); });
+  res.once("close", () => { trackRequestComplete(requestId); trackRequestEnd(requestId); });
+  const baseUrl = sanitizeBaseUrl(process.env.OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL, "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1");
+  const apiKey = process.env.OMNIROUTE_API_KEY;
+
+  bandit.recordRequest(); // +1 per ogni richiesta ricevuta
+  // === Stima token e (eventuale) auto-compress del contesto ===
+  let estimatedTokens = bandit.estimateTokens(req.body);
+  // Hard cap: se il contesto stimato supera 150k token, rifiuta
+  const MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS = parseInt(process.env.MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS || "150000");
+  // Timeout proporzionale: contesti grandi → prefill più lungo.
+  // Scala linearmente (100k = 2x, 200k+ = 3x, cap 3x).
+  const baseTimeout = parseInt(process.env.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS) || 20000;
+  const tokenScale = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.ceil((estimatedTokens || 0) / 100000)));
+  const upstreamTimeoutMs = baseTimeout * tokenScale;
+  if (tokenScale > 1 && debugVerbose) {
+    console.log(`[TIMEOUT] scala ${tokenScale}x → ${upstreamTimeoutMs}ms (tokens=${estimatedTokens})`);
+  }
+  const autoCompress = String(req.get("x-auto-compress") || "").toLowerCase() === "true";
+  if (debugVerbose) console.log(`[CONTEXT] autoCompress=${autoCompress} header="${req.get("x-auto-compress") || "<assente>"}" tokens=${estimatedTokens} maxCatalog=${bandit.maxCatalogInput()}`);
+
+    // === MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS check (con compress d'emergenza se autoCompress) ===
+    if (estimatedTokens > MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS) {
+      if (autoCompress) {
+        const compressed = compressBody(req.body, MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS - 500);
+        if (compressed && compressed.body) {
+          const newTokens = bandit.estimateTokens(compressed.body);
+          console.log(`[CONTEXT] Globale ${estimatedTokens} > ${MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS} → compresso a ${newTokens}`);
+          req.body = compressed.body;
+          estimatedTokens = newTokens;
+        }
+      }
+      if (estimatedTokens > MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS) {
+        console.warn(`[REJECT] Contesto ${estimatedTokens} > ${MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS} → 413`);
+        return res.status(413).json({
+          error: {
+            message: `Context too large (${estimatedTokens} tokens). Max ${MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS}. Compress or start new chat.`,
+            type: "context_too_large",
+            status: 413
+          }
+        });
+      }
+    }
+  // Debug sessione
+  const sessionDebug = {
+    user: req.body?.user || null,
+    ip: req.ip || req.connection?.remoteAddress || "?",
+    ua: (req.get("user-agent") || "").substring(0, 40),
+    convHeader: req.get("x-conversation-id") || req.get("x-session-id") || null,
+    firstMsgHash: req.body?.messages?.[0]?.content?.substring?.(0, 60) || null
+  };
+  console.log(`[SESSION] ${JSON.stringify(sessionDebug)}`);
+  const maxCatalog = bandit.maxCatalogInput();
+
+  if (autoCompress && maxCatalog > 0 && estimatedTokens > maxCatalog) {
+    console.log(`[CONTEXT] Richiesta ${estimatedTokens} token > max catalogo ${maxCatalog}, tentativo di compressione`);
+    const compressed = compressBody(req.body, maxCatalog);
+    if (compressed) {
+      req.body = compressed.body;
+      estimatedTokens = bandit.estimateTokens(req.body);
+      console.log(`[CONTEXT] Compresso: ${compressed.omitted} messaggi rimossi, ora ${estimatedTokens} token`);
+    } else {
+      console.warn(`[CONTEXT] Compressione non possibile, procedo con contesto originale`);
+    }
+  }
+  // Header x-force-model: bypassa UCB1 al primo tentativo (per training manuale)
+  const forceModel = (req.get("x-force-model") || "").trim();
+  const feedbackSource = (req.get("x-source") || "").toLowerCase() === "training" ? "training" : "prod";
+  // Initialize attempt counter before session affinity code that references it
+  let attempt = 0;
+    const fallbackTried = new Set();
+    // === Session key per affinity ===
+  const sessionKey = computeSessionKey(req.body?.messages);
+  if (sessionKey) {
+    const sys = req.body?.messages?.find(m => m.role === "system");
+    const usr = req.body?.messages?.find(m => m.role === "user");
+    const sysPreview = (typeof sys?.content === "string" ? sys.content : JSON.stringify(sys?.content || "")).slice(0, 120);
+    const usrPreview = (typeof usr?.content === "string" ? usr.content : JSON.stringify(usr?.content || "")).slice(0, 80);
+    if (debugVerbose) console.log(`[SESSION-KEY] ${sessionKey.slice(0,8)} | sys="${sysPreview}" | usr="${usrPreview}"`);
+  }
+
+  // === MODE / PROFILE ===
+  const sysMsg = req.body?.messages?.find(m => m.role === 'system');
+  const sysText = (typeof sysMsg?.content === 'string') ? sysMsg.content : '';
+  const modeResult = detectProfile(sysText);
+  // === STRUGGLING DETECTION ===
+  // Guarda gli ultimi 8 messaggi (user + assistant), esclude l'ultimo
+  // <environment_details> che è sempre presente.
+  const allMsgs = req.body?.messages || [];
+  const lastMsgs = allMsgs.slice(-8);
+  let isStruggling = false;
+  let strugglingReason = '';
+  for (const m of lastMsgs) {
+    const c = typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : JSON.stringify(m.content || '');
+    // Salta l'ultimo messaggio con environment_details
+    if (/<environment_details>/i.test(c) && /Current Time/i.test(c)) continue;
+    if (/edit unsuccessful|no sufficiently similar|repetition limit|unable to apply all diff|apply_diff.{0,50}(fail|error|unsuccessful)/i.test(c)) {
+      isStruggling = true; strugglingReason = 'apply_diff fail'; break;
+    }
+    const isToolMessage = m.role === 'tool' || m.role === 'function' || m.tool_call_id || m.name === 'tool';
+    if (isToolMessage) {
+      if (/tool (execution )?failed|tool.{0,20}(error|abort)|"status"\s*:\s*"(error|failed)"|"is_error"\s*:\s*true/i.test(c)) {
+        isStruggling = true; strugglingReason = 'tool failed'; break;
+      }
+    }
+    if (/<error>[\s\S]{0,300}<\/(error|tool_result)>/i.test(c) && (isToolMessage || /tool_result|tool_call/i.test(c))) {
+      isStruggling = true; strugglingReason = 'tool error'; break;
+    }
+    if (/"status"\s*:\s*"error"/i.test(c) && (isToolMessage || /tool_result/i.test(c))) {
+      isStruggling = true; strugglingReason = 'status error'; break;
+    }
+  }
+  if (isStruggling) {
+    console.log(`[AFFINITY] Attempt ${attempt}: ⚠ Session struggling (${strugglingReason})`);
+  }
+    // === LOOP DETECTION: 3+ ask_followup_question consecutivi negli assistant ===
+    let isAskLoop = false;
+    let loopModelHint = '';
+    {
+      const assistants = allMsgs.filter(m => m.role === 'assistant' && Array.isArray(m.tool_calls) && m.tool_calls.length > 0);
+      const last3 = assistants.slice(-3);
+      if (last3.length === 3) {
+        const allAsks = last3.every(m => m.tool_calls.every(tc => {
+          const name = (tc.function?.name || tc.name || '').toLowerCase();
+          return name === 'ask_followup_question';
+        }));
+        if (allAsks) {
+          isAskLoop = true;
+          loopModelHint = 'ask_followup_question×3';
+          console.log(`[AFFINITY] Attempt ${attempt}: ⚠ Loop detected: 3 ask_followup_question consecutivi → changing model`);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  if (debugVerbose) {
+    const lastMsg = allMsgs[allMsgs.length - 1];
+    const lastContent = lastMsg?.content
+      ? (typeof lastMsg.content === 'string' ? lastMsg.content : JSON.stringify(lastMsg.content))
+      : '<none>';
+    const asstTcCount = allMsgs.filter(m => m.role === 'assistant' && Array.isArray(m.tool_calls) && m.tool_calls.length > 0).length;
+    const toolResultCount = allMsgs.filter(m => {
+      const c = typeof m.content === 'string' ? m.content : JSON.stringify(m.content || '');
+      return /<tool_result>/i.test(c);
+    }).length;
+    console.log(`[MSGS] total=${allMsgs.length} asst_tc=${asstTcCount} tool_result_msgs=${toolResultCount} lastRole=${lastMsg?.role} lastContent="${lastContent.slice(0, 250).replace(/\n/g, ' ')}"`);
+  }
+  // === MSGS-ERR: dump diagnostico ===
+  if (debugVerbose) {
+    const rolesSummary = {};
+    for (const mm of allMsgs) rolesSummary[mm.role] = (rolesSummary[mm.role] || 0) + 1;
+    console.log(`[MSGS] total=${allMsgs.length} roles=${JSON.stringify(rolesSummary)}`);
+
+    // Ultimi 3 messaggi role:tool — mostro il loro contenuto
+    const toolMsgs = allMsgs.filter(m => m.role === 'tool');
+    const lastTools = toolMsgs.slice(-3);
+    for (let i = 0; i < lastTools.length; i++) {
+      const tm = lastTools[i];
+      const c = typeof tm.content === 'string' ? tm.content : JSON.stringify(tm.content || '');
+      const preview = c.slice(0, 300).replace(/\n/g, ' ');
+      console.log(`[MSGS-TOOL#${i + 1}] name=${tm.name || '?'} content="${preview}"`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  const profile = modeResult.profile;
+  if (modeResult.mode) {
+    console.log(`[MODE] ${modeResult.mode} → profile=${profile} (${modeResult.source}${modeResult.sig ? ' sig=' + modeResult.sig.slice(0,8) : ''})`);
+  } else if (modeResult.source === 'unknown') {
+    console.log(`[MODE] unknown → registrata per labeling (sig=${modeResult.sig.slice(0,8)})`);
+  }
+
+  if (forceModel) {
+    console.log(`[FORCE] Modello forzato: ${forceModel}`);
+  }
+
+  const excluded = new Set();
+  // requireTools: richiede tool calls SOLO se:
+  //   1. la richiesta ha tools
+  //   2. il system prompt NON è di summarization (Zoo Code summarizza il contesto senza tool)
+  const hasTools = Array.isArray(req.body?.tools) && req.body.tools.length > 0;
+  const firstMsg = req.body?.messages?.[0]?.content || "";
+  const firstMsgStr = typeof firstMsg === "string" ? firstMsg : JSON.stringify(firstMsg);
+  const isSummarization = /summariz|summariz|condense|context.*compress|riassunt/i.test(firstMsgStr.slice(0, 500));
+  const requireTools = hasTools && !isSummarization;
+
+  if (hasTools && isSummarization) {
+    console.log(`[TOOLS] Richiesta di summarization rilevata → rimuovo tools dal body`);
+    // Per summarization, il modello deve rispondere con TESTO.
+    // Se gli passiamo i tools, tende a chiamarli anche se non serve.
+    delete req.body.tools;
+    delete req.body.tool_choice;
+    delete req.body.parallel_tool_calls;
+  }
+  if (requireTools) {
+    console.log(`[TOOLS] Richiesta con ${req.body.tools.length} tools → solo modelli tool-capable`);
+  }
+  const cooledDownThisRequest = new Set();
+  let controller = null;
+  let model;  // <-- FIX: declare model before while loop (used at line 1272)
+  // Timer streaming — dichiarati fuori da if(stream) così il catch esterno può accedervi
+  const STREAM_IDLE_MS = parseInt(process.env.STREAM_IDLE_MS || "60000", 10);
+  const isSummarizer = (profile === 'summarizer');
+  const STREAM_MAX_MS = parseInt(process.env.STREAM_MAX_MS || (isSummarizer ? "60000" : "180000"), 10);
+  let idleTimer = null;
+  let hardCapTimer = null;
+  let lastMeaningfulByte = Date.now();
+  let timeoutHandle = null;
+  let retryDelay = 0; // Exponential backoff delay in milliseconds
+
+  const providerCount = bandit.getProviderCount();
+  const maxAttempts = forceModel ? 1 : Math.min(500, providerCount * 4 + 100);
+  const startedAt = Date.now();
+  const MAX_TOTAL_MS = parseInt(process.env.MAX_TOTAL_MS) || 10 * 60 * 1000;
+
+  const cleanup = () => {
+    if (timeoutHandle) { clearTimeout(timeoutHandle); timeoutHandle = null; }
+    if (controller) { controller.abort(); controller = null; }
+  };
+  // Circuit breaker: contatore fallimenti per provider in questa richiesta.
+  // Al 3° fail, mette in cooldown il provider (5 min) → il while salta i suoi modelli.
+  const providerFailCount = new Map();
+  const PROVIDER_FAIL_THRESHOLD = 3;
+
+  function noteProviderFail(modelId) {
+    const prov = modelId.split('/')[0];
+    const n = (providerFailCount.get(prov) || 0) + 1;
+    providerFailCount.set(prov, n);
+    if (n === PROVIDER_FAIL_THRESHOLD) {
+      console.log(`[BANDIT] Provider ${prov} ha fallito ${n} volte in questa richiesta → cooldown 5min`);
+      try {
+        bandit._forceProviderCooldown(prov, 5 * 60 * 1000, "cascade-fail");
+        cooledDownThisRequest.add(prov);
+      } catch (_) {}
+    }
+  }
+
+  let clientDisconnected = false;
+  res.once("close", () => {
+    if (!res.writableEnded) {
+      clientDisconnected = true;
+      cleanup();
+    }
+  });
+
+  let retriesExhausted = false;
+  while (++attempt <= maxAttempts) {
+    if (attempt >= maxAttempts) {
+      retriesExhausted = true;
+    }
+    if (clientDisconnected) {
+      console.log(`[BANDIT] Client disconnesso, stop retry (dopo ${attempt - 1} tentativi)`);
+      cleanup();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    // Trigger fallback if retries are exhausted for felo/* models
+    if (retriesExhausted && model?.startsWith('felo/')) {
+      const fallbackModels = bandit.getFallbackModels();
+      if (fallbackModels.length > 0) {
+        const fallbackModel = fallbackModels[0];
+          if (fallbackTried.has(fallbackModel) || !bandit.isModelAvailable(fallbackModel)) {
+            console.error(`[FALLBACK] ${fallbackModel} non disponibile o già tentato → 503`);
+            cleanup();
+            return res.status(503).json({ error: { message: "No models available", status: 503 } });
+          }
+          fallbackTried.add(fallbackModel);
+        console.log(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: Fallback to ${fallbackModel} due to retries exhausted for ${model}`);
+        model = fallbackModel;
+        retriesExhausted = false; // Reset flag after fallback
+      } else {
+        console.error(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: No fallback models configured`);
+        cleanup();
+        return res.status(503).json({ error: { message: "No models available", status: 503 } });
+      }
+    }
+    if (Date.now() - startedAt > MAX_TOTAL_MS) {
+      console.warn(`[BANDIT] Limite tempo totale (${MAX_TOTAL_MS}ms) raggiunto dopo ${attempt} tentativi`);
+      cleanup();
+      return res.status(504).json({ error: { message: "Gateway timeout: nessun modello disponibile in tempo utile", status: 504 } });
+    }
+
+    if (attempt === 1 && forceModel) {
+      if (!bandit.isModelAvailable(forceModel)) {
+        cleanup();
+        return res.status(404).json({
+          error: { message: `Modello forzato ${forceModel} non disponibile in catalogo`, status: 404 }
+        });
+      }
+      model = forceModel;
+  } else {
+  // === SESSION AFFINITY ===
+  // Se la sessione è struggling, rimuovi il pin per riselezionare
+  // Se la sessione è struggling, penalizza il modello pinnato E rimuovi il pin
+  if ((isStruggling || isAskLoop) && sessionKey) {
+    const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+    if (entry) {
+      // Accumula fail nella blacklist di sessione (Nuanced approach: persistent or severe errors only)
+      let bl = sessionBlacklist.get(sessionKey);
+      if (!bl) { bl = new Map(); sessionBlacklist.set(sessionKey, bl); }
+      let record = bl.get(entry.model);
+      if (!record || typeof record === 'number') {
+        const prevFails = typeof record === 'number' ? record : 0;
+        record = { fails: prevFails, severe: false, lastReason: '' };
+        bl.set(entry.model, record);
+      }
+      record.fails += 1;
+      const reason = isAskLoop ? `loop ${loopModelHint}` : (strugglingReason || 'struggling');
+      record.lastReason = reason;
+
+      // Mark severe if status 400/404/422 or severe error
+      if (isAskLoop || /status 400|status 404|status 422|context window|validation/i.test(reason)) {
+        record.severe = true;
+      }
+
+      console.log(`[AFFINITY] Attempt ${attempt}: Unpin ${entry.model} (${reason}, fails=${record.fails}) → exclude and select another`);
+      excluded.add(entry.model);       // Force UCB1 to choose another
+      sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+
+      // Ban only if persistent (fails >= 3) or severe (status 400, 422, loop, etc.)
+      const isBanned = isAskLoop || record.severe || record.fails >= 3;
+      if (isBanned) {
+        console.log(`[AFFINITY] Attempt ${attempt}: 🚫 ${entry.model} BANNED in session ${sessionKey.slice(0,8)} (reason: ${reason}, fails: ${record.fails}, severe: ${record.severe})`);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  let pinnedEntry = null;
+  if (sessionKey) {
+    const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+    if (entry && (Date.now() - entry.ts) < SESSION_TTL_MS) {
+      pinnedEntry = entry;              // ← l'OGGETTO, non .model
+    } else if (entry) {
+      sessionModels.delete(sessionKey); // scaduto
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Aggiungi al set di esclusione i modelli bannati in questa sessione (fails >= 3 or severe) PRIMA di validare il pin
+  if (sessionKey) {
+    const bl = sessionBlacklist.get(sessionKey);
+    if (bl) {
+      for (const [modelId, record] of bl) {
+        const isBanned = typeof record === 'number' ? record >= 3 : (record.severe || record.fails >= 3);
+        if (isBanned) excluded.add(modelId);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  const pinnedMaxInput = pinnedEntry ? bandit.getModelMaxInput(pinnedEntry.model) : 0;
+  const pinnedTokenCapacityValid = !pinnedEntry || pinnedMaxInput <= 0 || estimatedTokens <= pinnedMaxInput;
+
+  const pinnedValid = pinnedEntry
+    && !excluded.has(pinnedEntry.model)
+    && bandit.isModelAvailable(pinnedEntry.model)
+    && pinnedTokenCapacityValid;
+
+  if (pinnedValid) {
+    model = pinnedEntry.model;
+    pinnedEntry.ts = Date.now();        // rinnova TTL (sliding)
+    console.log(`[AFFINITY] ↻ ${model} (sessione ${sessionKey.slice(0, 8)})`);
+  } else {
+    if (pinnedEntry && !pinnedTokenCapacityValid) {
+      console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${pinnedEntry.model} rimosso (token capacity insufficient: tokens=${estimatedTokens} > max=${pinnedMaxInput})`);
+      sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+      excluded.add(pinnedEntry.model);
+    }
+    model = await bandit.selectModel(excluded, estimatedTokens, requireTools, profile, cooledDownThisRequest);
+    if (model && sessionKey) {
+      sessionModels.set(sessionKey, { model, ts: Date.now() });
+      if (sessionModels.size > 10000) {
+        const firstKey = sessionModels.keys().next().value;
+        sessionModels.delete(firstKey);
+        sessionBlacklist.delete(firstKey);
+      }
+      console.log(`[AFFINITY] ⊕ pin ${model} (sessione ${sessionKey.slice(0, 8)})`);
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+trackRequestUpdate(requestId, {
+  model,
+  attempt,
+  triedModels: Array.from(excluded),
+  selectionHistory: bandit.getLastSelectionHistory()
+});
+    if (!model) {
+      console.warn(`[BANDIT] Attempt ${attempt}: selectModel returned null - no models available or filtering exhausted all models (requireTools=${requireTools}, tokens=${estimatedTokens}, excluded=${excluded.size})`);
+      notifier.notify("system.no_models", "Nessun modello disponibile: tutti in cooldown/ban o needs_attention", {
+        estimatedTokens,
+        attempt
+      }).catch(() => {});
+
+      // Check if fallback models are available
+      const fallbackModels = bandit.getFallbackModels();
+      if (fallbackModels.length > 0) {
+        let selectedFallbackModel = null;
+
+        // Iterate through ALL fallback models to find one that meets requirements
+        for (const fallbackModel of fallbackModels) {
+          // Skip if already tried
+          if (fallbackTried.has(fallbackModel)) {
+            console.log(`[FALLBACK] Skipping fallback model ${fallbackModel}: already tried`);
+            continue;
+          }
+
+          // Check if model is available
+          if (!bandit.isModelAvailable(fallbackModel)) {
+            console.log(`[FALLBACK] Skipping fallback model ${fallbackModel}: not available in catalog/status`);
+            continue;
+          }
+
+          // Check if model supports tools when required
+          if (requireTools) {
+            const modelInfo = bandit.db.prepare(
+              `SELECT supports_tools FROM catalog WHERE id = ?`
+            ).get(fallbackModel);
+
+            if (!modelInfo || modelInfo.supports_tools !== 1) {
+              console.log(`[FALLBACK] Skipping fallback model ${fallbackModel}: does not support tools (required)`);
+              continue;
+            }
+          }
+
+          // Model passes all checks
+          selectedFallbackModel = fallbackModel;
+          break;
+        }
+
+        if (selectedFallbackModel) {
+          fallbackTried.add(selectedFallbackModel);
+          console.log(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: Fallback to ${selectedFallbackModel} due to no available models (filtering exhausted all models)`);
+          model = selectedFallbackModel;
+        } else {
+          console.error(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: All fallback options are exhausted / no suitable fallback models found (requireTools=${requireTools}, tried=${Array.from(fallbackTried).join(', ')})`);
+          cleanup();
+          return res.status(503).json({ error: { message: "No models available (filtering exhausted all models, fallback options exhausted)", status: 503 } });
+        }
+      } else {
+        console.error(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: No fallback models configured (no models available, filtering exhausted all models)`);
+        cleanup();
+        return res.status(503).json({ error: { message: "No models available (no fallback models configured)", status: 503 } });
+      }
+    }
+
+    console.log(`[BANDIT] Selezionato ${model} (tentativo ${attempt})`);
+
+    // === AUTO-COMPRESS per il modello specifico ===
+    let requestBody = req.body;
+    if (autoCompress) {
+      const modelMaxInput = bandit.getModelMaxInput(model);   // nuovo metodo
+      if (modelMaxInput > 0 && estimatedTokens > modelMaxInput) {
+        console.log(`[CONTEXT] Richiesta ${estimatedTokens} tok > ${model} max ${modelMaxInput} tok → comprimo`);
+        const compressed = compressBody(req.body, modelMaxInput - 500);
+        if (compressed) {
+          requestBody = compressed.body;
+          const newTokens = bandit.estimateTokens(requestBody);
+          console.log(`[CONTEXT] Compresso: ${compressed.omitted} messaggi rimossi, ora ${newTokens} tok`);
+          estimatedTokens = newTokens;
+        } else {
+          console.warn(`[CONTEXT] Compressione impossibile per ${model}, salto`);
+          // Se il modello che ha fallito era il pin della sessione → unpin
+          if (sessionKey) {
+            const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+            if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+              console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} fallito → unpin`);
+              sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+            }
+          }
+          noteProviderFail(model);
+          excluded.add(model);
+          continue;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+      // Strip campi reasoning non universali (OpenRouter-only).
+      // Groq, nvidia, mistral li rifiutano come "unsupported".
+      if (Array.isArray(requestBody?.messages)) {
+        for (const m of requestBody.messages) {
+          if (m && typeof m === "object" && m.role === "assistant") {
+            if ("reasoning_details" in m) delete m.reasoning_details;
+            if ("reasoning_content" in m) delete m.reasoning_content;
+            if ("reasoning" in m) delete m.reasoning;
+          }
+        }
+      }
+    trackRequestUpdate(requestId, {
+      model,
+      attempt,
+      status: "fetching",
+    });
+    const start = Date.now();
+    controller = new AbortController();
+
+    timeoutHandle = setTimeout(() => {
+      console.warn(`[TIMEOUT] ${model} superato timeout (${upstreamTimeoutMs}ms)`);
+      controller.abort();
+    }, upstreamTimeoutMs);
+
+    try {
+      const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
+      if (apiKey) headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${apiKey}`;
+
+      const endpointUrl = buildEndpointUrl(baseUrl, "/chat/completions");
+      const r = await fetch(endpointUrl, {
+        method: "POST",
+        headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify({ ...requestBody, model, stream: !!stream }),
+        signal: controller.signal
+      });
+
+      clearTimeout(timeoutHandle);
+      timeoutHandle = null;
+      const dur = (Date.now() - start) / 1000;
+
+      if (!r.ok || r.status === 499) {
+        const txt = await r.text().catch(() => "");
+        console.error(`[DIAGNOSTIC] Upstream failure response: status=${r.status}, model=${model}, bodySnippet=${txt.substring(0, 200)}`);
+        console.error(`[UPSTREAM ${r.status}] ${model}: ${txt.substring(0, 200)}`);
+        bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: txt, status: r.status }, { source: feedbackSource, estimatedTokens });
+
+        if (sessionKey) {
+          const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+          if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+            sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+            console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} rimosso (upstream error status ${r.status})`);
+          }
+        }
+
+        // Parse Retry-After header for 429 errors
+        let retryAfter = 0;
+        if (r.status === 429) {
+          const retryAfterHeader = r.headers.get('Retry-After');
+          if (retryAfterHeader) {
+            retryAfter = parseInt(retryAfterHeader, 10) * 1000; // Convert to milliseconds
+            console.log(`[RETRY] Retry-After header: ${retryAfterHeader}s → ${retryAfter}ms`);
+          }
+        }
+
+        // 413 / 429 / ITPM / TPM / Request too large / tokens per minute: il modello ha superato il limite di token o TPM.
+        // Rimuovi il pin e mark severe in sessionBlacklist per evitare di riprovare lo stesso modello.
+        if (r.status === 413 || r.status === 429 || /ITPM|tokens?\s*per\s*minute|TPM|input tokens per minute|Request too large|Requested \d+.*Limit \d+|Limit \d+.*Requested \d+/i.test(txt)) {
+          if (sessionKey) {
+            sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+            let bl = sessionBlacklist.get(sessionKey);
+            if (!bl) { bl = new Map(); sessionBlacklist.set(sessionKey, bl); }
+            let record = bl.get(model);
+            if (!record || typeof record === 'number') {
+              record = { fails: (typeof record === 'number' ? record : 0) + 1, severe: true, lastReason: 'tpm-exceeded' };
+            } else {
+              record.severe = true;
+              record.fails += 1;
+              record.lastReason = 'tpm-exceeded';
+            }
+            bl.set(model, record);
+            console.log(`[AFFINITY] 🚫 model ${model} bannato in sessione ${sessionKey.slice(0, 8)} (TPM/413 limit exceeded, status=${r.status})`);
+          }
+        }
+
+        // 400 / Context window exceeded: il modello non può gestire il contesto.
+        // Rimuovi il pin per evitare di riprovare lo stesso modello al prossimo turno.
+        if (r.status === 400 && /context window|input tokens.*exceed|too large.*context/i.test(txt)) {
+          if (sessionKey) {
+            const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+            if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+              sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+              console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} rimosso (context window exceeded)`);
+            }
+          }
+        }
+
+        // Exponential backoff for 429 errors (only for felo/* models)
+            if (r.status === 429 && model?.startsWith('felo/')) {
+              const baseDelay = Math.max(retryAfter, retryDelay);
+              const exponentialFactor = Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
+              retryDelay = Math.min(baseDelay * exponentialFactor, 60000); // Cap at 60 seconds
+              console.log(`[RETRY] Attempt ${attempt}: 429 Error for ${model}. Retrying in ${retryDelay}ms (Retry-After: ${retryAfter}ms, exponential factor: ${exponentialFactor}x)`);
+              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, retryDelay));
+            }
+
+        noteProviderFail(model);
+        excluded.add(model);
+        console.log(`[FAILURE] Attempt ${attempt}: ${model} failed with status ${r.status}. Error: ${txt.slice(0, 100)}`);
+        trackRequestUpdate(requestId, { status: `error-${r.status}`, lastError: txt.slice(0, 100) });
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      if (stream) {
+        // Se gli header sono già stati inviati (stream già aperto), non possiamo ritentare
+        if (res.headersSent) {
+          console.error(`[RETRY BLOCKED] headers già inviati per ${model}, stream chiuso`);
+          bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: "stream already started" }, { source: feedbackSource });
+          cleanup();
+          try { res.end(); } catch (_) {}
+          return;
+        }
+
+        const reader = r.body.getReader();
+        const dec = new TextDecoder();
+
+        res.setHeader("Content-Type", "text/event-stream");
+        res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
+        res.setHeader("Connection", "keep-alive");
+
+        let streamFailed = false;
+        let streamStarted = false;
+        let firstChunk = true;
+        let accumulated = "";
+        hardCapTimer = setTimeout(() => {
+          console.error(`[TIMEOUT] ${model}: stream superato hard cap ${STREAM_MAX_MS/1000}s → abort`);
+          console.error(`[HARDCAP] timer fired, controller.signal.aborted=${controller?.signal?.aborted}, STREAM_MAX_MS=${STREAM_MAX_MS}`);
+          try {
+            if (controller && !controller.signal.aborted) {
+              controller.abort(new Error('stream-hard-cap'));
+            }
+          } catch (e) { console.error(`[HARDCAP] abort failed: ${e.message}`); }
+          try { reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}
+        }, STREAM_MAX_MS);
+        if (hardCapTimer.unref) hardCapTimer.unref();
+        // Idle timeout: scatta solo se NESSUN CONTENUTO REALE per N sec.
+        // I ping SSE (`: keep-alive\n\n`) NON resettano il timer.
+        const resetIdle = () => {
+          if (idleTimer) clearTimeout(idleTimer);
+          idleTimer = setTimeout(() => {
+            const elapsed = Math.round((Date.now() - lastMeaningfulByte) / 1000);
+            console.error(`[TIMEOUT] ${model}: stream idle ${elapsed}s senza contenuto → abort`);
+            try {
+              if (controller && !controller.signal.aborted) {
+                controller.abort(new Error('stream-idle-timeout'));
+              }
+            } catch (e) { console.error(`[TIMEOUT] abort failed: ${e.message}`); }
+            try { reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); } catch (_) {}
+          }, STREAM_IDLE_MS);
+          if (idleTimer.unref) idleTimer.unref();
+        };
+        // Un chunk è "utile" solo se contiene contenuto reale.
+        // Ping/commenti SSE iniziano con `:` e vanno ignorati.
+        const isMeaningfulChunk = (c) => {
+          const stripped = c.replace(/^:\s*.*$/gm, '').replace(/\s+/g, '');
+          return stripped.length > 0;
+        };
+        resetIdle();
+
+        try {
+          while (true) {
+            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
+            if (done) break;
+
+            if (value) {
+              const chunk = dec.decode(value, { stream: true });
+
+              // Reset idle SOLO se il chunk ha contenuto reale
+              if (isMeaningfulChunk(chunk)) {
+                lastMeaningfulByte = Date.now();
+                resetIdle();
+              }
+
+              if (firstChunk && (chunk.includes('"error"') || chunk.includes('"code"'))) {
+                streamFailed = true;
+                console.error(`[STREAM ERR] ${model}: ${chunk.substring(0, 200)}`);
+                res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ error: "Stream error" })}\n\n`);
+                break;
+              }
+              firstChunk = false;
+              streamStarted = true;
+              accumulated += chunk;
+              res.write(chunk);
+            }
+          }
+          if (idleTimer) { clearTimeout(idleTimer); idleTimer = null; }
+          if (hardCapTimer) { clearTimeout(hardCapTimer); hardCapTimer = null; }
+          if (!streamFailed && streamStarted) {
+            // validazione
+            const streamInvalid = validateStreamAccumulated(accumulated, { requireTools });
+            if (requireTools) {
+              const tcMatches = accumulated.match(/"tool_calls"/g);
+              console.log(`[RESPONSE-STREAM] ${model} | tool_calls found: ${tcMatches?.length || 0}`);
+            }
+              if (streamInvalid) {
+                const details = (typeof streamInvalid === "object" && streamInvalid !== null)
+                  ? streamInvalid
+                  : { message: String(streamInvalid) };
+                const displayMsg = details.message || details.reason || String(streamInvalid);
+                console.error(`[STREAM INVALID] ${model}: ${displayMsg}`);
+                bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, details, { source: feedbackSource });
+                // Header già inviati: NON possiamo cambiare modello.
+                // Chiudiamo lo stream con un errore e usciamo.
+                try {
+                  res.write(`data: ${JSON.stringify({ error: { message: "Stream invalid: " + displayMsg } })}\n\n`);
+                  res.write(`data: [DONE]\n\n`);
+                } catch (_) {}
+                cleanup();
+                try { res.end(); } catch (_) {}
+                return;
+              }
+
+            const baseReward = Math.max(0, 1.0 - (dur / 30));
+            // Estrai i nomi dei tool chiamati dallo stream accumulato
+            const streamToolNames = [...accumulated.matchAll(/"name"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]);
+            const hasWritten = sessionHasWritten(req.body?.messages);
+            const mult = computeToolRewardMultiplier(streamToolNames, hasWritten);
+            const rewardScore = baseReward * mult;
+            bandit.recordFeedback(model, true, rewardScore, null, { source: feedbackSource });
+            logSuccess(model, dur, { stream: true, toolNames: streamToolNames, hasWritten, rewardScore, baseReward });
+            trackRequestUpdate(requestId, { status: "success", lastDurationSec: dur });
+          } else if (streamFailed) {
+            bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: "stream error" }, { source: feedbackSource });
+            // Header già inviati → non si può ritentare
+            cleanup();
+            try { res.end(); } catch (_) {}
+            return;
+          }
+
+          res.end();
+          cleanup();
+          return;
+        } catch (e) {
+          console.error(`[STREAM ABORT] ${model}: ${e.message}`);
+          if (sessionKey) {
+            const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+            if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+              sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+              console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} rimosso (stream abort/error)`);
+            }
+          }
+          bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: e.message }, { source: feedbackSource });
+          noteProviderFail(model);
+          excluded.add(model);
+          reader.cancel().catch(() => {});
+          if (!res.writableEnded) res.end();
+          continue;
+        }
+      } else {
+        const data = await r.json();
+
+        // === VALIDAZIONE RISPOSTA ===
+        const invalidReason = validateNonStreamResponse(data, { requireTools });
+        // DEBUG: log risposta modello (solo se ha tools)
+        if (requireTools) {
+          const msg = data.choices?.[0]?.message;
+          const tc = msg?.tool_calls;
+          const content = msg?.content;
+          if (debugVerbose) {
+            console.log(`[RESPONSE] ${model} | tool_calls: ${tc?.length || 0} | content: ${(content || "").substring(0, 100)} ${tc && tc.length > 0 ? `tool chiamati: ${tc.map(t => t.function?.name).join(", ")}` : ''}`);
+          }
+        }
+        if (invalidReason) {
+          console.error(`[APP ERR] ${model}: ${invalidReason}`);
+          if (sessionKey) {
+            const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+            if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+              sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+              console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} rimosso (response invalidation)`);
+            }
+          }
+          bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: invalidReason }, { source: feedbackSource });
+          noteProviderFail(model);
+          excluded.add(model);
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        const baseReward = Math.max(0, 1.0 - (dur / 30));
+        const respToolNames = (data.choices?.[0]?.message?.tool_calls || []).map(tc => tc.function?.name).filter(Boolean);
+        const hasWritten = sessionHasWritten(req.body?.messages);
+        const mult = computeToolRewardMultiplier(respToolNames, hasWritten);
+        const rewardScore = baseReward * mult;
+        bandit.recordFeedback(model, true, rewardScore, null, { source: feedbackSource });
+        logSuccess(model, dur, { stream: false, toolNames: respToolNames, hasWritten, rewardScore, baseReward });
+        trackRequestUpdate(requestId, { status: "success", lastDurationSec: dur });
+        cleanup();
+        return res.json(data);
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      if (timeoutHandle) { clearTimeout(timeoutHandle); timeoutHandle = null; }
+
+      if (sessionKey) {
+        const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+        if (entry && entry.model === model) {
+          sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+          console.log(`[AFFINITY] ✗ pin ${model} rimosso (fetch error / timeout)`);
+        }
+      }
+
+      if (e.name === "AbortError") {
+        if (idleTimer) { clearTimeout(idleTimer); idleTimer = null; }
+        console.error(`[ABORT] ${model}: timeout or client disconnect`);
+        bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: "timeout/abort" }, { source: feedbackSource });
+      } else {
+        console.error(`[FETCH ERR] ${model}: ${e.message}`);
+        bandit.recordFeedback(model, false, 0, { message: e.message }, { source: feedbackSource });
+      }
+      noteProviderFail(model);
+      excluded.add(model);
+    }
+  }
+
+  cleanup();
+  res.status(502).json({ error: { message: `${attempt - 1} tentativi esauriti su ${maxAttempts}`, status: 502 } });
+});
+
+// Serve static files from public directory (manifest, icons, etc.)
+app.use(express.static(path.join(__dirname, "../public")));
+
+// ========================================
+// ERROR HANDLERS GLOBALI
+// ========================================
+
+let unhandledRejectionCount = 0;
+process.on("unhandledRejection", (reason) => {
+  unhandledRejectionCount++;
+  console.error(`[UNHANDLED REJECTION #${unhandledRejectionCount}]`, reason?.message || reason);
+  // Non terminiamo il processo: un errore in una richiesta non deve uccidere il proxy.
+  // Se gli errori sono troppi (>20 in 60s), allora c'è un bug serio → crash pulito.
+  if (unhandledRejectionCount > 20) {
+    console.error("[FATAL] Troppi unhandled rejection, termino per evitare loop");
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+  // Reset contatore dopo 60s senza errori
+  setTimeout(() => { unhandledRejectionCount = 0; }, 60000).unref();
+});
+
+process.on("uncaughtException", (error) => {
+  console.error("[UNCAUGHT EXCEPTION]", error);
+  bandit.close();
+  process.exit(1);
+});
+
+process.on("SIGTERM", () => {
+  healthChecker.stop();
+  console.log("[SHUTDOWN] SIGTERM ricevuto, chiusura graceful...");
+  bandit.close();
+  process.exit(0);
+});
+
+process.on("SIGINT", () => {
+  healthChecker.stop();
+  console.log("[SHUTDOWN] SIGINT ricevuto, chiusura graceful...");
+  bandit.close();
+  process.exit(0);
+});
+
+// ========================================
+// STARTUP
+// ========================================
+
+async function startServer(attempt = 1) {
+  const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5;
+  try {
+    console.log("[INIT] Sincronizzazione modelli in corso...");
+    await bandit.fetchAndSyncModels();
+    console.log("[INIT] Modelli sincronizzati con successo");
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (attempt >= MAX_ATTEMPTS) {
+      console.error(`[FATAL] Troppi tentativi falliti di sincronizzazione (${MAX_ATTEMPTS}), arresto`);
+      bandit.close();
+      process.exit(1);
+    }
+    console.error("[INIT] Errore sincronizzazione:", err.message);
+    console.log(`[INIT] Ritento tra 5 secondi... (tentativo ${attempt + 1}/${MAX_ATTEMPTS})`);
+    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000));
+    return startServer(attempt + 1);
+  }
+
+  initRegistry();
+  const server = app.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
+    console.log(`[PROXY] ✓ Server avviato su http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
+    console.log(`[DASHBOARD] ✓ Dashboard disponibile su http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/dashboard`);
+    console.log(`[CONFIG] Timeout upstream: ${process.env.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS || 60000}ms`);
+    if (!REQUIRE_AUTH) {
+      console.warn("[SECURITY] DASHBOARD_TOKEN non configurato: le API di controllo sono esposte senza autenticazione");
+    } else {
+      console.log("[SECURITY] Auth attiva sulle API di controllo");
+    }
+
+    // Health check parte DOPO che il server è in ascolto
+    if (String(process.env.HEALTH_CHECK_ENABLED || "true").toLowerCase() === "true") {
+      healthChecker.start();
+    } else {
+      console.log("[HEALTH] Health check disabilitato (HEALTH_CHECK_ENABLED=false)");
+    }
+        // Cleanup sessioni scadute ogni 5 min
+    setInterval(() => {
+      const now = Date.now();
+      let removed = 0;
+      for (const [k, v] of sessionModels.entries()) {
+        if (now - v.ts > SESSION_TTL_MS) {
+          sessionModels.delete(k);
+          sessionBlacklist.delete(k); // pulisci anche la blacklist
+          removed++;
+        }
+      }
+      if (removed > 0) console.log(`[AFFINITY] Cleanup: rimosse ${removed} sessioni scadute`);
+    }, 5 * 60 * 1000).unref();
+  });
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1] && path.resolve(process.argv[1]) === path.resolve(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))) {
+  startServer().catch(err => {
+    console.error("[FATAL] Impossibile avviare server:", err);
+    bandit.close();
+    process.exit(1);
+  });
+}
+
+export { sessionModels, sessionBlacklist, SESSION_TTL_MS, computeSessionKey, compressBody, truncateBiggestMessage };

+import { test, describe, beforeEach, afterEach } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from "../src/bandit.mjs";
+import { isImageGenerationRequest, convertImageGenerationToChatCompletion } from "../src/index.mjs";
+
+// Helper: crea un bandit con DB in-memory
+function makeBandit() {
+  return new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+}
+
+// Helper: inserisce un modello nel catalogo
+function seedCatalog(b, id, provider, supportsImageGen = false) {
+  b.db.prepare("INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools, supports_image_generation) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
+    .run(id, provider, 4000, 1, 0, supportsImageGen ? 1 : 0);
+}
+
+// Helper: inserisce un modello nel catalogo senza supports_image_generation column (for backwards compatibility testing)
+function seedCatalogLegacy(b, id, provider) {
+  b.db.prepare("INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)")
+    .run(id, provider, 4000, 1, 0);
+}
+
+describe("Image Generation Request Detection", () => {
+  describe("isImageGenerationRequest()", () => {
+    test("detects explicit prompt without messages", () => {
+      const body = { prompt: "A beautiful sunset" };
+      assert.equal(isImageGenerationRequest(body), true);
+    });
+
+    test("does not detect when both prompt and messages present", () => {
+      const body = { prompt: "A beautiful sunset", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello" }] };
+      assert.equal(isImageGenerationRequest(body), false);
+    });
+
+    test("detects image-specific parameter n", () => {
+      const body = { prompt: "test", n: 2 };
+      assert.equal(isImageGenerationRequest(body), true);
+    });
+
+    test("detects image-specific parameter size", () => {
+      const body = { prompt: "test", size: "1024x1024" };
+      assert.equal(isImageGenerationRequest(body), true);
+    });
+
+    test("detects image-specific parameter response_format", () => {
+      const body = { prompt: "test", response_format: "url" };
+      assert.equal(isImageGenerationRequest(body), true);
+    });
+

+    test("converts URL-based image response", () => {
+      const imageGenResponse = {

+        data: [
+          { url: "https://example.com/image.png" }
+        ],
+        model: "dall-e-3"
+      };
+
+      const result = convertImageGenerationToChatCompletion(imageGenResponse);
+
+      assert.equal(result.object, "chat.completion");
+      assert.equal(result.model, "dall-e-3");
+      assert.equal(result.choices.length, 1);
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].index, 0);
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].message.role, "assistant");
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].message.content, "https://example.com/image.png");
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].finish_reason, "stop");
+      assert.equal(result.usage.prompt_tokens, 0);
+      assert.equal(result.usage.completion_tokens, 0);
+      assert.equal(result.usage.total_tokens, 0);
+    });
+
+    test("converts base64-based image response", () => {
+      const imageGenResponse = {
+        created: 1234567890,
+        data: [
+          { b64_json: "base64encodeddata==" }
+        ],
+        model: "stable-diffusion"
+      };
+
+      const result = convertImageGenerationToChatCompletion(imageGenResponse);
+
+      assert.equal(result.object, "chat.completion");
+      assert.equal(result.model, "stable-diffusion");
+      assert.equal(result.choices.length, 1);
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].message.content, "data:image/png;base64,base64encodeddata==");
+    });
+
+    test("handles missing data array", () => {
+      const imageGenResponse = {
+        created: 1234567890
+        // missing data property
+      };
+
+      const result = convertImageGenerationToChatCompletion(imageGenResponse);
+
+      assert.equal(result.object, "chat.completion");
+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].message.content, "[Image generated successfully]");
+    });
+
+    test("handles empty data array", () => {
+      const imageGenResponse = {
+        created: 1234567890,
+        data: []
+      };

+      assert.equal(result.choices[0].message.content, "[Image generated successfully]");

+        ]
+      };
+

+# OmniRoute Bandit Proxy - Image Generation Routing & Filtering Documentation
+
+## Overview
+
+OmniRoute Bandit Proxy includes robust support for **Image Generation** models and requests. This enables seamless handling of text-to-image workflows alongside standard LLM chat completions, leveraging the multi-armed bandit algorithm (`DiscountedUCB1Bandit`) to intelligently route requests to the best available image generation models.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Catalog Synchronization & Detection
+
+During startup and catalog synchronization (`fetchAndSyncModels` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:365)), models retrieved from OmniRoute are inspected for image generation capabilities:
+- **API Capabilities**: Checks if the upstream model object specifies `capabilities.image_generation === true` or `type === "image"`.
+- **Pattern Matching**: Automatically identifies image generation models based on model ID regex patterns:
+  - `dall-e`
+  - `stable-diffusion`
+  - `midjourney`
+  - `flux` / `flux-schnell` / `flux-dev`
+  - `imagen`
+  - `sdxl` / `sd-xl`
+  - `playground`
+- **Database Schema**: The `catalog` table features a `supports_image_generation` integer flag (`0` or `1`), added automatically via additive migration (`_migrateDB`).
+
+---
+
+## 2. API Endpoints
+
+### [`POST /v1/images/generations`](src/index.mjs:1)
+An OpenAI-compatible endpoint dedicated to image generation requests.
+
+**Request Body Example:**
+```json
+{
+  "prompt": "A futuristic cyberpunk city at sunset",
+  "model": "dall-e-3", // Optional; if omitted, bandit selects the best available image model
+  "n": 1,
+  "size": "1024x1024",
+  "response_format": "url" // or "b64_json"
+}
+```
+
+**Response Format:**
+Returns standard OpenAI image generation format or converts seamlessly into chat completion responses when invoked via chat fallback paths.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Chat/Completions Image Generation Detection & Handling
+
+When requests arrive at `POST /v1/chat/completions`, the proxy inspects the payload via [`isImageGenerationRequest()`](src/index.mjs:1) to determine if image generation is requested:
+1. **Explicit Prompt**: `prompt` field is present while `messages` is absent/empty.
+2. **Image Parameters**: Presence of `n`, `size` (`\d+x\d+`), or `response_format` combined with an image model pattern.
+3. **Intent Keywords**: Natural language prompt detection in user messages (e.g., `"generate image"`, `"create image"`, `"draw"`, `"paint"`, `"make a picture"`, `"text to image"`).
+
+When detected, the proxy routes the request through image-generation model selection and upstream endpoints (`/images/generations`).
+
+---
+
+## 4. Filtering Logic
+
+During model selection (`selectModel()` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1411)):
+- When `requireImageGeneration = true`, `filterModels()` strictly filters out any model where `supports_image_generation !== 1`.
+- Conversely, standard chat completions exclude image-generation-only models unless specifically requested, preventing image models from being incorrectly selected for text chat tasks.

+# Chat/Completions Endpoint Image Generation Detection
+
+## 1. Detection Logic Placement
+
+Add image generation detection logic early in the `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint handler in `src/index.mjs`, right after the initial request processing but before token estimation and context compression.
+
+## 2. Detection Criteria
+
+A chat/completions request should be treated as an image generation request when:
+
+### A. Explicit Image Generation Parameters Present
+- `prompt` field is present (string or array) AND `messages` field is absent or empty
+- `model` field specified and matches known image generation model patterns
+- `n` (number of images) parameter present
+- `size` parameter present with format like "256x256", "512x512", "1024x1024", etc.
+- `response_format` parameter present with value "b64_json" or "url"
+
+### B. Context Clues in Messages
+- Last user message contains image generation keywords: "generate image", "create image", "draw", "paint", "make a picture of", etc.
+- System prompt or user message contains explicit image generation instructions
+- Messages contain only image-related content with no conversational context
+
+## 3. Implementation Approach
+
+### A. Helper Function: `isImageGenerationRequest`
+
+Create a helper function near the top of `src/index.mjs` (after imports):
+
+```javascript
+/**
+ * Detects if a chat/completions request is actually requesting image generation
+ * @param {Object} body - Request body
+ * @returns {boolean} - True if request is for image generation
+ */
+function isImageGenerationRequest(body) {
+  // Check for explicit image generation parameters
+  if (body.prompt && (!body.messages || body.messages.length === 0)) {
+    return true;
+  }
+
+  // Check for image-specific parameters
+  const hasImageParams =
+    (body.n !== undefined && typeof body.n === 'number' && body.n > 0) ||
+    (body.size && /^\d+x\d+$/.test(body.size)) ||
+    (body.response_format && ['b64_json', 'url'].includes(body.response_format));
+
+  if (hasImageParams && body.model) {
+    const modelId = String(body.model).toLowerCase();
+    const imageModelPatterns = [
+      'dall-e', 'stable-diffusion', 'midjourney', 'flux',
+      'imagen', 'sdxl', 'sd-xl', 'playground'
+    ];
+    if (imageModelPatterns.some(pattern => modelId.includes(pattern))) {
+      return true;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Check messages for image generation intent
+  if (Array.isArray(body.messages) && body.messages.length > 0) {
+    const lastUserMessage = body.messages
+      .filter(m => m.role === 'user')
+      .pop();
+
+    if (lastUserMessage && lastUserMessage.content) {
+      const content = typeof lastUserMessage.content === 'string'
+        ? lastUserMessage.content
+        : JSON.stringify(lastUserMessage.content);
+
+      const imageGenerationKeywords = [
+        'generate image', 'create image', 'draw', 'paint',
+        'make a picture', 'create a picture', 'generate picture',
+        'text to image', 'image from text', 'create artwork',
+        'generate artwork', 'make an image'
+      ];
+
+      return imageGenerationKeywords.some(keyword =>
+        content.toLowerCase().includes(keyword));
+    }
+  }
+
+  return false;
+}
+```
+
+### B. Integration Point

+# POST /v1/images/generations Endpoint Design
+
+## Overview
+Create a new endpoint for image generation requests that follows the same pattern as the chat/completions endpoint but routes to image generation models only.
+
+## Request Format (OpenAI-compatible)
+```json
+{
+  "prompt": "A beautiful sunset over the ocean",
+  "model": "dall-e-3", // optional, if not provided will use bandit selection
+  "n": 1, // number of images to generate (default: 1)
+  "size": "1024x1024", // image size (default: 1024x1024)
+  "quality": "standard", // or "hd" for dall-e-3
+  "style": "vivid", // or "natural" for dall-e-3
+  "response_format": "url", // or "b64_json"
+  "user": "optional-user-id"
+}
+```
+
+## Implementation Details
+
+### 1. Route Registration
+Add to src/index.mjs after the chat/completions endpoint:
+```javascript
+app.post("/v1/images/generations", async (req, res) => {
+  // Image generation endpoint implementation
+});
+```
+
+### 2. Request Processing Steps
+Similar to chat/completions but adapted for image generation:
+
+#### A. Setup and Tracking
+- Generate request ID
+- Start request tracking
+- Set up cleanup handlers for disconnect/finish
+
+#### B. Parameter Extraction and Validation
+- Extract `prompt` (required)
+- Extract optional parameters: model, n, size, quality, style, response_format, user
+- Validate prompt is present and not empty
+- Validate n is reasonable (1-10 typically)
+- Validate size is supported format
+- Set defaults for missing parameters
+
+#### C. Token Estimation (Adapted)
+- For image generation, estimate tokens based on prompt length
+- Use similar 4 chars/token heuristic or adjust for image context
+- Apply context limits if needed (though less critical for image gen)
+
+#### D. Session Affinity (Optional)
+- Consider if session affinity applies to image generation
+- Might use prompt hash as session key for consistency
+- Or skip session affinity entirely for image generation
+
+#### E. Model Selection
+- Call `bandit.selectModel()` with `requireImageGeneration = true`
+- Pass excluded models set
+- Pass estimated tokens (from prompt)
+- Pass profile (maybe detect from prompt or use default)
+- Pass cooledDownThisRequest set
+
+#### F. Fallback Handling
+- If no models available, check fallback models
+- Ensure fallback models also support image generation
+- Return appropriate error if none available
+
+#### G. Upstream Call
+- Build endpoint URL for provider's image generation API
+- Prepare request body with image generation parameters
+- Set appropriate headers (auth, content-type)
+- Make fetch request to provider
+- Handle timeouts and abort controller
+
+#### H. Response Handling
+- For non-streaming: validate and return provider response directly
+- For streaming: handle if provider supports streaming image generation
+- Apply OpenAI-compatible response formatting
+- Record feedback for success/failure
+
+#### I. Error Handling
+- Handle provider errors (4xx, 5xx)
+- Handle timeouts and aborts
+- Apply exponential backoff for rate limits where appropriate
+- Update session affinity and blacklists on failures
+- Clean up resources on completion/error
+

+- No tool call handling
+- No context compression needed (typically)
+- Different parameter set (prompt vs messages)
+- Different response format (image data vs text)
+- May not need streaming handling (unless provider supports it)
+- Different model requirements (image generation vs chat)

+        cooldownMs = 30000; // 30s (appropriate cooldown)
+      }
+      return { action: "cooldown-model", scope: "model", reason: "high-demand", cooldownMs };
+    }
+
     // Timeout -> cooldown-model 10m
     if (/fetch timeout|timeout/i.test(message)) {
       return { action: "cooldown-model", scope: "model", reason: "timeout", cooldownMs: 10 * 60 * 1000 };

-# Architectural Design: ITPM (Input Tokens Per Minute) Tracking & Enforcement
-
-## 1. Overview & Problem Statement
-Currently, the OmniRoute Bandit Proxy tracks Request Per Minute (RPM) and Requests Per Day (RPD) in [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1). However, LLM providers enforce strict **Input Tokens Per Minute (ITPM)** / **Tokens Per Minute (TPM)** limits (e.g., a limit of 7000 tokens per minute when 7861 input tokens are requested). 
-
-When a request exceeds ITPM, providers return status `413 Payload Too Large` or `429 Rate Limit` with messages containing dynamic limit values (e.g., `Requested 7861, Limit 7000`). Currently, the proxy reacts reactively via error classification (`_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1)) and session blacklisting, but lacks proactive rolling window ITPM tracking and precise extraction of provider-enforced token limits.
-
----
-
-## 2. Proposed Architecture & Data Flow
-
-### A. Database Schema Enhancements (`_migrateDB` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1))
-Extend `provider_history` (and optionally `models`) with ITPM tracking columns:
-- `itpm_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 0` (configured limit or dynamically learned from error messages)
-- `tokens_last_minute INTEGER DEFAULT 0` (rolling 60-second window counter for input tokens)
-- `tokens_minute_started REAL DEFAULT 0` (timestamp when the current token window started)
-- `itpm_resets_at REAL DEFAULT 0` (cooldown timestamp when ITPM quota resets)
-
-### B. Configuration Updates (`config/provider-limits.json`)
-Add `itpm` field alongside `rpm` and `rpd` for each provider:
-```json
-{
-  "providers": {
-    "groq": {
-      "rpm": 50,
-      "rpd": 500,
-      "itpm": 7000
-    },
-    "openrouter": {
-      "rpm": 100,
-      "rpd": 1000,
-      "itpm": 50000
-    }
-  }
-}
-```
-
-### C. Enhanced Error Parsing & Limit Extraction (`_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1))
-When an upstream error occurs (status 413 or 429 containing TPM / token limit messages):
-1. Parse error messages matching patterns like:
-   - `Requested (\d+).*Limit (\d+)` or `Limit (\d+).*Requested (\d+)`
-   - `reset after (\d+)(s|m|h)`
-2. Extract the exact token limit (e.g. `7000`) and dynamically update `itpm_limit` in `provider_history` (or model history).
-3. Record quota exhaustion or model cooldown with calculated `retryAfter` duration.
-
-### D. Proactive ITPM Enforcement (`canCall` & `recordCall` in [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1))
-1. **Window Roll**: In `_rollWindows(provider)`, check if 60 seconds have elapsed since `tokens_minute_started`. If so, reset `tokens_last_minute = 0` and update `tokens_minute_started = now`.
-2. **Pre-check (`canCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`)**:
-   - Check if `itpm_resets_at > now`.
-   - Check if `tokens_last_minute + estimatedTokens > itpm_limit`. If exceeded, reject/skip proactively before sending the request.
-3. **Recording (`recordCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`)**:
-   - Increment `tokens_last_minute += estimatedTokens`.
-
----
-
-## 3. Workflow Diagram
-
-```mermaid
-graph TD
-    A[Incoming Request /v1/chat/completions] --> B[Estimate Input Tokens]
-    B --> C{Check Provider Quota & ITPM}
-    C -->|RPM/RPD/ITPM Exceeded| D[Skip Model / Provider & Try Fallback]
-    C -->|Within Limits| E[Forward Request to Upstream Provider]
-    E --> F{Response Status}
-    F -->|200 OK| G[Record Success & Log Input Tokens]
-    F -->|413 / 429 TPM Exceeded| H[Parse Error Message & Extract Limit / Reset Time]
-    H --> I[Update itpm_limit & recordQuotaExhausted / Cooldown]
-    I --> D
-```
-
----
-
-## 4. Implementation Plan Steps
-1. Update `config/provider-limits.json` to include default `itpm` limits for providers.
-2. Update [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1) to add `itpm` rolling window tracking, `canCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`, and `recordCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`.
-3. Update `_migrateDB` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) to add `itpm_limit`, `tokens_last_minute`, `tokens_minute_started`, and `itpm_resets_at` columns to `provider_history`.
-4. Enhance `_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) to parse exact limits and reset durations from 413/429 error messages.
-5. Integrate ITPM checks into the request retry loop in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1).

+import { test, describe, beforeEach, afterEach } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from "../src/bandit.mjs";
+import ProviderQuota from "../src/provider-quota.mjs";
+
+/**
+ * @fileoverview Comprehensive unit and integration test suite for ITPM quota limits,
+ * [`__tests__/itpm-quota.test.js`](__tests__/itpm-quota.test.js:1) 413 error parsing, rolling token/call windows,
+ * and provider/model skipping in [`DiscountedUCB1Bandit`](src/bandit.mjs:30) and [`ProviderQuota`](src/provider-quota.mjs:5).
+ */
+describe("ITPM Quota and Error Parsing Test Suite", () => {
+  let bandit;
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    bandit = new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+  });
+
+  afterEach(() => {
+    if (bandit && typeof bandit.close === "function") {
+      bandit.close();
+    }
+  });
+
+  /**
+   * @test Error classification parsing of 413 messages containing ITPM limits and reset times.
+   */
+  test("_classifyError parses 413 and ITPM limit messages with custom reset duration", () => {
+    const errorMsg = "ITPM limit exceeded. Limit 7000, Requested 7861. Please reset after 3s.";
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError({ status: 413, message: errorMsg });
+
+    assert.equal(classification.action, "cooldown-model");
+    assert.equal(classification.scope, "model");
+    assert.equal(classification.reason, "tpm-exceeded");
+    assert.equal(classification.cooldownMs, 3000, "Should parse 'reset after 3s' into 3000ms");
+  });
+
+  /**
+   * @test Error classification parsing of general 413 error without explicit reset time.
+   */
+  test("_classifyError parses standard 413 payload too large with default 5m cooldown", () => {
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError({ status: 413, message: "Payload too large" });
+
+    assert.equal(classification.action, "cooldown-model");
+    assert.equal(classification.scope, "model");
+    assert.equal(classification.cooldownMs, 300000, "Default 413 cooldown should be 5 minutes (300000ms)");
+  });
+
+  /**
+   * @test ProviderQuota canCall, recordCall, and recordQuotaExhausted behavior.
+   */
+  test("ProviderQuota canCall, recordCall, and recordQuotaExhausted enforce rolling limits and quota resets", () => {
+    const quota = bandit.quota;
+    const provider = "test-provider";
+
+    // Initially canCall should be true
+    assert.equal(quota.canCall(provider), true);
+
+    // Record calls
+    quota.recordCall(provider);
+    assert.equal(quota.canCall(provider), true);
+
+    // Simulate quota exhaustion with a future reset timestamp
+    const futureReset = Date.now() + 10000;
+    quota.recordQuotaExhausted(provider, futureReset, "quota_exhausted");
+
+    // canCall should now return false due to active quota reset
+    assert.equal(quota.canCall(provider), false);
+
+    // Snapshot should reflect quota exhaustion
+    const snap = quota.snapshot();
+    const providerSnap = snap.find(p => p.provider === provider);
+    assert.ok(providerSnap, "Snapshot should contain provider");
+    assert.equal(providerSnap.quotaExhausted, true);
+    assert.equal(providerSnap.quotaReason, "quota_exhausted");
+
+    // Simulate expired reset timestamp
+    const pastReset = Date.now() - 1000;
+    quota.recordQuotaExhausted(provider, pastReset, "quota_exhausted");
+    assert.equal(quota.canCall(provider), true, "Should allow calls after quota_resets_at has passed");
+  });
+

+   * @test Integration behavior where a provider exceeding ITPM or quota is skipped on subsequent requests.
+   */
+  test("Integration: provider exceeding ITPM/quota is correctly skipped on subsequent requests until reset period passes", async () => {
+    // Seed catalog with two models from different providers
+    bandit.db.prepare("INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)").run("prov-a/model-1", "prov-a", 100000, 1);
+    bandit.db.prepare("INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)").run("prov-b/model-2", "prov-b", 100000, 1);
+
+    // Select initial model
+    const selected1 = await bandit.selectModel();
+    assert.ok(selected1, "Should select a model initially");
+
+    // Simulate ITPM / quota exhaustion on prov-a via recordQuotaExhausted
+    const futureReset = Date.now() + 30000;
+    bandit.quota.recordQuotaExhausted("prov-a", futureReset, "itpm_exceeded");
+
+    // Verify selectModel skips prov-a because quota.canCall("prov-a") is false
+    const selected2 = await bandit.selectModel();
+    assert.ok(selected2, "Should select another available model");
+    assert.notEqual(selected2.provider, "prov-a", "Should skip provider prov-a when quota is exhausted");
+    assert.equal(selected2.provider, "prov-b", "Should fall back to prov-b");
+
+    // Simulate reset time passing for prov-a
+    const pastReset = Date.now() - 1000;
+    bandit.quota.recordQuotaExhausted("prov-a", pastReset, "itpm_exceeded");
+
+    // Now prov-a should be eligible again
+    const selected3 = await bandit.selectModel();
+    assert.ok(selected3, "Should be able to select model from prov-a after quota reset");
+  });
+});

+# Architectural Design: ITPM (Input Tokens Per Minute) Tracking & Enforcement
+
+## 1. Overview & Problem Statement
+Currently, the OmniRoute Bandit Proxy tracks Request Per Minute (RPM) and Requests Per Day (RPD) in [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1). However, LLM providers enforce strict **Input Tokens Per Minute (ITPM)** / **Tokens Per Minute (TPM)** limits (e.g., a limit of 7000 tokens per minute when 7861 input tokens are requested). 
+
+When a request exceeds ITPM, providers return status `413 Payload Too Large` or `429 Rate Limit` with messages containing dynamic limit values (e.g., `Requested 7861, Limit 7000`). Currently, the proxy reacts reactively via error classification (`_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1)) and session blacklisting, but lacks proactive rolling window ITPM tracking and precise extraction of provider-enforced token limits.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Proposed Architecture & Data Flow
+
+### A. Database Schema Enhancements (`_migrateDB` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1))
+Extend `provider_history` (and optionally `models`) with ITPM tracking columns:
+- `itpm_limit INTEGER DEFAULT 0` (configured limit or dynamically learned from error messages)
+- `tokens_last_minute INTEGER DEFAULT 0` (rolling 60-second window counter for input tokens)
+- `tokens_minute_started REAL DEFAULT 0` (timestamp when the current token window started)
+- `itpm_resets_at REAL DEFAULT 0` (cooldown timestamp when ITPM quota resets)
+
+### B. Configuration Updates (`config/provider-limits.json`)
+Add `itpm` field alongside `rpm` and `rpd` for each provider:
+```json
+{
+  "providers": {
+    "groq": {
+      "rpm": 50,
+      "rpd": 500,
+      "itpm": 7000
+    },
+    "openrouter": {
+      "rpm": 100,
+      "rpd": 1000,
+      "itpm": 50000
+    }
+  }
+}
+```
+
+### C. Enhanced Error Parsing & Limit Extraction (`_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1))
+When an upstream error occurs (status 413 or 429 containing TPM / token limit messages):
+1. Parse error messages matching patterns like:
+   - `Requested (\d+).*Limit (\d+)` or `Limit (\d+).*Requested (\d+)`
+   - `reset after (\d+)(s|m|h)`
+2. Extract the exact token limit (e.g. `7000`) and dynamically update `itpm_limit` in `provider_history` (or model history).
+3. Record quota exhaustion or model cooldown with calculated `retryAfter` duration.
+
+### D. Proactive ITPM Enforcement (`canCall` & `recordCall` in [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1))
+1. **Window Roll**: In `_rollWindows(provider)`, check if 60 seconds have elapsed since `tokens_minute_started`. If so, reset `tokens_last_minute = 0` and update `tokens_minute_started = now`.
+2. **Pre-check (`canCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`)**:
+   - Check if `itpm_resets_at > now`.
+   - Check if `tokens_last_minute + estimatedTokens > itpm_limit`. If exceeded, reject/skip proactively before sending the request.
+3. **Recording (`recordCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`)**:
+   - Increment `tokens_last_minute += estimatedTokens`.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Workflow Diagram
+
+```mermaid
+graph TD
+    A[Incoming Request /v1/chat/completions] --> B[Estimate Input Tokens]
+    B --> C{Check Provider Quota & ITPM}
+    C -->|RPM/RPD/ITPM Exceeded| D[Skip Model / Provider & Try Fallback]
+    C -->|Within Limits| E[Forward Request to Upstream Provider]
+    E --> F{Response Status}
+    F -->|200 OK| G[Record Success & Log Input Tokens]
+    F -->|413 / 429 TPM Exceeded| H[Parse Error Message & Extract Limit / Reset Time]
+    H --> I[Update itpm_limit & recordQuotaExhausted / Cooldown]
+    I --> D
+```
+
+---
+
+## 4. Implementation Plan Steps
+1. Update `config/provider-limits.json` to include default `itpm` limits for providers.
+2. Update [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1) to add `itpm` rolling window tracking, `canCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`, and `recordCall(provider, estimatedTokens)`.
+3. Update `_migrateDB` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) to add `itpm_limit`, `tokens_last_minute`, `tokens_minute_started`, and `itpm_resets_at` columns to `provider_history`.
+4. Enhance `_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) to parse exact limits and reset durations from 413/429 error messages.
+5. Integrate ITPM checks into the request retry loop in [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1).

-# Automated Git Workflow Script Technical Design (`auto-git`)
-
-## Overview & Recommendation
-
-This document outlines the technical design for a robust, automated Git workflow script for the [`omniroute-bandit-proxy`](package.json) project.
-
-### Language Recommendation: **Node.js (`.mjs`) Utility Script**
-While the project contains both Bash scripts (e.g., [`scripts/switch-mode.sh`](scripts/switch-mode.sh)) and Node.js ES module scripts (e.g., [`scripts/train-daemon.mjs`](scripts/train-daemon.mjs)), we strongly recommend implementing [`scripts/auto-git.mjs`](scripts/auto-git.mjs) as a **Node.js ES module (`.mjs`) script** running with Node >= 22.0.0.
-
-**Rationale:**
-1. **Advanced Text Processing & Regex**: Generating conventional commit messages (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`) based on diff parsing and file path analysis is significantly cleaner, safer, and more maintainable in JavaScript using regex and built-in string methods than fragile `sed`/`awk`/`grep` pipelines in Bash.
-2. **Secret Scanning**: Robust regex pattern matching against staged diffs to prevent leaking API keys (`OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, JWT secrets, private keys, AWS keys, etc.) is cleaner and less error-prone in Node.js.
-3. **Structured Reporting**: Formatting comprehensive compliance reports, commit counts, potential duplicate analysis, and squash suggestions is straightforward with JavaScript object structures and JSON/console reporting.
-4. **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Ensures consistent behavior across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments without relying on GNU vs BSD utility flags.
-
----
-
-## Architecture & Logic Steps
-
-The script [`scripts/auto-git.mjs`](scripts/auto-git.mjs) will follow these sequential phases:
-
-```mermaid
-graph TD
-    A[Start auto-git workflow] --> B[1. Repository Clean & Validation]
-    B --> C{Changes detected?}
-    C -- No --> D[No-op: Exit gracefully]
-    C -- Yes --> E[2. Cleanup Untracked Artifacts & Stale Staged Entries]
-    E --> F[3. Stage Changes & Validate against .gitignore]
-    F --> G[4. Secret Scanning on Staged Diff]
-    G -- Secrets Found --> H[Abort: Print security warning]
-    G -- Clean --> I[5. Auto-Generate Conventional Commit Message]
-    I --> J[6. Commit Changes]
-    J --> K[7. Push to Remote & Handle Conflicts]
-    K -- Conflict --> L[Attempt fetch/rebase or prompt]
-    K -- Success --> M[8. Generate Comprehensive Feedback Report]
-    M --> N[Complete]
-```
-
-### Detailed Logic Steps
-
-#### 1. Repository Clean & No-Op Check
-- Check git status (`git status --porcelain`).
-- If no changes (staged, unstaged, or untracked), exit immediately with a clean no-op message.
-
-#### 2. Clean Untracked Artifacts & Stale Staged Entries
-- Remove unnecessary temporary files and untracked build artifacts (e.g., `test_*.txt`, debug logs, dangling core dumps, temporary test outputs) using safe filters.
-- Run `git rm --cached` on any stale staged entries that match [` .gitignore`](.gitignore).
-
-#### 3. Stage Changes & `.gitignore` Validation
-- Automatically stage relevant modifications (`git add -A`).
-- Verify that no files violating [` .gitignore`](.gitignore) (e.g., `.env`, `node_modules/`, log files) were accidentally staged.
-
-#### 4. Secret Scanning (Safety Guarantee)
-- Inspect the staged diff (`git diff --cached`) using regex patterns for common secrets:
-  - API keys (`omniroute_`, `sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}`, `bearer `, `token=`)
-  - Private keys (`-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`)
-  - Connection strings with credentials.
-- Abort execution immediately if any potential secret is detected, detailing the offending file and pattern match.
-
-#### 5. Conventional Commit Message Generation
-- Analyze staged files and diff summaries:
-  - If `__tests__/` or `tests/` modified: `test: ...`
-  - If `README.md` or `*.md` or [`plans/`](plans/) modified: `docs: ...`
-  - If `package.json` or `package-lock.json` modified: `chore(deps): ...`
-  - If `src/bandit.mjs` or core routing modified: `feat(bandit): ...` or `refactor(bandit): ...`
-  - Default fallback: `chore: update repository files`
-- Summarize changes into a clean conventional commit message title and body.
-
-#### 6. Commit Execution
-- Execute `git commit -m "..."`.
-
-#### 7. Push to Remote & Conflict Handling
-- Run `git push origin <current-branch>`.
-- If push fails due to remote divergence (conflict), attempt `git pull --rebase` or gracefully handle/report the conflict state to prevent data loss.
-
-#### 8. Comprehensive Feedback Report
-- Output a detailed summary report including:
-  - **Commit Count**: Number of commits made or pushed.
-  - **Compliance Report**: Conventional commit adherence check.
-  - **Potential Duplicates**: Detection of similar recent commits.
-  - **Squash Suggestions**: Recommendations if multiple minor fixups can be squashed.
-  - **Remote Status**: Push confirmation.
