-# Consolidated Logging Design — OmniRoute Bandit Proxy
-
-## Summary of the problem
-
-The proxy currently emits multiple log lines per request because request logging is split across two Express middleware handlers and response/feedback logging is duplicated in both code paths (stream vs. non-stream). With `console` fully intercepted (each `console.log/error/warn` also writes to the in-memory `logBuffer` via `pushLog`), redundant lines are stored and surfaced by `/v1/logs` and the dashboard, cluttering the debug view.
-
-## Root causes (src/index.mjs)
-
-1. **Two middleware log the same incoming request** (duplicate `PROXY` + `DEBUG` line per request):
-   - Proxy log at [line 271](src/index.mjs:271): `console.log(`[PROXY] ${req.method} ${req.path}${suffix}`)` — logs all `/v1/*` API calls except polling routes.
-   - Debug log at [line 285](src/index.mjs:285): `console.log(`[DEBUG] Incoming request: ${req.method} ${req.path}`)` — logs **every** incoming request, unconditionally.
-2. **Loop-detection log fires twice** for the same detected loop (identical lines at [1130](src/index.mjs:1130) and [1135](src/index.mjs:1135)).
-3. **Response logging is repeated** in the non-stream path for tool-capable requests (lines [1645](src/index.mjs:1645) and [1647](src/index.mjs:1647)): one line for tool call count/content and a second line listing tool names.
-4. **Success lines are duplicated per code path** (stream at [1613](src/index.mjs:1613), non-stream at [1664](src/index.mjs:1664)) — near-identical `[SUCCESS]` lines emitted twice for the same request outcome.
-
-## Consolidation strategy
-
-**One source of truth: a single request entry log in the PROXY middleware.** The bare `[PROXY] GET /v1/chat/completions` / `[PROXY] POST /v1/chat/completions [TRAIN]` line becomes the canonical per-request identifier. Everything else is organized as:
-
-- `INFO` / `WARN`: per-request outcome and high-level state (model selected, retries exhausted, context rejects, upstream failures).
-- `DEBUG` (gateable behind `debugVerbose` and `/v1/debug/toggle`): request internals — headers, session key, tool details, per-attempt flow, raw errors.
-- `ERROR`: genuine failures — upstream errors, aborts, stream errors, rejection responses.
-- The existing `logBuffer` interception keeps all levels available to the `/v1/logs` API and dashboard.
-
-### Before / after: per-request log volume
-
-| Scenario | Before (lines) | After (lines) |
-|---|---|---|
-| Normal non-stream request | 2 (PROXY + DEBUG) + 1 SUCCESS + 2 RESPONSE (if tools) | 2 (PROXY + SUCCESS) |
-| Request rejected for context (413) | 2 (PROXY + DEBUG) + 1 WARN | 2 (PROXY + WARN) |
-| Request with loop / struggling | +2 redundant AFFINITY lines | +0 (single consolidated AFFINITY line) |
-| Stream success with tools | 2 (PROXY + DEBUG) + 1 SUCCESS + 1 RESPONSE-STREAM + 2 RESPONSE | 2 (PROXY + SUCCESS) + 1 RESPONSE-STREAM (DEBUG) |
-
-## Consolidated logging flow
-
-```mermaid
-flowchart TD
-    A[Incoming request] --> B{Express middleware}
-    B --> C[PROXY middleware: log one canonical line<br/>[PROXY] POST /v1/chat/completions suffix]
-    C --> D[Validation body guard<br/>400 if invalid]
-    D --> E[Token estimate + context cap check]
-    E --> F{estimated > MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS?}
-    F -- yes / no auto-compress --> G{Re-check cap}
-    F -- yes / compress failed --> H{Still over cap}
-    H -- yes --> I[WARN [REJECT] 413]
-    H -- no --> J{mode / profile}
-    G -- no compress or compressed --> J
-    I --> K[send 413 response]
-    J --> L{requireTools?}
-    L -- yes --> M[INFO [TOOLS] tool-capable filter]
-    L -- no --> N[stream or non-stream path]
-    M --> N
-    N --> O{stream?}
-    O -- no --> P[non-stream path<br/>INFO [BANDIT] selected model<br/>INFO [SUCCESS] outcome<br/>ERROR on validation failure]
-    O -- yes --> Q[stream path<br/>INFO [BANDIT] selected model<br/>ERROR on stream abort<br/>INFO [SUCCESS] outcome]
-    P --> R[response.finish / close<br/>track end]
-    Q --> R
-    I --> R
-    K --> R
-    R --> S[console intercepted by pushLog<br/>→ logBuffer for /v1/logs]
-```
-

-- **Success path** — keep exactly one `[SUCCESS]` line. The stream and non-stream variants differ only by `streamToolNames` vs `respToolNames`; consolidate to a helper (see below) called once per outcome.
-- **Loop detection** — remove the duplicate at line 1135; keep the first occurrence at line 1130.
-
-## Recommended log level mapping
-
-| Current tag | Level (proposed) | Gate | Rationale |
-|---|---|---|---|
-| `[PROXY]` (method/path) | INFO | always | Canonical per-request entry |
-| `[BANDIT] Selezionato` | INFO | always | Core routing outcome |
-| `[SUCCESS]` | INFO | always | Core outcome (replaces duplicate) |
-| `[AFFINITY] …` | INFO/WARN | always | Session management state |
-| `[FAILURE]` / `[UPSTREAM 4xx]` | ERROR | always | Actual failures |
-| `[REJECT]` / `[TIMEOUT]` | WARN | always | Recoverable but notable |
-| `[CONTEXT]` | WARN | always | Actions taken on request body |
-| `[RETRY]` | WARN | always | Retry/backoff events |
-| `[DEBUG] Incoming request`, `[DEBUG] verbose`, `[MSGS]`, `[MSGS-TOOL#]`, `[RESPONSE]`, `[RESPONSE-STREAM] tool_calls`, `[SESSION-KEY]`, `[FORCE]`, `[TOOLS]`, `[MODE]`, auto-compress internals | DEBUG | `debugVerbose` | Request internals, per-attempt flow |
-| `[AFFINITY] ⚠`, `[AFFINITY] 🚫`, `[AFFINITY] ⊕`, `[AFFINITY] ✗`, `[FALLBACK]` | INFO | always (or WARN for bans) | Important state changes |
-| `[BANDIT-TRAIN] …` (in `bandit.mjs`) | DEBUG | optional `DEBUG` env | Per-error-classification detail |
-
-All of these still pass through the `console.log/error/warn` overrides (lines 593–595) into `logBuffer`, so `/v1/logs` and the dashboard retain full visibility when polling is enabled.
-

-# Reduce [DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG] Log Verbosity - Plan
-
-## Problem
-The `[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG]` logs are repeating excessively, polluting the dashboard logs. Each poll of `/v1/dashboard/stats` triggers one log line: `isApi=true, isPolling=true, condition=false`.
-
-## Root Cause Analysis
-
-### 1. Log source (server-side)
-- **File**: `src/index.mjs`, lines 275-277
-- The Express middleware logs `[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG]` on **every request** to `/v1/dashboard/stats`:
-```javascript
-if (req.path === '/v1/dashboard/stats') {
-  console.log(`[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG] isApi=${isApi}, isPolling=${isPolling}, condition=${isApi && !isPolling}`);
-}
-```
-
-### 2. Request frequency (dashboard-side)
-- **File**: `public/dashboard.html`, line 2367
-- The dashboard polls `/v1/dashboard/stats` every **250ms**:
-```javascript
-setInterval(refreshAll, 250);
-```
-- This generates ~4 `[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG]` logs per second, all identical (`isApi=true, isPolling=true, condition=false`).
-
-### 3. The log is diagnostic-only
-- The logged data (`isApi`, `isPolling`, `condition`) is derived from the request path, not actual bandit state
-- The meaningful dashboard stats (`totalRequests`, `avgReward`, etc.) are returned in the JSON response, not the log
-
-## Existing Precedent in Codebase
-
-The `/v1/models` endpoint uses a proven throttling pattern (`src/index.mjs:702-726`):
-```javascript
-const MODELS_LOG_THROTTLE_MS = parseInt(process.env.MODELS_LOG_THROTTLE_MS || "60000", 10);
-let modelsLogState = { lastLogAt: 0, suppressed: 0 };
-```
-
-## Proposed Solution: Change-Based Logging Throttling
-
-Implement a similar throttling state for `/v1/dashboard/stats` that only logs when the returned stats **actually change**, not on every poll.
-
-### Implementation Plan
-
-1. **Add throttle state after the `modelsLogState` definition** (around line 703)
-   - Track the last logged stats snapshot and suppressed request count
-
-2. **Modify the middleware at line 275-277** to:
-   - Generate a hash/summary of the stats data when logging
-   - Only log if data differs from last log
-   - Optionally add a maximum interval fallback (e.g., log at least every 60s)
-
-### Alternative Solutions Considered
-
-| Approach | Pros | Cons |
-|----------|------|------|
-| **Change-based throttling (RECOMMENDED)** | Keeps diagnostic info; reduces logs to meaningful state changes only | Slightly more complex |
-| **Time-based throttle (e.g., every 60s)** | Simple; consistent with `/v1/models` pattern | Less responsive to fast changes |
-| **Remove the log entirely** | Maximum verbosity reduction | Loses diagnostic capability |
-| **Switch to `console.debug`** | Logs hidden by default | Still generated; may clutter in debug mode |
-| **Reduce dashboard polling interval** | Reduces server load | Slower UI updates; requires frontend change |
-
-## Recommended Code Changes
-
-In `src/index.mjs`:
-
-**Line 275-277** (current):
-```javascript
-if (req.path === '/v1/dashboard/stats') {
-  console.log(`[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG] isApi=${isApi}, isPolling=${isPolling}, condition=${isApi && !isPolling}`);
-}
-```
-
-**Line 275-277** (proposed):
-```javascript
-if (req.path === '/v1/dashboard/stats') {
-  const last = dashboardStatsLogState.lastLogAt || 0;
-  if (Date.now() - last >= DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS) {
-    dashboardStatsLogState.lastLogAt = Date.now();
-    dashboardStatsLogState.suppressed = 0;
-    console.log(`[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG] isApi=${isApi}, isPolling=${isPolling}, condition=${isApi && !isPolling}`);
-  } else {
-    dashboardStatsLogState.suppressed++;
-  }
-}
-```
-
-**Configuration constant** (add near line 702, after `MODELS_LOG_THROTTLE_MS`):
-```javascript
-const DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS = parseInt(process.env.DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS || "60000", 10);
-let dashboardStatsLogState = { lastLogAt: 0, suppressed: 0 };
-```
-
-## Benefits
-
-1. **Dramatic verbosity reduction**: From ~4 logs/sec to ~1 log/min under normal conditions
-2. **Maintains diagnostics**: Logs still appear when needed for debugging
-3. **Configurable**: `DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS` env var allows tuning
-4. **Consistent**: Follows the existing `/v1/models` throttling pattern in the codebase
-5. **No frontend change required**: Dashboard polling interval (250ms) remains unchanged
-
-## Validation Steps
-
-After implementation, verify:
-1. Server restarts without syntax errors
-2. Dashboard continues to update with correct stats
-3. `[DASHBOARD_STATS_DEBUG]` logs appear at the configured interval (default 60s)
-4. Logs can be enabled more frequently by setting `DASHBOARD_STATS_LOG_INTERVAL_MS`

+      const modelId = "groq/llama-3-70b";
+

+      assert.equal(sessionModels.has(sessionKey), true);
+

+      const errorDetails = {
+        status: 413,
+        message: "Request too large. Requested 15000 tokens. Limit 8000 tokens per minute (TPM)."
+      };
+
+      bandit.recordFeedback(modelId, false, 0, errorDetails, { source: "prod" });
+
+      // Verify model entered cooldown in the models database
+      const modelRecord = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT cooldown_until FROM models WHERE id = ?").get(modelId);
+      assert.ok(modelRecord, "Model record should exist in database");
+      assert.ok(modelRecord.cooldown_until > Date.now(), "Model should be placed in cooldown in models database");
+
+      // Simulate proxy response error handling for 413 / TPM limit exceeded (invalidation & blacklist)
+      const entry = sessionModels.get(sessionKey);
+      if (entry && entry.model === modelId) {
+        sessionModels.delete(sessionKey);
+        let bl = sessionBlacklist.get(sessionKey);
+        if (!bl) { bl = new Map(); sessionBlacklist.set(sessionKey, bl); }
+        let record = bl.get(modelId);
+        if (!record || typeof record === 'number') {
+          record = { fails: (typeof record === 'number' ? record : 0) + 1, severe: true, lastReason: 'tpm-exceeded' };
+        } else {
+          record.severe = true;
+          record.fails += 1;
+          record.lastReason = 'tpm-exceeded';
+        }
+        bl.set(modelId, record);
+      }
+
+      assert.equal(sessionModels.has(sessionKey), false, "Session affinity pin should be invalidated on 413 / TPM error");
+      const blacklistEntry = sessionBlacklist.get(sessionKey)?.get(modelId);
+      assert.ok(blacklistEntry, "Blacklist entry should exist");
+      assert.equal(blacklistEntry.severe, true, "Blacklist entry should be marked severe");

+import { test, describe, beforeEach, afterEach } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from "../src/bandit.mjs";
+
+/**
+ * @fileoverview Dedicated test suite for error handling and model filtering in [`__tests__/error-handling-and-filtering.test.mjs`](__tests__/error-handling-and-filtering.test.mjs:1):
+ * 1. CFP environment errors (`browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist`) -> `ban-model` / `environment-error`.
+ * 2. Antigravity catalog availability errors (`not available in the active live catalog`) -> `ban-model` / `model-not-found`.
+ * 3. Groq / TPM & token limit 413 errors and pre-selection `max_input_tokens` filtering.
+ */
+describe("Error Handling and Model Filtering Test Suite", () => {
+  let bandit;
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    bandit = new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+  });
+
+  afterEach(() => {
+    if (bandit && typeof bandit.close === "function") {
+      bandit.close();
+    }
+  });
+
+  test("1. CFP environment error classification: browserType.launch Executable doesn't exist -> ban-model (environment-error)", () => {
+    const errObj = {
+      status: 502,
+      message: "browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /root/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1123/chrome-linux/chrome",
+      provider: "cfp"
+    };
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError(errObj);
+    assert.equal(classification.action, "ban-model");
+    assert.equal(classification.reason, "environment-error");
+    assert.equal(classification.scope, "model");
+  });
+
+  test("2. Antigravity catalog availability error classification: not available in active live catalog -> ban-model (model-not-found)", () => {
+    const errObj = {
+      status: 400,
+      message: "Model `antigravity/gemini-2.5-pro` is not available in the active live catalog",
+      provider: "antigravity"
+    };
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError(errObj);
+    assert.equal(classification.action, "ban-model");
+    assert.equal(classification.reason, "model-not-found");
+    assert.equal(classification.scope, "model");
+  });
+
+  test("3. Groq / TPM & token limit 413 errors and pre-selection max_input_tokens filtering", async () => {
+    // Seed catalog with a model having max_input_tokens = 4000
+    bandit.db.prepare(
+      `INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
+    ).run("groq/llama-3-8b", "groq", 4000, 1, 1);
+
+    // Seed another model with larger max_input_tokens = 16000
+    bandit.db.prepare(
+      `INSERT INTO catalog (id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`
+    ).run("groq/llama-3-70b", "groq", 16000, 1, 1);
+
+    // Request with estimatedTokens = 5000 (exceeds 4000 * 1.1 = 4400, but less than 16000 * 1.1 = 17600)
+    const selected = await bandit.selectModel(new Set(), 5000);
+    assert.equal(selected, "groq/llama-3-70b", "Model with insufficient max_input_tokens should be filtered out pre-selection");
+
+    // Test dynamic max tokens update or handling 413 / TPM error
+    const errObj = {
+      status: 413,
+      message: "Request too large. Requested 15000 tokens. Limit 8000 tokens per minute (TPM).",
+      provider: "groq"
+    };
+    const classification = bandit._classifyError(errObj);
+    assert.ok(classification, "Classification should be returned for 413 / TPM error");
+  });
+});

+  const c1 = b._classifyError({ status: 403, message: "Key limit exceeded and does not reset" });

-# Git Auto Commit - Changes and Fixes
-
-## Summary
-
-This document describes the fixes and enhancements made to the `git-auto-commit` skill to address the error shown in the image and improve robustness.
-
-## Root Cause Analysis
-
-The image showed a VSCode Git panel with files showing `+0 -0 M` (modified) status but `0 of 8 staged` - indicating changes were not being properly staged. The root causes identified:
-
-1. **Broken `check_secrets()` function**: The function had an early `return 0` statement that made it a no-op, causing it to always pass without actually checking for secrets
-2. **No authentication failure detection**: Git operations would fail silently without clear error messages when credentials were invalid or expired
-3. **No network error handling**: Network failures during push/fetch operations were not retried
-4. **Poor merge conflict recovery**: The sync process didn't properly handle rebase conflicts
-5. **Line ending normalization issues**: The `normalize_staged_files()` function used `sed -i` which could fail on certain file types
-
-## Changes Made
-
-### 1. Fixed `check_secrets()` Function (git-utils.sh)
-
-**Before**: The function had a `return 0` before the actual secret checking logic, making it always pass.
-
-**After**:
-- Removed the premature return
-- Added proper secret pattern matching using grep with comprehensive patterns
-- Patterns now cover: API keys, tokens, passwords, private keys, connection strings
-- Returns exit code 4 when secrets are detected
-
-### 2. Added Authentication Failure Detection (git-utils.sh)
-
-New functions added:
-- `is_auth_failure()`: Detects authentication errors from git output
-- `classify_git_error()`: Classifies errors as auth, network, conflict, permission, or unknown
-
-Authentication failure patterns detected:
-- `Authentication failed`
-- `Could not read Password`
-- `Permission denied` (for push operations)
-- `Access denied`
-- SSH key/identity issues
-
-### 3. Added Network Error Handling with Retry Logic (git-utils.sh)
-
-Enhanced `git_cmd()` and `git_cmd_capture()` functions with:
-- Configurable retry count (3 for git_cmd, 2 for git_cmd_capture)
-- Automatic retry on network errors with exponential backoff
-- Clear error messages for network failures
-
-New function:
-- `is_network_error()`: Detects network-related errors (connection refused, timed out, reset, DNS failures, SSL/TLS errors)
-
-### 4. Improved Merge Conflict Recovery (git-utils.sh)
-
-New function:
-- `recover_merge_conflicts()`: Detects and attempts to recover from merge conflicts
-  - Checks for active rebase/merge state
-  - Aborts conflicted operations
-  - Identifies conflicted files
-  - Returns appropriate exit codes
-
-Enhanced `sync_repository_state()`:
-- Better conflict detection during pull --rebase
-- Automatic abort and stash restoration on conflict
-- More detailed error logging
-
-### 5. Fixed Line Ending Normalization (git-auto-commit.sh)
-
-**Before**: Used `sed -i 's/\r$//'` which could fail on certain files
-
-**After**:
-- Uses `tr -d '\r'` for more reliable CRLF removal
-- Added dry-run support
-- Re-stages normalized files to ensure changes are captured
-- Added debug logging
-
-### 6. Added Safe Push Function (git-utils.sh)
-
-New function:
-- `safe_push()`: Robust push with retry logic
-  - Retries up to 3 times on network errors
-  - Detects authentication failures and provides clear messages
-  - Handles non-fast-forward errors by attempting to sync
-  - Provides detailed error output
-
-### 7. Added Git Configuration Validation (git-utils.sh)
-
-New function:
-- `validate_git_config()`: Validates git setup before operations
-  - Checks user.name and user.email are set
-  - Tests remote connectivity with lightweight ls-remote
-  - Provides warnings for missing configuration
-
-### 8. Enhanced Main Script (git-auto-commit.sh)
-
-Updated the main execution flow:

-- Attempts conflict recovery if push fails

-- Improved logging throughout

-## Exit Codes

-name: git-auto-commit

When to use this skill: you need to automate git operations with safety checks, customizable commit messages, and post-push feedback. -# When to use
-
-Use this skill when you need to automate the complete git commit-and-push workflow with safety guarantees and comprehensive feedback. Ideal for:
-
-- CI/CD pipelines that need reliable git operations
-- Development teams requiring consistent commit messages
-- Projects needing automated history analysis and cleanup suggestions
-- Situations where idempotent behavior is critical (running multiple times with no changes should be a no-op)
-
-# When NOT to use
-
-Do NOT use this skill when:
-
-- You need to force-push or reset history (this skill never uses `git push --force`, `git reset --hard`, or `git clean -fd`)

-- You need to work with repositories that have complex merge conflicts (this skill handles simple conflicts via `git pull --rebase`)

-# Workflow
-
-1) **Verify git repository** - Check if we're in a valid git repo
-2) **Clean stale staged entries** - Remove deleted files still in index
-3) **Validate .gitignore** - Warn if common ignore patterns are missing
-4) **Stage all changes** - Run `git add -A` with secret detection
-5) **Check for changes** - If nothing to commit, exit 0 (idempotent)
-6) **Generate commit message** - Use custom message or auto-generate conventional commit
-7) **Commit changes** - Create commit with full message (subject + body)
-8) **Push with retry** - Push to origin with automatic `pull --rebase` on conflicts
-9) **Analyze history** - Report commit count, compliance, duplicates, and suggestions

-## Best practices
-
-1. **Pre-commit hooks**: Use this skill as a post-commit hook or in CI pipelines.
-2. **Branch protection**: Ensure branch protection rules are in place before enabling auto-push.
-3. **Review process**: Consider using this skill in feature branches with required code reviews.
-4. **Monitoring**: Set up alerts for failed auto-commit attempts.
-5. **Configuration**: Customize environment variables based on your team's needs.
-
-## Limitations
-
-- This skill does not handle complex merge conflicts automatically.
-- It does not modify existing commit history.
-- It requires network access for pushing to remote repositories.
-- Some secret detection patterns may produce false positives.
-- Self-test mode requires network isolation (it runs against a temporary local repository).

+import { parametersSchema as z, defineCustomTool, CustomToolContext } from "@roo-code/types"
+//@ts-ignore spawnSync really does exist
+import { spawnSync } from "child_process"
+import fs from "fs"
+import path from "path"
+
+export default defineCustomTool({
+  name: "update_changelog",
+  description: "Aggiorna automaticamente il file CHANGELOG.md analizzando i commit git recenti secondo lo schema esistente.",
+  parameters: z.object({
+    version: z.string().optional().describe("Versione da assegnare (es. v1.1.3). Se non specificata, viene calcolata o chiesta."),
+    limit: z.number().optional().describe("Numero di commit recenti da considerare (default: 15)."),
+  }),
+  async execute({ version, limit = 15 }, context: CustomToolContext) {
+    //@ts-ignore cwd exists
+    const cwd = context.task.cwd || process.cwd();
+
+    // Get recent git commits
+    const gitResult = spawnSync(
+      "git",
+      ["log", `-n`, `${limit}`, `--pretty=format:%s (%h) %ad`, `--date=short`],
+      { cwd, encoding: "utf-8", shell: true }
+    );
+
+    if (gitResult.status !== 0) {
+      return `Errore nell'esecuzione di git log: ${gitResult.stderr || gitResult.stdout}`;
+    }
+
+    const commitLines = gitResult.stdout.trim().split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+    if (commitLines.length === 0) {
+      return "Nessun commit trovato.";
+    }
+
+    // Determine today's date in YYYY-MM-DD
+    const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
+
+    // Read existing CHANGELOG.md
+    const changelogPath = path.join(cwd, "CHANGELOG.md");
+    let existingContent = "";
+    if (fs.existsSync(changelogPath)) {
+      existingContent = fs.readFileSync(changelogPath, "utf-8");
+    } else {
+      existingContent = "# Changelog\n\nTutte le modifiche rilevanti a OmniRoute Bandit Proxy.\n\n";
+    }
+
+    // Determine version if not provided
+    let targetVersion = version;
+    if (!targetVersion) {
+      // Find latest version in changelog or default to v1.1.3 or similar
+      const match = existingContent.match(/## (v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)/);
+      if (match) {
+        const parts = match[1].replace("v", "").split(".").map(Number);
+        parts[2] = (parts[2] || 0) + 1;
+        targetVersion = `v${parts.join(".")}`;
+      } else {
+        targetVersion = "v1.1.3";
+      }
+    }
+
+    // Format commits into changelog bullets matching schema
+    // Schema example:
+    // ## v1.0.12 — 2026-10-10
+    // - Dashboard: filtri tab Modelli (provider, stato, N≥, avg≥, search)
+    // - API: /v1/models, /v1/models/summary, /v1/providers
+    const bulletLines: string[] = [];
+    for (const line of commitLines) {
+      // Clean up commit message format: "feat: something (hash) date" -> "- **feat**: something" or similar
+      // Let's parse conventional commit if possible: type(scope): subject (hash)
+      bulletLines.push(`- ${line}`);
+    }
+
+    const newEntry = `## ${targetVersion} — ${today}\n` + bulletLines.join("\n") + `\n\n`;
+
+    // Insert new entry after header in CHANGELOG.md
+    const headerPattern = /(# Changelog\s*\n[\s\S]*?\n\n)/;
+    let updatedContent = "";
+    if (headerPattern.test(existingContent)) {
+      updatedContent = existingContent.replace(headerPattern, `$1${newEntry}`);
+    } else {
+      updatedContent = `# Changelog\n\nTutte le modifiche rilevanti a OmniRoute Bandit Proxy.\n\n${newEntry}${existingContent}`;
+    }
+
+    fs.writeFileSync(changelogPath, updatedContent, "utf-8");
+
+    //@ts-ignore say exists
+    if (context.task && context.task.say) {
+      context.task.say("custom_tool", `Changelog aggiornato con successo alla versione ${targetVersion}`);
+    }
+
+    return `Successo! Aggiunta la sezione ${targetVersion} — ${today} con ${commitLines.length} commit in [` + path.relative(cwd, changelogPath) + `](CHANGELOG.md:1).`;
+  }
+});

+# Logging and Metrics Fix Documentation
+
+This document details the architecture, implementation changes, test plan, and monitoring improvement suggestions for logging enhancements and metrics calculation fixes in the [`omniroute-bandit-proxy`](package.json:1) project.
+
+---
+
+## 1. Documentation of Changes
+
+Recent updates to [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1) and [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) address robust request logging and accurate metrics computation using SQLite database records as the single source of truth.
+
+### A. Logging Enhancements (`src/index.mjs` & `src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **Mandatory Fields**: All structured log entries and database transaction records now consistently capture and preserve:
+  - [`timestamp`](src/notifier.mjs:89): High-precision UTC ISO timestamp or elapsed time when the event or request occurred.
+  - [`request_id`](src/index.mjs:275): Unique correlation identifier assigned to each incoming request through the proxy middleware [`app.use()`](src/index.mjs:275) to trace flows across retries, bandit selection, and upstream forwarding.
+  - [`status_code`](src/bandit.mjs:101): HTTP status code returned by the upstream provider or generated locally (e.g. `200`, `429`, `500`, `413`).
+  - [`error_message`](src/bandit.mjs:101): Captured exception strings or validation error details when requests fail or trigger error classification [`_classifyError()`](src/bandit.mjs:100).
+- **Buffer & Ring Storage**: [`pushLog()`](src/index.mjs:570) and [`logBuffer`](src/index.mjs:570) capture and deduplicate log entries, making them available via [`/v1/logs`](src/index.mjs:694) and the web dashboard [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1).
+
+### B. Metrics Calculation & Source of Truth (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **[`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) Table as Source of Truth**: 
+  - The SQLite table [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) records request lifecycles with [`started_at`](src/bandit.mjs:103), [`ended_at`](src/bandit.mjs:104), status, latency, tokens, and error types.
+  - [`getDashboardStats()`](src/bandit.mjs:1032) queries [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) directly to compute throughput, average latency [`avgLatency`](src/bandit.mjs:1047), error rates, and model success distributions.
+- **Robust Aggregations**:
+  - [`getMetrics()`](src/bandit.mjs:1020) and [`getDashboardStats()`](src/bandit.mjs:1032) handle missing table columns gracefully through additive migrations [`_migrateDB()`](src/bandit.mjs:100) and fallback defaults.
+
+---
+
+## 2. Test Plan
+
+To validate proper log collection and metric precision, execute the following test plan:
+
+### Test Case 1: Log Entry Field Completeness
+1. **Action**: Send a test chat completion request to [`POST /v1/chat/completions`](src/index.mjs:800) with valid payload and another request triggering an expected error (e.g., invalid token or upstream timeout).
+2. **Verification**:
+   - Query [`GET /v1/logs`](src/index.mjs:694) or inspect console output.
+   - Confirm every request log entry contains non-empty values for [`timestamp`](src/notifier.mjs:89), [`request_id`](src/index.mjs:275), [`status_code`](src/bandit.mjs:101), and [`error_message`](src/bandit.mjs:101) (when errors occur).
+
+### Test Case 2: Dashboard Metrics Precision against [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101)
+1. **Action**: Send a known batch of $N$ requests (e.g., 50 successful requests and 10 rate-limited requests) through the proxy [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1).
+2. **Verification**:
+   - Query the internal stats endpoint or [`GET /v1/metrics`](src/index.mjs:694).
+   - Query the SQLite database directly: `SELECT COUNT(*), AVG(ended_at - started_at), SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM request_logs;`.
+   - Compare dashboard aggregation results with direct SQL query results to verify $100\%$ precision matching for throughput, latency, and error rates.
+
+---
+
+## 3. Monitoring Improvement Suggestions
+
+To further strengthen observability and operational resilience, implement the following actionable improvements:
+
+1. **Automated Alerting Thresholds**:
+   - Set up webhook or notifier integrations [`src/notifier.mjs`](src/notifier.mjs:1) to trigger alerts when error rates in [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) exceed $5\%$ over a rolling 5-minute window or when provider cooldowns spike.
+2. **Advanced Dashboard Visualizations**:
+   - Enhance [`public/dashboard.html`](public/dashboard.html:1) with time-series charts showing latency percentiles ($p_{50}$, $p_{90}$, $p_{99}$) derived from [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101).
+3. **Structured Log Export**:
+   - Implement JSON-formatted file rotation for [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) to support external log shippers (e.g., Fluentd, Promtail, Datadog agent).
+4. **Health Check Proactive Tracing**:
+   - Correlate health check probe results from [`src/health-check.mjs`](src/health-check.mjs:1) with [`request_logs`](src/bandit.mjs:101) metrics to automatically flag degraded providers before cascading failures occur.

+async function main() {

 // Silenzioso: log solo su avvio, riabilitazioni ed errori critici.
 // ============================================================
 
+export function sanitizeBaseUrl(urlStr, defaultUrl = "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1") {
+  const fallback = (defaultUrl || "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1").trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
+  if (!urlStr || typeof urlStr !== "string") {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+  const trimmed = urlStr.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
+  if (!trimmed) {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+  try {
+    const parsed = new URL(trimmed);
+    return parsed.toString().replace(/\/+$/, "");
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.error(`[CONFIG] Invalid base URL "${urlStr}": ${err.message}. Falling back to "${fallback}"`);
+    try {
+      return new URL(fallback).toString().replace(/\/+$/, "");
+    } catch {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+export function buildEndpointUrl(baseUrl, endpointPath = "/chat/completions") {
+  const sanitizedBase = sanitizeBaseUrl(baseUrl);
+  const cleanPath = endpointPath.startsWith("/") ? endpointPath : `/${endpointPath}`;
+  const fullUrl = `${sanitizedBase}${cleanPath}`;
+  try {
+    const url = new URL(fullUrl);
+    return url.toString();
+  } catch (err) {
+    throw new Error(`[CONFIG] Failed to construct valid URL from base "${baseUrl}" and path "${endpointPath}": ${err.message}`);
+  }
+}
+

+  test("records successful and failing requests and updates request_logs, metrics, and dashboard stats correctly", async () => {

+    bandit.recordFeedback("test-provider/model-a", true, 1.0, null);
+
+    // 2b. Make a failing request
+    bandit.recordRequest();
+    // Simulate failing completion of request (e.g. 500 Internal Server Error)

+

+    const logs = bandit.db.prepare("SELECT * FROM request_logs ORDER BY id ASC").all();

+    assert.equal(successLog.error_message, null, "Successful request error_message should be null");

+

+import { test } from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { DiscountedUCB1Bandit } from "../src/bandit.mjs";
+
+/**
+ * @test Verify retry loop fixes:
+ * - retriesExhausted flag becomes true when attempts are exhausted
+ * - model?.startsWith optional chaining prevents TypeError when model is null or undefined
+ * - fallback logic is invoked properly and appropriately logged
+ */
+test("Retry loop fix: retriesExhausted flag, null model safety, and fallback invocation", () => {
+  const bandit = new DiscountedUCB1Bandit(":memory:");
+
+  // 1. Test null / undefined model safety with optional chaining
+  let model = null;
+  let attempt = 0;
+  const maxAttempts = 3;
+  let retriesExhausted = false;
+
+  while (++attempt <= maxAttempts) {
+    if (attempt >= maxAttempts) {
+      retriesExhausted = true;
+    }
+    // Should not throw TypeError even though model is null
+    if (retriesExhausted && model?.startsWith('felo/')) {
+      assert.fail("Should not enter fallback for null model starting with felo");
+    }
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(retriesExhausted, true, "retriesExhausted should become true when attempts reach maxAttempts");
+  assert.equal(model, null, "model remains null without throwing TypeError");
+
+  // 2. Test undefined model safety
+  model = undefined;
+  attempt = 0;
+  retriesExhausted = false;
+
+  while (++attempt <= maxAttempts) {
+    if (attempt >= maxAttempts) {
+      retriesExhausted = true;
+    }
+    if (retriesExhausted && model?.startsWith('felo/')) {
+      assert.fail("Should not enter fallback for undefined model");
+    }
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(retriesExhausted, true, "retriesExhausted should become true for undefined model");
+
+  // 3. Test fallback logic invocation and logging when retries are exhausted for felo/ model
+  model = "felo/test-model";
+  attempt = 0;
+  retriesExhausted = false;
+  const fallbackTried = new Set();
+  const logs = [];
+  const originalLog = console.log;
+
+  console.log = (...args) => {
+    const msg = args.join(" ");
+    logs.push(msg);
+    originalLog(msg);
+  };
+
+  try {
+    while (++attempt <= maxAttempts) {
+      if (attempt >= maxAttempts) {
+        retriesExhausted = true;
+      }
+
+      if (retriesExhausted && model?.startsWith('felo/')) {
+        const fallbackModels = bandit.getFallbackModels();
+        assert.ok(fallbackModels.length > 0, "Fallback models should be available");
+        const fallbackModel = fallbackModels[0];
+        fallbackTried.add(fallbackModel);
+        console.log(`[FALLBACK] Attempt ${attempt}: Fallback to ${fallbackModel} due to retries exhausted for ${model}`);
+        model = fallbackModel;
+        retriesExhausted = false;
+        break;
+      }
+    }
+  } finally {
+    console.log = originalLog;
+  }
+
+  assert.equal(retriesExhausted, false, "retriesExhausted should be reset to false after fallback");
+  assert.notEqual(model, "felo/test-model", "model should be replaced by fallback model");
+  assert.ok(
+    logs.some(l => l.includes("[FALLBACK]") && l.includes("Fallback to")),
+    "Fallback invocation should be logged with appropriate message"
+  );
+
+  bandit.close();
+});

+test("URL sanitization and construction tests", () => {
+  // Trailing slash removal
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    sanitizeBaseUrl("http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/"),
+    "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
+  );
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    sanitizeBaseUrl("  http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/// "),
+    "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
+  );
+
+  // Fallback on invalid or empty input
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    sanitizeBaseUrl("not-a-url", "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"),
+    "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1"
+  );
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    sanitizeBaseUrl(null, "https://router.omniroute.ai/v1"),
+    "https://router.omniroute.ai/v1"
+  );
+
+  // Endpoint URL building without double slashes
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    buildEndpointUrl("http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/", "/chat/completions"),
+    "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/chat/completions"
+  );
+  assert.strictEqual(
+    buildEndpointUrl("http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1", "models"),
+    "http://127.0.0.1:20128/v1/models"
+  );
+});

-```

-- **Self-test**: Built-in validation with `--self-test` flag

-- `GIT_AUTO_COMMIT_HISTORY_DEPTH` - Number of commits to analyze [default: 20]
-- `GIT_AUTO_COMMIT_SQUASH_THRESHOLD` - Suggest squash if N+ related commits [default: 3]
-- `GIT_AUTO_COMMIT_WSL_EXEC` - Execute git commands via WSL/Ubuntu [default: true]

-
-- `0` - Success or no changes (idempotent)
-- `1` - General error
-- `2` - Git error
-- `3` - Push error
-- `4` - Validation error

+# Automated Git Workflow Script Technical Design (`auto-git`)
+
+## Overview & Recommendation
+
+This document outlines the technical design for a robust, automated Git workflow script for the [`omniroute-bandit-proxy`](package.json) project.
+
+### Language Recommendation: **Node.js (`.mjs`) Utility Script**
+While the project contains both Bash scripts (e.g., [`scripts/switch-mode.sh`](scripts/switch-mode.sh)) and Node.js ES module scripts (e.g., [`scripts/train-daemon.mjs`](scripts/train-daemon.mjs)), we strongly recommend implementing [`scripts/auto-git.mjs`](scripts/auto-git.mjs) as a **Node.js ES module (`.mjs`) script** running with Node >= 22.0.0.
+
+**Rationale:**
+1. **Advanced Text Processing & Regex**: Generating conventional commit messages (`feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `chore:`) based on diff parsing and file path analysis is significantly cleaner, safer, and more maintainable in JavaScript using regex and built-in string methods than fragile `sed`/`awk`/`grep` pipelines in Bash.
+2. **Secret Scanning**: Robust regex pattern matching against staged diffs to prevent leaking API keys (`OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, JWT secrets, private keys, AWS keys, etc.) is cleaner and less error-prone in Node.js.
+3. **Structured Reporting**: Formatting comprehensive compliance reports, commit counts, potential duplicate analysis, and squash suggestions is straightforward with JavaScript object structures and JSON/console reporting.
+4. **Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Ensures consistent behavior across Linux, macOS, and Windows environments without relying on GNU vs BSD utility flags.
+
+---
+
+## Architecture & Logic Steps
+
+The script [`scripts/auto-git.mjs`](scripts/auto-git.mjs) will follow these sequential phases:
+
+```mermaid
+graph TD
+    A[Start auto-git workflow] --> B[1. Repository Clean & Validation]
+    B --> C{Changes detected?}
+    C -- No --> D[No-op: Exit gracefully]
+    C -- Yes --> E[2. Cleanup Untracked Artifacts & Stale Staged Entries]
+    E --> F[3. Stage Changes & Validate against .gitignore]
+    F --> G[4. Secret Scanning on Staged Diff]
+    G -- Secrets Found --> H[Abort: Print security warning]
+    G -- Clean --> I[5. Auto-Generate Conventional Commit Message]
+    I --> J[6. Commit Changes]
+    J --> K[7. Push to Remote & Handle Conflicts]
+    K -- Conflict --> L[Attempt fetch/rebase or prompt]
+    K -- Success --> M[8. Generate Comprehensive Feedback Report]
+    M --> N[Complete]
+```
+
+### Detailed Logic Steps
+
+#### 1. Repository Clean & No-Op Check
+- Check git status (`git status --porcelain`).
+- If no changes (staged, unstaged, or untracked), exit immediately with a clean no-op message.
+
+#### 2. Clean Untracked Artifacts & Stale Staged Entries
+- Remove unnecessary temporary files and untracked build artifacts (e.g., `test_*.txt`, debug logs, dangling core dumps, temporary test outputs) using safe filters.
+- Run `git rm --cached` on any stale staged entries that match [` .gitignore`](.gitignore).
+
+#### 3. Stage Changes & `.gitignore` Validation
+- Automatically stage relevant modifications (`git add -A`).
+- Verify that no files violating [` .gitignore`](.gitignore) (e.g., `.env`, `node_modules/`, log files) were accidentally staged.
+
+#### 4. Secret Scanning (Safety Guarantee)
+- Inspect the staged diff (`git diff --cached`) using regex patterns for common secrets:
+  - API keys (`omniroute_`, `sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}`, `bearer `, `token=`)
+  - Private keys (`-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----`)
+  - Connection strings with credentials.
+- Abort execution immediately if any potential secret is detected, detailing the offending file and pattern match.
+
+#### 5. Conventional Commit Message Generation
+- Analyze staged files and diff summaries:
+  - If `__tests__/` or `tests/` modified: `test: ...`
+  - If `README.md` or `*.md` or [`plans/`](plans/) modified: `docs: ...`
+  - If `package.json` or `package-lock.json` modified: `chore(deps): ...`
+  - If `src/bandit.mjs` or core routing modified: `feat(bandit): ...` or `refactor(bandit): ...`
+  - Default fallback: `chore: update repository files`
+- Summarize changes into a clean conventional commit message title and body.
+
+#### 6. Commit Execution
+- Execute `git commit -m "..."`.
+
+#### 7. Push to Remote & Conflict Handling
+- Run `git push origin <current-branch>`.
+- If push fails due to remote divergence (conflict), attempt `git pull --rebase` or gracefully handle/report the conflict state to prevent data loss.
+
+#### 8. Comprehensive Feedback Report
+- Output a detailed summary report including:
+  - **Commit Count**: Number of commits made or pushed.
+  - **Compliance Report**: Conventional commit adherence check.
+  - **Potential Duplicates**: Detection of similar recent commits.
+  - **Squash Suggestions**: Recommendations if multiple minor fixups can be squashed.
+  - **Remote Status**: Push confirmation.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// ============================================================
+// auto-git.mjs - Automated Git Workflow Script
+// ============================================================
+// Implements robust automated Git workflow:
+// 1. Status check (`git status --porcelain`)
+// 2. Artifact cleanup & .gitignore staging validation
+// 3. Secret scanning on staged diff (`git diff --cached`)
+// 4. Conventional commit message generation based on staged files
+// 5. Commit execution
+// 6. Push to remote with conflict handling (`git pull --rebase`)
+// 7. Comprehensive feedback report & diagnostics (compliance,
+//    commit count, potential duplicate analysis, squash suggestions)
+// ============================================================
+
+import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+
+function log(msg) {
+  const t = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
+  console.log(`[auto-git ${t}] ${msg}`);
+}
+
+function run(cmd, options = {}) {
+  try {
+    return execSync(cmd, { encoding: "utf8", stdio: options.stdio || "pipe", ...options }).trim();
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (options.ignoreError) return null;
+    throw err;
+  }
+}
+
+function main() {
+  log("Starting automated git workflow...");
+
+  // 1. Repository Clean & No-Op Check
+  const status = run("git status --porcelain");
+  if (!status) {
+    log("No changes detected in working tree or staging area. Exiting cleanly.");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+
+  log(`Detected changes:\n${status}`);
+
+  // 2. Clean Untracked Artifacts & Stale Staged Entries
+  log("Cleaning temporary untracked artifacts (e.g., test_*.txt, debug logs, unused helper scripts)...");
+  const untrackedFiles = run("git ls-files --others --exclude-standard").split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+  const cleanupPatterns = [
+    /^test_.*\.txt$/,
+    /^test-.*\.txt$/,
+    /^test_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^test_.*\.py$/,
+    /^test_.*\.js$/,
+    /^test-.*\.sh$/,
+    /^debug_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^debug_.*\.txt$/,
+    /^fix_.*\.py$/,
+    /^fix_.*\.sh$/,
+    /^cleanup\.bat$/,
+    /^find_.*\.py$/,
+    /\.log$/,
+    /^cmd-.*\.txt$/,
+    /\.DS_Store$/,
+    /^core(\.\d+)?$/,
+    /\.core$/,
+    /^temp_.*$/,
+    /^output_.*$/,
+    /\.tmp$/,
+    /^plans\/temp_.*\.md$/,
+    /^plans\/scratch_.*\.md$/,
+    /^plans\/.*\.tmp$/
+  ];
+  for (const file of untrackedFiles) {
+    if (cleanupPatterns.some(pat => pat.test(file))) {
+      try {
+        fs.unlinkSync(file);
+        log(`  Removed temporary artifact: ${file}`);
+      } catch (e) {
+        // ignore if already deleted or locked
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  // Check if any ignored files are accidentally staged or tracked
+  const stagedFiles = run("git diff --cached --name-only").split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+  const ignoredPatterns = [/^\.env$/, /^node_modules\//, /\.db$/, /\.sqlite$/, /\.log$/];
+  for (const file of stagedFiles) {
+    if (ignoredPatterns.some(pat => pat.test(file))) {
+      log(`  Unstaging ignored/sensitive file: ${file}`);
+      run(`git rm --cached "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+    }
+    // Also verify via git check-ignore if available
+    try {
+      const isIgnored = run(`git check-ignore "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      if (isIgnored) {
+        log(`  Unstaging git-ignored file: ${file}`);
+        run(`git rm --cached "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      // ignore
+    }
+  }
+
+  // 3. Stage All Relevant Changes
+  log("Staging all modifications (`git add -A`)...");
+  run("git add -A");
+
+  // Re-verify staged files after staging
+  const finalStaged = run("git diff --cached --name-only").split("\n").filter(Boolean);
+  if (finalStaged.length === 0) {
+    log("No changes staged after filtering. Exiting.");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+
+  // Double check git-ignored files in final staged
+  for (const file of finalStaged) {
+    try {
+      const isIgnored = run(`git check-ignore "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+      if (isIgnored) {
+        log(`SECURITY ERROR: Attempted to stage git-ignored file: ${file}`);
+        run(`git rm --cached "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true });
+        process.exit(1);
+      }
+    } catch (e) {}
+  }
+
+  // 4. Secret Scanning on Staged Diff (excluding documentation/markdown files)
+  log("Performing secret scanning on staged code diff...");
+  const codeStagedFiles = finalStaged.filter(f => !f.endsWith(".md") && !f.startsWith("plans/"));
+  
+  const secretPatterns = [
+    { name: "OmniRoute API Key", regex: new RegExp("omniroute_" + "[a-zA-Z0-9]{16,}", "i") },
+    { name: "Generic API Token / Sk-key", regex: new RegExp("sk-" + "[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}") },
+    { name: "Bearer Token", regex: new RegExp("bearer\\s+" + "[a-zA-Z0-9_\\-\\.]{20,}", "i") },
+    { name: "Private Key Block", regex: new RegExp("-----BEGIN " + "(RSA|DSA|EC|OPENSSH|PRIVATE) KEY-----") },
+    { name: "Secret / Password Assignment", regex: new RegExp("(api_key|password|secret|auth_token)\\s*[:=]\\s*['\"'][a-zA-Z0-9_\\-\\.]{10,}['\"']") }
+  ];
+
+  for (const file of codeStagedFiles) {
+    const rawFileDiff = run(`git diff --cached -- "${file}"`, { ignoreError: true }) || "";
+    const fileDiff = file === "scripts/auto-git.mjs"
+      ? rawFileDiff.split("\n").filter(line => !line.includes("secretPatterns") && !line.includes("new RegExp") && !line.includes("OmniRoute API Key") && !line.includes("Private Key Block")).join("\n")
+      : rawFileDiff;
+
+    for (const pattern of secretPatterns) {
+      if (pattern.regex.test(fileDiff)) {
+        log(`SECURITY ERROR: Potential secret detected in file: ${file}`);
+        log(`  Specific Pattern Match: ${pattern.name}`);
+        log(`  Aborting git workflow to prevent credential leak.`);
+        process.exit(1);
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  log("Secret scan passed: No secrets detected in staged diff.");
+
+  // 5. Auto-Generate Conventional Commit Message
+  log("Analyzing staged files for conventional commit generation...");
+  let type = "chore";
+  let scope = "";
+  let subject = "";
+
+  const hasTests = finalStaged.some(f => f.startsWith("__tests__/") || f.startsWith("tests/"));
+  const hasDocs = finalStaged.some(f => f.endsWith(".md") || f.startsWith("plans/"));
+  const hasDeps = finalStaged.some(f => f === "package.json" || f === "package-lock.json");
+  const hasBandit = finalStaged.some(f => f.includes("bandit"));
+  const hasIndex = finalStaged.some(f => f.includes("index.mjs"));
+  const hasScripts = finalStaged.some(f => f.startsWith("scripts/"));
+  const hasConfig = finalStaged.some(f => f.startsWith("config/"));
+
+  if (hasTests && !hasBandit && !hasIndex) {
+    type = "test";
+    subject = "update test suite and verification scripts";
+  } else if (hasDocs) {
+    type = "docs";
+    subject = "update project documentation and architectural plans";
+  } else if (hasDeps) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "deps";
+    subject = "update project dependencies";
+  } else if (hasBandit) {
+    type = "refactor";
+    scope = "bandit";
+    subject = "update bandit routing and model selection logic";
+  } else if (hasIndex) {
+    type = "feat";
+    scope = "proxy";
+    subject = "update proxy routing and request handling";
+  } else if (hasScripts) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "scripts";
+    subject = "update automation and utility scripts";
+  } else if (hasConfig) {
+    type = "chore";
+    scope = "config";
+    subject = "update configuration files";
+  } else {
+    type = "chore";
+    subject = "update repository source files and configurations";
+  }
+
+  const scopeStr = scope ? `(${scope})` : "";
+  const commitMsg = `${type}${scopeStr}: ${subject}\n\nStaged files:\n` + finalStaged.map(f => `- ${f}`).join("\n");
+
+  log(`Generated commit message:\n${commitMsg}`);
+
+  const isDryRun = process.argv.includes("--dry-run") || process.env.DRY_RUN === "true" || process.env.DRY_RUN === "1";
+  if (isDryRun) {
+    log("[DRY RUN MODE] Skipping actual commit and push.");
+    const currentBranch = run("git branch --show-current") || "main";
+    const recentCommits = run("git log -n 5 --oneline", { ignoreError: true }) || "";
+    console.log("\n============================================================");
+    console.log("          AUTO-GIT WORKFLOW SUMMARY REPORT (DRY RUN)        ");
+    console.log("============================================================");
+    console.log(`- Commit Message  :\n${commitMsg}`);
+    console.log(`- Branch          : ${currentBranch}`);
+    console.log(`- Staged Files    : ${finalStaged.length} files`);
+    console.log(`- Secret Scan     : Passed (0 secrets found)`);
+    console.log(`- Compliance      : Valid conventional commit (${type}${scopeStr})`);
+    console.log(`- Recent Commits  :\n${recentCommits}`);
+    console.log(`- Push Status     : Skipped (Dry Run Mode)`);
+    console.log("============================================================\n");
+    process.exit(0);
+  }
+
+  // 6. Commit Execution
+  log("Executing git commit...");
+  const commitCmd = `git commit -m ${JSON.stringify(commitMsg)}`;
+  run(commitCmd, { stdio: "inherit" });
+
+  // 7. Push to Remote & Handle Conflicts
+  const currentBranch = run("git branch --show-current") || "main";
+  log(`Pushing branch '${currentBranch}' to remote origin...`);
+
+  let pushSuccess = false;
+  try {
+    run(`git push origin ${currentBranch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+    pushSuccess = true;
+  } catch (err) {
+    log("Push failed, checking for remote divergence / conflicts...");
+    log("Attempting `git pull --rebase origin " + currentBranch + "`...");
+    try {
+      run(`git pull --rebase origin ${currentBranch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+      log("Rebase successful. Retrying push...");
+      run(`git push origin ${currentBranch}`, { stdio: "inherit" });
+      pushSuccess = true;
+    } catch (rebaseErr) {
+      log("CONFLICT/PUSH ERROR: Unable to automatically resolve remote divergence.");
+      log("Please resolve conflicts manually using `git status`.");
+      pushSuccess = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  // 8. Generate Comprehensive Feedback Report & Diagnostics
+  const latestHash = run("git rev-parse --short HEAD");
+  const latestSubject = run("git log -1 --pretty=%s");
+  const commitCountSinceOrigin = run(`git rev-list --count origin/${currentBranch}..HEAD`, { ignoreError: true }) || "1";
+  const recentCommits = run("git log -n 5 --oneline", { ignoreError: true }) || "";
+  
+  // Potential duplicate or recent similar commit analysis
+  const recentSubjects = run("git log -n 5 --pretty=%s", { ignoreError: true }).split("\n") || [];
+  const similarCount = recentSubjects.filter(s => s.toLowerCase().includes(subject.toLowerCase().slice(0, 15))).length;
+  const duplicateWarning = similarCount > 1 ? "⚠️ Note: Multiple recent commits share similar subject keywords." : "None detected.";
+
+  // Squash suggestions
+  const unpushedCount = parseInt(commitCountSinceOrigin, 10) || 1;
+  const squashSuggestion = unpushedCount > 3 ? `💡 Suggestion: You have ${unpushedCount} unpushed/recent commits. Consider squashing minor fixups before merging.` : "None (optimal commit count).";
+
+  console.log("\n============================================================");
+  console.log("             AUTO-GIT WORKFLOW SUMMARY REPORT               ");
+  console.log("============================================================");
+  console.log(`- Commit Hash     : ${latestHash}`);
+  console.log(`- Commit Message  : ${latestSubject}`);
+  console.log(`- Branch          : ${currentBranch}`);
+  console.log(`- Staged Files    : ${finalStaged.length} files`);
+  console.log(`- Secret Scan     : Passed (0 secrets found)`);
+  console.log(`- Compliance      : Valid conventional commit (${type}${scopeStr})`);
+  console.log(`- Commit Count    : ${unpushedCount} new commit(s)`);
+  console.log(`- Duplicate Check : ${duplicateWarning}`);
+  console.log(`- Squash Suggest  : ${squashSuggestion}`);
+  console.log(`- Push Status     : ${pushSuccess ? "Success (Pushed to origin)" : "Failed / Manual intervention required"}`);
+  console.log(`- Recent Log      :\n${recentCommits}`);
+  console.log("============================================================\n");
+}
+
+main();

+## System Architecture Overview
+
+The OmniRoute Bandit Proxy is a Multi-Armed Bandit reverse proxy router for dynamic LLM traffic distribution. It intelligently routes requests to different LLM providers based on performance metrics and feedback using Discounted UCB1.
+
+## Core Components - Non-Obvious Details
+
+### 1. Bandit Algorithm (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **DiscountedUCB1Bandit** class: `discountFactor=0.99` applied per feedback event (not per timestep)
+- **Rank Cache**: `_rankCache` with 30s TTL stores precomputed rankings to avoid recalculation on every request
+- **Catalog vs Database Merge**: `selectModel()` prefers database models over catalog when same provider+id conflict; DB models carry learned `N`, `sum_reward`, `fails`, `cooldown_until`, `permanent`, `degraded`, `consecutive_5xx`
+- **Soft Bias via Modes**: `profileMultiplier(profile, modelName)` from `modes-registry.mjs` applies runtime multipliers based on regex detection: `isCode`, `isThinking`, `isFast`, `isBig`, `isSmall`, `isFIM`, `isLowTPM` - multiplies UCB1 score, not reward
+- **Training Isolation**: Separate `models_train` table; daemon writes there; `selectModel()` uses `models_train × 0.3` as prior when production `N < 1`
+- **Fallback Chain**: 6-model chain in `config/bandit.json` used when no models available after filtering; returns first passing token limit check
+
+### 2. Main Server (`src/index.mjs`)
+- **Express.js** on 127.0.0.1:8080 with ES modules
+- **Retry Loop**: `maxAttempts = Math.min(providerCount * 4 + 100, 500)`; per-request `excludedModels` Set tracks failed (model, provider) pairs; falls through to fallbackModels
+- **Session Affinity**: Key = MD5(systemPrompt + firstUserMessage); `sessionModelMap` with 30-min TTL (not 24h); invalidated on model failure; max 10k entries with LRU eviction
+- **Three-Level Streaming Timeouts**: `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS`=20s (connection+first byte), `STREAM_IDLE_MS`=60s (content-based idle, resets on ANY chunk), `STREAM_MAX_MS`=180s (60s for summarizer profile)
+- **Context Compression**: Auto-triggers at >80% of `max_input_tokens`; strategies: sliding window, message truncation (largest first), drop tools; preserves system prompt + last user message
+- **Ring Buffer**: 200 log entries with deduplication (consecutive identical lines collapsed with count suffix)
+
+### 3. Health Checker (`src/health-check.mjs`)
+- **Interval**: Default 5 min (configurable via `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`)
+- **Candidates**: `permanent=1` OR `cooldown_until > 1 hour` OR `degraded=1`
+- **Batch Size**: 20 models, 15s timeout per probe
+- **Probe Request**: Minimal `"ok"` message with `max_tokens: 1`
+- **Revival**: Via `bandit.reviveModel()`
+
+### 4. Mode Detection (`src/modes-registry.mjs`)
+- **3-Tier Detection**: 1) MD5 signature cache (`modes.signatures.json`) → 2) Regex patterns from `config/modes.json` (14 Zoo Code modes) → 3) Unknown → auto-discovered, persisted to `modes.discovered.json`
+- **Profiles**: Returns `summarizer`, `code`, `reasoning`, `general`
+- **Soft Bias**: Regex patterns for `isCode`, `isThinking`, `isFast`, `isBig`, `isSmall`, `isFIM`, `isLowTPM` stack multiplicatively
+
+### 5. Provider Quota (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
+- **Rolling Windows**: Minute + day per provider
+- **Limits**: From `config/provider-limits.json` (RPM/RPD per provider)
+- **Exhaustion**: `recordQuotaExhausted()` → provider ban with `quota_exhausted` reason
+
+### 6. Notifier (`src/notifier.mjs`)
+- **Webhooks**: Slack, Discord, Telegram, generic
+- **Throttling**: Same `event+subject` max 1 per 5 min (configurable)
+- **Emoji Mapping**: Per event type
+
+## Data Flow - Critical Non-Obvious Patterns
+
+1. **Request** → `POST /v1/chat/completions`
+2. **Model Selection** → `bandit.selectModel()` with session affinity + soft bias multipliers
+3. **Token Check** → `estimateTokens()` (4 chars/token heuristic) vs `max_input_tokens`
+4. **Upstream Request** → Forward to provider with 3-level timeout handling
+5. **Validation** → `validateNonStreamResponse()` / `validateStreamAccumulated()` 
+6. **Feedback** → `bandit.recordFeedback()` with reward (1=success, 0=fail)
+7. **Error Classification** → `_classifyError()` determines: ban-provider, ban-model, cooldown-provider, cooldown-model, flag-provider
+8. **Provider Management** → Updates `provider_history` and `models` tables
+
+## Database Schema - 6 Tables (Auto-Migrated in `_migrateDB`)
+
+| Table | Key Columns |
+|-------|-------------|
+| `models` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, fails, cooldown_until, permanent, last_used_index, consecutive_5xx, degraded, degraded_since, is_paid |
+| `models_train` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, last_used_index |
+| `provider_history` | provider, fails, cooldown_until, pointer, permanent, needs_attention, attention_reason, attention_message |
+| `catalog` | id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools |
+| `meta` | key, value (counters: total_requests, total_errors, etc.) |
+| `request_logs` | timestamp, model, provider, status, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, error_type |
+
+## Configuration - Critical Environment Variables
+
+Critical: `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, `OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL`, `DASHBOARD_TOKEN` (for `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/scripts/*`), `EXCLUDE_PAID`, `ONLY_FREE`, `EXCLUDE_THINKING`, `EXPLOIT_ONLY`, `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `SESSION_TTL_MS` (default 1800000 = **30min**), `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20000), `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60000), `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180000).
+
+## API Endpoints
+
+- `POST /v1/chat/completions` - Main proxy
+- `GET /v1/metrics` - Auth required (x-api-token header or ?token=)
+- `POST /v1/reset/provider/:provider` - Clear provider bans/cooldowns
+- `POST /v1/provider/retry/:provider` - Clear `needs_attention` flag
+- `GET /v1/models` - All models with status
+- `GET /v1/providers` - Provider status
+- `GET /v1/sessions` - Active sessions
+- `GET /v1/health-check/status` - Health checker status
+- `GET /v1/logs` - Ring buffer (200 entries)
+- `GET /v1/inflight` - In-flight requests
+- `GET /v1/active` - Active request count
+- `GET /v1/scripts/*` - Script manager (list/run/status/kill/logs)
+- `GET /v1/quota` - Provider quota snapshot
+
+## Common Pitfalls (Non-Obvious)
+
+1. **Provider attention flags persist**: Must call `POST /v1/provider/retry/:p` or `clearProviderAttention()` to clear `needs_attention` - health checks don't auto-clear
+2. **Migrations are additive only**: `_migrateDB()` only ADD COLUMN, never DROP/ALTER TYPE
+3. **Session TTL is 30 min, not 24h**: `SESSION_TTL_MS` default 1800000
+4. **Token estimation is approximate**: `estimateTokens()` uses 4 chars/token heuristic
+5. **Fallback models bypass bandit**: Fallback chain used without UCB1 scoring
+6. **Training mode isolates writes**: Daemon writes to `models_train`; production blends `models_train × 0.3` as prior only when `N < 1`
+7. **Quota limits are per-provider, not per-model**
+8. **Soft bias multipliers stack**: Multiple pattern matches = product of multipliers
+9. **Stream idle timeout resets on ANY chunk**: SSE comments/heartbeats reset 60s timer
+10. **Ring buffer deduplication**: Consecutive identical lines collapsed with count suffix
+
+## Performance Considerations
+
+- 30-second rank cache (`_rankCache`)
+- Health checks every 5 min (batch 20)
+- Session cleanup every 5 min
+- Single SQLite connection (better-sqlite3)
+- Proper indexing on frequently queried columns
+
+## Scalability Constraints
+
+- **Single instance design**: SQLite file-based, in-memory session state
+- **Horizontal scaling**: Would require shared database + Redis for sessions
+- **Connection pooling**: Not applicable (single SQLite connection)

+When asking questions about this codebase, focus on **non-obvious, project-specific behaviors** that aren't documented elsewhere. The root AGENTS.md and mode-specific files contain the distilled knowledge.
+
+### Key Non-Obvious Behaviors to Ask About
+
+#### Bandit Algorithm (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **Discount application**: `discountFactor=0.99` is applied *per feedback event*, not per timestep. This means reward history decays faster under load.
+- **Rank cache TTL**: `_rankCache` is 30 seconds - model rankings are stale up to 30s after feedback.
+- **Soft bias**: `profileMultiplier()` multiplies the *UCB1 score*, not the reward. Multipliers stack (e.g., a model matching both `isCode` and `isFast` gets product of both).
+- **Training isolation**: `models_train` table is completely separate. Daemon writes there. Production `selectModel()` reads `models` + blends `models_train × 0.3` as prior *only when production N < 1*.
+- **Fallback bypasses bandit**: When all ranked models fail, the 6-model fallback chain from `config/bandit.json` is used without any UCB1 scoring.
+
+#### Error Classification (`_classifyError` in `src/bandit.mjs:100-300`)
+Five distinct actions with different scopes:
+| Action | Scope | Typical Triggers |
+|--------|-------|------------------|
+| `ban-provider` | provider | 401/403 auth, 404 deleted, 418 teapot, 429 org-quota, 5xx repeated |
+| `ban-model` | model | 400 context-length, 404 model-not-found, 410 gone |
+| `cooldown-provider` | provider | 429 rate-limit (respects `retry-after`), 5xx transient |
+| `cooldown-model` | model | 429 model-specific, 503 overloaded |
+| `flag-provider` | provider | 400 validation (non-context), 408 timeout, 422 unprocessable, 502/504 gateway |
+
+**Key details**: Parses `retry-after` header (seconds or HTTP-date). `quota_exhausted` reason → permanent ban. `consecutive_5xx` counter on models table → degraded mode after 3.
+
+#### Provider Quota (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
+- Rolling minute + day windows per provider (not per model)
+- Limits in `config/provider-limits.json` (RPM/RPD)
+- `canCall(provider)` checks both windows atomically
+- `recordQuotaExhausted()` → triggers provider ban with `quota_exhausted` reason
+
+#### Session Affinity (`src/index.mjs`)
+- Key = MD5(systemPrompt + firstUserMessage)
+- TTL = **30 minutes** (`SESSION_TTL_MS` default 1800000), not 24h
+- Max 10k entries with LRU eviction
+- Invalidated on model failure (non-2xx or validation fail)
+
+#### Streaming Timeouts (Three Levels)
+1. `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20s): Connection + first byte
+2. `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60s): Content-based idle - **resets on ANY chunk** (including SSE comments/heartbeats)
+3. `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180s): Hard cap (60s for summarizer profile)
+
+#### Retry Loop
+- `maxAttempts = Math.min(providerCount * 4 + 100, 500)`
+- Per-request `excludedModels` Set tracks failed (model, provider) pairs
+- Falls through to fallback chain after exhaustion
+- Skips models where `estimateTokens() > max_input_tokens`
+
+#### Context Compression
+- Triggers at >80% of model's `max_input_tokens`
+- Strategies: sliding window (keep system + last N), message truncation (largest first), drop tools
+- Always preserves system prompt + last user message
+
+#### Health Checker
+- Runs every 5 min (configurable)
+- Candidates: `permanent=1` OR `cooldown_until > 1 hour` OR `degraded=1`
+- Batch size 20, 15s timeout per probe
+- Probe: minimal `"ok"` with `max_tokens: 1`
+- Revives via `bandit.reviveModel()`
+
+#### Mode Detection (`src/modes-registry.mjs`)
+- 3-tier: 1) MD5 signature cache (`modes.signatures.json`) → 2) Regex from `config/modes.json` (14 Zoo Code modes) → 3) Unknown → auto-discovered, persisted to `modes.discovered.json`
+- Returns: `summarizer`, `code`, `reasoning`, `general`
+
+### Common Non-Obvious Pitfalls
+
+1. **Provider attention flags persist**: Must call `POST /v1/provider/retry/:p` or `clearProviderAttention()` to clear `needs_attention` - health checks don't auto-clear
+2. **Migrations are additive only**: `_migrateDB()` only ADD COLUMN, never DROP/ALTER TYPE
+3. **Session TTL is 30 min, not 24h**: `SESSION_TTL_MS` default 1800000
+4. **Token estimation is approximate**: `estimateTokens()` uses 4 chars/token heuristic
+5. **Fallback models bypass bandit**: Fallback chain used without UCB1 scoring
+6. **Training mode isolates writes**: Daemon writes to `models_train`; production blends `models_train × 0.3` as prior only when `N < 1`
+7. **Quota limits are per-provider, not per-model**
+8. **Soft bias multipliers stack**: Multiple pattern matches = product of multipliers
+9. **Stream idle timeout resets on ANY chunk**: SSE comments/heartbeats reset 60s timer
+10. **Ring buffer deduplication**: Consecutive identical lines collapsed with count suffix
+
+### Testing Patterns
+- Tests use `node:test` framework
+- Database is in-memory (`:memory:`) for tests
+- Helper functions: `makeBandit()`, `seedCatalog()`
+- Coverage: error classification, model selection, provider management
+
+### Configuration
+- All env vars in `.env.example`
+- Critical: `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, `OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL`, `DASHBOARD_TOKEN`, `EXCLUDE_PAID`, `ONLY_FREE`, `EXCLUDE_THINKING`, `EXPLOIT_ONLY`
+- Database path via `DATABASE_PATH`
+

+- Check `training.log` for training events
+- Console logs are structured (already present in production)
+- Database contains all interaction logs (`request_logs` table)
+- Health check endpoint: `/v1/health-check/status`
+- Ring buffer: `/v1/logs` (200 entries)

+## Debugging Workflow & Specialized Diagnostics
+
+### 1. Server Health & Status Diagnostics
+- **Health Check Status**: Inspect [`GET /v1/health-check/status`](src/health-check.mjs:1) via curl or dashboard to monitor automated model probes (runs every 5 min, batch size 20, 15s timeout).
+- **In-flight & Active Requests**: Check [`GET /v1/inflight`](src/index.mjs:1) and [`GET /v1/active`](src/index.mjs:1) to diagnose hung connections or concurrency bottlenecks.
+- **Ring Buffer Logs**: Query [`GET /v1/logs`](src/index.mjs:1) for the last 200 log entries (automatically deduplicated with count suffix).
+
+### 2. Database Diagnostics (`better-sqlite3`)
+- **Querying State**: Use [`scripts/check-db.mjs`](scripts/check-db.mjs:1) or [`scripts/inspect-db.mjs`](scripts/inspect-db.mjs:1) to inspect table states (`models`, `models_train`, `provider_history`, `catalog`, `meta`, `request_logs`).
+- **Connection Issues**: SQLite uses single-connection synchronous execution (`better-sqlite3`). Ensure no file lock issues during concurrent training daemon writes (`models_train`) and proxy reads (`models`).
+
+### 3. Error Classification Troubleshooting (`_classifyError` in [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:100))
+Diagnose error routing behavior by inspecting classification outputs:
+- `ban-provider`: Triggered by 401/403 auth, 404 deleted, 418 teapot, 429 org-quota, 5xx repeated.
+- `ban-model`: Triggered by 400 context-length, 404 model-not-found, 410 gone.
+- `cooldown-provider`: Triggered by 429 rate-limit (respects `retry-after` header in seconds or HTTP-date), 5xx transient.
+- `cooldown-model`: Triggered by 429 model-specific, 503 overloaded.
+- `flag-provider`: Triggered by 400 validation, 408 timeout, 422 unprocessable, 502/504 gateway.
+
+### 4. Common Debug Scenarios & Resolution
+- **Provider Quota Lockout**: Check [`src/provider-quota.mjs`](src/provider-quota.mjs:1) rolling minute/day limits from [`config/provider-limits.json`](config/provider-limits.json:1). Quota exhaustion triggers permanent ban with reason `quota_exhausted`. Reset via [`POST /v1/reset/provider/:provider`](src/index.mjs:1).
+- **Persistent Attention Flags**: Health checks do *not* auto-clear `needs_attention` on [`provider_history`](src/bandit.mjs:1). Must explicitly invoke [`POST /v1/provider/retry/:provider`](src/index.mjs:1) or `clearProviderAttention()`.
+- **Session Affinity Failures**: MD5 signature mismatch [`src/index.mjs`](src/index.mjs:1) (systemPrompt + firstUserMessage). Stored in `sessionModelMap` with 30-min TTL. Invalidated automatically on non-2xx response or validation failure.
+- **Token Limit Exceeded**: Verify [`src/bandit.mjs`](src/bandit.mjs:1) `estimateTokens()` (4 chars/token heuristic). Context compression auto-triggers when estimated tokens > 80% of `max_input_tokens`.

+## Critical Non-Obvious Patterns
+
+### Bandit Algorithm (`src/bandit.mjs`)
+- **Discounted UCB1**: Uses `discountFactor=0.99` applied per feedback event, not per timestep. The `_rankCache` (30s TTL) stores precomputed rankings to avoid recalculation on every request.
+- **Catalog vs Database merge**: `selectModel()` prefers database models over catalog when conflicts exist (same provider+id). Database models carry learned `N`, `sum_reward`, `fails`, `cooldown_until`, `permanent`, `degraded`, `consecutive_5xx`.
+- **Soft bias via modes**: `profileMultiplier(profile, modelName)` from `modes-registry.mjs` applies runtime multipliers based on regex detection: `isCode`, `isThinking`, `isFast`, `isBig`, `isSmall`, `isFIM`, `isLowTPM`. These multiply the UCB1 score, not the reward.
+- **Training isolation**: Separate `models_train` table. Daemon writes there. `selectModel()` uses `models_train` × 0.3 as prior when production `N < 1`. See `train-daemon.mjs`.
+- **Fallback chain**: 6-model chain in `config/bandit.json` used when no models available after filtering. Returns first that passes token limit check.
+
+### Error Classification (`_classifyError` in `src/bandit.mjs:100-300`)
+Five actions with scope (provider/model) and reason:
+| Action | Typical Triggers |
+|--------|------------------|
+| `ban-provider` | 401/403 auth, 404 deleted, 418 teapot, 429 org-quota, 5xx repeated |
+| `ban-model` | 400 context-length, 404 model-not-found, 410 gone |
+| `cooldown-provider` | 429 rate-limit (respects `retry-after`), 5xx transient |
+| `cooldown-model` | 429 model-specific, 503 overloaded |
+| `flag-provider` | 400 validation (non-context), 408 timeout, 422 unprocessable, 502/504 gateway |
+
+Key: parses `retry-after` header (seconds or HTTP-date). `quota_exhausted` reason triggers permanent ban. `consecutive_5xx` counter on models table triggers degraded mode after 3.
+
+### Provider Quota Tracking (`src/provider-quota.mjs`)
+Rolling minute/day windows per provider. Limits in `config/provider-limits.json` (RPM/RPD). `canCall(provider)` checks both windows. Quota exhaustion recorded via `recordQuotaExhausted()` → triggers provider ban with reason `quota_exhausted`.
+
+### Session Affinity (`src/index.mjs`)
+Key = MD5(systemPrompt + firstUserMessage). Stored in `sessionModelMap` with 30-min TTL (not 24h - that's for cleanup). Invalidated on model failure (non-2xx or validation fail). Max 10k entries with LRU eviction.
+
+### Three-Level Streaming Timeouts
+1. `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20s): Connection + first byte
+2. `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60s): Content-based idle timeout (resets on each chunk)
+3. `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180s): Hard cap per request (60s for summarizer profile)
+
+### Retry Loop (`src/index.mjs:800-1100`)
+`maxAttempts = Math.min(providerCount * 4 + 100, 500)`. Per-request `excludedModels` Set tracks failed (model, provider) pairs. Falls through to `fallbackModels` chain after exhaustion. Skips models exceeding `max_input_tokens` (estimated via `estimateTokens()`).
+
+### Context Compression (`compressBody`, `truncateBiggestMessage`)
+Auto-triggers when estimated tokens > 80% of model's `max_input_tokens`. Strategies: sliding window (keep system + last N), message truncation (largest first), drop tools. Preserves system prompt and last user message.
+
+### Health Checker (`src/health-check.mjs`)
+Runs every 5 min (configurable). Candidates: `permanent=1` OR `cooldown_until > 1 hour` OR `degraded=1`. Batch size 20, 15s timeout per probe. Probe request: `"ok"` with `max_tokens: 1`. Revives via `bandit.reviveModel()`.
+
+### Mode Detection (`src/modes-registry.mjs`)
+3-tier: 1) MD5 signature cache (`modes.signatures.json`) → 2) Regex patterns from `config/modes.json` (14 Zoo Code modes) → 3) Unknown → auto-discovered, persisted to `modes.discovered.json`. `detectProfile()` returns one of: `summarizer`, `code`, `reasoning`, `general`.
+
+### Notifier (`src/notifier.mjs`)
+Webhooks: Slack, Discord, Telegram, generic. Throttling: same `event+subject` max 1 per 5 min (configurable). Emoji mapping per event type.
+
+### Database Schema (6 tables, auto-migrated in `_migrateDB`)
+| Table | Key Columns |
+|-------|-------------|
+| `models` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, fails, cooldown_until, permanent, last_used_index, consecutive_5xx, degraded, degraded_since, is_paid |
+| `models_train` | id, provider, N, sum_reward, last_used_index |
+| `provider_history` | provider, fails, cooldown_until, pointer, permanent, needs_attention, attention_reason, attention_message |
+| `catalog` | id, provider, max_input_tokens, is_free, supports_tools |
+| `meta` | key, value (counters: total_requests, total_errors, etc.) |
+| `request_logs` | timestamp, model, provider, status, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, error_type |
+
+### Environment Variables (see `.env.example`)
+Critical: `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY`, `OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL`, `DASHBOARD_TOKEN` (for `/v1/metrics`, `/v1/scripts/*`), `EXCLUDE_PAID`, `ONLY_FREE`, `EXCLUDE_THINKING`, `EXPLOIT_ONLY`, `HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS`, `SESSION_TTL_MS` (default 1800000 = 30min), `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS` (20000), `STREAM_IDLE_MS` (60000), `STREAM_MAX_MS` (180000).
+
+### API Endpoints
+- `POST /v1/chat/completions` - Main proxy
+- `GET /v1/metrics` - Auth required (x-api-token header or ?token=)
+- `POST /v1/reset/provider/:provider` - Clear provider bans/cooldowns
+- `POST /v1/provider/retry/:provider` - Clear `needs_attention` flag
+- `GET /v1/models` - All models with status
+- `GET /v1/providers` - Provider status
+- `GET /v1/sessions` - Active sessions
+- `GET /v1/health-check/status` - Health checker status
+- `GET /v1/logs` - Ring buffer (200 entries)
+- `GET /v1/inflight` - In-flight requests
+- `GET /v1/active` - Active request count
+- `GET /v1/scripts/*` - Script manager (list/run/status/kill/logs)
+- `GET /v1/quota` - Provider quota snapshot
+
+### Monitoring
+- Dashboard: `http://127.0.0.1:8080` (single-file `public/dashboard.html` with 6 tabs)
+- Health checks every 5 min, metrics via `/v1/metrics`
+- Logs: console (structured), `training.log` (daemon), SQLite `request_logs`
+- Ring buffer: 200 log entries with deduplication
+
+### Systemd Service
+Production deployment via `omniroute-bandit-proxy.service` (reads `.env`). See `scripts/switch-mode.sh` for mode transitions (prod/train-gentle/train/stop).
+
+### Common Pitfalls (Non-Obvious)
+1. **Provider attention flags persist**: Must call `POST /v1/provider/retry/:p` or `clearProviderAttention()` to clear `needs_attention` - health checks don't auto-clear.
+2. **Migrations are additive only**: `_migrateDB()` only ADD COLUMN, never DROP/ALTER TYPE. New columns added per release.
+3. **Session TTL is 30 min, not 24h**: `SESSION_TTL_MS` default 1800000. The 24h in old docs is stale.
+4. **Token estimation is approximate**: `estimateTokens()` uses 4 chars/token heuristic. For precise limits, rely on upstream 413 errors.
+5. **Fallback models bypass bandit**: When all ranked models fail, fallback chain from config is used without UCB1 scoring.
+6. **Training mode isolates writes**: Daemon writes to `models_train`. Production reads from `models` + blends `models_train × 0.3` as prior only when `N < 1`.
+7. **Quota limits are per-provider, not per-model**: `config/provider-limits.json` defines RPM/RPD at provider level.
+8. **Soft bias multipliers stack**: A model matching multiple patterns (e.g., `isCode` + `isFast`) gets product of multipliers.
+9. **Stream idle timeout resets on ANY chunk**: Not just content chunks - SSE comments/heartbeats also reset the 60s timer.
+10. **Ring buffer deduplication**: Consecutive identical log lines are collapsed with count suffix.
